name: The Blood Moon Rises
description:
Long ago, before the vampyres were united as one, they lived in disparate clans in their ancestral home of Vampyrium. For the Drakan clan, strength ruled above all else. Clan leaders were selected during a brutal festival of combat known as the Night of the Blood Moon. Along with leadership of the clan, the victor of this festival was granted a title: they became known as the Blood Moon.

Now, thousands of years later, Lord Lowerniel Drakan, the last Blood Moon has returned. He has but one goal: to return his people to the old ways and reclaim his former title, even if he has to sacrifice every life in Morytania to do it.

For Drakan, this is the endgame. Failure is not an option and he does not intend to let anyone stand in his way. No matter what, the Blood Moon will rise once more.
recommendedItems: Combat 110
rewards: Access to the Maggot King boss

walkthrough.heading: Character customization
walkthrough.body: Upon logging in to the game for the first time after account creation, players will find themselves in a house in the centre of Tutorial Island. The Character Creator interface will be open, which allows setting their character's appearance, such as body type, skin colour, and clothing styles. All of these customisation options can later be altered through Makeover for free after leaving Tutorial Island.

walkthrough.heading: Adventure Paths
walkthrough.body: After customizing your appearance, you will be asked how familiar you are with Old School Runescape. To use the Adventure Paths system, you must indicate that you are either brand new, or have played in the past but not recently. Adventure Paths offer basic rewards such as Mithril equipment as you complete beginner tasks on your account, for example reaching a certain level in a skill. More information on the system will be given after leaving Tutorial Island. {{Clear}}

walkthrough.heading: Gielinor Guide
walkthrough.body: Throughout the tutorial, the game will indicate the next action to take with a flashing arrow visible both in the game world and on the minimap, starting with the Gielinor Guide. To move around, simply left click on the ground or on the minimap. To interact with objects and non-player characters in the game world, you may either left click on them to use their primary action, or right click to open the options menu which may contain several actions. Left click on the Gielinor Guide to talk to him and he will ask you to open the Settings interface, the spanner icon in the bottom right bar. You must open it to continue, but browsing it is optional. Talk to the Gielinor Guide again, who wants you to visit the first instructor. {{Clear|left}}

walkthrough.heading: Survival Expert
walkthrough.body: :'Note': The compass just above the minimap indicates the cardinal direction based on your camera angle. The wiki will often use these directions to guide you. Exit through the door to the east by interacting with it. Talk to the Survival Expert to the south, who will give you a small fishing net and ask you to catch some shrimp in the nearby pond; but first, he wants you to view the net in your inventory. Open the Inventory interface by selecting the backpack icon from the bottom right bar. To fish, you can either use the fishing net on the fishing spot by left clicking the net and then the fishing spot, or simply left click the fishing spot to use it automatically. Once you catch a shrimp, you will gain some Fishing experience, and the tutorial will prompt you to open the Skills interface. Once you've opened it, talk to the Survival Expert again, who will give you a bronze axe and tinderbox and ask you to make a fire to cook the shrimp on. Chop down any nearby tree to obtain some logs, then use the tinderbox on the logs to light them and create a fire. Finally, use the shrimps on the fire to cook them. {{Clear|left}}

walkthrough.heading: Master Chef
walkthrough.body: Exit through the gate to the west and head to the nearby house, opening the door to enter. Talk to the Master Chef, who will give you a pot of flour and a bucket of water and ask you to cook some bread. To make the bread, use the pot of flour on the bucket of water to make some bread dough, then either use the bread dough on the nearby range or simply left click on the range. {{Clear|left}}

walkthrough.heading: Quest Guide
walkthrough.body: Exit through the north-western door and follow the path to enter the next house. Talk to the Quest Guide, who wants you to open the Quest List interface. After opening it, talk to the Quest Guide again, who will explain more about questing in Gielinor. {{Clear|left}}

walkthrough.heading: Mining Instructor
walkthrough.body: Climb down the ladder in the south-east corner of the room, and talk to the Mining Instructor to the north. He will give you a bronze pickaxe and ask you to mine some tin and copper. Mine the tin rocks to the west until you receive tin ore, then mine the copper rocks to the east until you receive copper ore. Use one of the ores on the furnace to the south, or simply left click on the furnance to smelt the ore into a bronze bar. Speak to the mining instructor again, who will give you a hammer and ask you to make a bronze dagger using the nearby anvil. Use the bronze bar on it or simply left click on the anvil, then select the dagger to create one. {{Clear|left}}

walkthrough.heading: Combat Instructor
walkthrough.body: Exit through the gate to the east and talk to the Combat Instructor, who wants you to wield your dagger. Select the icon of a man in the bottom right bar to view your worn items, then click the bottom left icon to view your equipment stats. Click your bronze dagger in the inventory to equip it in the weapon slot. Talk to the Combat Instructor again, who will give you a bronze sword and wooden shield. Left click on the bronze sword in your inventory to equip it, unequipping the dagger in the process, and left click on your bronze shield to equip it in the shield slot. Open the Combat Options interface by clicking the crossed swords icon on the bottom right interface, which will display the different attack styles you can use with your weapon. Enter the rat pit through the gate, and left click a rat to kill it. Return to the Combat Instructor, who will give you a shortbow and 50 bronze arrows. Equip both, and kill another rat from outside the pen. {{Clear|left}}

walkthrough.heading: Account Guide
walkthrough.body: Climb up the ladder to the east, and enter the nearby building to use the bank booth, which will display your bank containing 25 coins. Use the poll booth on the western wall to learn about the poll system for adding future content to the game. Enter the eastern door and talk to the Account Guide, who will ask you to open the Account Management interface. Click the icon of a man's face with a cog to view it, then talk to the Account Guide again, who will teach you about Membership, Worlds, Bonds, and other aspects of having an account. {{Clear|left}}

walkthrough.heading: Brother Brace
walkthrough.body: Exit through the door to the east, and follow the path to the next house to talk to Brother Brace, who wants you to open the Prayer interface. Select the star icon in the bottom right bar to view it, then talk to Brother Brace again, who will teach you about activating Prayers and burying bones for Prayer experience. {{Clear|left}}

walkthrough.heading: Magic Instructor
walkthrough.body: Exit through the door to the south and enter the building to the south-east. Talk to the Magic Instructor, who wants you to open the Magic interface. Select the spellbook icon in the bottom right bar to view your spells. Talk to the instructor again, who will give you some air runes and mind runes to cast Wind Strike on the chickens in the northern pen. Select Wind Strike in the Magic interface and then click on the chicken to cast the spell. 'Congratulations, quest complete!' After completing the quest, talk to the Magic Instructor and he will tell you to cast the Lumbridge Home Teleport spell to teleport to Lumbridge. He will ask whether you want to talk to the Ironman tutor first before leaving, who would teach you about the Ironman mode. If you wish to participate in this mode's account restrictions, you 'must' talk to the tutor before leaving. {{Clear|left}}

start: Speak to the Cook in the kitchen of Lumbridge Castle.
description:
The Lumbridge Castle cook is in a mess. It is the Duke of Lumbridge's birthday and the cook is making the cake.

He needs a lot of ingredients and doesn't have much time.
itemRequirements: Egg (can be obtained during the quest)
A bucket (if obtaining the milk during the quest)
A pot (if obtaining the flour during the quest)
rewards: Permission to use the Cook-o-matic 100, which reduces the chance of burning some foods.
requiredFor: Easy Lumbridge & Draynor Diary: Bake some bread on the Lumbridge castle kitchen range.
leagueRegion: <poem> Unlocking Asgarnia will auto-complete the quest Unlocking Kandarin will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: A feast for a Duke
walkthrough.body: Begin the quest by speaking with the Lumbridge cook found in the kitchen on the ground floor of Lumbridge Castle. He mentions it is Duke Horacio's birthday and that he is supposed to bake the Duke a cake. Unfortunately, however, he has forgotten to buy the ingredients and asks the player to bring him a bucket of milk, an egg, and a pot of flour. ====Bucket and pot==== A bucket spawns in the cellar of Lumbridge Castle, and a pot spawns in the kitchen on the centre table. You can also purchase both a bucket and a pot from the Lumbridge General Store for 2 coins and 1 coins coins, respectively. ====Egg====, found in the coop north of Lumbridge.]] Go east out of Lumbridge Castle and run north along the path until you reach the chicken coop north-west of Farmer Fred's house. Go into the coop and pick up an egg. ====Bucket of milk====.]] With an empty bucket, go north into the cow pasture. Use the empty bucket on a dairy cow (distinguishable by its cowbell) to get a bucket of milk. You can optionally talk to Gillie Groats for an explanation on how to milk a cow. She can be found across the river next to the dairy cow in the eastern Lumbridge cow field. ====Pot of flour==== With an empty pot, leave the cow pasture and go south-west to the wheat field. Pick some grain, and then enter the Mill Lane Mill, found up the road to the north-east. Climb to the top floor, put the grain in the hopper, then pull the lever and climb back down to the ground floor. Finally, use an empty pot on the flour bin (which is now full of flour) to get a pot of flour. You can optionally talk to Millie Miller inside the mill for an explanation on how to make flour.

walkthrough.heading: Delivery
walkthrough.body: After collecting the ingredients, speak to the cook to deliver them. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Demon Slayer
start: Speak to Aris in the tent on the western side of Varrock Square.
description: A mighty demon is being summoned to destroy the city of Varrock. You find out you are the one destined to stop him (or at least try).
itemRequirements: A water container, such as a bucket of water (obtainable during the quest)
25 bones (can't be noted, but can be delivered in increments)
recommendedItems: Combat 15
Armour and some food
Fast travel to several locations
Varrock to start the quest - Varrock teleport or Chronicle or Skills necklace to Cooks' Guild (Members only) or Ring of wealth to Grand Exchange (Members only)
Wizard's Tower (1 trip) - Necklace of passage or Amulet of the eye or Amulet of glory to Draynor Village (All Members only)
Champions' Guild (1 trip) - Chronicle or Combat bracelet (Members only) or Varrock Teleport
rewards: Silverlight (if lost, players may retrieve it from Sir Prysin for a fee of 500 coins.)
5 Kudos, which members can claim by talking to Historian Minas in the Varrock Museum
requiredFor: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide
leagueRegion: <poem> Unlocking Desert will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Scrying the future
walkthrough.body: 3 empty inventory spaces, 1 gold coin. slaying Delrith.]] Speak to Aris in the tent on the western side of Varrock Square. Pay her one coin and she will scry the future, seeing a vision of the player wielding an impressive sword fighting a demon named Delrith, who terrorized Varrock over a century prior. Delrith was previously defeated by a hero named Wally; just your luck, the demon is being summoned again. Ask Aris where you can find the demon, and she will mention that to defeat him you must first find Wally's sword Silverlight. Ask Aris, "So, how did Wally kill Delrith?" She will show you the incantation Wally used: write down or screenshot the phrase, as it will be important later on. 'The word order of this spell is randomised for every player.' After telling you the incantation, she tells you to talk to Sir Prysin to help. Go north to Varrock Palace. Sir Prysin will be wandering the south-west portion of the ground floor of the castle. Talk to him and tell him that Aris sent you. Ask for Silverlight, the weapon needed to kill Delrith. He will tell you that to prevent the weapon from falling into the wrong hands, it was put into a special box that requires three different keys to open it. He has dropped his key in the drain just outside the palace kitchen, and the other two are in the possession of Captain Rovin and the Wizard Traiborn.

walkthrough.heading: Captain Rovin's key
walkthrough.body: Captain Rovin is located in the north-west corner of the palace on the floor 2, up two flights of stairs. Talk to him and tell him that you need the key in order to recover Silverlight to slay a demon that threatens the city. Mention that Sir Prysin said Captain Rovin would give the key to you, to which he will rant about the King being the only one to tell him what to do. Next, ask him why Sir Prysin gave the key to him in the first place, and he'll state the King made Sir Prysin give him the key so that it wouldn't get lost. After this dialogue, he'll then hand over the key, under the condition that you do not allow Sir Prysin to kill the demon.

walkthrough.heading: Sir Prysin's key
walkthrough.body: Bucket of water. On the ground floor of the palace, head to the kitchen in the north-east corner of the ground floor. If you do not already have a bucket of water, you can find an empty bucket up the stairs, in the bedroom to the north-east. With the bucket, return to the kitchen and use it on the sink to obtain a bucket of water. Next, head outside through kitchen door and look for a drain against the wall north of the doorway. Use your bucket of water on the drain. 'If you do not do this, you cannot obtain the key'. The key will be washed down the drain, so you must now retrieve it from the sewer below. Head east, out of the palace, and look for a manhole located south of the palace's east walls. It is marked by the icon on the minimap. Once you find it, open the manhole and climb down to enter the sewer. <!-- This doesn't use the regular map template because it cannot draw text labels; the GeoJSON used as an alternative is somewhat bloated, and therefore placed in mapspace and transcluded here-->{{Map:Demon Slayer key location}}{{clear}} While in the sewer, go north-west and follow the path highlighted on the map above until you reach a stream. You should see a muddy patch to your left, next to a pile of skeletons. Examine this and you will find a rusty key.

walkthrough.heading: Wizard Traiborn's key
walkthrough.body: 25 unnoted bones. You can save some time by having all of the bones when you first speak to him. An easy way to get the bones is to kill Goblin goblins south of the prison outside of Draynor Village Wizard Traiborn is located on the floor 1 of the Wizards' Tower, which stands on an island south of Draynor Village. Ask him about the key and at first he won't remember it - but once you ask whether he has 'any keys knocking around', he will recall that he sealed it inside a magical wardrobe, for which he needs 25 regular bones to open. Once all 25 bones have been delivered, Traiborn will perform his ritual and then give you his key. Note that you can deliver the bones in increments, so Ultimate Ironmen will not need to clear out their inventory to complete this step. 'If you die with the key, you will have to pay another 25 bones to re-retrieve it.'

walkthrough.heading: Silverlight
walkthrough.body: Now that you have all three keys, head back to Sir Prysin in Varrock. Give him the keys, and he will give you Silverlight. Players can drop Silverlight and ask Sir Prysin for another one for free; after the quest he will charge {{Coins|500}}. Equip the sword, get any food and armour you may need for combat, and prepare to fight Delrith. If you have forgotten the magical incantation, you can speak with Aris at her tent in Varrock Square to hear it again. When you're ready, head south of Varrock, and go east towards the stone circle surrounded by dark wizards. A cutscene will play of Delrith being summoned by the wizards after you enter the circle.

walkthrough.heading: Banishing Delrith
walkthrough.body: The final part takes place in an instance of the Varrock stone circle, with Delrith and several dark wizards (two level 7 wizards and a level 20 wizard). Level 7 and 20 wizards will be aggressive to players with lower than 15 or 41 combat level respectively. Additionally, upon the cutscene finishing for the first time, one of the level 7 wizards will attack regardless of combat level. The level 20 wizard's maximum hit of 6 can threaten players with a low Hitpoints level, especially if the player has negative Magic Defence bonus. 'To leave, run to the edge at any time during the fight.' Because the fight takes place in a single-way combat zone, if you are already under attack from a dark wizard, you will need to kill or hide from it before you are able to begin combat with Delrith. It is recommended for lower-level players to approach from the south, and hide from wizards behind the southernmost stone wall until Delrith is nearby. Since the wizards 'do not respawn' in the instance, it is also possible to kill them first, leave and restock, and then return to face Delrith. Attack Delrith with Silverlight equipped. Despite his combat level of 27, the Silverlight's weakening effect will reduce Delrith's hitpoints to less than that of a cow. When he reaches 0 hitpoints, say the magical incantation. If the wrong incantation is said, Delrith regenerates to full health. 'If you cannot remember your personal randomized incantation you can return to Aris and she will repeat it when prompted.' ==== Pures and lower levels ==== For those wishing to attack with magic, wielding Silverlight and manually casting spells will also deal damage. Other methods include flinching him or using Confuse, Curse, or Weaken to make him easier to kill with melee. Ring of recoils can be used for this fight. <!-- is combat xp normal? --> If you take too long<!-- how long? --> to finish off Delrith, he will disappear and you will need to leave and re-enter the instance. If Delrith disappears during the dialogue to banish him the quest can still be completed by pressing "continue" until the end. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

steps: Go to north-west corner of the palace and go up two flights of stairs.
Speak to Captain Rovin in the north-west tower on the floor 2 about the demon.
Go to the kitchen to the north-east, on the ground floor.
If you don't have a bucket of water, head up the staircase in the kitchen and grab one from the room to the east. Head back down to the kitchen and fill the bucket from the sink.
Use a bucket of water on the drain outside of the eastern kitchen wall.
Climb down the manhole east of the palace, just outside the wall near the tree patch.
Take the north-west path down to the end and take the rusty Silverlight key from the floor. (It does not appear on the minimap)
Take 25 un-noted bones from your bank.
Ultimate Ironmen: You can deliver the bones a few at a time. You do not have to deliver all 25 at once.
Go to Wizards' Tower (south of Draynor Village) (fairy ring code DIS).
Climb up the stairs and talk to Wizard Traiborn.
He will ask for 25 bones (noted will not work); bring him these and he will give you his key.
Return to Sir Prysin (south-west room of Varrock Castle) and give him the keys.
Wield Silverlight and go to the Dark wizards by Varrock's south entrance. A cutscene will occur.
Defeat Delrith; right-click Delrith and banish him with the incantation seen earlier. The incantation varies from player to player; Aris will remind players of the incantation if forgotten.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: The Restless Ghost
aliases: Get the Ghost's skull in the basement
Quests that require The Restless Ghost
start: Speak to Father Aereck in the chapel south-east of Lumbridge Castle.
description: A ghost is haunting Lumbridge graveyard. The priest of the Lumbridge church of Saradomin wants you to find out how to get rid of it.
recommendedItems: Combat 10
Fast travel to several locations
Wizard's Tower (1 trip) - Necklace of passage or Amulet of the eye or Amulet of glory to Draynor Village (All members only)
Father Urhney in the Lumbridge Swamp (1 trip) - Necklace of passage to Wizard's Tower or Amulet of glory to Draynor Village (Both members only)
Lumbridge (3 trips) - Lumbridge Teleport or Lumbridge Home Teleport (once)
rewards: Ghostspeak amulet (keep for several quests and content in the future)
leagueRegion: <poem> Unlocking Varlamore will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Ghost speak
walkthrough.body: {{Map|3144,3178|3152,3178|3152,3173|3144,3173|mtype=polygon|caption=Father Urhney's small house.|align=right|width=200|height=200|zoom=3}} Talk to Father Aereck, found in the Lumbridge chapel just east of Bob's Brilliant Axes. Tell him you are looking for a quest, and he will ask you to get rid of a ghost haunting the graveyard. He suggests you start by talking to Father Urhney, an expert on ghosts. Go south of the castle, and into the Lumbridge Swamp. Head west through the swamp until you come upon a small house by the coast and talk to the irate Father Urhney inside. After you mention Father Aereck's request, he gives you an amulet of ghostspeak, which allows you to communicate with the ghost. 'It is highly recommended to keep the amulet for future quests.' Once you have the amulet in your inventory, teleport or run back to Lumbridge, and make your way to the graveyard located beside the chapel. {{Clear}}

walkthrough.heading: Freeing the ghost
walkthrough.body: .]] In a small building in the south-east corner of the graveyard is a marble coffin. Wearing your amulet of ghostspeak, search the coffin, and a ghost will dramatically emerge. Talk to him, and he tells you he is missing his skull. A warlock from the Wizards' Tower stole it, and he wants it back. Head to the Wizards' Tower located on an island south of Draynor Village, and climb down the ladder in the room directly next to the entrance. Across the room, you will find an altar, which you will need to search to obtain the ghost's skull. 'A skeleton will appear and attack you.' You do not need to fight the skeleton and can simply leave the room. Make sure you have the skull in your inventory. Run or teleport back to Lumbridge to speak with the restless ghost. He wants you to put the skull in his coffin. Use the skull on the coffin, and you will see the ghost's spirit disappear into the river. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

steps: Talk to Father Aereck in the Lumbridge church. (Lumbridge teleport can be used for quick travel to Lumbridge)
Go through the graveyard's southern exit and head to the hut west of Lumbridge Swamp.
Talk to Father Urhney inside the hut.
Head to the small room in the Lumbridge graveyard south of the church.
Equip the Ghostspeak amulet and click the coffin, talk to the ghost.
Head to the Wizards' Tower, and climb down the ladder to the basement. (Use Necklace of passage to teleport to Wizards' Tower if you have one.)
Search the altar, and you will receive a ghost's skull. A level 13 skeleton will appear, you don't have to kill it, just leave.
Go back to the graveyard and use the skull on the coffin with it open.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Romeo & Juliet
start: Speak to Romeo in Varrock Square.
description: Romeo and Juliet are desperately in love, but Juliet's father doesn't approve. Help them to find a way to get married and live happily ever after.
leagueRegion: <poem> Not completable, as it requires access to Misthalin. </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Starting out
walkthrough.body: Romeo can be found in or near Varrock Square. Speak to him, and he'll ramble about his love for Juliet. Ask him if you can help, and he'll ask you to talk to her in her mansion.

walkthrough.heading: Speaking to Juliet
walkthrough.body: Go and talk to Juliet, located on the upper floor balcony of the mansion directly west of the Varrock west bank, just outside the western walls of Varrock. She will give you a letter to give to Romeo. Go back to Romeo at Varrock Square, and deliver the letter. If you cannot find Romeo, he may have wandered inside the general store located south of the square.

walkthrough.heading: Father Lawrence
walkthrough.body: After delivering the letter to Romeo, he will despair upon learning that Juliet's father opposes their marriage. He suggests going to Father Lawrence for help, who is located in the Varrock chapel north-east of the square. After speaking to Father Lawrence, he will suggest that you fake Juliet's death by giving her a cadava potion to appear dead, so that Romeo can later collect her from the crypt. He will ask you to go to the Apothecary who will be able to make one for you.

walkthrough.heading: The potion
walkthrough.body: '''Note:' You can save some time by having the cadava berries required for the potion in your inventory before speaking to the apothecary. Consider also picking one extra for the quest Making Friends with My Arm. Ironman players are recommended to grab some redberries at the same time as the cadava berries, for use in later quests.'' The Apothecary can be found in south-western Varrock located west of the Varrock Swordshop, in a building with a purple potion icon. Speak to him about the quest (selecting 'Talk about something else' first) and he will ask you to bring him some cadava berries to finish the potion. Cadava berries can be picked from several bushes just west of the south-east Varrock mine. Return to the Apothecary with the berries and he will give you the cadava potion. 'Be careful not to drink the potion yourself', as this will cause the player to black out for a short amount of time. Now, head back to Juliet, and give her the potion. You will now see a cutscene of her "dying", though she really falls into a coma.

walkthrough.heading: To the crypt
walkthrough.body: Go back to Romeo, and tell him that he must rescue Juliet from the crypt. He needs someone to accompany him, which ends up being you. You will now see another cutscene of you entering the crypt with Romeo. When he sees Juliet's cousin, Phillipa, he forgets all about Juliet and falls in love with her. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Sheep Shearer
start: Speak to Fred the Farmer in the house by the sheep pen north of Lumbridge Castle.
description: Fred the Farmer's sheep are getting mighty woolly. He will pay you to shear them.
itemRequirements: Shears if obtaining wool to spin into balls of wool (obtained during the quest)
rewards: Crafting 150 Crafting experience (An additional 50 experience if you make the balls of wool on a spinning wheel instead of buying it yourself)
leagueRegion: <poem> Unlocking Asgarnia will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Obtaining the wool
walkthrough.body: If you did not bring shears, Fred will give you some. Enter the fenced area connected to the east side of the house where the sheep are. on the floor 1 of Lumbridge Castle.]] 'Note': Players planning to do the free-to-play quest Prince Ali Rescue are advised to shear and spin at least three more balls of wool. Shear the sheep, either by selecting the "shear" option on the sheep, or right-clicking the shears and selecting "use," then clicking the sheep. After shearing them, the skinny looking sheep will grow back their wool after one minute. If they run away while shearing, just keep trying. Avoid the rams, which look like regular sheep with horns. They cannot be sheared, and it is easy to accidentally attack them. The pen also contains "The Thing", which Fred warned the player about. This is actually two penguins in disguise as a sheep, and attempting to shear it will cause the penguins to squeak and run away from you. It can be identified as the only sheep with the "Talk to" option, and poses no danger during the quest. "The Thing" is later encountered during the Cold War quest. Low-level players may consider setting their attack options to "Hidden" for the duration of this quest to avoid entering combat with them on accident. s disguised as a sheep.]]

walkthrough.heading: Spinning the wool
walkthrough.body: Once you have 20 pieces of wool, they must be spun into balls of wool. Go to the floor 1 of the Lumbridge Castle, and find the bedroom on the south end of the castle. Inside is a spinning wheel; click on the wheel with the wool in your inventory to spin your wool into balls. When they are all spun, go back to Fred the Farmer to finish the quest. If you do not have the space to carry all 20 pieces of wool, you can make smaller deliveries until you reach the required total. Note that Fred will not accept noted balls of wool. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

quickGuide.section: If you already have the 20 unnoted balls of wool
steps: Talk to Fred the Farmer north of Lumbridge.
Fred takes the 20 balls of wool.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

quickGuide.section: If you don't have the balls of wool
steps: Talk to Fred the Farmer north of Lumbridge.
He will give you shears if you do not have them.
Enter the sheep pen to the east, connected to his house and shear sheep for 20 wool.
Ultimate Ironmen: You can deliver the balls of wool in several trips. You do not have to deliver all 20 at once.
Go to the floor 1 of Lumbridge Castle.
Click on the spinning wheel in the southern room to spin the wool.
With 20 'un-noted' balls of wool, return to Fred the Farmer.
Talk to Fred the Farmer and hand them in.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Shield of Arrav
aliases: Do Shield of Arrav on any visit to Varrock
start: Varrock Palace library. Talk to Reldo, the librarian, located at the northern end of Varrock Castle.
description: Varrockian literature tells of a valuable shield, stolen long ago from the museum of Varrock, by a gang of professional thieves. See if you can track down this shield and return it to the museum. You will need a friend to help you complete this quest.
itemRequirements: Black Arm Gang: 2 Phoenix crossbows (obtained during the quest)
recommendedItems: Combat 10
requirements: A trustworthy friend or partner. Players can join the official chat-channel "OSRS SOA" to look for a partner.
rewards: Ability to claim 5 Kudos and an Antique lamp rewarding 1,000 XP in any skill of at least level 20 from Historian Minas after completion of the quest (members only)
leagueRegion: <poem> Unlocking Asgarnia will auto-complete the quest Unlocking Fremennik will auto-complete the quest Unlocking Kandarin will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Choosing your gang
walkthrough.body: Talk to Reldo in the Varrock Palace library, the northernmost room on the ground floor. Ask him for a quest, and he will suggest you look around for a book called the Shield of Arrav, which may have a quest for you. To find it, search the bookcase with a blue and white book in the top shelf, located on the east side of the short bookcases in the middle of the room. Read the book, then speak with Reldo again to tell him you have read it. The player will ask him about the whereabouts of the Phoenix Gang and the Black Arm Gang. At this stage, you can choose to join either gang. If you wish to join the Phoenix Gang, speak to Baraek, the fur trader in the market. Otherwise, talk to Charlie the Tramp next to the southern gate of Varrock. 'Note': You will only need to follow the steps to join one of the two gangs. It is recommended to 'make sure you have a partner from the opposite gang' before choosing one. To find one, you may ask in the official chat-channel OSRS SOA. Warning: Although the majority of players in the chat-channel offer their services for free, some players also charge in-game money. Beware of the possibility of being scammed when engaging in trust trades with other players. When picking your gang, there are a number of considerations: *It is much easier to find Phoenix Gang members via the official chat-channel. *Phoenix Gang is recommended for lower combat levels. *Black Arm Gang is recommended if you do not want to gain combat experience. *If your partner has previously combined the two half pieces to create the complete certificate or has completed the quest, they cannot obtain the half piece of the shield from their gang hideout - which means certificates cannot be obtained from them. If your partner is from Phoenix Gang, they can help you acquire the key to the weapon store only. *The half shield of arrav reappears in their respective locations if the half certificate is lost, allowing players to repeatedly offer half certificates as long as they have not completed the quest. <choose> <option> {{:Shield of Arrav/Phoenix Gang}} {{:Shield of Arrav/Black Arm Gang}}</option> <option> {{:Shield of Arrav/Black Arm Gang}} {{:Shield of Arrav/Phoenix Gang}}</option> </choose>

walkthrough.heading: Finishing up
walkthrough.body: Broken shield Take your half of the shield to Curator Haig Halen, located in the Varrock Museum. He will take your half of the shield and give you two copies of half the certificate. Your partner, who has the other half of the Shield, will receive the other half of the certificate. Trade one half of the certificate with your partner for the other half. When you have both certificate halves, use them on the other to obtain a completed certificate. If completing the quest as an Ironman you must 'use' the key/certificate on each other. Take the certificate to King Roald in Varrock Palace to receive your reward. Congratulations, quest complete!

steps: Talk to Reldo, located in the library in Varrock Palace.
Check the bookcase with a bright blue book in the top shelf, and read the book.
Talk to Reldo again.
Take your half of the shield to Curator Haig Halen, located in the Varrock Museum.
Trade your half of the certificate with your partner. '(Ironmen: Use the certificate halves on your partner)'
Use both halves of the certificate on each other to make a completed certificate.
Take the certificate to King Roald in the castle to receive your reward.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Ernest the Chicken
start: Speak to Veronica, south of Draynor Manor by the gate.
description: Veronica is very worried. Her fiancé went into the big spooky manor house to ask for directions. An hour later and he's still not out yet.
recommendedItems: (Members only) Fast travel to Draynor Manor (Draynor Manor Teleport or amulet of glory)
Food (If lower hp a lvl 22 skeleton and dead trees attack you)
requirements: The ability to defend from a level 22 Skeleton.
rewards: Access to the Killerwatt Plane (Members only)
leagueRegion: <poem> Unlocking Fremennik will auto-complete the quest Unlocking Kandarin will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Ernest the missing
walkthrough.body: Talk to Veronica standing just outside the courtyard of the Draynor Manor. She wants you to find her fiancé, Ernest, who had gone to the manor an hour ago for directions and has not come back yet. Enter the manor and climb up the staircase in the centre room. Then climb up the spiral stairs immediately west to find Professor Oddenstein. He will explain that Ernest was turned into a chicken when he was helping on an experiment with his 'pouletmorph' machine. However, to change him back, the professor needs parts that were stolen and hidden by the poltergeists in the manor. You need to help him find a pressure gauge, a rubber tube, and an oil can in any order.

walkthrough.heading: Pressure gauge
walkthrough.body: To get the pressure gauge, fish food and poison are required. Fish food is in a blue box, one is found on the floor 1 in the room directly south of the main staircase. Poison is in a green bottle, one is found on the ground floor in the small north-western room south of the kitchen. Use the poison on the fish food to create poisoned fish food. Go to the south-eastern room (of the ground floor), 'grab the spade' next to the door leading outside (respawn every 48s), if you do not already have one to get the rubber tube. Leave the manor by exiting the door in the south-eastern room, go to the south-western corner of the manor grounds to the fountain. 'Use' the poisoned fish food on the fountain to kill the piranhas then search the fountain to get the pressure gauge.

walkthrough.heading: Rubber tube
walkthrough.body: On the west side of the grounds look for a compost heap, north of the belladonna special patch near a patch of cabbages. Search the compost heap, requiring a spade and you will get a key. Go back into the manor through the front door then go through the door to the room behind the stairs containing the aggressive skeleton and take the rubber tube. The skeleton will attack you, so if you are a low level it is recommended to get the tube and leave as quickly as possible. {{Clear|left}}

walkthrough.heading: Oil can
walkthrough.body: Go to the western room on the ground floor, search the bookcase on the western side on the wall to gain access to a secret room. Go down the ladder into the basement where there will be doors and levers around you. It is 'not' possible to use Telekinetic Grab to pick up the oil can. 'Note:' The levers can be reset by leaving the room and returning. Follow the steps given below to obtain the oil can: {{Checklist| *Pull levers B then A down. *Enter door 1. *Pull lever D down. *Enter doors 2, then 3. *Pull levers B, then A up. *Enter doors 3, 4, and 5. *Pull levers E, then F down. *Enter doors 6 and 7. *Pull lever C down. *Enter doors 7 and 6. *Pull lever E up. *Enter doors 6, 8, and 3. *Go through door 9 and grab the oil can. }}

walkthrough.heading: Transmogrification
walkthrough.body: Leave the basement and leave the secret room by pulling the lever on the eastern wall. Finally, go back to the top floor and talk to Professor Oddenstein. Give him the items, he will fix his machine which turns Ernest back into a human. :'Note:' You are still required to leave the manor through the back doors. {{Clear}} 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Vampyre Slayer
start: Speak to Morgan in his house in Draynor Village, just north of Ned's house.
description: The people of Draynor Village live in constant terror. Their numbers are dwindling, all due to the foul creature lurking in the manor to the north known as a vampyre.
itemRequirements: Hammer (can be bought from the general store just north of the Blue Moon Inn for 1 coin)
Beer (obtainable during the quest for 2 coins)
recommendedItems: Combat 20
Garlic, highly recommended to weaken the Count (obtainable during the quest)
Combat equipment - Magic is recommended if using the safespot
Fast travel to Varrock (such as the Varrock teleport)
(Members only) Fast travel to Draynor Village (amulet of glory or Draynor Manor Teleport)
rewards: Count Draynor accessible in the Nightmare Zone.
leagueRegion: <poem> Unlocking Morytania will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: The vampyre threat
walkthrough.body: {{Map|name=Morgan|x=3099|y=3269|r=3|mtype=square|align=right|width=200|height=200|caption=Morgan's location.}} Speak to Morgan in his house in Draynor Village, just north of Ned's house. He will tell you that the village is being ravaged by an evil vampyre that lives in the basement of the nearby manor, and they need someone to get rid of it. He wants you to first talk to the retired vampyre hunter Dr Harlow for tips on how to kill it. If you don't already have garlic, you can search the cupboard upstairs to find some.

walkthrough.heading: The retired vampyre slayer
walkthrough.body: {{Map|name=Dr Harlow|x=3222|y=3397|r=4|mtype=square|align=right|width=200|height=200|caption=Dr Harlow's location at The Blue Moon Inn.}} Dr Harlow can be found in the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock, south of the square. Tell him Morgan needs his help, and he will ask for a beer in return, which you can buy from the bartender for 2 coins if you didn't bring one. Talk to him again and he will give you a stake, advise you to use a hammer to drive it in, and to bring some garlic to weaken the vampyre. If you don't already have a hammer, you can buy one from the Varrock General Store to the north for 1 coin.

walkthrough.heading: Count Draynor
walkthrough.body: weapon, armour, food, garlic, hammer and a stake Head to Draynor Manor north of Draynor Village, bringing your combat equipment and food, garlic, a hammer and the stake. Once inside, go down the large stairs on the east side of the building. There are candles in this room that you can walk on, causing the player to exclaim, but these do not deal damage. There is a coffin in the centre of the room. Open it and the vampyre, Count Draynor, will pop up and attack you. If you brought garlic, upon beginning melee combat, the Count will automatically take 10 damage at the start of the fight, and have his attack/strength reduced by 10 levels, and defence by 40. This effect lasts for 30 seconds. It is possible to safespot him by running to the south-western corner between the staircase and the skeleton. Once the Count is next to you, step into the tile he is occupying. He should move into the tile you just left, but this may take a couple of tries. Once he is in the corner, move to the square diagonal to him so that you are standing in front of the skeleton. If using the safespot, it is recommended to use Magic as flinching with melee is slow and the Count regenerates health at roughly 6 times the rate of regular monsters. Upon defeating Count Draynor, you will automatically stab him with the hammer and stake; if you didn't bring a hammer, {{Mes|You are unable to push the stake far enough in}} will appear in the chat, and you will be unable to kill him. 'Note': It is possible to set up a Dwarf Multi Cannon in this area. 'Note': If you take too long to kill Count Draynor, he returns to his coffin and heals to full health. The quest is completed after defeating the count, and you can exit Draynor Manor through the exit in the eastern-most room or teleport. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

steps: Talk to Morgan in Draynor Village about a vampyre.
Go upstairs in Morgan's house and take garlic from the cupboard.
Talk to Dr Harlow in the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock, south of Varrock Centre.
Buy a beer if you haven't already.
Talk to Dr Harlow again and receive a stake.
Buy a hammer from the general store just north of the bar if you haven't already.
Bring your combat gear (food recommended), garlic, hammer, and stake to Draynor Manor.
Go to the basement (east stairs, not through the west room).
Open the coffin and kill Count Draynor. (You do not need to use the hammer/stake on him. Just kill him with them in your inventory).
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Imp Catcher
start: Speak to Wizard Mizgog on the top floor of the Wizards' Tower.
description: The Wizard Grayzag has summoned hundreds of little imps. They have stolen a lot of things belonging to the Wizard Mizgog including his magic beads.
recommendedItems: (Members only) Fast travel to the Wizards' Tower (necklace of passage, amulet of glory to Draynor Village, or Fairy Rings to dis)
rewards: After the quest players can obtain more amulets by speaking to Wizard Mizgog with a complete set of beads.
leagueRegion: <poem> Not completable, as it requires access to Misthalin. </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Mizgog's little helper
walkthrough.body: Make your way to the Wizards' Tower, south of Draynor Village and over a long stone bridge. Climb the stairs, and go up to the floor 2. Talk to Wizard Mizgog and ask him questions to find out that he needs your help. He will tell you that Wizard Grayzag's imps have stolen his beads and he wants you to get them back for him. He needs you to collect: *A black bead - {{Coins|{{GEP|Black bead}}}} *A yellow bead - {{Coins|{{GEP|Yellow bead}}}} *A red bead - {{Coins|{{GEP|Red bead}}}} *A white bead - {{Coins|{{GEP|White bead}}}} ''Note: You can collect the beads in advance without starting the quest to save additional trips to the Wizards' Tower.

walkthrough.heading: Obtaining beads
walkthrough.body: Beads are only obtained as a 5/128 drop from imps, buying them through the Grand Exchange, or trading with other players. Because of the relatively low drop rate, many players may choose to buy beads on the Grand Exchange to avoid the hassle of killing imps (for a total cost of {{Coins|{{GEP|Red bead|1}} + {{GEP|Black bead|1}} + {{GEP|Yellow bead|1}} + {{GEP|White bead|1}}}}). If looking to collect the beads as a drop, imps commonly spawn throughout Gielinor, and you might consider collecting them passively over time when encountering them. Alternatively, you can use some of the following hotspots where many spawn at a time: *East of the Ardougne Monastery *On top of the Karamja Volcano (be aware of level 14 scorpions in this area) *Southern entrance to Falador *In a basement in Kastori Every 30–120 seconds there is a 25% chance for an imp to disappear into a puff of smoke and teleport a short distance away. Using Magic or Ranged is recommended to reduce downtime when killing them.

walkthrough.heading: Finishing up
walkthrough.body: Once you have all four beads, return to Wizard Mizgog and give them to him to finish the quest. He won't accept them one at a time, so Ultimate Ironmen should plan to get the whole thing done at once. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Prince Ali Rescue
aliases: Get the key imprint, wig and skin paste for Prince ali rescue
Rescue prince ali from the jail
start: Speak to Hassan in the palace at Al Kharid.
description: Prince Ali of Al Kharid has been kidnapped by the scheming Lady Keli. You are hired to stage a rescue mission.
itemRequirements: Yellow dye or 2 onions and 5 coins
Bucket of water or jug of water (obtainable during quest)
Rope (can be bought during the quest from Ned for 18 coins)
30-40 coins for the Al Kharid toll gate if not using teleports to and from Al Kharid
recommendedItems: Combat 10
Fast travel to several locations:
(Members only) Al Kharid (2 trips) - Amulet of glory or ring of dueling
(Members only) Draynor Village (2 trips) - Amulet of glory or necklace of passage to Wizards' Tower
Quick access to a furnace:
(Members only) Amulet of glory to Edgeville
Lumbridge Teleport or Lumbridge Home Teleport
rewards: Free passage through the Lumbridge - Al Kharid toll gate from now on.
(Members) Access to the Sorceress's Garden Thieving minigame.
(Members) Use of the window shortcut at the rear of Al Kharid Palace (requires 70 Agility).
leagueRegion: <poem> Unlocking Desert will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Setting up (obtaining the required items)
walkthrough.body: axe, tinderbox, pickaxe, shears, 16 coins 'Skip this part if you have all the required items' (can be bought on the Grand Exchange). {{Checklist| *Purchase the pink skirt at Thessalia's Fine Clothes immediately south of the Varrock town square. *Buy 3 beers at the Blue Moon Inn just south-east of Thessalia's Fine Clothes, and pick up the pot in the bar. *Cut down a tree, light the logs, then wait for it to burn out to take the ashes. *Head to the south-east Varrock mine and mine one tin and one copper ore to later make a bronze bar, and pick one bunch of redberries from the nearby bushes. *Head to the south-west Varrock mine, and mine one clay. *Head to Fred the Farmer's pen north of Lumbridge and shear three sheep for wool. Pick two onions from the garden behind his house. *Pick some wheat from the nearby grain field, then make a pot of flour at the windmill. *Spin the wool on the floor 1 of the Lumbridge Castle using the spinning wheel to get three balls of wool. *Take the jug from the castle's kitchen basement and fill it with water, then use it on your clay to create soft clay, and then refill it. *Head to Al Kharid through the toll gate to the east across the river with your 10 coins, and smith a bronze bar on the furnace there. }} The remaining items can be gathered during the quest.

walkthrough.heading: Planning a rescue
walkthrough.body: 3 balls of wool, rope (unless buying from Ned), 2 onions 'or' yellow dye, 1 redberries, pot of flour, ashes, a bucket of water or jug of water, soft clay, a bronze bar, 3 normal beers, a pink skirt, and 30 coins (unless teleporting) {{Map|name=Leela|x=3113|y=3262|plane=0|r=3|mtype=square|caption=Leela's location just east of Draynor Village.|align=right|width=250|height=250}} Head to the Al Kharid palace, located in the south of Al Kharid. There is a jug of water in the eastern room if you did not bring one. Talk to Chancellor Hassan in the southern chamber and ask if he needs help; he will direct you towards Spymaster Osman, who can be found outside the northern perimeter of the palace. Osman will explain that Prince Ali, heir to the Emir of Al Kharid, has been taken by a group of bandits to the abandoned jail just east of Draynor Village. He wants you to talk to his daughter Leela, who will help you attempt a rescue. Leela can be found strolling east of Draynor Village just south of the wheat field. Talk to Leela and ask her about the key and disguise, and she will explain what you will need to pull off the escape. To the west of Leela is Ned's house. Ask him to make you a wig from the balls of wool. If you haven't brought a rope, you can buy one from his shop for 18 coins (15 through dialogue). Once you have the rope and wig, talk to Aggie in the house just west of Ned's, and ask her to make you some paste. She will use your redberries, ashes, flour and water to make the paste. If you did not bring yellow dye, you can ask her to make it for you in exchange for 2 onions and five coins. Use the dye on the wig to dye it yellow. Head inside the jail directly east of Draynor, avoiding the aggressive level 26 jail guards. They will ignore you if your combat level is 53 or higher. Once inside, speak to Lady Keli and tell her she's famous, then ask her about her latest plan, then praise her skill. Ask her how she knows someone won't try to free him, and she'll mention the key. Ask her if you can see the key and then if you can touch the key for a short amount of time. You will make a key print of the key using the soft clay. Once you have the key print, head to any furnace to smelt the bronze key using the key print and your bronze bar. The closest is in Lumbridge. Members may use a Amulet of glory to teleport to the Edgeville furnace, and then to teleport to Draynor Village for the next section. {{Clear|left}}

walkthrough.heading: Saving the Prince
walkthrough.body: 3 beers, rope, a pink skirt, a wig (dyed yellow), and paste Talk to Leela, who will tell you to talk to Joe the guard to find a weakness before breaking the prince out. 'Note': If she doesn't tell you to talk to the guard, you may have forgotten to dye the wig yellow. Talk to Joe and offer him a drink of all three beers, until he is drunk. Use the rope on Lady Keli, the key on the cell door, then talk to Prince Ali and he will use the wig and pink skirt as a disguise and escape. Return to Hassan in the Al Kharid palace to claim your reward. 'Congratulations, quest complete!' :'Tip:' Members may talk to Osman outside the palace after the quest to unlock the Minigame Teleport to the Sorceress's Garden.

update: Yet another new quest, and new options menu

steps: Begin the quest by talking to Chancellor Hassan, who is in the southern room on the ground floor of Al Kharid palace. Grab the jug of water off the table in the eastern room if you did not bring your own.
Talk to Osman just north of the palace.
Go to Ned's house with 3 ball of wool (just west of Leela in Draynor Village) and obtain the wig from him. if Dragon Slayer I is not started or if Dragon Slayer I is completed or started.
You may buy a rope from Ned for 15 coins through dialogue, or 18 coins from his shop if you do not already have one.
Go to Aggie's house (just west of Ned's house)
If needed, use the 2 onions on Aggie to get yellow dye.
Talk to her to get the skin paste (ash, pot of flour, bucket of water and redberries).
Use the yellow dye on the wig.
Go to the jailhouse east of Draynor Village (big red exclamation mark east of Draynor bank).
Talk to Lady Keli.
Take the key print and bronze bar to any furnace to smelt the bronze key.
The closest is in Lumbridge. Members may use a Amulet of glory to teleport to the Edgeville furnace, and then to teleport to Draynor Village for the next section.
Talk to Leela south of the wheat fields in Draynor Village and talk to her. She will ask you to find the guard's weakness.
Go to the jailhouse.
Talk to Joe and offer him the 3 drinks.
Use the rope on Lady Keli.
Open the prison door with the key.
Talk to Prince Ali. He will take the wig, skin paste, and pink skirt.
Report back to Chancellor Hassan.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Doric's Quest
start: Speak to Doric in the small house north of Falador, just outside the east gate of Taverley.
description: Doric the dwarf is happy to let you use his anvils but first he would like you to run an errand for him.
recommendedItems: Pickaxe and Mining 15 (boostable) if you wish to mine the ores yourself (bronze pickaxe obtained during the quest)
rewards: The ability to use Doric's anvils
Bronze pickaxe given at the start of the quest
ironmanConcerns: *A method of obtaining iron ore: **Mining 15 (boostable) to mine it **As a 1/20 drop from Flesh Crawlers in the Stronghold of Security **As a 1/8.667 drop from Mind Golems in the Ruins of Camdozaal (requires Quest Below Ice Mountain) **As a drop from other monsters
leagueRegion: <poem> Asgarnia — location requirement Unlocking Desert will auto-complete the quest Unlocking Fremennik will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Getting started
walkthrough.body: {{Map|name=Doric|x=2952|y=3452|r=4|height=250|width=250|mtype=square|align=right|caption=The quest's start location.}} Doric can be found in a small building on the crossroads north of Falador, east of the Taverley gate, and south of the Goblin Village. Ask Doric if you could use his whetstone or anvil. Doric will tell you he needs some materials in order to manufacture some pickaxes. He will hand you a bronze pickaxe. He wants you to get him: *6 clay *4 copper ores *2 iron ores (These cannot be noted) These materials must be turned in all at once (12 inventory slots).

walkthrough.heading: Obtaining the materials
walkthrough.body: (Skip this part if you already have all of the required materials) Where you obtain the ores does not matter, and can for example be obtained from other players or by mining the ores yourself (15 Mining is required for iron ore). The Dwarven Mine is located near Doric's house, so you can head there. To get there, go east from Doric's house and then north to find a path onto Ice Mountain. On the mountain, walk south and look for a ladder surrounded by buildings and dwarves. Climb down the ladder to enter the Dwarven Mine. The iron, copper, and tin rocks are located due south of the entrance. Clay rocks are located a little further south. Dwarves located outside the Dwarven Mine, east of Doric's house, sometimes drop iron ore. This may help Ironmen trying to complete this quest before level 15 Mining. Members can buy the copper ores and iron ores at the store in Blast Furnace. Ironmen can also complete the quest before reaching level 15 Mining by pickpocketing H.A.M members as they have an uncommon chance to give Iron ore. Also you can kill for example Sand or Rock Crabs which drop both copper and iron. Alternatively, instead of mining in the Dwarven Mine, you can use the Rimmington mine south of Falador, which contains all the required ores right next to each other.

walkthrough.heading: Finishing up
walkthrough.body: When you have all the ores needed, return to Doric to finish the quest. He will appreciate your help, reward you, and allow you to use his anvils whenever you'd like.

name: Black Knights' Fortress
start: Speak to Sir Amik Varze on the {{FloorNumber|uk=2}} of the White Knights' Castle's western tower in Falador.
description: The Black Knights are up to no good. You are hired by the white knights to spy on them and destroy their secret weapon.
itemRequirements: Cabbage (can be obtained from the cabbage patch in Edgeville Monastery and South Falador Farm, as well as Lumbridge cellar. Cabbages obtained from Draynor Manor 'CANNOT' be used)
Iron chainbody (can be purchased at Horvik's Armour Shop in Varrock and from Wayne's Chains in Falador)
Bronze med helm (can be purchased in the helmet shop in Barbarian Village, spawns by the backdoor of Draynor Manor)
recommendedItems: Combat 15
Food
Armour
Falador teleports
(Members only) Combat bracelet to the Monastery and head west towards the Black Knights' Fortress
requirements: The ability to evade level 33 Black Knights
leagueRegion: <poem> Asgarnia — location requirement Unlocking Desert will auto-complete the quest Unlocking Fremennik will auto-complete the quest Unlocking Kandarin will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Spy mission
walkthrough.body: Talk to Sir Amik Varze, who can be found on the floor 2 west wing of White Knights' Castle in Falador. Ask him for a quest, and he will tell you that he needs a spy to infiltrate the Black Knights' Fortress. The Black Knights claim to have developed a powerful new secret weapon, and he wants you to find it and sabotage it. He will hand you a dossier (requires a free inventory space). Read it and it will self destruct, signifying the start of the quest. If you still need the required items, on the way to the fortress you can purchase an iron chainbody from Wayne's Chains to the west of the southern entrance to Falador, a bronze med helm from Peksa in Barbarian Village, and a cabbage may be taken from the Edgeville Monastery.

walkthrough.heading: Infiltrating the fortress
walkthrough.body: An iron chainbody, a bronze med helm, and a cabbage not from Draynor Manor. {{Map|width=250|height=250|x=3020|y=3514|align=right|caption=The fortress is due north-east of Falador and slightly west of the Monastery.}} Make your way to the Black Knights' Fortress, located north-east of the Dwarven Mine and the Oracle, and north-west of the Monastery. Run through the Black Knights outside the fortress; they will be aggressive to players under 67 combat. Equip the Iron chainbody and Bronze med helm to disguise yourself as a Black Knight before entering through the southern door (you may enter with anything equipped in any of the other slots). :'Note:' You only need to be wearing the chainbody and med helm to enter the fortress - you can then unequip it and use the slots for something else. Throughout the following steps, there will be numerous black knights that will attack you. While in an area without any, make sure you have healed up and read ahead to the next steps to quickly pass them. {{Checklist| *Once inside, the wall right in front of you can be pushed. Push it to enter a small room. *Climb up the ladder in this small room. *Climb up the ladder immediately to the right of it. *Climb down the ladder just south. *Go through a door to the east. *Go up the closest ladder. *Climb down the ladder immediately to the east. *Open the sturdy door to the south and climb down the ladder to the west of it. }} In this small room, there will be a grill. Click on it to listen. You will overhear a conversation between the Black Knight Captain, a witch and a goblin. The witch is talking about an invincibility potion she has been working on - she needs Greldo the goblin to retrieve the final ingredient to complete it, a special type of cabbage grown only in Draynor Manor. She mentions that any other type of cabbage would wreck the potion.

walkthrough.heading: Sabotaging the secret weapon
walkthrough.body: :'Note:' Lower levelled players may choose to heal at the Edgeville Monastery to the east by speaking to a Monk before continuing. Return to the entrance of the building and enter the room directly east; after entering, the guard will warn you the Black Knights inside are in the middle of an important meeting, and will try to kill anyone that interrupts it. Click the option saying you don't care to enter the room, and then climb the ladder on the northern wall. Walk around the upper, L shaped landing, and Push the wall open. 'Right-click' your cabbage so that you do not eat it, and use it on the hole. A cutscene will play showing the potion being destroyed by the cabbage. Return to Sir Amik Varze, and tell him you sabotaged the weapon. 'Congratulations, quest complete!' {{Clear}}

name: Witch's Potion
start: Talk to Hetty in her house in Rimmington, south of Falador and west of Port Sarim.
description: Become one with your darker side. Tap into your hidden depths of magical potential by making a potion with the help of Hetty the Rimmington witch.
itemRequirements: Rat's tail (only obtainable after starting the quest)
recommendedItems: Fast travel to Rimmington to start the quest - Teleport to House (the default house location is Rimmington) or Skills necklace to Crafting Guild
leagueRegion: <poem> Asgarnia — location requirement </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Hetty the witch
walkthrough.body: Talk to Hetty in her house in south-east Rimmington, and tell her you want to know more about the black arts. She will tell you she is making a potion and needs four ingredients that she wants you to get: a rat's tail, a piece of burnt meat, an eye of newt, and an onion.

walkthrough.heading: Rat's tail
walkthrough.body: Kill a level 1 rat (they can be found in the archery shop west of Hetty's house) to obtain a rat's tail. '''Note: You can only obtain a rat's tail if you have started the quest! Giant rats will NOT drop a rat's tail.'''

walkthrough.heading: Burnt meat
walkthrough.body: '- You can skip this point if you have already obtained Burnt meat.' Kill a giant rat just north of the chapel graveyard south-east of Rimmington, or kill a cow in the cow pen just south of Falador, and cook the meat. Meat can be used on the fireplace in Hetty's own house. If you didn't manage to burn the meat, use the cooked meat on the fire or range to purposely burn it. (A player-lit fire will also work.) You can also buy raw meat from Wydin at the food store in Port Sarim.

walkthrough.heading: Eye of newt
walkthrough.body: '- You can skip this point if you have already obtained an Eye of newt.' You can buy an eye of newt from the magic shop in Port Sarim for 3 coins. The magic shop is labelled with a fire rune symbol on the map.

walkthrough.heading: Onion
walkthrough.body: '- You can skip this point if you have already obtained an onion.' Onions can be found in a field directly north of Rimmington and east of Melzar's Maze, or in the backyard of Fred the Farmer's farmhouse west of the sheep pen in Lumbridge.

walkthrough.heading: Finishing up
walkthrough.body: When you have all these items, talk to Hetty. She'll put them in her cauldron and tell you to drink from it. Drink from the cauldron to complete the quest and gain your reward. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

steps: To start, talk to Hetty in her house in Rimmington.
Kill a rat in the archery store directly west of Hetty to get a rat's tail.
Buy an eye of newt from Betty for 3gp.

Run to the chapel south of Port Sarim. Kill a giant rat and take the raw rat meat. Run back to Hetty's house. Use the raw rat meat on the fireplace. If you accidentally cook the meat you can re-cook it on the fireplace again to burn it.
Pick an onion from the field north of Rimmington.
Talk to Hetty while carrying all four items.
Drink from the cauldron.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: The Knight's Sword
start: Speak to the squire in the courtyard of the White Knights' Castle in Falador.
description: Sir Vyvin's squire is in trouble. He has accidentally lost Sir Vyvin's ceremonial sword. Help him find a replacement without Sir Vyvin finding out.
itemRequirements: Redberry pie (not half a redberry pie)
2 or 4 iron bars (4 if you want your own blurite sword)
1-3 Blurite ore (obtained during the quest) - optionally an additional ore each for your own blurite sword and the Falador easy diary (Members only)
recommendedItems: Combat 20
Armour and some food for aggressive enemies near the blurite rocks
Fast travel to several locations:
Falador to start the quest plus 2 additional trips - Falador Teleport, Ring of wealth (Members only)
Varrock (1 trip) - Varrock Teleport, Chronicle, Skills necklace to Cooks' Guild (Members only) or Ring of wealth to Grand Exchange (Members only)
Mudskipper Point (2 trips) - fairy ring aiq (Members only), Teleport to House (Rimmington) (Members only), Rat Pits minigame teleport (Members only), or Falador Teleport
requirements: The ability to run from level 57 ice warriors and level 53 ice giants could help.
rewards: A blurite sword (if you got Thurgo to make you an extra one)
The ability to smelt blurite ore into blurite bars (members only)
ironmanConcerns: *A method to obtain iron bars: **Mining 15 Mining and Smithing 15 Smithing if smelting iron ore **Spawn in level 18 Wilderness north-west of the Ferox Enclave, next to the bears west of the Graveyard of Shadows. Accessible via Minigame Clan Wars Minigame Teleport **1/42.67 drop from dwarves (Combat 10) in the mines under Falador **(Members only) Spawn in Thurid's Brain Buckets on the Sunset Coast in Varlamore (requires Quest Children of the Sun) **(Members only) 1/34.42 drop from sorting small salvage with Sailing 15 *A method to obtain a redberry pie: **Cooking 10 Cooking to cook one. A pie dish can be found in the Varrock Palace kitchen, and redberries can be picked just west of the South-east Varrock mine **(Members only) Purchased from Romily Weaklax in the Cooks' Guild with Cooking 32 and a chef's hat **(Members only) Partial completion of Perilous Moons to purchase a Redberry pie from Yarnio
leagueRegion: <poem> Not completable, as it requires access to Misthalin. </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Sword trouble
walkthrough.body: {{Map|name=Squire|x=2977|y=3342|r=3|mtype=square|align=right|caption=The location of Sir Vyvin's squire.|width=200|height=200}} Talk to the Squire, found in the courtyard of the White Knights' Castle in Falador. He has lost Sir Vyvin's sword, a family heirloom made many generations ago by the Imcando dwarves. Offer to make a new one and he will mention that Reldo the Varrock Palace librarian may know where to find an Imcando dwarf. :'Note': If you have already completed The Giant Dwarf, skip the following step and go straight to Thurgo; otherwise you must talk to Reldo before you may continue. Talk to Reldo in the Varrock Palace library, the northernmost room on the ground floor. Ask him what he knows about Imcando dwarves, and he will point you towards Mudskipper Point, just south of Port Sarim. :'Note:' If you still need ingredients for the redberry pie required in the following section, you can take the pie dish from the kitchen to the east now, then pick redberries by the South-east Varrock mine. {{Map|name=Thurgo|x=3001|y=3144|r=2|mtype=square|align=right|caption=The location of Thurgo, an Imcando dwarf.|width=200|height=200}}

walkthrough.heading: Thurgo the Imcando dwarf
walkthrough.body: Redberry pie Head south of Port Sarim to find Thurgo on the west side of a hill, in his hut with the anvil. Ask him if he would like some redberry pie, and he will take some and eat it. Ask if he can make a special sword, and he requests that you bring him a picture of the lost sword as a reference. {{Clear|left}}

walkthrough.heading: Acquiring the picture
walkthrough.body: Return to the Squire in the Falador Castle courtyard again, and he will mention that a portrait of Sir Vyvin's father includes the sword. 'Note:' You must have spoken to the squire before you may obtain the portrait. From the courtyard of the White Knights' Castle in Falador, go east through three doors, and then up the ladder. Go west through the door and then further west through the open doorway, then up the stairs. Sir Vyvin's room will be directly to the south. You need to obtain the portrait by searching the cupboard inside his room, but Sir Vyvin will stop you if he is inside the room and looking towards the player. Open the door to his room and wait for him to walk out, or hop worlds until you find one where he is outside the room, then take the portrait from the cupboard.

walkthrough.heading: Mining the blurite
walkthrough.body: A pickaxe, the portrait, 2 iron bars (4 if making extra sword) Return to Thurgo and give him the portrait. He now knows a blurite sword is what he needs to make, and you must obtain the blurite ore for it. This ore is only found in the Asgarnia Ice Dungeon, located on the hill to the north east. 'All enemies in the dungeon are aggressive, so get ready to run past them'. Head down the ladder on the hill, run north through the dungeon until you reach the pirates, then head east down the first corridor and enter the large icy room, which contains several bright blue rocks to mine for the ore. At the south-eastern end of the icy room, there is an entrance to the skeletal wyverns section of the cave. Standing directly in front of this entrance is a safespot, which you may wait in until it is safe to mine the nearby rocks. 'Note': Mine 1-2 extra if you are planning to complete the easy Falador Diary and/or want your own blurite sword. {{Clear}}

walkthrough.heading: Creating the sword
walkthrough.body: 2 iron bars (4 if making extra sword), blurite ore (2 if making extra sword) Return to Thurgo with your blurite ores and your iron bars and he will make you a sword. If you want a sword for yourself, drop it and ask Thurgo for a replacement, then pick up the second sword again. 'Note': Members planning on doing The Giant Dwarf soon after this quest are recommended to give Thurgo an additional redberry pie now to avoid a return trip during that quest. Go back to the Squire and he will take one of your blurite swords. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Goblin Diplomacy
start: Speak to General Bentnoze or General Wartface in Goblin Village.
description: There's a disturbance in the Goblin Village. Help the goblins solve their dispute so the world doesn't have to worry about rioting goblins. Aim: to help the goblins decide which colour they will wear.
itemRequirements: 3 sets of Goblin mail (obtained during the quest)
1 Blue dye (or 2 woad leaves and 5 coins to obtain a blue dye from Aggie)
Offer 20 coins to Wyson the gardener and he will give you two woad leaves
1 Orange dye – created by combining red dye with yellow dye
1 Red dye (or 3 redberries and 5 coins to obtain a red dye from Aggie)
1 Yellow dye (2 onions and 5 coins to obtain a yellow dye from Aggie)
requiredFor: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals
leagueRegion: <poem> Asgarnia — location requirement Unlocking Fremennik will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Getting started
walkthrough.body: Talk to General Bentnoze or General Wartface in Goblin Village, in the Kingdom of Asgarnia (located north of Falador, and east of Taverley). They will say that the goblin race is on the brink of civil war over armour colour, and they want their armour to be orange which is different to their normal colour.

walkthrough.heading: Gathering the required items
walkthrough.body: <u>Skip this subsection if you already have the items required.</u> Ask the generals where you can get orange armour. Eventually, one will answer that you can dye Goblin mail orange. Grubfoot will mention he stole yellow dye from a witch in Draynor Village, and mentions you may be able to find it there. One of the generals will mention you can find goblin mail in three different crates around the village. Grab the suits of goblin mail from the following crates: *Behind the generals' hut in a crate. *Inside the western hut in between the small square hut and the generals' hut. *Up a ladder near the gate to the goblin village. ''Note: DO NOT dye 3 pieces of armour. You only want 1 blue and 1 orange. Leave one plain. If you mistakenly paint an armour you won't get new ones from the crates.'' Alternatively, goblin mail can be obtained as a drop from killing goblins. The goblins in Goblin Village drop red or green goblin mails, which can be dyed, but you will need one uncoloured one from a standard goblin. You can go up the only ladder in the goblin village, up there will be some crates, search them to find a brown goblin mail. Wyson the head gardener in Falador Park will sell you the needed woad leaves. Ask him if you can buy some. When you do, he'll ask how much you are willing to pay. Say, "<u>About 20 coins</u>," and he'll say you are generous and will give you two woad leaves. This is the cheapest option. Two onions can easily be picked from the field just north of Rimmington, or alternate places such as Lumbridge, in the backyard of Farmer Fred's farm, which is next to the sheep paddock. Three redberries can be purchased from Wydin's Food Store in Port Sarim for 3 coins each or picked west of Varrock's south-east mine.

walkthrough.heading: Making the dyes
walkthrough.body: <u>Skip this subsection if you already have Orange dye and Blue dye.</u> You need to make orange dye and blue dye from the components you gathered in the previous section. Take the supplies to Aggie in Draynor Village, and have her make one yellow, one red, and one blue dye. To make orange dye, use the yellow dye and red dye on each other in your inventory. Note: dying Yellow Goblin Mail with red dye makes Red Goblin Mail (and vice versa), so make sure you mix the dyes before using them!

walkthrough.heading: The generals' verdict
walkthrough.body: Dye one Goblin mail orange, one blue, and leave the last one unaltered. Go back to Goblin Village, and give the orange goblin mail to the generals. They will have Grubfoot try it on, and say they do not like it. They will ask for blue armour. Give them the blue goblin mail. Again, they will have Grubfoot try it on, and again, it is rejected. They now want brown. Give them the plain brown goblin mail. Grubfoot tries it on for the last time. They decide that the original colour, brown, is best after all. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

steps: Offer to buy 2 woad leaves for 20 gp from Wyson the gardener in Falador Park.
Take 2 onions from the farm north of Rimmington.
Buy 3 redberries from Wydin's Food Store in Port Sarim '(hop worlds to replenish stock)'. Buy 2 extra Redberries if you plan on doing The Knight's Sword.
Take the ingredients, along with 15 gp to Aggie in Draynor Village.
Use the woad leaves on her to make a blue dye.
Use the redberries on her to make a red dye.
Use the onions on her to make a yellow dye Warning: Do not eat with left-click.
Use the red dye on the yellow dye to create an orange dye.
Continue with the normal guide.

name: Pirate's Treasure
start: Speak to Redbeard Frank at the northernmost dock at Port Sarim, just outside The Rusty Anchor.
description: Redbeard Frank knows the location of pirate treasure, but he'll only part with the knowledge for a bottle of Karamjan rum.
itemRequirements: Karamjan rum (obtainable during the quest for 30 coins)
White apron (obtainable during the quest in Port Sarim at Gerrant's Fishy Business.)
60 coins (only 30 are needed if using a Ring of charos(a))
recommendedItems: Fast travel to several locations
Port Sarim to start the quest - Amulet of glory to Draynor Village or Explorer's ring 2-4 or Teleport to House (Rimmington) or Skills necklace to Crafting Guild
Varrock (1 trip) - Varrock Teleport or Chronicle or Ring of wealth or Skills necklace
Falador Park (1 trip) - Ring of wealth or Falador Teleport
rewards: Access to One-Eyed Hector's Treasure Chest (contains a gold ring, an emerald, and 450 coins).
leagueRegion: <poem> Not completable, as it requires access to Misthalin. Unlocking Morytania will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Captain Redbeard
walkthrough.body: 60 coins. Talk to Redbeard Frank located in front of the northernmost dock in Port Sarim. Tell him you are in search of treasure, and he will ask you to bring him some Karamjan rum before he'll tell you where to find some. Walk south on the docks to see three sailors (NOT the Monks of Entrana). Talk to any one of these sailors to board the ship to Karamja for 30 coins (free using a Ring of Charos (a)). {{Clear}}

walkthrough.heading: Rum smuggling
walkthrough.body: 30 coins. {{Map|name=Pirate's Treasure crate|x=2939|y=3149|r=1|mtype=pin|align=right|caption=Location of the crate used to hide the rum.|width=200|height=200}} When you arrive in Karamja, follow the path to the west and enter the bar. Trade with Zembo and buy one Karamjan rum. 'Do not leave the island' with the rum - it will be confiscated by the officers as Asgarnia has banned the import of intoxicating spirits. The bottle will also break if you teleport or accept a random event where you would be temporarily teleported. You will need to find a method to smuggle the rum off the island. First, pick 10 bananas from the plantation to the north. Then talk to Luthas in his hut to the east of the plantation and ask him for a job, and he will hire you as his worker. Outside the south east corner of his hut is a crate. Use the rum on it to hide it in the crate, then "Fill Crate" on it to fill it with bananas. 'Note': If you get a message saying "Why would I want to do that?" make sure you have asked for employment first. Talk to Luthas again and he will pay you 30 coins for loading the crate. Ask him where the crate goes, and he will tell you they go to Wydin, who owns the food store in Port Sarim. Travel back to Port Sarim at the customs officer to the east for 30 coins (free with Ring of charos (a)).

walkthrough.heading: Retrieving the rum
walkthrough.body: {{Map|name=Chest|x=3219|y=3396|plane=1|mtype=pin|align=right|caption=Location of Hector's chest.|width=200|height=200}} Varrock]] and Falador Teleport Falador. Once you are in Port Sarim, make a quick stop at the fishing shop just to the west. Hanging on the back wall is a white apron. Take it and wear it. Talk to Wydin at his food store directly south of the fishing shop, and ask him for a job. He will agree as long as you are wearing your white apron. Enter the back room and search the crate with a banana on top of it. You will find the rum. 'Do not teleport with it in your inventory (including random events).' Head back to Redbeard Frank and give him the drink. Frank will give you a key to the chest found upstairs in Varrock's Blue Moon Inn, owned by the now deceased One-Eyed Hector.
