Travel to Varrock and head to the Blue Moon Inn located just north of the city's southern gate. Go upstairs and find the chest in the room at the end of the hall. Use the key on the chest to find a pirate message. It will give you a clue to the treasure's location. 'Be sure to read the clue'.

walkthrough.heading: Buried treasure
walkthrough.body: Spade, pirate message Travel to Falador Park, located in the north of Falador. If you don't yet have a spade, grab one from the estate agency just south-west of the park. Find the statue of Saradomin in the middle of the park, and notice where it's pointing. Note the configuration of the dirt, which vaguely makes an X. Stand in the middle of the dirt "X" and dig. An angry level-4 gardener will appear out of nowhere and attack you. You will be unable to dig again until you either kill him, or run out of the park to despawn him. Dig again in the same spot to get a casket and complete the quest. {{Map|name=Chest|x=2999|y=3383|plane=0|mtype=pin|align=right|caption=Location of the buried treasure.|width=200|height=200}} 'Congratulations, Quest Complete!'

update: The island of Karamja is open

steps: Talk to Redbeard Frank by the pub to the north Port Sarim dock.
Travel to Karamja for 30 coins (talk to Seaman Thresnor, Seaman Lorris, or Captain Tobias on the south-west docks).
Head west to the Karamja Wines, Spirits, and Beers bar and buy one Karamjan rum for 30 coins. (Do not try to leave the island with the rum.)
Grab 10 Bananas from the nearby trees.
Talk to Luthas the banana farmer about the customs workers, then talk to him again to ask for a job.
Place your rum in the crate outside, then right-click Fill to add the 10 bananas (the crate outside, not in the bedroom. Careful not to eat the bananas).
Talk to Luthas and get your payment from him.
Take the boat back to Port Sarim.
Take a white apron from the fishing store Gerrant's Fishy Business..
Talk to Wydin in the food store South of Gerrant's and get a job while wearing your white apron.
Search the crate with the banana on it to get the rum.
Give the rum to Redbeard Frank, he will give you a key.
Go upstairs in the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock and use your key on the chest in the room directly west. Read the pirate message.
Head to Falador Park.
If you didn't have a spade already, you can get one from the Estate agent's house on the south-west side of the park, right next to the study desk.
Dig in Falador park, kill the Gardener (or run away to despawn him).
Dig again to get a casket.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Dragon Slayer I
start: Speak to the Guildmaster in the Champions' Guild.
description: Prove yourself a true champion. Kill the mighty dragon Elvarg of Crandor and earn the right to buy and wear the Rune platebody.
itemRequirements: Unfired bowl (can be made with soft clay on a Potter's Wheel with Crafting 8 Crafting)
Wizard's mind bomb (can be bought in the Rising Sun Inn in Falador or The Toad and Chicken in Burthorpe)
Lobster pot (can be bought from any fishing shop)
Silk (can be bought from Thessalia for 30 coins or the Al Kharid silk stall for 3 coins -- members can steal it from the Ardougne silk stall with Thieving 20 Thieving)
Magic/ranged weapon as well as a law and air rune (to cast Telekinetic Grab if your Magic level is 33 or higher) 'or' 10,000 coins
90 steel nails (Members can buy these from the Sawmill operator north-east of Varrock, they can also be smithed at Smithing 34 Smithing using 6 steel bars by all players)
Free-to-play: Buy from Sawmill operator at the sawmill or pick up the spawns in the Graveyard of Shadows, level 19 Wilderness
Member: Several other spawn locations or buy them at the sawmill
recommendedItems: Combat 45
Magic 33(boostable), otherwise you will have to pay 10,000 coins.
Prayer 37(boostable) for Protect from Magic against Elvarg's magic attacks.
(Members only) Antifire potions to significantly lower Elvarg's dragonfire attack damage
Weight-reducing clothing (Members only) and stamina (Members only) or energy potions
Fast travel to several locations
Champions' Guild to start the quest, plus one additional trip - Chronicle, Varrock Teleport, or combat bracelet (Members only)
Edgeville (2 trips) - Amulet of glory (Members only), Combat bracelet (Members only), fairy ring dkr (Members only), Varrock Teleport, Canoe
Melzar's Maze (1 trip) - Teleport to House (Members only) (Rimmington), Skills necklace to Crafting Guild (Members only)
Ice Mountain (1 trip) - Combat bracelet to Edgeville Monastery (Members only), Amulet of glory to Edgeville (Members only), Falador Teleport

Port Sarim (1 trip) - Amulet of glory to Draynor Village (Members only), Explorer's ring 2-4 (Members only), Teleport to House (Rimmington) (Members only), Skills necklace to Crafting Guild (Members only)
'Optional:' Karamja Volcano for shortcut to return to the Elvarg fight - amulet of glory to Karamja (Members only)
requirements: Quest 32 Quest points to enter the Champions' Guild
The ability to defeat a level 83 dragon
rewards: The ability to be assigned Dragons as a Slayer task (obtainable immediately after starting the quest)
The ability to use dragonfire protection (partial completion required)
The ability to equip a green d'hide body, rune platebody, and dragon platebody
The ability to hire the ghost of Cabin Boy Jenkins as a crewmate with Sailing 60.
requiredFor: Freeing Sir Amik Varze (a Recipe for Disaster subquest)
ironmanConcerns: * Crafting 8 Crafting (boostable) to create an unfired bowl *(Free-to play only) Smithing 34 Smithing (boostable) to create steel nails
leagueRegion: <poem> Unlocking Varlamore will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: The Champions' Guild and Oziach
walkthrough.body: Head to the Champions' Guild immediately south of the southern gates of Varrock and ask the Guildmaster for a quest. He will tell you to visit Oziach, the maker of rune platebodies, who sets the tasks that champions must complete to earn the right to wear one. Oziach can be found in the north-west corner of Edgeville, near the Wilderness ditch and the Edgeville Monastery. Speak to him, and he will set the player the task of killing the dragon of Crandor. Return to the Guildmaster, who will recount the tale of Elvarg, the dragon that laid waste to the whole of Crandor, leaving a trio of wizards as the sole survivors. To reach Crandor, the player will need a ship capable of getting through dangerous reefs, a map to show the way, and protection against the dragon's breath. '''Important:' Ask him 'all the follow up questions below'; each one unlocks a stage of the quest. You will need to return later if you do not.'' Ask him how you can find the route to Crandor, and he will tell you that only one map exists - it was split into three pieces, each held by a wizard. Ask him where to find each map piece, and he will give you information about each piece, as well as give you a Maze key (requires free inventory space). Ask him where you can find the right ship, and he will suggest looking in Port Sarim. Ask him how to protect against the dragon's breath, and he will mention that Duke Horacio has a special shield which is enchanted against dragon's breath.

walkthrough.heading: Obtaining the anti-dragon shield
walkthrough.body: Non-ironmen may purchase the Anti-dragon shield on the Grand Exchange for {{Coins|{{GEP|Anti-dragon shield}}}}. Alternatively, you can obtain one for free from Duke Horacio on the floor 1 of Lumbridge Castle. The drop trick can be used to obtain several shields, which may be useful if you die during the dragon fight and need to return, as Elvarg shoots dragonfire immediately upon entering her arena. {{Clear}}

walkthrough.heading: Three pieces make a whole
walkthrough.body: The three map pieces may be collected in any order. After collecting all three, use any piece on another, and all three pieces will combine to form Crandor map. ====Melzar==== {{Main|Melzar's Maze}}'''Items required:' The Maze key, food, and combat equipment. (The most difficult enemy is the lesser demon; you can safespot it with Magic/Ranged and with melee as well.)'' Head to Melzar's Maze for the first map piece, located north-west of Rimmington, south of the Crafting Guild, and west of Port Sarim, with your Maze key and combat equipment. Food is recommended for lower level players. <gallery mode="packed" widths="200px"heights="220px"> File:Melzar's Maze map.png File:Lesser demon (Melzar's Maze) safespot.png File:Lesser demon (Melzar's Maze) safespot.gif </gallery> Enter the maze, where you will be required to identify monsters which look slightly different to their counterparts: {{Checklist| *Kill the one long-tailed small zombie rat to get a red key. *Enter the north-western red door (room with the spooky picture) and go up the ladder. *Kill the capeless, hooded ghost wearing a tube top to get a orange key (they are weak to air spells). *Enter the second most northern door (room with the ladder in the centre) and go up the ladder. *Kill the skeleton with a small, round shield to get a yellow key (they are weak to earth spells). *Enter the south-western door (room with the spooky picture) and go down the ladder at the end of the room, then go down two more ladders. *Kill the zombies until you get a blue key (they are weak to fire spells). *Enter the blue door. 'Exiting through the normal door will send you back to the beginning!' Melzar the Mad (level 43) will spawn. *Kill Melzar the Mad to get a magenta key. It is possible to safespot or flinch him by dragging him over to the southern side of the room (where you entered), and then running to the square inbetween the crate and the barrel, so that he gets stuck on the crate. *Enter the magenta door. In this room, there is a lesser demon (level 82) that you must kill to get a green key. It can be safespotted with Ranged or Magic (weak to water spells) by dragging the demon into the corridor, and then standing one square to the east of the magenta door. For melee, it can be flinched by dragging the demon into the corridor, attacking it at maximum attack range then walking one square west in a repetitive motion (see gif). *Use the green key on the green door then both 'open' and 'search' the chest to get a map part. *Go up the ladder to exit the maze. }} {{clear}} ====Thalzar==== An unfired bowl, a wizard's mind bomb, a lobster pot, and silk and Thalzar's magic chest.]]. Thalzar's room is at the north-east corner.]] Bring an unfired bowl, Wizard's mind bomb, silk and lobster pot to the Oracle, located on top of the northern end of Ice Mountain, south-west of the shabby tent. The mountain is directly west of the Edgeville Monastery entrance. Tell her you seek a piece of the map to the island of Crandor, and she will explain through riddle that the map piece is behind a door below, and that you require the items you have brought to open it. 'Note': If you didn't ask the Guildmaster about Thalzar's map piece, you won't have the option to ask the Oracle about the map. Descend the mountain and head slightly south, to enter the Dwarven Mine (using the ladder, under the canopy where all the dwarves are standing). Head to the square room at the north-east corner where you will find the magic door (see the attached map.) Use your silk, wizard's mind bomb ('Be careful to not drink it!'), unfired bowl and lobster pot on the door to open it. Open the chest and search for the second map piece. 'Note:' Using an incorrect item on the door will not affect the process. If you forgot an item, you may leave and return to the door - your progress will not be lost. {{clear}} ====Lozar==== 10,000 coins 'OR' air rune and law rune to cast telekinetic grab (33+ Magic required) + ranged/magic gear to attack Wormbrain the goblin {{Map|name=Dragon Slayer I|3015,3188|zoom=1|rectX=18|rectY=26|mtype=rectangle|align=right|height=200|width=200|caption=Port Sarim jail}} For the third and final piece, the Guildmaster mentioned that one of the goblins from Goblin Village probably has the map piece, after Lozar was slain by goblins. It is possible to skip visiting Goblin Village - General Bentnoze would have told you that Wormbrain the thief was caught, and is currently in the jail in Port Sarim. Head to Port Sarim jail, which is in the south of the port. Wormbrain is in the third cell from the entrance - you can either talk to him to pay him {{Coins|10000}} in exchange for the map piece, or attack him using Ranged or Magic if you want to use Telekinetic grab to obtain it. Once his health reaches zero (he has 5 Hitpoints), he will say {{Overhead|Ow!}} and drop the map part for you to telegrab. 'Note': If you didn't ask the Guildmaster about Lozar's map piece, you will not be able to attack Wormbrain. Now that you have all three pieces, combine them to make the Crandor map.

walkthrough.heading: Lady Lumbridge
walkthrough.body: A hammer, 90 steel nails, 3 planks, Crandor map, and 2,000 coins Take your nails, planks, hammer, and {{Coins|2000}}, and head to Port Sarim. If you do not yet have a hammer, you can buy one from a Trader Crewmember on the dock to the south (Members only). Nine planks can be made at the sawmill in free-to-play, but only once. The Sawmill operator will only talk to you after you have purchased the ship. Look for Klarense, a sailor, who is located on the second-most southern dock. Talk to him and he will ask if you are interested in buying his ship, the Lady Lumbridge. Reply that you'd like to buy her, and he will sell you the ship for {{Coins|2000}}. The boat is not yet seaworthy, and you will need to fix it first. Board the ship and climb down the ladder. Patch the hole in the ship's hull by clicking it three times, and the ship will be seaworthy again. You now need to find a captain to sail it. Go to Draynor Village and talk to Ned, located in the house just north-east of the Wise Old Man's home. Ask him if he will take you to Crandor, and he'll agree to sail you to Crandor 'if' you have already repaired the ship and hand him the Crandor map.

walkthrough.heading: Preparing for the fight
walkthrough.body: Anti-dragon shield, combat equipment and food ==== Dragonfire ==== Without the use of dragonfire protection, Elvarg's dragonfire can deal up to '70' damage at range. Equipping an anti-dragon shield is 'highly recommended' to mitigate this at a minimum; Protect from Magic will also reduce some of the damage. Members may also drink an antifire potion or super antifire potion in combination with the other two methods. See the below table for the maximum damage Elvarg will deal based on your combination of dragonfire protection used. {{:Dragonfire/Elvarg}} Note that every dragonfire attack from Elvarg will also drain 10% of your remaining Prayer, rounded down. ====General preparations==== As well as dragonfire protection, consider taking prayer potions or restore potions with you for when Elvarg drains your prayer, if you plan to use it during the battle. Lower levelled players may find it useful to use rings of recoil to deal additional damage, as Elvarg's fast hits make it particularly useful in dealing back damage. The rest of your inventory should be filled with food - lobsters (12 HP) should be enough for most players with a combat level of around 40 and appropriate gear, but swordfish (14 HP) or higher would be useful. You may also consider taking a teleportation method with you, either to escape death or to leave the island after killing her. 'Note': While it will allow you to set up a cannon in the area, it will not attack Elvarg. ====Choosing a combat style==== Before fighting Elvarg, you'll need to choose a combat style: melee, ranged or magic. 'Melee' This is the preferred style, as Elvarg will not solely use her dragonfire attack but also melee attacks when standing next to her, and the latter are less powerful. You may also consider using flinching (see the tips section below for more information). Equip good-quality armour; preferably adamant armour or better. Like all dragons, Elvarg is weak to stab attacks; see the page about Attack types. As such, consider wielding a stab weapon: a sword or dagger instead of a scimitar. Adamant or better is recommended. For free-to-play players, a rune sword is recommended as it possesses the highest stab bonus in F2P, with its aggressive style the optimum for most players. A rune longsword, rune scimitar, battleaxe or mace are less effective but may still do decent enough damage. Elvarg is not immune to poison, so adding weapon poison would turn the battle even more in your favour; thus a poisoned dagger would be effective. 'Ranged' Elvarg is also weak against ranged attacks, but as you should be using an Anti-dragon shield, you must use a one-handed weapon such as a crossbow. This may be trickier for Free-to-play players who only have access to the weakest types and bronze bolts. For Members this is more viable, and they should use the best crossbow with the best bolts they can use (preferably poisoned). Make sure you have Auto Retaliate on and select the Rapid firing style. 'Magic' While Elvarg, like many other dragons, has somewhat strong defences against magic, she has a 30% elemental weakness to water spells. This means that water spells have their accuracy and damage increased by 30% against her. As such, mages should use the strongest water spell they have available.

walkthrough.heading: Travelling to Crandor & locating Elvarg
walkthrough.body: {{Map|2840,3268|align=left|width=220|height=280|zoom=2|caption=The surface of Crandor.}} Head back to and board your ship to meet up with Ned and Cabin boy Jenkins. Speak with Ned to depart and a cutscene will begin... After crashing on the southern side of the island, make your way to the top of the volcano (the dungeon marker on your minimap), avoiding aggressive skeletons, moss giants, hobgoblins, and lesser demons. Enter the hole and a short cutscene plays, followed by abruptly finding yourself surrounded by skeletons (level 25). Down the corridor you'll find large skeletons (level 45), and you'll see Elvarg in the main chamber behind stalagmites and stalactites. 'Note': If you are a Member, you can climb back up the rope to complete a medium task in the Karamja Diary, then climb back down. 'Note:' Before fighting Elvarg, there is a wall to the south you can open. Once opened, it will allow you to travel back to Crandor from the Karamja Volcano, by climbing down the rocks on the eastern side of the volcano, then heading north. If you die during the fight, you would otherwise need the materials to repair the boat again (90 steel nails, 3 planks and a hammer). Once you have unlocked this shortcut, trying to repair the ship will result in the message {{Mes|You don't need to mess about with broken ships now that you have found the secret passage from Karamja}}, and you will be unable to use it to return to Crandor. After the quest has been completed, you will be able to return to Crandor via the Karamja Volcano regardless of whether you opened it during the quest or not. Now, go back to the main chamber, climb over the low stalagmites, and fight Elvarg (see section below for tips).

walkthrough.heading: Tips for the fight & potential strategies
walkthrough.body: *Make sure that you have your dragonfire protection active before you enter the arena, as Elvarg, unlike other green dragons, can use dragonfire attacks at a distance. *You may consider standing under Elvarg while eating, as it takes her a moment to move and hit you again. *If you happen to teleport away during battle, she will take some time before fully healing, and may still be missing health if you can return quickly. * Aside from teleporting, you can exit the arena whenever you'd like, however re-entering the arena will result in guaranteed dragon fire attack. * Members who are unable to kill Elvarg in one trip may choose to escape through the shortcut to Karamja and go through the cave entrance to Mor Ul Rek to get extra food from their bank. If you return quickly, Elvarg will not have enough time to heal. Be sure to keep enough food to survive being hit by monsters on the way. *Elvarg can be flinched using melee attacks. Flinching is a combat tactic that entails attacking an opponent while it is out of combat and going to a safespot before the monster can retaliate. This can and will still go wrong every now and then, so it is still recommended to bring food and have a decent combat level. *To flinch her, stand in the south-eastern corner of her cave, in the game square directly next to the north-west corner of the little lava pool. You'll also need to get Elvarg to stand directly left of the skeleton on the ground to the north-west. (See the image for the place to stand.) If you pull this off, she will be unable to hit you; this is a safespot. From there, begin to attack her, and immediately click on the north-west corner (don't click on a rat) of the little lava pool to walk back to the safespot. Wait for Elvarg's health bar to disappear, and repeat the process. {{clear}}

walkthrough.heading: Returning to Oziach
walkthrough.body: Once Elvarg is defeated and you have triumphed, you will automatically collect Elvarg's head if you have a free inventory slot (not required to complete the quest). You will need to return to Edgeville; either teleport out, or go through the shortcut and past the deadly red spiders, to the south-east of the dungeon where the skeletons are, and climb up the hanging rope to arrive on top of the Karamja volcano. Talk to Oziach and the player will inform him that they have slain the dragon. Impressed, Oziach will agree to sell you rune platebodies. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

steps: Talk to the Guildmaster in the Champions' Guild.
Talk to Oziach in Edgeville.

Talk to the Guildmaster in the Champions' Guild. Make sure you get the maze key by asking about Melzar's map piece, and also ask about Thalzar and Lozar's map pieces as well as where to find the right ship.
If you don't already have an anti-dragon shield, speak to Duke Horacio on the floor 1 of the Lumbridge Castle.
Map pieces can be obtained in any order.
Talk to Oracle on Ice Mountain. Make sure you have talked to the Guildmaster about where the Thalzar's map piece is.

Enter the Dwarven mine and 'use' silk, lobster pot, unfired bowl, (make sure to right click) wizard's mind bomb on the magic door at the north-east side of the mine. You should automatically enter the door.

Enter the magic door, open the chest, and 'search' the chest to receive a map piece. Press space or ensure that you finish the dialogue. (Re-entry doesn't require the re-use of the items if you make a mistake.)
Once you've gotten the Maze key from the Guildmaster head to Rimmington.
Enter Melzar's Maze.
Kill the small zombie rat with a long tail to get the key and enter the north-western door and climb up the ladder.
Kill the ghost wearing a hood, a tube top, and no cape to get the key and enter the second door from the north on the eastern wall and climb up the ladder.
Kill the skeleton with the round shield to get the key and enter the westmost door on the southern wall and climb down the ladder 3 times.
Kill the zombies to get the key and enter the blue door.
Kill Melzar the Mad to get the key and enter the purple (magenta) door.
Kill the lesser demon to get the key and enter the green door. (Can be safespotted by luring him to the magenta door)
Open and search the chest to receive a map piece.
Go to the jail in Port Sarim.
Either kill Wormbrain with ranged/magic/halberd and telegrab the map piece or pay him 10,000 coins for it. Make sure you have talked to the Guildmaster about where the Lozar's map piece is.
After obtaining all 3, combine them by using them on each other.
Talk to the Guildmaster and ask him where to find a ship and captain.
Grab 3 wood planks, 90 steel nails, a hammer, and 2,000 coins out of the bank.
Talk to Klarense in the southern docks of Port Sarim by the Void Outpost boat and pay him 2,000 coins.
Go on board, climb down the ladder and repair the hole 3 times.
Talk to Ned in Draynor Village with the map in your inventory.
Prepare for the fight. Make sure you have your Antifire potion and Anti-dragon shield with you.
Return to the boat you previously repaired in Port Sarim. Board the ship and talk to Captain Ned.
Climb on top of the volcano and enter the hole. (After the cutscene climb back out of the hole for a Karamja medium task.)
(Optional) Before teleporting out, head south from Elvarg's cave and open the wall to unlock another Karamja medium task.

Head south and kill Elvarg. Depending on your level, you may flinch Elvarg in the south-east corner of her cave for a long, but safe fight. You will automatically collect her head as proof of your victory.
Talk to Oziach in Edgeville.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Druidic Ritual
start: Speak to Kaqemeex in the stone circle north of Taverley.
description: The Druids north of Taverley need help making a potion to reclaim the stone circle south of Varrock.
recommendedItems: Combat 10
rewards: The ability to use the Herblore skill
leagueRegion: <poem> Unlocking Varlamore will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: The stone circle
walkthrough.body: .]] Head to the stone circle on the hill just north of Taverley, immediately east of the road to Burthorpe. Talk to Kaqemeex and tell him you are in search of a quest. He will mention that the stone circle south of Varrock used to belong to the druids of Guthix, but the dark wizards have cursed the rocks. They are in need of an adventurer to help purify the circle. He asks you to speak to Sanfew, who is working on a purification ritual. Sanfew can be found to the south, upstairs in the big octagonal Herblore shop marked with a herb. Tell him that you were sent to help, and Sanfew will request raw rat meat, raw bear meat, raw beef and raw chicken, to be dipped in the Cauldron of Thunder for the ritual.

walkthrough.heading: Acquiring the meat
walkthrough.body: :Skip this section if you already have the meat. These meats can all be bought on the Grand Exchange, or purchased at Rufus' Meat Emporium in Canifis after the completion of Quest Priest in Peril. If obtaining the meat by killing the animals, Lands End in Great Kourend has a bear, chicken and rat in close vicinity. You can reach the area via Veos in Port Sarim after the completion of Quest X Marks the Spot. The cow can be killed in the Lumbridge pasture. Alternately, there is the bear near the building just west of Ice Mountain, the chicken and cow at the farm just south-east of Falador, and the giant rat near the graveyard just north of the church below Port Sarim.

walkthrough.heading: Enchanting the meat
walkthrough.body: location.]] Raw bear meat, Raw rat meat, Raw chicken and Raw beef The Cauldron of Thunder is located in Taverley Dungeon. Head south of Taverley and down the ladder. Head north, past the level 22 and level 25 skeletons until you see a gate to the east, with two level 19 suits of armour on either side. Try to open the gate and they will attack you (regardless of combat level). Either kill them, or simply continue to click on the gate until it opens. Enchant the meat by using each piece on the Cauldron of Thunder inside the room, and you will notice they will turn blue. Once you have enchanted all four meats, return to Sanfew, who will take them and thank the player for bringing the druids one step closer to reclaiming their stone circle. He then asks the player to speak again to Kaqemeex. Return to Kaqemeex, who will teach the player the basics of the Herblore skill. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Lost City
start: Go to Lumbridge Swamp. Talk to the campers there.
description: Can you find the legendary lost city of Zanaris?
itemRequirements: Woodcutting axe (you will need to bank the axe before accessing Entrana - you cannot use a blessed axe)
recommendedItems: Combat 45
Weight-reducing clothing and stamina or energy potions
Food (armour is not allowed on Entrana)
If using Magic for the Entrana Dungeon (recommended):
Magic 13 Magic and enough runes to cast Fire Strike for the Tree Spirit which has a 35% Fire weakness OR
Magic 39 Magic and enough runes to cast Crumble Undead against the Zombies and the Tree Spirit, who are susceptible to it (about 65 casts should be enough)
A Celastrus bark to fletch into a battlestaff for the added Magic bonus (requires Fletching 40 Fletching)
If using Melee for the Entrana Dungeon:
Prayer potion (Prayer is almost fully drained when entering the dungeon)
Rings of recoil
If using Ranged as an alternative to Magic against the Zombies (not recommended for the Tree spirit):
Arrows, bow string and an unstrung bow
Fast travel to several locations:
Lumbridge Swamp to start the quest (plus one additional trip) - Necklace of passage or Ring of the elements or Amulet of glory or Lumbridge Teleport
Entrana (1 trip) - Monk of Entrana on the second northern dock at Port Sarim or Balloon transport system.
An instant teleport to leave the Entrana Dungeon (the only alternative is to leave via the Magic Door to level 32 wilderness)
requirements: Ability to kill a level 101 Tree spirit with limited armour and weapons.
rewards: Ability to buy and wield dragon longswords and dragon daggers (with level 60 Attack)
Ability to make cosmic runes with the Runecraft skill
A permanent portal to Puro-Puro in the wheat field east of the fairy ring in Zanaris.
Tree spirit accessible in the Nightmare Zone.
ironmanConcerns: The player is required to go to Entrana.
leagueRegion: <poem> Unlocking Varlamore will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Searching for Zanaris
walkthrough.body: {{Map|name=Warrior|x=3150|y=3205|plane=0|r=4|mtype=square|caption=The start point.|align=right|width=200|height=200}} A woodcutting axe Head to the north-western edge of the Lumbridge Swamp, just south of Draynor Village, where you will find an adventurers' camp. Ask the warrior why he is camped out here, and he will let it slip that he is searching for Zanaris. Ask who's Zanaris, and he will also let it slip that Zanaris is actually a hidden magical city. Finally, after asking him how he plans to find it, and then observing that it looks like he doesn't know, he will accidentally reveal that there is a leprechaun hiding in a nearby tree who knows how to get to Zanaris. Look for a nearby tree that only has a "Chop" option instead of a "Chop down" option. Chop it and a leprechaun named Shamus will pop out. Shamus will mention that the player will need to visit the shed in the swamp; ask him how Zanaris fits in a shed, and he will tell you that the doorway is a portal. However, to enter the portal you will first need a Dramenwood staff, crafted from a Dramen tree, found only in the Entrana Dungeon. {{Clear}}

walkthrough.heading: The island of Entrana
walkthrough.body: A knife Monks of Entrana do not allow armour or weapons on Entrana, but you can take: * Items to make armour, such as a needle, thread, and dragonhide or leather * Some clothing options, such as H.A.M Robes and full graceful * Celastrus bark to make a battlestaff * A knife and logs (or unstrung bow), and a bow string to make a bow * Arrows * Runes (for combat and teleports) * Potions * Food * Jewellery * God books * Blessings {{Map|caption=The route on Entrana to reach the dungeon.|align=right|width=250|height=250|mtype:line,2833:3335,2845:3335,2848:3338,2855:3338,2855:3340,2858:3340,2859:3341,2859:3355,2856:3358,2856:3373,2854:3375,2842:3375,2840:3374,2820:3374,stroke-width:4|mtype:pin,2820:3374,title:Entrana Dungeon}} Head to Port Sarim and find the Monks of Entrana, south of the Rusty Anchor Inn on the second jetty. Use the nearby bank deposit box to store your axe if you still have it, and any other gear that violates the restrictions of Entrana. Speak to one of the monks to travel to Entrana. On arrival head east around the church, then north over the bridge. West of the bridge you will find a cave monk next to a dungeon entrance. :'Note:' When you enter the dungeon, your Prayer will be reduced to nearly 0. Make sure not to have crafted any weapons before climbing down the ladder, or you will be kicked off the island. Climb down into the dungeon, and kill the zombies (level 25) until one of them drops a bronze axe. There is a safespot by the mushrooms against the west wall, and another by the small group of mushrooms in the southern part of the zombie area. :'Note:' If using the Crumble Undead spell to fight zombies, make sure to save runes for 20-30 casts against the Tree spirit later. Once you have obtained an axe, head south through the cave until you see some greater demons and a small cave off to the south. :'Warning: Do not go through the magical door to the east, it takes you to level 32 wilderness'. Run past the demons to the south, and chop the Dramen Tree found inside (Woodcutting 36) - a level 101 tree spirit will appear.

walkthrough.heading: Fighting the tree spirit
walkthrough.body: {{Map|3204,3169|r=3|mtype=square|caption=Entrance to Zanaris.|align=right|width=200|height=200}} If using Magic or Ranged, you can utilise a safespot by cutting the tree from the south, then running inbetween the three mushrooms to the south-west once the tree spirit spawns. :{{Color|red|Warning:}} The tree spirit will respawn after cutting the tree again if you kill it from outside of the room. :'Note': Rings of recoil can be used and other players can assist in the kill, but the questing player must deal at least 1 damage themselves for the kill to count. Once you've defeated the tree spirit, cut the tree again to get a Dramen branch, then use a knife on it to make the Dramen staff (Crafting 31). :'Tip:' A dramen branch is required for the Freeing Sir Amik Varze subquest of Recipe for Disaster, and another is useful for the smuggling into Thorvald's trial in The Fremennik Trials, but do not make them into staves yet. Cutting at least three branches is recommended. 'Teleport out' and head to the tool shed in the centre of Lumbridge Swamp. Equip the Dramen staff before entering, and upon opening the door you'll find yourself in Zanaris. 'Congratulations, quest complete!' {{Clear}}

name: Witch's House
start: Talk to the boy near the gate entrance of Taverley.
description:
A young boy who lives in Taverley has kicked his ball into the garden of a scary old lady.

He asks you to get it back for him. This proves more difficult than it first sounds.
itemRequirements: Cheese (You may wish to bring several in case you mess up. One source is in Draynor Village - Aggie's house)
Leather gloves or any of the gloves listed here (obtainable during the quest, may take some time)
recommendedItems: Combat 35
Weapon, armour and some food
4 free inventory slots
requirements: The ability to defeat 4 monsters from level 19 to 53 without a break.
rewards: Witch's experiment (multiple forms) accessible in the Nightmare Zone.
requiredFor: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide
leagueRegion: <poem> Asgarnia — location requirement </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Lost ball
walkthrough.body: .]] Head to Taverley and talk to the boy near the eastern entrance along the hedges. He will start crying; ask him what's the matter, and he will say that he kicked his ball over the hedge into the garden, and the witch living in the house put it in her shed. The boy wants you to get it back for him.

walkthrough.heading: Breaking in
walkthrough.body: .]] Cheese, gloves, combat equipment Head west then north around the hedge to the front door of the house - it is locked. Look-under the pot north of the door to find a door key and enter the house. Read the entire diary on the table. Go down the ladder in the northern room to enter the basement. If you don't already have leather gloves, search the boxes for a pair, however it may take many attempts to find them. Equip your gloves, go through the gate, and search the cupboard for the magnet. Go back up the ladder and into the southern room with the door that leads to the garden. Drop your cheese or use it on the mouse hole. Suddenly, a mouse will come out; use the magnet on the mouse and it will unlock the door. 'Be quick or the mouse will leave, and you will lose the cheese.' Enter the door into the garden. {{Clear|left}}

walkthrough.heading: Getting past the witch
walkthrough.body: Once in the garden, you will see the witch walking back and forth in the middle. You cannot walk through the garden, and must walk around it while using the hedges as cover until you reach the fountain. If the witch catches you, she will teleport you out of the garden and you will have to repeat most of the previous steps. Search the fountain to obtain a key. {{Clear|left}}

walkthrough.heading: Witch's experiment
walkthrough.body: Head to the shed (east of the courtyard) and use the key on the door. Do 'not' attempt to take the ball otherwise the Witch's experiment will lower your stats. Attack the Witch's experiment. Each time you kill the experiment's current form it changes to a stronger form. You have to kill the experiment four times before it is defeated - the first stage is a Skavid (level 19), then a spider (level 30), then a bear (level 42), and finally a wolf (level 53). If you flee during the battle you will have to start over..]] :'Note:' Rings of recoil may be used - a maximum of 4 will be required, as the experiments combined have a total of 144 hitpoints. :'Note:' You cannot use a Dwarf multicannon in the shed. The first and second forms can be safespotted with Magic or flinched with Melee by going into the north-east corner and waiting for the experiment to move south of you. Once it is in position, run past it, then walk on top of it. After this, walk west 1 tile so you are positioned diagonally from the Witch's experiment, then you're free to attack. The third and fourth can also be safespotted by walking to the south wall of the shed between the sacks and the crate with the ball on it and using Ranged or Magic attacks from there. Once you have killed the Witch's experiment, take the ball and return it to the boy. 'Do not let the witch see you' or she will teleport you outside and 'you will lose the ball'. You can avoid needing to pass her by teleporting out. If she does catch you, the doors to the shed will need to be unlocked again. Although the creature will respawn, it will not attack you. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

steps: Talk to the Boy south-east of the long garden in Taverley, next to the members gate.
Head west, then north to the front door of the house, across from the player-owned house portal.
Look-under the potted plant closest to the door for a door key and enter the door.
Read the Diary on the table
Climb down the ladder to the north, equip gloves, and enter the gate. (The boxes can be searched for a pair of leather gloves.)
Equip your leather gloves before opening the gate.
Search the cupboard for a magnet.
Climb up the ladder and go to the small southern room.
Drop cheese in the room and a mouse will come out.
'QUICKLY' use the magnet on the mouse.
Go around the garden to the fountain without being caught by the Witch. (Full run energy or a stamina potion may be useful.)
Note: Use the hedges, getting caught means repeating all previous steps except for getting the door key. You 'cannot' walk over the grass.
Check the fountain.
Go to the shed on the east and use the key on the door.
'Warning:' Attempting to take the ball now makes the Witch's experiment lower your combat stats.'''
Kill the Witch's experiment in all four forms.
Low levels can use the north-eastern corner to step under the first and second forms of the Witch's experiment until it goes north where it is safespottable with magic 1 tile south-west.
The third and fourth forms can be safespotted in the south of the shed past the ball.
Take the ball.
Leave the Witch's house by teleporting out, or by exiting through the garden then the front door.
Do not get caught or you will have to get the ball again. If the ball does not spawn when you lose it, hop worlds.
Go back to the boy and give him the ball.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Merlin's Crystal
aliases: Get the magic words for Merlin's crystal at the altar
start: Talk to King Arthur in Camelot.
description: The wizard Merlin has been trapped in a magical crystal by the witch Morgan Le Faye. So far, King Arthur hasn't been able to figure out how to free his mentor from his crystal prison. Can you help?
itemRequirements: Bucket of wax (obtainable during the quest with either the Beekeeper's outfit or insect repellent; a bucket spawns near the east gate of the beehive enclosure)
recommendedItems: Combat 20
Stamina or energy potions
Fast travel to several locations
Camelot (Camelot teleport)
Falador (Falador teleport)
Varrock (Varrock teleport, Chronicle or combat bracelet to the Champions' Guild)
Taverley (Taverley teleport, Balloon Transport System or Teleport to House if your house is in Taverley)
Port Sarim (Explorer's Ring 2, Rat Pits or Pest Control minigame teleport, or Teleport to House if your house is in Rimmington)
enemiesToDefeat: Giant bat (level 27) (optional, to acquire bat bones)
rewards: Ability to claim 5 Kudos and an Antique lamp rewarding 1,000 XP in any skill of at least level 20 from Historian Minas after completion of the quest
Appointment with a title as a Honorary Knight of the Round Table.
leagueRegion: <poem> Unlocking Asgarnia will auto-complete the quest Unlocking Fremennik will auto-complete the quest Unlocking Kandarin will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Merlin's predicament
walkthrough.body:
{{map|width=250|height=250|align=right|zoom=2|x=2759|y=3500|caption= {{legend|#F0FF00|caption=King Arthur}} {{legend|#00FF00|caption=Sir Gawain}} |mtype:pin,icon:yellowPin,2764:3515 |mtype:pin,2763:3506 |mtype:text,class:,label:Camelot
Castle,2759:3484 }} Head to Camelot, east of Seers' Village. Ask King Arthur if you can join the Knights of the Round Table, and he'll suggest you complete a quest first to prove yourself; Merlin has been found trapped in a crystal. He wants you to ask the other knights for ideas on how to rescue him. {{Clear|left}}

walkthrough.heading: Gathering information
walkthrough.body: Speak to Sir Gawain, found either within the castle or roaming in the courtyard. Ask him how Merlin got trapped, and he will suspect it to be the work of Morgan Le Faye. However, he does not know how to get into her keep, which is guarded by Mordred and his group of renegade knights. Next, talk to Sir Lancelot on the floor 1. Ask him if he has any ideas on how to get into the keep. He will mention that there is a sea entrance to the keep, and that the knights get all of their deliveries by boat from Catherby. {{Clear|left}}

walkthrough.heading: Infiltrating the keep
walkthrough.body: Now that you have a lead, follow the road south-east to Catherby. If you do not already have a bucket of wax, pick up the nearby insect repellent for use later, which can be found on a table in the house containing Perdu just north of the bank. Ensure you have your combat equipment, then head just north of the dock between the bank and the Candle Shop, where you'll find a few crates against the back of the shop. Click on them to hide inside. There will be a bit of dialogue as workers come to pack you up and put you in the boat. After a while, you'll end up in the Keep Le Faye; when prompted, choose yes to climb out.

walkthrough.heading: Defeating Mordred
walkthrough.body: Head up the stairs to the top floor, ignoring the renegade knights that are wandering around the castle. You should find Sir Mordred (level 39); fight him, and just as you are about to defeat him, Morgan Le Faye will appear and beg for her sons life. '''Do not select the option to kill him or interrupt the conversation, or you'll need to fight Mordred again. Running out of Prayer will interrupt it.''' Agree to spare him in return for information on how to untrap Merlin, and she will tell you that you will need a magic symbol, bat bones, and a black candle, in order to summon a mighty spirit. You'll need to bind the spirit with magic words, and then obtain the sword Excalibur to finally shatter the crystal. {{Clear|left}}

walkthrough.heading: Obtaining the items
walkthrough.body: bread, bat bones (obtainable below), bucket of wax (obtainable below) ====Bat bones==== If you did not bring bat bones, you can obtain some by descending the stairs to the ground floor and leaving through the doors, then killing the giant bats around the keep. :'Note:' Upon leaving the keep, you will only be able to return through the Catherby crates. ====Black candle==== The black candle can be obtained by bringing a bucket of wax to the candle maker in Catherby, located in his house west of the bank. Ask him about black candles, then talk to him again to give him the wax. If you do not yet have a bucket of wax, head to the fenced-in area north of the keep, by the flax field. Pick up a bucket by the gate. If you have insect repellent, use it on one of the beehives, then use the bucket on the beehive to obtain your bucket of wax. If you wear the Beekeeper's outfit, you can simply click the beehive with the bucket in your inventory, without needing to use insect repellant. ====Excalibur==== Bread The sword is kept by The Lady of the Lake, found by the lake within Taverley, in the peninsula just south of the Hot Air Balloon. Tell her you seek Excalibur, and she will say that she will only give it to one who is worthy and good. She has set a test for you; she wants you to first enter the Port Sarim Jeweller's shop. Head to Port Sarim. If you don't have any bread, you can make bread dough on the cooking range just south of the Jeweller's shop. Purchase a pot of flour from Wydin's Food Store, a bucket from the Trader crewmember's on the southernmost dock, fill it at the sink east of the magic shop, then use it on the flour to make bread dough for cooking. Alternately, if you have completed X Marks the Spot, you can travel via Veos to Port Piscarilius, and head west to the Kourend Castle Baker's Stall. to purchase some bread. Open the door to the jeweller's shop and a beggar will approach, asking for food to feed his starving family. Give him the loaf of bread. When you do, he will change into the Lady of the Lake, who gives you Excalibur for passing the test. 'You must finish this dialogue or you will need another piece of bread to repeat it.' {{clear|left}}

walkthrough.heading: Chaos altar inscription
walkthrough.body: {{Map|mtype=pin|3258,3381|align=right|caption=Location of the inscription.|width=200|height=200}} Finally, you will need the magic words for the spell. Head to the Zamorak chaos temple in the south-east corner of Varrock. "Check" the altar to find the words needed: Snarthon Candtrick Termanto. 'Finishing this dialogue is required to progress further.'

walkthrough.heading: Breaking the Crystal
walkthrough.body: Excalibur, black candle, tinderbox, bat bones Now that you have all the required items and the magic words, return to Camelot, where you will find the magical symbol on the north-east side of the castle's garden, just inside the fence. Light your black candle and 'drop' the bat bones in the circle ('DO NOT BURY THEM'). A demonic spirit named Thrantax the Mighty will appear, and you will be presented with a sequence of words. The correct incantation is "'Snarthon Candtrick Termanto'". If you get it right, the spirit will obey you. :'Warning:' If you recite the wrong phrase, the spirit will attack you, and you will have to get a new black candle and try again. Be careful as the spirit is level 92, with a max hit of 10, and can hit rather accurately. Once under your control, the spirit will offer a boon, which the player uses to make the request to free Merlin. After granting your boon, he will disappear. Head into Camelot Castle, and climb up the south-east ladder to the very top of the south-east tower, where Merlin is imprisoned in a blue crystal. Use Excalibur on the crystal, and it will shatter. Head back down and talk to King Arthur, who will dub the player an honorary Knight Of The Round Table. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

steps: Talk to King Arthur.
Talk to Sir Gawain, who can be found in the courtyard to the south or nearby in the castle.
Talk to Sir Lancelot upstairs.
Go to Catherby.
If you didn't bring a bucket of wax, grab insect repellent in the house north of the bank in Catherby.
Use the insect repellent on one of the beehives to the west with an empty bucket (a bucket can be found near the beehives) in your inventory to get a bucket of wax.
Hide in the crate east of the candle maker's shop. Wait and finish the cutscene. Climb out of the crate.
Climb to the top floor. The Renegade Knights will attack you on your way up.

Attack Sir Mordred. He cannot be safespotted, but he can be flinched using the stairs (position him on the square left of the stairs whilst flinching from the square north-east of him). He can also be killed with rings of recoils or by another account poisoning and attacking right before his death.

When Sir Mordred reaches 0 hitpoints, Morgan Le Faye will appear and ask that you spare him. Spare his life to discover how to save Merlin. Warning: Do 'not' interrupt the dialogue or you will have to fight Sir Mordred again.
If you don't already have bat bones, exit the keep through the west doors and kill a bat before leaving.
Can be recoiled down after dealing a 0 and not splashing Magic.
Talk to the candle-maker in Catherby.
Talk to him again for a black candle.
Talk to The Lady of the Lake south-east of Taverley on the peninsula.
Go to Port Sarim. (Make sure you have bread in your inventory.)
Enter the jewellery shop to the north.
Give the beggar your bread. Finish the conversation.
Go to the Zamorakian temple in the south-east corner of Varrock.
Check the Chaos Altar's inscription.
Return to Camelot with a tinderbox and enter the castle gates.
Go to the ritual site at the north-east corner of the Camelot castle grounds (a red star in the middle of 8 columns).
Stand on the star and light the black candle.
'Drop' the bat bones on the star.
The magic words are "Snarthon Candtrick Termanto".
Enter the castle and climb to the top of the south-east tower.
Smash the giant crystal with Excalibur. ('Does not' require 20 Attack, just use Excalibur on the crystal instead of attempting to wield it)
Talk to King Arthur.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Heroes' Quest
start: Speak to Achietties by the entrance to the Heroes' Guild, between Taverley and Burthorpe.
description: Prove you are worthy to enter the Heroes' Guild. To prove your status as a hero you will need to obtain a number of items. There are many challenges standing between you and these items.
itemRequirements: Ice gloves (obtainable during the quest) or Smiths gloves (i)

Dusty key (obtainable during the quest; if travelling to Taverley Dungeon for the lava eel, without 70 Agility) 'OR' a knife or slash weapon (if travelling to the Lava Maze for the lava eel) 'OR' 60 Sailing level (if travelling to the Charred Dungeon)
Harralander potion (unf) (or a harralander and a vial of water)
Black full helm (trimmed will not work)
Black platelegs (plateskirt or trimmed will not work)
Some form of Ranged or Magic attack method
recommendedItems: Combat 50
Weapons and armour to kill the Ice Queen
Stamina or energy potions
Anti-dragon or dragonfire shield to protect against the blue dragons' dragonfire breath
Antifire potion to protect against dragonfire breath (Note: Using both the potion and shield fully negates dragonfire damage)
Fast travel to several locations
Burthorpe (games necklace or Burthorpe Games Room Minigame Teleport)
Varrock (Varrock teleport, Chronicle, ring of wealth to the Grand Exchange or combat bracelet to the Champions' Guild)
Brimhaven (Brimhaven teleport, Teleport to House if it is in Brimhaven, charter ship or ship from Ardougne or Rimmington to Brimhaven or amulet of glory to Karamja)
enemiesToDefeat: Ice Queen (level 111) (unless you already have Ice Gloves)
rewards: The ability to purchase and wield dragon battleaxes and maces
Access to the Fountain of Heroes, where players can recharge their amulets of glory
Ability to use Charge dragonstone jewellery scrolls.
Ability to recharge amulets of glory at the Fountain of Rune (This grants 6 charges instead of the usual 4)
ironmanConcerns: The player briefly visits Entrana. *Obtaining black armour for Black Arm Gang members **The helm and legs can be purchased from the Champions' Guild and the platebody can be obtained from Horvik's Armour Shop in Varrock
leagueRegion: <poem> Unlocking Asgarnia will auto-complete the quest Unlocking Fremennik will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: The greatest heroes of the land
walkthrough.body: Talk to Achietties outside the Heroes' Guild just south of Burthorpe about joining the guild. If you meet the requirements, she will acknowledge your questing prowess and set you the entry tasks. She will tell you that in order to get in you need to give her three items: a fire feather from an Entrana firebird, a cooked lava eel, and a Master Thieves' Armband. For the armband, she suggests you probably have 'relevant contacts' yourself with whom to enquire about it. To obtain the feather she only offers the most helpful advice that Entranan firebirds tend to live on Entrana. To get the eel, she advises you to talk to someone who knows a lot about fishing. The items may be obtained in any order, but must be given to Achietties simultaneously.

walkthrough.heading: Master Thieves' armband
walkthrough.body: {{Map|2771,3194|mtype=rectangle|rectX=24|rectY=12|caption=The location of Scarface Pete's mansion in Brimhaven.|align=right|width=250|height=250}} To earn the armband, you will have to contact your old gang associates from the Shield of Arrav quest, as indicated by the quest journal. For this part of the quest, you will need the help of a player of the opposite gang. Players that have completed the quest may go back and help others. For finding a quest partner, the Grouping interface is useful. You can also usually find a partner on the chat-channel 'Osrs Soa' during peak hours. :'Note:' For this part of the quest you 'do not' need to meet the skill requirements. This means you can complete this part of the quest in order to help a friend complete their entire quest; see Trivia for more details. You can even help a friend if you have already completed the quest yourself. :'Note:' Traded Pete's candlesticks will not be accepted if the presenter did not kill Grip. As such, do not get scammed into buying or taking free candlesticks unless you are a Phoenix Gang member and can kill Grip. Black Arm gang members can never kill Grip so they should not accept traded candlesticks under any circumstances. Likewise, a miscellaneous key without a Black Arm member to lure Grip is useless. Do not get scammed into buying miscellaneous keys.

walkthrough.heading: Black Arm Gang member
walkthrough.body: A black full helm, a black platebody and black platelegs Go to Varrock and talk to Katrine who is inside the Black Arm Gang Headquarters, which is situated in the south-west of the city. She tells you that you need to do something amazing in order to attain the rank of master thief. She explains some of the most coveted items for thieves are in Brimhaven. The leader of the pirates there is one Scarface Pete. She will tell you that you have to steal his very valuable candlesticks and that his security is very good. You have to visit the Black Arm members in their hideout in the alleyway of Palm Street. The gang's password is "four leafed{{sic}} clover". =====The Hideout on Palm Street===== Go to Brimhaven and find the gang office, which is the building along the fence, east of the two inns and south of the Agility Arena. Give Grubor the password "four leaved clover"at the door, and inside speak to Trobert, the leader of the Black Arms in Brimhaven. Trobert explains one of the only keys to Pete's treasure room is carried by his head guard Grip, who was taking on a new deputy called Hartigen, a deserter of the Black Knights seeking employment in Brimhaven. The Black Arms have waylaid Hartigen and stolen his identification papers. Volunteer to impersonate Hartigen. He will give you the Id papers, which you will need to get into Scarface Pete's mansion, and tell you to introduce yourself to its guards. Speak to Garv, who is the guard patrolling along the southern wall of the large building on Brimhaven's western side. He will not believe you are Hartigen, stating that the Black Knight dressed differently. Equip a full set of black armour: full helm, platebody and platelegs. Garv will then allow you to go inside tells you to speak to Grip. =====Getting a Grip on the key===== Once inside, talk to Grip. He explains you will be working various guard duties, and that the important keys are in Grip's jacket. Ask him "So what do my duties involve?" and then "Anything I can do now?" and he will give you a Miscellaneous key. :'Note:' If you have already done the quest and have the Miscellaneous key in your bank, he will not give you a new one. Grip won't allow you to enter the treasure room and you can't kill him without drawing attention to yourself. This means you will need an accomplice. Leave the building and trade the key to your Phoenix Gang partner. =====Handling the candlesticks=====.]] Back inside, head into the north-eastern room from the entrance. Wait for your partner to get to the room behind the eastern wall, behind the arrowslit; then, search the cupboard. A pirate guard will say that Grip really doesn't like his drinks cabinet being touched, but open it anyway. Grip will then come into the room, telling you to get your hands off his drinks. Make sure the door is open. Grip can become stuck on the guards in the room, so you may need to wait or kill some guards to create space or else Grip may be blocked and leave the room. If this happens, just search the cupboard again. Your Phoenix Gang partner will then kill Grip through the slit from the hidden room. Once he dies, pick up Grip's keyring. Using the key, go to the treasure room (the ground floor room with coins on the floor next to the staircase in the north-west corner) and open the north chest in the first room to receive two candlesticks. 'Give one candlestick to your Phoenix Gang partner.' Go back to Varrock and talk to Katrine. She will give you the Thieves' armband. :'Note:' The door to the treasure room will not open and give you a message if you attempt to open it with Grip's keyring without having obtained a miscellaneous key at least once. :'Note:' The chest containing Pete's candlesticks (position to the north) will be empty if you have a candlestick in your inventory or bank. If you have a traded one in the bank, you will need to discard it then come back to search this chest as you will not be able to turn in a traded candlestick to Katrine at any time. :'Note:' Be sure to pick up the candlesticks yourself; otherwise, Katrine will say you weren't the one to retrieve the candlestick and you will have to go back to do it all over again. :'Note:' Grip's Keyring is unique to the player you are doing the quest with. If you complete the quest and are retrieving candlesticks for a different player and still have Grip's Keyring, drop it and ask him for a new one.

walkthrough.heading: Phoenix Gang member
walkthrough.body: A Ranged weapons ranged weapon and ammo (brutal arrows will not work) or runes for Magic Go to Varrock and speak to Straven at the hideout. Enquire about becoming a master thief. He will explain that some eager gang members are trying to steal the valuable candlesticks of Scarface Pete, the pirate leader of Brimhaven. He gives you the password gherkin to tell Alfonse, a gang member posing as a waiter in The Shrimp and Parrot inn. Get a bow and arrows, or magic gear if using magic, before heading to Brimhaven. =====The side entrance===== Go to the Shrimp and Parrot restaurant in Brimhaven. Once you are there, talk to Alfonse the waiter and ask about gherkins. He will wink and redirect you to Charlie the cook in the back room. Give him the password as well and tell him you are after Pete's candlesticks. Charlie the cook will tell you that the restaurant was set up as part of the heist. There is a secret wall-door that opens into Mr. Olbors's garden that you are able to push to open. Across the garden is an old side entrance into the mansion that has since been blocked. However, the Phoenixes are unable to get hold of the key to that door. The pushable wall is in the kitchen, in the same room as where Charlie is. Beware of Mr. Olbors's guard dogs. 'Get a miscellaneous key from your Black Arm Gang partner.' Head into Olbors's garden and enter the mansion's eastern door. Once inside, use the miscellaneous key on the northern door. This brings you in a cramped room with an arrowslit into a room with a cupboard. Shoot through the hole in the wall at Grip and kill him with Ranged or Magic. Your partner will have to lure him inside the room by rummaging through his drinks cabinet. Grip will drop the key for your Black Arm Gang partner. 'Your Black Arm Gang partner will get two candlesticks and should trade you one of them.' :'Note:' You must actually kill Grip! If you don't, Straven will NOT accept your candlestick. Don't buy it or the key off other players as shortcut; you can't kill Grip alone. Go back to Varrock and give the candlestick to Straven to get the Thieves' armband.

walkthrough.heading: Entrana firebird feather
walkthrough.body: Ice gloves, or a pickaxe and combat equipment if you do not already own a pair Energy]]/stamina potions if obtaining ice gloves If you want, speak to a monk in the Entranan church about the firebird. He does not think they exist but redirects you to the head monk, who is more knowledgeable. The High Priest tells you that the bird lives somewhere on Entrana, and that you will need some cold gloves to pick up its feather. The firebird lives on the northern half of Entrana. It is very weak and easy to kill. However, its fire feather is too hot to pick up; you require something cold in order to do so. In order to pick up the fire feather, you'll need ice gloves. They are dropped by the level 111 Ice Queen located underneath White Wolf Mountain. If you do not own ice gloves, see the section below. Once you have a pair of ice gloves, bank your weapons and armour, but keep the gloves. Head to Entrana and kill the firebird near the Law Altar. Make sure to have the ice gloves equipped before picking up the feather. You can also grab a fishing rod from the house beside the fishing platform on the south east corner of the island if you need a spare to use for making the oily fishing rod. ====Ice Spy with my Little Eye==== If you do not already own Ice gloves, go to White Wolf Mountain (east of Catherby, west of Taverley), to the rock slide on the north side. It can be found just north-west of the gnome glider. Otherwise, enter the mountain at the southern entrance and walk or run north until you come to the rock slide. Use a pickaxe on the rock slide (Mining 50) and go through it. Once you are through, you will be near level 57 ice warriors and three ladders..]] {| class="wikitable lighttable"!Steps |- |After the rock slide, head 'down' the 'southernmost' ladder |- | Go down the 'south-west' tunnel and climb 'up' the ladder at the end |- |Avoiding the ice giants, climb down the 'easternmost' ladder |- |Go 'north' through the long tunnel, and climb 'up' the ladder at the end |- |Climb 'down' the ladder immediately next to it |- |Follow the tunnel 'north' until it opens into a large room |} {{Clear}} At the end of the room resides the Ice Queen, kill her and she will drop the ice gloves. If you stand behind the throne, you can avoid the ice warriors and can still attack the Ice Queen if positioned right. Once you have the gloves, exit using the same route back or teleport out.

walkthrough.heading: Cooked lava eel
walkthrough.body: A fishing rod, fishing bait, harralander potion (unf) (or a harralander and vial of water), other items depending on chosen location (see below) Go to Port Sarim and talk to Gerrant at the fishing shop. He will tell you that catching a lava eel requires a lava-proof fishing line, which can be created by coating an ordinary fishing rod with blamish oil. Gerrant will give you a free bottle of blamish snail slime, which is added to a harralander potion (unf) to make the blamish oil. Buy a fishing rod and some bait from him if you haven't got any yet. After making the blamish oil, right-click on it to use it on a normal fishing rod to get an oily fishing rod. There are 'three possible locations' where you can catch lava eels: * Taverley Dungeon is a safe option, but requires the player to to take a long and winding path if they do not have at least level 70 Agility to use the shortcut. * The Lava Maze (level 40-45 Wilderness) may alternatively be chosen as catching a lava eel there is a hard Wilderness Diary task. As with all Wilderness activities, there is a risk of being killed by other players. * The Charred Dungeon requires level 60 Sailing to access. The route is shorter and more straightforward than Taverley Dungeon, but players will need to spend time sailing there. ====Taverley Dungeon==== Dusty key (can be obtained in the dungeon) or Agility 70 stamina]] or energy potions, food or prayer points for Protect from Melee if low-levelled Make your way to Taverley and enter the dungeon to the south of the town. Some options include the balloon transport system, Falador Teleport and going west over the Agility 5 shortcut, or using Teleport to House if it is in Taverley. 'If you have 70 Agility' (which can be boosted), enter the pipe after putting on your dragonfire protection and run south. The fishing spot is near some baby blue dragons, which generally do not attack you from the position. '''If you don't have 70 Agility''', follow the magenta path on the image to the right. Walk through the dungeon and use the dusty key on the door between the lesser demons and blue dragons. If you have 63 Agility, you can save a bit of time by squeezing through loose railings to go straight to the lesser demon area. If you don't have the dusty key, go past the bridge, continue south-west past the hill giants, and you will enter the Black Knights' Base. Go to the east into a jail, kill the jailer and then pick up his key. Use it on the jail cell holding Velrak the explorer. Ask him if there are any good places to explore to get the dusty key. Head back north past the hill giants and follow the magenta path to the fishing spot. Use the key on the door between the lesser demons and blue dragons. The fishing spot is near some baby blue dragons; from here, catch a lava eel. ====Lava Maze==== A knife or a slash weapon (all tiers of Wilderness sword will always succeed) {{Map|name=Lava Maze|3070,3853|zoom=1|align=right|height=180|width=280|caption=A map of the Lava Maze.}} 'Warning:' The Lava Maze is located in level 40-45 Wilderness, meaning that many player killers will be within the level range to attack you. Do not bring any items you are not willing to lose. There are several methods to get to the Laval Maze: *Teleporting there directly using the burning amulet. This is the quickest way. *Casting the Ghorrock Teleport spell (or tablet) in the Ancient Magicks spellbook. This requires completing the quest Desert Treasure I. *Take the Wilderness Obelisks to the destination at level 35 or level 44 Wilderness. This may take several attempts. The obelisks can be quickly accessed by taking the Minigame Teleport to Ferox Enclave. ** Beware of the Chaos Fanatic if arriving from the Ghorrock Teleport of level 44 Wilderness Obelisk. *Take a waka canoe from Edgeville or any other River Lum Canoe Station to the northmost destination. This requires 57 Woodcutting. Then walk west to arrive near the entrance. Upon arriving at the entrance, use your knife or slash weapon to cut the web and proceed through the maze until you see the fishing icon on your minimap. The fishing spot is relatively near the entrance. If you die with your oily fishing rod, you will probably lose it and have to make a new one. If Gerrant does not give you another bottle of blamish snail slime<!--requires testing-->, you can also get it by killing a Myre blamish snail and grinding its meat with a pestle and mortar with an empty sample bottle in your inventory. The sample bottle can be obtained from Fidelio in the Canifis General Store. Once you catch a raw lava eel (Fishing 53), cook it over a fire or a range (Cooking 53). :'Note:' Lava eels do not burn when cooked (or, indeed, when swimming in lava). Do not worry about obtaining multiple eels if you are worried about burning one.

walkthrough.heading: Quest end
walkthrough.body: Go back to the Heroes' Guild, talk to Achietties outside and give her the three collected items. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

steps: Talk to Achietties outside the Heroes' Guild in Burthorpe.
Talk to Gerrant, the fishing shop owner in Port Sarim about lava eels. He'll give you a bottle of blamish snail slime.
Use the blamish snail slime on your harralander potion (unf) to create blamish oil.
Buy a fishing rod and some bait if you do not have them.
Right-click to '
Travel to the Taverley Dungeon.
You
Alternatively, players with 60 Sailing (
To obtain a dusty key:
Use the map (pictured right) to find Velrak the explorer. He is in the southern part of the dungeon.
Kill the Jailer standing by the prison and use the key he drops to get into Velrak's cell.
Talk to him for the dusty key. '
Enter the area with the blue dragons, either by using your key on the locked door or take the agility shortcut.
Run to the southernmost lava pool.
Catch a lava eel. You only need one, as they cannot be burned. (Catch extra in case you accidentally eat it.)
Cook the eel on a range or fire.
quickGuide.itemsNeeded: If you already have a dusty key (steel key ring with dusty key works), or 70 Agility, skip the next step.

steps: To obtain the ice gloves:
Equip combat gear and food to kill a level 111 Ice Queen.
Go to White Wolf Mountain. Note: If you need to boost your mining to 50, bring the boost with you.
Walk to the northern part of the mountain, mine the rockslide.
Take the southern ladder.
Follow the tunnel south, go up the ladder.
Take the eastern ladder down.
Go through the long tunnel.
Go up the ladder.
Go down the northern ladder. Run north and kill the queen for her gloves.
Equip the ice gloves.
Travel to Entrana.
Kill the Firebird near the Law Altar, take the fire feather.
quickGuide.itemsNeeded: If you already have the ice gloves, skip the first step.

steps: Take the feather, eel, and armband to Achietties.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Scorpion Catcher
start: Speak to Thormac at the top floor of the Sorcerer's Tower, south-east of the Ranging Guild.
description: Thormac the Sorcerer has a hobby involving scorpions. Unfortunately, three of them have escaped and managed to run far away. If you manage to find them all, he may just be able to perform an important service for you.
itemRequirements: Dusty key (obtainable during the quest) or Agility 70 (boostable).
recommendedItems: Combat 40
Anti-dragon shield or dragonfire shield (highly recommended, see the guide for the alternative strategy if they are unavailable)
Antifire potion (provides complete immunity to the dragonfire if used with an anti-dragon or dragonfire shield)
Antipoison or superantipoison
Armour and some food
Stamina or energy potions
Fast travel to several locations
The Sorcerer's Tower (Camelot teleport, Ardougne teleport or combat bracelet to the Ranged Guild)
Taverley Dungeon (Taverley teleport, Falador teleport or Teleport to House if your house is in Taverley)
Barbarian Outpost (games necklace or Barbarian teleport)
Edgeville Monastery (combat bracelet or amulet of glory to Edgeville)
requirements: The ability to run past level 172 black demons and level 64 poison spiders
enemiesToDefeat: Jailer (level 47) if you need to acquire the dusty key (alternatively, you can skip this if you have access to the Legends Guild Shop of Useful Items, where the key is sold)
rewards: The ability to have Thormac turn a battlestaff into a mystic staff for 40,000 coins
leagueRegion: <poem> Asgarnia — location requirement Kandarin — location requirement Unlocking Fremennik will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Scattered scorpions
walkthrough.body: {{Map|name=Sorcerer's Tower|x=2702|y=3405|zoom=2|align=right|caption=The location of the Sorcerer's Tower.|width=200|height=200}} Talk to Thormac on the top floor of the Sorcerer's Tower, just south-east of the Ranging Guild and south of Seers' Village. He'll tell you that his rare Kharid Scorpions have escaped and are currently running loose. He'll give you a Scorpion cage to catch the scorpions with and suggest you go talk to the Seers that live just to the north. Speak with any Seer in Seers' Village. He will tell you that the first scorpion is in a secret room with nasty spiders nearby. This is the Taverley Dungeon. :'Note': The secret room is 'only' accessible once you have spoken to the seer about the location of the first scorpion. Once that is done, you can now catch the three scorpions in any order and may skip talking to the Seer again to find their locations. {{Clear|left}}

walkthrough.heading: The first scorpion
walkthrough.body: {{Map|2877,9796|name=Kharid Scorpion|width=250|height=250|r=3|mtype=square|mapID=20|caption=The location of the first scorpion, in the Taverley Dungeon.|align=right}} 'Note': In the following section, low levelled players are 'highly recommended' to use an anti-dragon shield when passing the blue dragons, as their dragonfire can inflict up to 50 damage, which the shield reduces by roughly 80%. If used in combination with an antifire potion, the player will gain full immunity. If you have not started Dragon Slayer I to obtain the shield, read the following sections for a more difficult strategy to avoid the dragonfire. The blue dragons may also be skipped if you have 80 Agility. Make your way to the Taverley Dungeon. Once inside, you can skip the following steps if you have 70+ Agility, by either using the shortcut to the blue dragons (70 Agility) or the shortcut directly to the poison spiders (80 Agility). If you cannot use the shortcuts, a dusty key is required to enter the section of the dungeon that the scorpion is located in. If you do not already have one, follow the track towards the Black Knights' Base and kill the jailer located in the eastern area of the base, who will drop a jail key. Use the jail key on the door of the cell containing Velrak the explorer. Speak to him; ask if there are any good places to explore, and when he asks you if you want to go further into the dungeon, say yes and he will give you a dusty key. Head to the blue dragons area. Walk south of the blue dragons, west to pass the black demons, and north to the poison spiders. To the south of the two coffins, there's a small room with a false wall that you can search to open (see the map). If you are unable to open the door, you probably did not speak with the seer about the first scorpion. Use the scorpion cage on the small scorpion inside this room to catch it (if you try to pick it up, it will sting you for 3 Hitpoints of damage). 'Strategy without anti-dragon shield:' When running past the blue dragons, ensure a baby blue dragon is fighting you at all times (they do not breathe dragonfire). The dungeon is single-combat, so the more dangerous blue dragons will not attack you while you are in combat. Avoid standing too close to adult dragons, and hop from baby to baby and draw their aggression when passing through. This strategy is not recommended for hardcore ironmen who are not confident they know what they are doing. {{Map|3058,3488|name=Kharid Scorpion|plane=1|caption=The location of the second scorpion.|width=200|height=200|r=3|mtype=square|align=left}}

walkthrough.heading: The second scorpion
walkthrough.body: The second scorpion is on the floor 1 of the Edgeville Monastery. To enter the floor 1 you'll need to speak with Abbot Langley to join their guild (Prayer 31). You do not have to do this again if you have already done it. Climb the south-east ladder in the Monastery. The scorpion will be either right at the top of the ladder, or in the bedroom directly north of the ladder. Use your cage on it to catch it.

walkthrough.heading: The third scorpion
walkthrough.body: {{Map|2553,3570|name=Kharid Scorpion|caption=The location of the third scorpion.|width=200|height=200|r=3|mtype=square|align=right}} The third scorpion is in the Barbarian Outpost Agility Course (requires completion of Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl), found in the north eastern gated building. The scorpion will be wandering just inside the entrance. Use your cage on it to catch it. Finally, bring the full scorpion cage to Thormac. 'Congratulations, quest complete!' {{Clear}}

steps: Talk to Thormac on the top floor of the Sorcerer's Tower south of Seers' Village. (blr)

Go to Seers Village and speak to a Seer. (Wait until the seer is done checking himself in the mirror.) Be sure not to skip this step, as the scorpion in Taverley Dungeon is not accessible without first speaking to the seer.
Scorpions can be caught in any order and there is no need to return between each catch.
Note: You will need a dusty key if you don't have 70 Agility, make sure to grab it before entering the dungeon.
Go into Taverley Dungeon, (South Taverley) and go to the poison spider area.

If you need a dusty key head south to the Black Knights' Base and kill the jailer. Use the key on the jail cell and talk to Velrak the explorer. He will give you the key. Alternatively, a dusty key spawns deep in Taverley Dungeon, near the lava eel fishing spot south of the blue dragon area.
Directly south of the level 80 Agility shortcut, search the old wall to enter a small room.
Use the scorpion cage on the Kharid Scorpion. If you try to pick it up, it will sting you instead.
Go to the Barbarian Outpost (a games necklace is helpful).
Go inside the fenced in area near the entrance to the agility course.
Go inside the building in the north-east corner of the area.
Use the scorpion cage on the Kharid Scorpion. If you try to pick it up, it will sting you instead.
Note: It is possible for the scorpion to be outside of the small room, in the Agility area, if someone has let it out.
Go to the Monastery between Edgeville and Ice Mountain (a combat bracelet will take you right there).
Climb the eastern ladder and go to the east side of the floor.
Note: If the Monk stops you and says only members of the order may go upstairs, simply say that you want to join and you will be allowed to go upstairs.
Use the scorpion cage on the Kharid Scorpion. If you try to pick it up, it will sting you instead.
Return the full scorpion cage to Thormac.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Family Crest
start: Talk to Dimintheis in south-east Varrock.
description: There is a man in Varrock who needs a bit of help. He is of noble heritage, but without his family's crest, he can't prove it. Unfortunately, his three sons took the crest with them when they left, scattering all across Gielinor.
itemRequirements: Pickaxe - adamant or rune (41+ Mining) highly recommended
Any poison cure (you will lose this item). Does not need to contain full doses.
Means to cast all 4 Blast spells
recommendedItems: Combat 55
