An extra antipoison potion for yourself (for the poison spiders in Edgeville Dungeon)
Fast travel to several locations
Varrock to start the quest plus 2 additional trips - Varrock Teleport, Chronicle, Skills necklace to Cooks' Guild, or Ring of wealth to Grand Exchange
Catherby (1 trip) - Catherby Teleport, Camelot Teleport, or Gnome glider to White Wolf Mountain
Al Kharid (2 trips) - Ring of dueling to Emir's Arena, Ring of the elements to Fire Altar, or Amulet of glory
Dwarven Mine (1 trip) - Combat bracelet to Edgeville Monastery or Falador Teleport
Witchaven (1 trip) - Ardougne Teleport, fairy ring blr, or Ardougne cloak 1-4
Jolly Boar Inn east of Varrock (1 trip) - Lumberyard Teleport, Ring of the elements to Earth Altar, Balloon transport system to Varrock, Varrock Teleport, or Digsite Teleport
Edgeville (1 trip) - Amulet of glory, Combat bracelet to Edgeville Monastery, fairy ring dkr, or Varrock Teleport
requirements: The ability to defeat a level 170 demon (can be safespotted)
rewards: The steel gauntlets offer useful perks. Each brother will imbue them with a special ability. They will initially do this for free. Be careful choosing, though, since you can only have one effect, and it will cost you 25,000 coins to change them. Dimintheis will provide you with a "magically" found pair should you lose them.
requiredFor: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze
ironmanConcerns: 'Warning:' The player visits the Wilderness section of Edgeville Dungeon *Obtaining the cooked fish: **All raw fish except salmon can be found at Frankie's Fishing Emporium in Port Piscarilius **Salmon can be purchased cooked from the West Ardougne General Store **Swordfish can be purchased cooked from The Shrimp and Parrot in Brimhaven, and 5 are received as a reward from Quest Tribal Totem **Bass can be obtained cooked as a 1/50 drop from Ankous, or from Gourmet implings with Hunter 28 (boostable). Bass can also be purchased cooked from the Warrior Guild Food Shop.
leagueRegion: <poem> Unlocking Fremennik will auto-complete the quest Unlocking Kandarin will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: The crest
walkthrough.body: {{Map|x=3281|y=3404|r=4|width=250|height=250|align=right|caption=The quest's starting point|mtype=square}} To begin, talk with Dimintheis, who lives in south-eastern Varrock, within the fenced off area, in the house just above the clothes shop. Tell him you are a bold adventurer and he will propose an adventure for you; he needs his family crest returned. Ask him where the crest is, and he will explain his three sons took it with them when they rode out to battle many years ago. He hadn't heard from them since, until he recently learned that his son Caleb was working as a chef beyond the White Wolf Mountain, in Catherby.

walkthrough.heading: Caleb
walkthrough.body: Shrimps, bass, salmon, tuna and a swordfish (all cooked). Head to Catherby, where Caleb can be found either inside the building with the sink to the south of the Farming shop, or wandering outside of it. Talk to him and ask if he is Caleb Fitzharmon, and he will tell you he has a 'bit' of the crest. Ask him what happened to the rest of it, and he will explain that he and his brothers broke the crest into three parts after a disagreement about who would become heir to their fathers' lands, and each of them ended up with a piece. Ask if you can have his bit of the crest, and he will agree to give you his piece provided you bring him ingredients for his fish salad. Agree to bring him the ingredients. :'Note': You must ask him what happened to the rest of the crest, or you will be unable to collect the other parts. Bring him the shrimp, salmon, tuna, bass, and swordfish (all cooked) and he will give you his piece of the crest.

walkthrough.heading: Avan
walkthrough.body: necklace mould, ring mould, any pickaxe, 2 Ruby cut rubies Caleb mentioned that the last he heard from his brother Avan, he was searching for treasure in the desert, and that you might want to ask the traders there about him. Head to the gem trader in the north of Al Kharid, found next to the gnome glider just south of the gate to Lumbridge. Ask him about Avan Fitzharmon, and he will remember that the man was searching for 'perfect gold'. The gem trader told him to search the sand dunes where gold rocks can be found. Head to the northern Al Kharid Mine, and a man can be found wandering around just at the entrance to the pit with a yellow cape on. This is, indeed, Avan, as he'll tell you when you ask him. He's not giving up his piece of the crest though unless you can help him win the affection of a certain lady by getting him a ring and necklace made out of perfect gold. Unfortunately, the stuff there in the desert isn't nearly good enough. He'll tell you a dwarf named Boot might know something about where to find the gold. :'Note:' The player must speak to Boot before being able to give the jewellery to Avan, even though it is possible to mine and smith perfect jewellery without speaking to him. {{Map|mapID=6|2984,9810|width=250|height=250|align=right|r=6|mtype=square|caption=Boot is located towards the far west end of Dwarven Mine.}} Head to the Dwarven Mines, located just west of the Edgeville Monastery. Climb down the trapdoor behind the eastern building to enter the mines. Boot can be found south-west from this northern entrance, wandering by the two rock columns - see the map to the right. Tell him you are in search of very high quality gold, and he will direct you to east of Ardougne, underground somewhere. The location you need to visit is the Witchaven Dungeon in Witchaven. :'Note': You will need to pass by level 28 hobgoblins, level 53 ogres, and level 122 hellhounds in this dungeon, though you do not need to kill any of them. The hobgoblins will attack you immediately after entering the dungeon if below 57 Combat Level, and you will need to solve a puzzle while being attacked by ogres. Protect from Melee will negate all damage, as the monsters only use melee. Enter the dungeon and head north east along the path. To the north and south are two rooms with levers in and outside of them. You'll have to complete a lever puzzle here to unlock the eastern area which contains the gold rocks and hellhounds: {{Checklist| *Go to the northern room and pull the outside lever up. *Head into the southern room using the eastern door, pull the lever up, then exit via the 'western' door. *Go to the northern room and pull the outside lever down, then enter and pull the inner lever up. *Leave the room and pull the outside lever up again. *Go back to the southern room through the 'western' door and pull the lever down, then exit via the 'eastern' door. *The hellhound room should now be unlocked. }} 'Note': Once unlocked, you do not need to do the puzzle again to re-enter. Enter the hellhound room to the east and mine at least two 'perfect' gold ore from the gold rocks (Mining 40). The hellhounds have a short aggression range - try and zigzag past them to find an open rock to mine. If you draw aggression before you are done mining, there is a safespot you can use to hide in behind the rock column directly south of the entrance - you can then world hop to lose aggression and try again. Low levelled players may also consider waiting 10 minutes in this safespot, after which the hellhounds will not attack you while mining the southern rocks. The rocks will take some time to respawn, so once you have mined one rock, use another or world hop to reset the rock. Once you have your two 'perfect' gold ore, head to any furnace with the ore, your rubies, your ring mould, and your necklace mould. You may consider using the one in Al Kharid, as you will be returning to Avan in the Al Kharid mine afterwards. Smelt the ore into 'perfect' gold bars (Smithing 40), then smelt a bar each into a ruby necklace and ruby ring respectively (Crafting 40, Smithing 40), which will make the 'perfect' ring and 'perfect' necklace ('DO NOT SELECT the GOLD necklace and ring!'). Return to Avan in the Al Kharid Mine, and he will take your jewellery and give you the second piece of the crest in return. He will then tell you how to find the final brother Johnathon.

walkthrough.heading: Johnathon
walkthrough.body: An antipoison potion, runes to cast the four Blast spells, combat equipment for the battle with Chronozon. The last brother is holed up on the floor 1 of the Jolly Boar Inn north-east of Varrock near the edge of the Wilderness. Bring your antipoison potion, and head up to the floor 1 where he is huddled in the north western room. Talk to him and he will be delirious - he has been bitten by a poisonous spider. Once he has finished speaking, use the antipoison on him (he'll take the entire potion, but you may bring a lower dosed potion) and he'll be very grateful to be cured. Johnathon will tell you that he lost the crest while attempting to kill a powerful demon named Chronozon. If you want it back, you'll have to kill the demon yourself. Johnathon explains that to defeat the demon, you will need to first hit him once with each of the four elemental spells of death. Chronozon can be found in the Edgeville Dungeon, by the poison spiders near the Earth obelisk. :'Warning:' You will be heading into the Wilderness, where other players may kill you. Only take items you are willing to lose to player killers, and consider using a low population world. To defeat Chronozon, you will need to cast Wind Blast, Water Blast, Earth Blast, and Fire Blast and 'successfully hit him' once with each (in any order). {{mes|Chronozon weakens....}} will appear in the chat after each individual hit from a blast spell. You do not need to kill him using Magic after he has been weakened, though he has no Magic defence and is weak to Water spells. Along with enough runes to cast each blast spell several times, bring food, combat equipment and a poison cure for the poison spiders near Chronozon. Head to Edgeville and enter the dungeon through the trapdoor in the south eastern corner of the building south of the bank. Head north, then east through the gate past the skeletons, then north through the gate with thugs on the other side. Continue north past the thugs, west past the red spiders and black demons, then south to the Obelisk of Earth. There is a safespot one square in front of the eastern standing torch for Magic and Ranged. If you draw aggression of the poison spiders, stand behind the stalagmite to avoid it, then hop worlds. Weaken him with each blast spell, then kill him with any combat style. :'Note': If you take too long to kill him, his weakness will wear off and you'll have to weaken him again. {{bug|The Twinflame staff's double cast feature does not kill him as expected.}} Chronozon will drop the final crest piece on death, pick it up.

walkthrough.heading: The crest reassembled
walkthrough.body: Now that you have all three crest pieces, put them together to make the Family Crest and then make your way back to Varrock. Give the crest to Dimintheis who will be very, very pleased to have it back. 'Congratulations, quest complete!' :'Tip:' You may choose to talk to Dimintheis again to start the Family Pest miniquest before imbuing one of the gauntlets, as you will additionally have the chat option to progress the miniquest.

steps: Talk to Dimintheis in a house south-east of the east bank (along city wall) in Varrock and north of the fancy dress shop.
Head to Catherby and talk to Caleb in the building north-east of the bank.
Speak to him again and give him all the fish. 'Note: Ask of the whereabouts of the other crest parts, or you will not be able to progress!'
Speak to the Gem Trader in Al Kharid.
Go north of the Gem Trader to the scorpion mining pit, and speak to the 'Man' with the yellow cape there (Avan).
Head into the Dwarven Mine underneath Ice Mountain and run to the far most western end and speak to Boot.

Teleport to Ardougne, head east and climb down the old ruin entrance to the Witchaven Dungeon near Witchaven and Ardougne ship port. (Labelled on the world map by the icon. You may need to defend yourself against some hellhounds, so come prepared).
Enter the dungeon. Do 'not' enter the wall to the east. There is a north room, a south room, and a locked eastern room that contains hellhounds and the perfect gold ore.
To unlock the east gate:
Go to the north and lift the lever outside (up)
Then to the south room through the eastern door and lift that lever (up). Exit through the western door.
Back north and pull the outer lever (down), enter and lift the inner lever (up)
Exit the room and lift the lever (up)
Enter the south room by the western door and lower the lever (down). Exit through the eastern door.

Go into the hellhound room and mine 2 'perfect' gold ores. Their aggro range is short so try to zigzag through them. Anticipating hits will manageably yield the ores with a rune pickaxe. Alternatively, low level players can stand in a safespot for 10 minutes so the hellhounds stop being aggressive.

Go to a furnace (northern Lumbridge - use the home teleport) and smelt the ores into bars, then use the bars on the furnace again and make one 'perfect' ruby necklace and 'perfect' ruby ring. 'Be careful not to use make-all as it will make two rings or necklaces'
Go back to the 'Man' (Avan) and give him the jewellery to receive the second crest piece.

Teleport to Varrock (lumberyard teleport), and head north-east to the Jolly Boar Inn near the lumberyard. Go upstairs and speak to Johnathon. Speak to him, and use your anti-poison on him to learn the location of the final crest piece.
Prepare for the fight:
Bring runes for each of the four blast spells: Wind Blast, Water Blast, Earth Blast, and Fire Blast as you need to deal damage with each spell.
'''Be aware that Chronozon's fight takes place in part of the Wilderness and other players may attack you there.'''
Maging is recommended. You will have to kill a poison spider to use the safespots, so anti-poison is recommended.

Diary tasks: Since Chronozon is at the Earth Obelisk and the Air Obelisk is to the north, you can bring two Unpowered orbs, 6 Cosmic runes, 60 Earth runes, 60 air runes to respectively complete a medium and hard Wilderness task (with 60/66 Magic).
Go to Edgeville or the small hut west of Varrock if you have a brass key to enter the Edgeville Dungeon.
Head to the gate dividing the Wilderness from the rest of the dungeon.
Travel slightly north, then make a left past the thugs and Chaos druids, through a second gate.
Travel west, then south past the poison spiders and Black demons, where you will find Chronozon.
Safespot him between the southern rocks. You may have to kill a poison spider first.
You must successfully cast each blast spell on Chronozon (No splashes or zeroes. Twinflame Staff will prohibit you from changing spells).
Once he has been weakened by each blast spell, kill him with any spell, melee, or ranged.
Pick up the last crest piece and teleport out.
Assemble the Family crest and head back to Dimintheis in Varrock to conclude.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Tribal Totem
start: Speak to Kangai Mau at The Shrimp and Parrot restaurant in Brimhaven.
description: Lord Handelmort of Ardougne is a collector of exotic artefacts. A recent addition to his private collection is a strange looking totem from Karamja. The Rantuki tribe are not happy about the recent disappearance of their totem.
recommendedItems: Fast travel to Brimhaven to start the quest - Brimhaven teleport, Teleport to House (Brimhaven), 30 coins to travel from Ardougne docks using Captain Barnaby, or take a charter ship

30 coins to travel from Brimhaven docks with Captain Barnaby to Ardougne. This is the recommended route to Ardougne as you end up by the next part of the quest, but you can otherwise use an Ardougne Teleport
leagueRegion: <poem> Kandarin — location requirement </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Stolen totem
walkthrough.body: Talk to Kangai Mau in Brimhaven, in the Shrimp and Parrot food shop. Tell him you are in search of adventure, and he will say that he needs someone to go on a mission to Ardougne. Lord Handelmort has stolen the Rantuki tribe tribal totem for his private museum, and he wants you to get it back. {{Clear|left}}

walkthrough.heading: Rerouting a magical delivery
walkthrough.body: If you were to head to Lord Handelmort's mansion in Ardougne, you would find that the door is locked. You need to find a method to get past the front door. Instead, head to the GPDT depot, just west of the Ardougne docks and just south of the eastern bank. Investigate the north-eastern crate to find an address label, addressed to Lord Handelmort. South of this crate is another crate, intended for delivery to the Wizards' Tower. This crate contains a teleport block, Wizard Cromperty's new invention. Use the address label on this crate to mark it for delivery to the mansion instead. Ask a nearby GPDT employee when the crate will be delivered, and he will agree to deliver it now.

walkthrough.heading: Sneaky teleportation
walkthrough.body: Talk to Wizard Cromperty, found in the house north-east of the Ardougne market. '''Do not use the right-click 'Teleport' option,''' or you will be sent to the Rune essence mine. Ask him what he has invented, and he will tell you about his new teleportation block. Ask to be teleported, then confirm that it sounds good when he says you will end up by the teleportation block. You will find yourself inside Handelmort's mansion. {{Clear|left}}

walkthrough.heading: Retrieving the totem
walkthrough.body: Go west through two doors. The second door is locked; the password is Lord Handelmort's middle name, which is 'K U R T'. You would have found this out by reading the Guide book in the Estate Agent's house, after some clues from Horacio the gardener, but this was not necessary to progress the quest. Enter the code using the left and right arrows (K=10 right, U=6 left, R=9 left, T=7 left). When the password is set, click enter to unlock the door. :'Note:' If the password K U R T does not work and it states "This combination is incorrect", try entering the letters very slowly and only clicking the right arrow, as the game may not register the letters if clicking too quickly. The stairs are booby trapped; 'Do not use the "climb-up" option first!' Instead, 'investigate' the stairs (Thieving 21), then climb up. If {{Mes|You don't find anything interesting}} appears, you don't have the required level. :'Note': If you trigger the trap, you will end up in the Ardougne Sewers. Go south-west and climb up the ladder, then return to Cromperty for another teleport. You will not need to enter the door code again. Exit the southern door onto the balcony and enter the room to the east. Open the chest and search it to find the tribal totem. :'Note': You can use the drop trick if you want more totems as a souvenir. Return the totem to Kangai Mau in Brimhaven. He will give you 5 swordfish as thanks.

name: Fishing Contest
start: Mountain Dwarves at either of the entrances to the tunnel that goes under White Wolf Mountain.
description: The mountain Dwarves' home would be an ideal way to get across White Wolf Mountain safely. However, the Dwarves aren't too fond of strangers. They will let you through if you can bring them a trophy. The trophy is the prize for the annual Hemenster fishing competition.
itemRequirements: 5 coins (10 if you buy a fishing rod from Jack)
Fishing rod or Pearl fishing rod (oily fishing rod does 'not' work)
recommendedItems: Food and armour for low levels
Fast travel to several locations:
White Wolf Mountain to start the quest plus one additional trip - Camelot teleport, Taverley Teleport, games necklace to Burthorpe, Catherby Teleport, or Teleport to House (Taverley)
McGrubor's Wood (1 trip) - Camelot Teleport, combat bracelet to the Ranging Guild or fairy rings to als)
Hemenster (1 trip) - combat bracelet to Ranging Guild, skills necklace to Fishing Guild, Ardougne cloak 2-4 to Ardougne farm
rewards: Access to the underground White Wolf Mountain passage
Ability to catch minnows in the Fishing Guild with 82 Fishing and a full Angler's outfit
requiredFor: Recipe for Disaster - Freeing the Mountain Dwarf
leagueRegion: <poem> Kandarin — location requirement </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Dwarves can't fish!
walkthrough.body: {{Map|x=2842|y=3486|x:2876,y:3483,desc:Austri|x:2821,y:3487,desc:Vestri|plane=0|mapID=0|zoom=1|height=220|width=220|align=right|mtype=pin|caption=This quest can be started from either side of the White Wolf Mountain.}} To start this quest, head to either the dwarf Austri east of White Wolf Mountain or the dwarf Vestri west of the mountain, at the points shown on the map. :'Tip:' The western quest start point is closer to the next part of the quest, so it is recommended if not planning to use fast travel. Talk with either dwarf, and use the following dialogue options. Ask what is down the stairs, and he will say you can't use them. Ask why not, and he will ask you how you would like it if he took a shortcut through your home. Tell him if he was your friend you wouldn't mind, and he will say he doesn't know you. Ask to be friends; he wants you to earn his trust first. Ask how you are meant to do that, and he will mention that the dwarves are after a gold artefact, the first prize at the Hemenster fishing contest. He will give you a fishing pass to enter in the competition. You must win the competition before the dwarves will allow you to use the shortcut.

walkthrough.heading: Help from the champion
walkthrough.body: A spade If you were to head to the contest, Grandpa Jack the previous champion would give you advice on how to win; you can skip this however, and gather the required items without needing to speak to him. If you don't already have garlic, pick up a piece off the table in the house south-west of the bank in Seers Village. With your spade, head to McGrubor's Wood west of Seers Village, also accessible by the Fairy ring als inside (using the ring will also complete a medium Kandarin Diary task). If entering from outside, the southern gate is locked and you must squeeze through the railing on the northern side. Beware of aggressive level 44 guard dogs. Just west of the fairy ring, you will find a red vine. Check the red vine and collect at least 2 red vine worms.

walkthrough.heading: Winning the trophy
walkthrough.body: A fishing pass, fishing rod, garlic, 5 coins (10 if no rod), and 1 red vine worm Head to Hemenster, located by the Ranging Guild. If you didn't bring a fishing rod, buy one for 5 coins from Grandpa Jack in the house slightly north-east of the town. Find Morris at the gate to Hemenster and show him your fishing pass and he will let you in. Put the garlic into one of the pipes on the south wall of the north building (just next to the gate). Pay Bonzo the contest fee to start the contest (5 coins). The Sinister Stranger will complain about a horrible smell and you will change places with him. Fish at the spot by the pipes using the red vine worms. You will catch a giant carp, a unique type of fish that you can't catch normally, and that will be the prize winning fish. Speak to Bonzo again and hand over the giant carp. You will be announced the winner of the Fishing Competition. After winning the contest and obtaining your trophy, head back to the quest starting point on either side of the mountain and give the dwarf your trophy. 'Congratulations, quest complete!' {{Clear}}

name: Monk's Friend
start: Speak to Brother Omad at the Ardougne Monastery south of East Ardougne.
description: A monk's child has had their blanket stolen. Find the thieves' den and return the blanket, then help Brother Omad organise the drinks for the child's birthday party.
itemRequirements: Regular logs or a regular plank
recommendedItems: Fast travel to Ardougne Monastery to start the quest - Ardougne cloak 1-4 or Ardougne Teleport or Spirit tree to Battlefield or fairy ring to djp or Captain Barnaby's ship from Rimmington or Brimhaven
rewards: Brother Omad will throw parties for you by speaking to him.
leagueRegion: <poem> Kandarin — location requirement </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Brother Omad
walkthrough.body: Talk to Brother Omad at the Ardougne Monastery south of Ardougne. Teleport nearby via Ardougne Cloak 1, fairy rings code DJP, or Fishing Trawler minigame teleport and walking north. He wants you to retrieve a child's blanket from some thieves found in a secret cave hidden under a ring of stones west of the monastery. {{Clear|left}}

walkthrough.heading: Child's blanket
walkthrough.body: {{Map|2561,3221|r=4|mtype=square|width=220|height=220|align=right|caption=The stone circle's location.}} Head west immediately after exiting the Ardougne Monastery. East of the Gnome Battlefield and south-west of the Clock Tower, there is a perfect circle of grey stones. When inside the ring, a ladder will appear. Climb down the ladder into a large dungeon. Take the first path south into the room at the end, where you'll find the child's blanket on the table guarded by two level 14 thieves and a level 26 Head Thief. Bring the blanket back to Omad. He will be pleased because he can sleep now. 'Talk to Omad again', who is now better and ready to organise a child's birthday party: he just needs Brother Cedric to return with the wine. 'Ask who he is, and then ask where to find him, or you will be unable to complete the following section.' He will point the player towards the nearby forest. {{Clear|left}}

walkthrough.heading: Brother Cedric
walkthrough.body: {{Map|name=Brother Cedric|x=2614|y=3259|r=3|mtype=square|width=220|height=220|align=right|caption=Brother Cedric's location.}} Leave the monastery and head directly north to find Brother Cedric south of the Ardougne Zoo's camel cage. He's very drunk and needs a jug of water to sober up. A jug of water can be found in the cooking shop in Yanille or the general store in Port Khazard. You cannot use the well next to Cedric to fill up your jug, but you can use the bucket on the well, then the bucket of water on a jug. There is also a sink south of the monastery. Alternatively, you can kill imps near Port Khazard for either a full or empty jug. Give the jug of water to Cedric to sober him up. Now, he needs logs or a plank to repair his cart. Cut a log if needed and talk to Cedric again. 'Only' regular logs work. If you do not have an axe, there are plank spawns in Port Khazard, south-west of the bank chest. He can now repair his cart and wants you to go back to Brother Omad to tell him he is coming soon. Go back to Brother Omad, who will finally start the party. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Temple of Ikov
aliases: As you reach to open the door a great terror overcomes you!
start: Speak to Lucien at the Flying Horse Inn in the north-west corner of East Ardougne.
description: A mysterious stranger called Lucien asks you to go on a mission deep under the Temple of Ikov in central Kandarin. He wants you to retrieve an artefact known as the Staff of Armadyl. After you retrieve it, the quest doesn't stop there... Are you on the side of good or evil?
itemRequirements: Any bow capable of firing ice arrows (yew bow or better) 'or' any thrown weapon
A method of reducing your weight to at least -1kg temporarily:
Boots of lightness (can be obtained during the quest with a light source and slash weapon, such as a lit candle and knife)
Other forms of weight-reducing clothing such as the graceful outfit
recommendedItems: Combat 45
Prayer 43 and prayer potions for protection prayers
Food if low level or without Protect from Melee and Protect from Magic
Ranged armour
Ava's accumulator
Fast travel to several locations
The entrance of the Temple of Ikov (skills necklace to the Fishing Guild, combat bracelet to the Ranged Guild or Fairy Rings to blr)
Ardougne (Ardougne teleport or Ardougne cloak)
Edgeville (amulet of glory to Edgeville, ring of wealth to Grand Exchange or Fairy Rings to dkr)
requirements: Ranged 40 (boostable) - bypassable <ref>This requirement can be bypassed - see below</ref>
The ability to defeat a level 84 enemy with Ranged
enemiesToDefeat: Guardian of Armadyl (level 43) (Safespottable) - only if siding with Lucien
Lucien (level 14) - only if siding with the Guardians of Armadyl
rewards: Armadyl pendant (if you sided with Lucien, you must kill Guardians of Armadyl to obtain it)
Pendant of Lucien, which grants access to a door in the Temple of Ikov
Optional; Shiny key, for a shortcut between the Temple of Ikov and McGrubor's Wood
Completing this quest awards the player with 5 kudos which can be claimed by talking to Historian Minas in the Varrock Museum
ironmanConcerns: * 20 unnoted items need to be delivered at once. *A method of defeating the Fire Warrior of Lesarkus: **Ranged 40 (boostable) and access to a Yew longbow or better. Yew longbows can be obtained as a rare drop from young implings. **'OR' Darts or Throwing knives to bypass the Ranged requirement.
leagueRegion: <poem> Unlocking Desert will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: A mighty hero
walkthrough.body: Speak to Lucien in the Flying Horse Inn in the north-western corner of East Ardougne. He wants you to retrieve the Staff of Armadyl from the deserted Temple of Ikov. Ask him why he can't get it himself, and he will explain that the guardians of the staff have set up a magical barrier that he is unable to overcome, and give you the Pendant of lucien, which is required to enter the Chamber of Fear within the dungeon. He wants you to bring the staff to him in his house in Edgeville once you have found it.

walkthrough.heading: The Temple of Ikov
walkthrough.body: pendant of lucien, 20 limpwurt roots, Yew bow or higher 'or' throwing weapon, light source and knife (only if collecting the boots of lightness) In the following section, you will need to briefly reduce your weight to -1kg or less. The easiest method is to use the boots of lightness found within the dungeon, but any weight-reducing clothing will work. You may wish to bank the limpwurt roots/combat gear and do the dungeon in two trips. You may alternatively bring all of the gear required to complete the quest in one trip, provided you are 'willing to temporarily drop your items' on the ground and pick them back up again after completing the weightless section (only takes a few seconds). The temple is located directly south of the Ranging Guild and west of the Sorcerer's Tower. Climb down the ladder to enter the dungeon.

walkthrough.heading: The Boots of Lightness
walkthrough.body: If you have not yet collected your boots of lightness and are using it as your weight reducing method, from the entrance run to the west until you come to a set of stairs. You will need your light source with you to descend. Slash the web, pick up 'and equip' the Boots of Lightness, then return upstairs.

walkthrough.heading: The Unsteady Bridge
walkthrough.body: Head through the northern gate of the room while wearing the pendant. Without wearing the pendant, you will stop and receive the message {{mes|As you reach to open the door a great terror overcomes you!}} Here you will find an unsteady bridge over lava. To successfully cross this bridge, 'your weight needs to be -1kg or less,' 'or you will fail and take 20 damage!' If you brought extra items, drop them now until your weight displays -2kg to be safe (you will need to pick up a lever weighing 0.056kg). 'Keep your pendant equipped, or you will be unable to retrieve your items if you messed up the weight and fall!' Walk across the bridge and take the lever on the other side. :'Note': If you fell, you made a mistake with the weight and must walk to the south and take the ladder. You will appear just south of Hemenster, walk east to return to the Temple of Ikov. Pick up any dropped items, then head back to the initial room and place the lever on the lever bracket on the wall south-west of the entrance ladder. 'Pull the lever' to open the southern room. If you forget to pull the lever and leave the area, it will need to be reobtained.

walkthrough.heading: The Ice Chamber
walkthrough.body: After pulling the lever, the southern gate will be unlocked. Enter it and follow the path to the ice chamber filled with level-61 ice spiders. You need to gather enough ice arrows in this room to battle the Fire Warrior of Lesarkus. If you've chosen to use throwing weapons, you only need to find at least 1 ice arrow. If using a bow, at least 20 arrows are recommended for low levels, though you can get by with much less if you have a high Ranged level and an Ava's device. To gather ice arrows, you must search the 6 chests in this room. Only one will contain arrows at a time. Each time you loot a chest with arrows, you'll obtain 1-5 arrows, and a chest is randomly selected as the next spawn for the arrows. 'After obtaining arrows from a chest, search it again' as it's possible for it to be randomly selected in succession.

walkthrough.heading: Fire Warrior of Lesarkus
walkthrough.body: .]] When you have enough ice arrows, return to the entrance and again enter the north door with the Pendant of Lucien equipped. :'Tip:' You may choose to unequip the pendant after entering if you want to utilise the neck slot for the following combat section. Continue north until you see a small alcove with a lever in it. Right-click the lever to Search for traps (Thieving 42), then pull it. '''{{Color|red|If you don't search the lever first, you will fall into a pit of spikes and take 20 damage.}}''' The door at the end of the western passage will now be unlocked. Open it to enter a room with a summoning mark in the middle of it. Attempt to open the door to the north, and you'll be stopped by the Fire Warrior of Lesarkus. To continue you must defeat the Fire Warrior. He is intended to only take damage from ice arrows, however using throwing weapons with at least 1 ice arrow equipped will circumvent this without using up the arrows. After interrupting you, he will not attack until you either attack him first or talk to him. He uses solely magic, so Protect from Magic comes in handy. Using Ava's accumulator will assist you in not running out of arrows, though you can also pick up fallen arrows during the fight. If you take too long to defeat him or walk too far from the room, he will disappear and you will need to start the fight over. :'Note': If you use the wrong weapon or run out of ice arrows, he will stop the fight and boast that your weapons do nothing, but will not regenerate health if you resume the fight. After defeating him, proceed through the north door. You'll find Winelda the witch standing near a stream of lava. She will teleport you across if you hand her 20 unnoted limpwurt roots, 'all given at once'. :'Note': In case you have to re-enter the room, you do not need to fight the Fire Warrior again or bring the witch more limpwurt roots. Pass the skeletons until you reach a room behind a brick wall. Push the wall to enter it. :'Tip:' Before entering consider picking up the shiny key found past the level-82 Lesser demons further along the corridor, which will allow you to access a shortcut to McGrubor's Wood through a ladder next to the skeleons. This may be useful if you want to return to fight the monsters in this part of the dungeon after the quest.

walkthrough.heading: Picking a side
walkthrough.body: At this stage you must decide whether to take the staff for Lucien, resulting in combat with a lvl 43 Guardian of Armadyl, or whether to side with the Guardians of Armadyl, who will ask you to defeat a lvl 14 Lucien. Your choice will have a minor impact on the While Guthix Sleeps quest dialogue. If you choose to side with Lucien and want to obtain the Pendant of Armadyl again after the quest (used as protection for the God Wars Dungeon), you will need to kill the guardians rather than talk to them. Otherwise, the rewards remain the same for both paths.

walkthrough.heading: Side with the Guardians of Armadyl
walkthrough.body: {{Color|red|Warning:}} If you don't unequip your pendant or choose the wrong dialogue option, the guardian will attack you. Unequip your Pendant of Lucien and talk to the Guardian. Tell them that you seek the Staff of Armadyl for Lucien, then explain that Lucien offered a grand reward for it. The Guardian will offer to cleanse you to save your soul as a result of working for that 'spawn of evil'. Tell them it's time for "your yearly bath", and they will cleanse you with holy water. They will explain that Lucien is an undead necromancer that raised an army of the undead against Varrock a generation ago. Offer to help defeat him, and they will give you the Armadyl pendant, which must be worn to defeat him. Head towards Lucien's house which is between Edgeville and the Grand Exchange. Defeat him (level 14) while wearing the Armadyl pendant. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

walkthrough.heading: Side with Lucien
walkthrough.body: lying on a table.]] You may ignore the conversation with the Guardians. Try to take the Staff of Armadyl on the table in the north-west room. You will be attacked by a Guardian of Armadyl (Level 43). Defeat them, and take the staff. Head towards Lucien's house which is between Edgeville and the Grand Exchange. Hand him the staff to complete your quest. 'Congratulations, quest complete!' {{Clear}}

steps: Speak to Lucien in the Flying Horse Inn in the north-west corner of East Ardougne.
Enter the temple directly south of the Ranging Guild by climbing down the ladder.
Go west down the stairs, slash the web, and take the boots of lightness '(light source and knife or slash weapon required)'.
Go back upstairs, then through the north gate with the Pendant of lucien equipped.
Cross the lava bridge wearing the boots of lightness '(weight must be -1 kg or less or you will not be able to cross and take 20 damage from falling)', open the Large door, and take the lever.
Cross the lava bridge again and attach the lever to the lever-bracket on the wall a bit west of the ladder you climbed to enter the dungeon.
Pull the lever after attaching it. You will receive the prompt: "You hear the clunking of some hidden machinery."
Go through the south gate and follow the path.
Search chests along the icy path to obtain ice arrows. 16 with Ava's device and 60+ Ranged is enough.
'Note': It is possible for the arrows to be in the same chest multiple times in a row. It is therefore recommended to search the chest again right after getting an arrow loot.
'Note': You must search every chest after finding arrows to reset the chests, hopping worlds at 1 chest no longer resets them.
Go back through the north gate with the Pendant of lucien equipped.
Continue straight north to a small room containing a lever.
Right-click the lever and search for traps. (Requires 42 Thieving) Then pull the lever.
Go west then north through the doors.
A Fire Warrior of Lesarkus will spawn in the room upon attempting to enter the second door.
Kill him with your ice arrows.
Use protect from magic to take no damage.
Give Winelda 20 unnoted limpwurt roots all at once. She will teleport you to the other side of the lava.

'Ultimate Ironmen should be extremely cautious if juggling items here.' As soon as you hand in the limpwurt roots, Winelda will teleport you across the lava. You will NOT be able to turn around or get back to her.
''Optional: follow the path to its end and take the shiny key to access this dungeon from McGrubor's Wood.''
Push the wall to the north leading to a room full of Guardians of Armadyl.
Pick the good or evil path.
Remove your Pendant of lucien and talk to a Guardian of Armadyl.
Enter the building west of the Grand Exchange wearing your Armadyl pendant and kill Lucien (level 14).
Take the Staff of Armadyl from the table, you may have to kill a level 43 Guardian of Armadyl.
The guardian can be easily safespotted behind a chair.
Make sure to take the staff.
Enter the building west of the Grand Exchange and give Lucien the Staff of Armadyl.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Clock Tower
start: Talk to Brother Kojo in the Clock Tower south of East Ardougne.
description: Help the confused Brother Kojo find the missing cogs and fix his clock tower. Search the dungeon using brawn and brains to correctly place the four cogs.
itemRequirements: Alternatively, a Jug of water, Ice gloves, or Smiths gloves (i)
recommendedItems: Combat 15
Weight-reducing clothing and stamina or energy potions
Fast travel to Ardougne to start the quest - Ardougne cloak 1-4 or Ardougne Teleport or Spirit tree to Battlefield or fairy ring to djp or Captain Barnaby's ship from Rimmington or Brimhaven
leagueRegion: <poem> Kandarin — location requirement </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Starting out
walkthrough.body: .]] Talk to Brother Kojo at the Clock Tower just south-west of the Ardougne Zoo. He will tell you that the clock is broken and that you need to find four different coloured cogs from the dungeon beneath the tower to fix it. 'Note:' Players cannot carry more than one cog at a time, regardless of colour. You will need to retrieve each cog individually and fit it in the right place before moving onto the next one.

walkthrough.heading: Obtaining the blue cog
walkthrough.body: cage.]] The blue cog is locked inside of a cell with a dungeon rat..]] Go outside of the Clock Tower and head north-east to where Brother Cedric is (from the Monk's Friend quest) just south of the Ardougne Zoo. If you forgot a bucket of water, this is where the bucket and well are. You will notice a ladder just south of the camel cage from the Ardougne Zoo, around the oak tree. Go down the ladder and follow the long, winding passage until the end, until you get to a wall that you can push. Push the wall to get inside and pick up the blue cog. Climb up the ladder in this cage and you'll find yourself south of the Clock Tower. Head back inside and climb the stairs to the floor 1 and use the blue cog with the blue spindle.

walkthrough.heading: Obtaining the black cog
walkthrough.body: A bucket of water or ice gloves..]] This is where the bucket of water or ice gloves come in handy. Go inside the clock tower and climb down the ladder in the middle room. Then head through the passage to the north-east until you see four large coloured tiles on the floor. These tiles will indicate which direction the corresponding coloured cogs are. Then head through the north-eastern door from the tile room and go as far east as you can until you see several level 2 spiders. You will see the black cog surrounded by short walls of fire. To pick up the cog, you may either use the bucket of water with the cog or simply wear your ice gloves. This will cool the cog down so that you can pick it up. After getting the black cog, head back to the ladder where you first entered, '''but don't go up'''. You should see four spindles near the ladder; use the black cog with the black spindle.

walkthrough.heading: Obtaining the red cog
walkthrough.body: .]] Head through the south-eastern door, indicated by the red tile and walk down the passageway until you see some Ogres. The red cog will be on the floor where the Ogres are. Run over and pick it up then return to the ladder where you came from. Climb up to the ground floor and use the red cog on the red spindle. The spindles are located on a column beside the ground-floor ladder.

walkthrough.heading: Obtaining the white cog
walkthrough.body: .]] Return to the tile room and head through the north-western door, indicated by the white tile and follow the outer passageway until you find some rat poison. 'Note': Hop worlds to pick up an extra one if planning to later complete Ratcatchers. Pick up the poison, then go north-east down the long passageway until you see two levers near the dungeon rats. Pull the levers up to open the rat cage. Then head through the two gates and use the poison that you picked up before with the food trough. The dungeon rats will eat the poisoned food and begin to die. Wait until they've all died, and then you'll find that the gate to the west has become unhinged. Head through the western gate until you find the white cog. Pick it up and use the ladder nearby to appear outside of the Clock Tower. Go inside and climb to the topmost floor. Now, use the white cog with the white spindle on the top floor. 'Note:' If you want to keep the cogs as a souvenir, you must reobtain each cog after they have been placed, and before completing the quest. They will not respawn afterwards.

walkthrough.heading: Finishing up
walkthrough.body: Once you've placed all of the cogs on their corresponding spindles, head back to Brother Kojo, and he will reward you. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

steps: To start, talk to Brother Kojo at the Clock Tower. Note: if he gives you a Watch speak to him again
Go down the ladder in the middle room.
Follow the path to a hub with four doors.
Head through the south-eastern door.
Walk down the passageway until you see some Ogres.
Pick up the red cog.
Head back to the ladder.
Climb up to the ground floor and use the red cog on the red spindle (located on the column beside the ladder, facing north).
Go outside of the Clock Tower and head east to where Brother Cedric is (South of Ardougne zoo).
If you did not bring a bucket of water or ice gloves for the next section, take the bucket nearby and use it on the nearby well.
Go down the ladder east of Brother Cedric.
Follow the tunnel to the end.
Push the wall to get inside and pick up the blue cog.
Climb up the ladder.
Head to the centre room of the Clocktower and climb the staircase to the floor 1.
Use the blue cog with the blue spindle (the spindle on the south side of the column).
Head back to the basement and go through the north-eastern door
Go as far east as you can, to the fire.
Use the bucket of water with the cog or simply wear your ice gloves to pick up the cog. Make sure to finish the dialogue or you will not pick up the cog.
Head back to the ladder. (Do not climb up the ladder)
Use the black cog with the black spindle. (In the basement of the Clock Tower on the east side of the column).
Head through the north-western door.
Pick up the rat poison to the north-west.
'Take an extra for Ratcatchers if not already completed.'
Head to the end of the tunnel
On the north wall of the dungeon rat cage are two levers.
Pull the levers up to open the rat cage.
Use the rat poison with the food trough.
Wait until all the rats have died.
Head through the western gate.
Pick up the white cog.
Climb-up the ladder.
Head inside to the top floor.
Use the white cog with the white spindle at the top of the clocktower (the spindle on the west side of the column).
Head back down and talk to Brother Kojo for your reward.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Holy Grail
start: Speak to King Arthur in Camelot.
description: King Arthur is sending out his knights on a quest for the famous Holy Grail. If you are a Knight of the Round Table go to King Arthur for further orders.
recommendedItems: Combat 50
Melee is 'highly recommended' as the Black Knight Titan has +1000 magic and ranged defence
A Halberd may be used to avoid taking damage entirely, but the final damage 'must' be dealt with Excalibur
If below 41 combat, a method to cure poison
Any pickaxe to complete an easy Karamja Diary task (requires Mining 40)
Fast travel to several locations
Camelot to start the quest, plus 2 additional trips - Camelot Teleport
Galahad's house (1 trip) - combat bracelet to the Ranging Guild or skills necklace to the Fishing Guild
Draynor Manor (1 trip) - Draynor Manor teleport or amulet of glory to Draynor Village
Entrana (1 trip) - Balloon transport system or via Port Sarim using the Explorer's Ring 2 or Rat Pits minigame teleport
Brimhaven (1 trip) - Brimhaven teleport, Teleport to House (Brimhaven), via a charter ship or via Captain Barnaby's ship from Ardougne using the Ardougne Teleport or Ardougne cloak
Fisher Realm (1 trip) - fairy ring BJR or Brimhaven options listed above
Goblin Village (1 trip) - Goblin village sphere, Balloon transport system, Falador teleport or Teleport to House (Taverley)
requirements: Must be able to defeat a level 120 Black Knight Titan (can be safespotted or flinched)
rewards: Ability to put King Arthur picture on the wall in the Construction skill
Black Knight Titan accessible in the Nightmare Zone.
ironmanConcerns: The player briefly visits Entrana.
leagueRegion: <poem> Unlocking Kandarin will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: King Arthur and the Holy Grail
walkthrough.body: Speak to King Arthur in Camelot, who mentions he is sending out knights on an important quest. Ask him about it, and he will say they have recently learned the holy grail has passed into Gielinor. He wants you to speak to Merlin who may know more about where to find it. Merlin can be found on the floor 1 of Camelot Castle, north-west of King Arthur up the staircase in the south-east room ('not' the south-east tower where you went up the ladder to rescue Merlin in the 'Merlin's Crystal' quest). Merlin will appear once you enter the south-east room. Merlin will suggest that the grail is likely to reside in a holy place like Entrana, and that Sir Galahad previously quested for the grail and may know more. {{Clear|left}}

walkthrough.heading: The old crone's warning
walkthrough.body: Before speaking to Galahad, you must first visit Entrana. Head to Port Sarim and travel with the Monks of Entrana, depositing any weapons or armour via the nearby bank deposit box, as the monks will not allow them on the island. Speak to the high priest of the church, who says that the grail passed through the island but is no longer here. A strange old crone will appear and say that a Fisher King is in trouble. To help him you must find where the six stone heads around the world point to and blow a magic whistle there, in order to enter his realm. {{Clear|left}}

walkthrough.heading: Galahad's holy table napkin
walkthrough.body: {{Map|name=Galahad|x=2613|y=3477|r=4|mtype=square|caption=Galahad's house west of McGrubor's Woods and Camelot.|width=220|height=220|align=right}} Head to Galahad, found in a house west of McGrubor's Wood. Tell him you're looking for an item from the Fisher Realm, and he will reluctantly give you a holy table napkin, a souvenir he took from the Fisher Realm. 'Note:' To complete a task in the easy Kandarin Diary, ask him if he ever gets lonely, and he will give you a cup of tea. With your napkin, head to the top floor of Draynor Manor and into the southern room. You will see a pair of magic whistles on the table. Pick up 'both', one will be taken from you later. Fairy ring BJR will become accessible later in the quest - if you plan to use it, you will only need one, though taking multiple is still useful in case of mistakes. More than two can be obtained by dropping the whistles outside the room, entering it again, grabbing the two new whistles that spawn, and picking the dropped ones back up. 'Note': The whistles have a despawn timer, but will respawn upon re-entering the room. {{Clear|left}}

walkthrough.heading: Passing into the Fisher Realm
walkthrough.body: Excalibur, magic whistle, and combat equipment{{Map|2742,3234|r=3|mtype=square|caption=The location to blow the magic whistle.|width=220|height=220|align=right}} Head to Brimhaven, ensuring you have your combat equipment with you. Go west of the town and then up the northern peninsula to the goldmine, avoiding the poisonous scorpions if below Combat level 41. Look for a guard tower north of where the gold rocks are. 'Note:' To complete an easy Karamja Diary task, take the rope swing to the western island (with the Giants) and back. 'Note:' If you brought a pickaxe, you can complete an easy Karamja Diary task by mining a piece of gold here with Mining 40. Go under the tower and blow one of the magic whistles, and you will be teleported to the Fisher King's Realm.

walkthrough.heading: Black Knight Titan
walkthrough.body: .]] The Black Knight Titan guards the bridge ahead, and you must defeat him before you may continue. You may deal damage to him with other weapons but the 'killing blow must be dealt with Excalibur', otherwise he will heal to full health. Using melee to defeat him is 'highly recommended', as he has +1000 defence against Magic and Ranged. As the Black Knight Titan will not move, it is extremely easy to defeat him through flinching, by hitting him and moving back one square immediately, then waiting for his health bar to disappear before repeating. If you do take damage, his max hit is up to 15, so beware. Using a halberd will allow you to defeat him with melee from range with no chance of taking damage. 'Remember to switch back to Excalibur' at around 10% hitpoints remaining to avoid accidentally healing him to full. At low levels the knight may take 15 minutes or more to kill due to its 142 hitpoints and high melee defence. After killing the titan, cross the bridge and then head south along the river until you find a fisherman. Ask him how to get inside the castle, and he will tell you to ring the bell. Head to the castle located south-west from the fisherman where you will find a grail bell on the ground in front of the entrance. Ring it and a Grail Maiden will invite you inside. Head upstairs and speak to the Fisher King. Tell him you seek the grail, and he will reply that legend has it a questing knight will restore the Fisher Realm to its former glory and then claim the grail as their prize. Tell the Fisher King he doesn't look well, and he will tell you he fears his life is running short; he wants you to find his son Percival, who is actually a Knight of the Round Table, and bring him to the castle. {{Color|Red|Warning:}} Complete both dialogues before leaving, or you may have to return and kill the titan again! Blow your whistle again to be teleported out, or teleport out through other means and return to Camelot.

walkthrough.heading: Finding Percival
walkthrough.body: .]] Both magic whistles. Speak to King Arthur, who will recall Percival riding off on a quest to recover the golden boots of Arkaneeses a few months back. He will give you a magic gold feather which is said to point towards the location of the boots. Blow on the feather, and it will guide you towards Goblin Village, located north of Falador. Once at the Goblin Village, Open the sacks in the east house (do not just prod), and you will find Sir Percival ('you must have the feather in your inventory'). Tell him that his father wishes to see him. Percival doesn't know how to get to the castle; if you have a magic whistle in your inventory, you will automatically give it to him when the conversation ends..]]

walkthrough.heading: Retrieving the Holy Grail
walkthrough.body: Head back to the Fisher King's Realm like before (you don't need to fight the Black Knight Titan this time). You may now also teleport there using fairy ring BJR. Return to where the Fisher King previously was to find that Percival has become the new king. Head back downstairs, go up the staircase on the east end of the castle, and continue up the ladder. Take the holy grail. Return to King Arthur in Camelot and the player will inform him that the grail has been retrieved. 'Congratulations, quest complete!' {{Clear}}

steps: Talk to King Arthur.
Talk to Merlin.

He will now be found on the floor 1, in the room with the cauldron. Go up the main staircase and head to the eastern room. He won't show up as a yellow dot on the minimap until you have entered the room.
Bank all weapons and armour. Travel to Entrana.
Talk to the High Priest in the chapel.
Travel to Galahad's house west of McGrubor's Wood (fairy ring code ALS) or combat bracelet to Ranging Guild.
Talk to Galahad and receive the holy table napkin.
(Talk to Galahad again to complete a task in the Kandarin easy diary )

Travel to Draynor Manor's floor 2 southern-most room with the holy table napkin in your inventory and pick up 2 magic whistles from the table. The whistles will not be visible until you enter the room.
Prepare for the fight against the Black Knight Titan.
Travel north-west of Brimhaven to the north-western peninsula (see the minimap image).
Stand under the tower and blow a magic whistle to be teleported to the Fisher Realm.
Fight the Black Knight Titan nearby on the bridge and kill the titan with Excalibur. See the in-depth quest guide for details.
Head south along the river and talk to the fisherman.

Head to the castle, south-west of the fisherman, pick up the Grail bell from the ground and ring it. (You must stand in front of the bricks to gain access to the castle. Make sure NOT to use the Magic Whistle or you will be teleported outside and you will have to fight the Black Knight Titan again.)
Take the stairs to the south, and talk to the Fisher King. (Make sure to talk to him about both options or you will have to kill the Black Knight Titan again if you leave.)
Travel to Camelot and talk to King Arthur. 'Make sure to have 1 empty slot in your inventory for Magic gold feather he gives you.'
Travel to Goblin Village.
Use the 'Open' option on the sacks in the house in the east side of Goblin Village.
Talk to Sir Percival, he will take your magic whistle. Make sure you have another to get to the Fisher Realm yourself.
Travel back to the Fisher Realm (via Brimhaven or using the fairy ring code BJR. You do not need to fight the Titan again either way)
Head to the top floor of the castle's eastern tower and take the Holy grail.
Return to King Arthur.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Tree Gnome Village
aliases: How to get to tree gnome village
start: Centre of the Tree Gnome Village Maze, talk to King Bolren.
description:
The tree gnomes are in trouble. General Khazard's forces are hunting them to extinction.

Find your way through the hedge maze to the gnomes secret treetop village.

Then help the gnomes fight Khazard and retrieve the orbs of protection.
itemRequirements: 6 normal logs (or an axe, obtainable during the quest by killing goblins in the Tree Gnome Village maze, or retrievable from the canoe station near the north entrance to the maze, if you have one stored)
recommendedItems: Combat 45
Weight-reducing clothing and stamina or energy potions
Fast travel to Tree Gnome Village to start the quest - Castle Wars minigame teleport, ring of dueling to Castle Wars, fairy ring to ciq, Ardougne cloak 1-4, or necklace of passage to The Outpost
requirements: The ability to defeat a level 112 Khazard warlord
rewards: Use of spirit trees for transportation
Khazard warlord accessible in the Nightmare Zone.
leagueRegion: <poem> Unlocking Kandarin will auto-complete the quest Unlocking the {{ilink|Nature's Accord (Demonic Pacts League)|Nature's Accord}} relic will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Protecting the Spirit Tree
walkthrough.body: {{Map:Tree Gnome Village path}} Head to the centre of the Tree Gnome Maze (see the map to the right for the path through the maze). The maze is located south-east of East Ardougne and north of Yanille. Talk to King Bolren, who will say that three orbs have been stolen by Khazard troops. Agree to help him, and you will be escorted by Elkoy out of the maze. {{Clear|left}}

walkthrough.heading: The three trackers
walkthrough.body: 6 normal logs. North to the maze you will find a battlefield. Find Commander Montai and speak with him, he is wearing red clothing. He will ask for you to bring him 6 logs to repair their defences. After giving him the logs, talk to Commander Montai again, and he'll tell you that three trackers that have been sent out to retrieve coordinates to fire the ballista have not returned. He asks you to find them. You can find all three tracker gnomes at the buildings north to the battlefield. (look at the picture to the right to see the locations) {{Clear|left}} *The first tracker is behind or on the side of the biggest building in the north-west. *The second tracker is in the north-east building in a Khazard Prison Cell. *The third tracker is roaming outside the south-west corner of the stronghold. The first two trackers will give you the coordinates you need, which you'll automatically commit to memory. The third tracker, however, has been driven mad as a result of the chaos. Though most of what he says is garbage, he will give you a hint as to the number you need. You may have to do a bit of guesswork, though. For instance, "Less than my hands" would equal 1, where "More than my head less than my fingers" could be 2, "More than we but less than our feet" is 3, and lastly, "My legs and your legs" is 4. (It should not be any other possible number so try and remember what the third tracker said.) Head back to the ballista (not the catapult, which is next to Montai), which is located in the south-west corner of the battlefield, here you want to choose the coordinate given from the third gnome tracker. If you miss, just try again until you get it.

walkthrough.heading: Retrieving the first orb
walkthrough.body: Once you get a hit, talk to Commander Montai once again then walk north to the stronghold (building where Gnome Tracker 1 was) and climb over the crumbled wall. 'Note:' There is a stall after climbing the crumbled wall where you are attacked without being able to heal; as a low-levelled player, this may be dangerous. Once you climb the wall you will be attacked by a level 48 Khazard commander; he has low Hitpoints (22) and should not be troublesome for most mid-levelled players (can be safespotted behind northern broken chair). You can skip defeating the commander if you wish and proceed to the western room and climb up the ladder. When you climb the ladder you will once again be attacked by a level 48 Khazard commander, kill him or head to the chest and find the orb of protection. When you have the orb, run back down the ladder and out of the nearby door. Return to the north-west maze entrance and talk to Elkoy, he will offer to lead you through the maze, accept his offer. Talk to King Bolren in the centre of the maze and he will inform you that the other two orbs of protection have been stolen by the Khazard Warlord.

walkthrough.heading: Retrieving the last two orbs
walkthrough.body: Combat equipment to defeat a level 112 'Note:' The orbs will only be dropped by the Warlord after you've spoken to the King. {{Map|name=Khazard warlord|2455,3301|r=4|mtype=square|caption=The location of the Khazard warlord.|align=right|width=220|height=220}} Exit the village and start heading north past the stronghold where you found the first orb. When you hit the wall to West Ardougne, follow it to the west past the wolves and then to the north until you see two Khazard troopers and the level 112 Khazard warlord. The warlord will be unaggressive until you talk with him, at which point he will challenge you to a fight and attack. Kill him to retrieve the other two orbs. Players with Rune armour and at least a rune scimitar should have little trouble fighting him if they have a small amount of decent quality food (lobster or better), though the warlord has a rather large HP of 170. Lower levelled players may consider using Magic or Ranged to safespot him. After initiating the fight, head west until the warlord de-aggros near the larger dead tree. Move a little south and attack the warlord with Ranged or Magic while outside his aggro range. This will force the warlord to walk backwards at an angle and get caught against the West Ardougne wall and the northern large dead tree. If done correctly, players can attack the warlord safely as long as they keep distant enough as to not aggro the warlord again. If you fail to get the warlord stuck, you can also simply run away from him whenever he gets close, only attacking him while he is wandering back. 'Note': He may despawn if you take too long to kill him using this method. He may also be flinched using melee by repeatedly stepping in and out of his walking range. One good spot is beside the large skull to the south. He does not despawn when flinched. After killing him, pick up the orbs of protection. Go back to King Bolren and hand over the orbs to him. A cutscene ensues, where the gnomes are seen celebrating and holding a ceremony in which the orbs are returned to their places on the sacred spirit tree. 'Congratulations, quest complete!' {{Clear}}

steps: Talk to King Bolren in Tree Gnome Village. Accept the quest and you will be taken out of the maze and placed at the north-west corner.
Walk slightly north and speak to Commander Montai (red hat) at the south-west edge of the battlefield, south of the river.
Talk to him again to give him 6 logs.
Then talk to him a third time.
Talk to the second tracker gnome in a building towards the east side of the Khazard Stronghold.
Talk to the first tracker gnome around the north-west of the Khazard Stronghold.
Talk to the third tracker gnome in the south-west corner of the Khazard Stronghold. Pay attention to his dialogue, he will give you the coordinates for the ballista:
"Less than my hands" - 0001
"More than my head less than my fingers" - 0002
"More than we, less than our feet" - 0003
"My legs and your legs" - 0004
Fire the ballista located in the south-west corner of the battlefield, past the bridge, and enter the coordinates as given by the third tracker gnome.
Walk north to the stronghold (building where Tracker gnome 1 was) and climb over the crumbled wall.
You can ignore or kill the level 48 Khazard commanders that will attack you.
Climb the ladder, search the chest, and take the orb of protection.
Exit the stronghold through the front door.
Return to the Tree Gnome Village, and talk to Elkoy to be sent to the centre.
King Bolren will ask you to get the other two orbs of protection.
Talk to Khazard warlord north-west of the battlefield (below west West Ardougne, outside of the wall underneath the Underground Pass) and then kill him to retrieve the Orbs of protection.

To safespot the warlord, begin the fight and head west until he de-aggros near a large dead tree. Move a bit south and attack him from outside his aggro range with Ranged or Magic. This will force him to walk backwards at an angle and get caught between the West Ardougne wall and northern large dead tree. Players can safely continue their attacks as long as they maintain distance.
Melee players can also safespot him by by repeatedly stepping in and out of his walking range. One good spot is beside the large skull to the south.
Head back to the village and return the orbs to King Bolren.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Fight Arena
start: Talk to Lady Servil. She is west by south-west of the Monastery that is south of Ardougne.
description:
The prosperous Servil family have been abducted by the infamous General Khazard. He plans to have the family battle for his entertainment in the Fight Arena.

Can you rescue the Servils before the tyrant has these innocent (not to mention wealthy) civilians slain?
recommendedItems: Combat 50, combat equipment and some food
Alternatively: Ranged, Magic or a Halberd to safespot all enemies (all enemies attack with melee)
Fast travel to Fight Arena to start the quest - Ardougne cloak 1-4 or fairy ring to djp or Spirit tree to Battlefield or Ardougne Teleport or Captain Barnaby's ship from Rimmington or Brimhaven
rewards: Bouncer accessible in the Nightmare Zone.
leagueRegion: <poem> Kandarin — location requirement Unlocking Desert will auto-complete the quest Unlocking Fremennik will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Kidnapping
walkthrough.body: {{Map|2566,3199|align=left|r=5|height=240|width=240|mtype=square|caption=Location of quest start.}} Head just south-west of the Ardougne Monastery and talk to Lady Servil by the north-east corner of the Tree Gnome Village maze. She will explain that her family has been kidnapped by General Khazard and his group of mercenaries and forced to fight in their arena. The player will agree to help rescue them. {{Map|2613,3190|mtype=pin|align=right|height=220|width=220|caption=The location of the suit of armour containing the armour.}}.]] Head east to a group of buildings located south of the Ardougne Monastery. In the most north-eastern house, search the chest to obtain Khazard armour. Equip both pieces and head south to the prison, which forms the south and east boundaries of the arena. 'Note:' Multiple sets of armour may be obtained using the drop trick. The guards will only let you into the prison wearing the Khazard armour. Once inside, do not remove it, or the guards will not speak to you. You can wear anything in any of the other slots.

walkthrough.heading: Staging a breakout
walkthrough.body: 5 coins Sammy Servil (the boy in the purple shirt) is located in the northernmost cell of the east wing of the prison. Ask him where the cell keys are, and he will explain the Head Guard has them. Head to the south-eastern corner of the jail and talk to the Head Guard by the staircase. He will mention his cravings for Khali brew and let it slip that last time he had too many, he fell asleep on the job. Head to the bar found west of the western entrance to the jail, and purchase Khali brew from the Khazard barman for five coins. 'If there is no option to, you must finish the dialogue with the head guard.' Return to the head guard and give him the brew, and he will quickly get drunk, handing the player the keys when asked. Ensure you have your combat equipment and prepare for three enemies you must fight in a row (all safespottable). Use the keys on Sammy's prison door to free him and a cutscene will begin, in which Sammy enters the main arena in search of his father Justin, who is being attacked by a Khazard ogre.

walkthrough.heading: The fights
walkthrough.body: {{Instance}} 'Note': The dwarven multicannon cannot be set up in the arena. 'Note:' Throughout the fights, you may teleport out if you run into trouble. Speaking to the Khazard Guard by the door of the prison will take you back into the arena. You must kill the level 63 Khazard Ogre attacking Sammy's father. There is a very easy safespot behind a nearby skeleton, whereby you may use Magic, Ranged or a halberd for an easy fight. All of the following enemies use melee, so you can alternately use Protect from Melee. 'Note': If a fight sequence does not initiate, speak to Justin in order to continue, 'but note that if the ogre has already spawned, a second one will appear if you talk to Justin.' After defeating the ogre, General Khazard will appear and order his guards to lock you away after suggesting that if you fight in his arena, he might let the Servils go. Talk to your cellmate Hengrad, and after a brief conversation the guard will bring you back to the arena. The second fight is with a level 44 non poisonous Khazard scorpion. Note that it will reach you quickly, so you should immediately run to the same safespot or activate Protect from Melee. with Magic using the safespot.]] After defeating the scorpion, Khazard will release Bouncer the level 137 hellhound. You will need high healing food if not using the safespot or Protect from Melee at a low level, but otherwise the strategy is the same. After killing the hellhound, a level 142 General Khazard will vow to make you pay for killing his puppy, and then attack you. 'This fight is optional', and the quest progresses the same if you leave now via the door (use its Quick-escape option to avoid needing to confirm you wish to leave). The same strategies as before are effective against the general. Return to Lady Servil and she will tell you that her son and husband are safe and recovering at home. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

steps: Ensure that you have 2 empty inventory slots.
Talk to Lady Servil just outside of the north-east corner of the Tree Gnome Village maze.
Go to the house in the most north-eastern corner of the area and search the chest for Khazard armour.
Equip the armour and head south into the prison (do not unequip the armour inside!).
Head inside the south-east room where the jails are located.
Talk to the Head Guard in the south most room of the jail near the staircase. The right guard will mention that he wants a "decent drink," saying he will fall asleep with too much Khali brew.
Go to outside, and head to the bar, located in the west and buy a Khali brew for five coins from Khazard barman (if you didn't talk to the right guard, the option is not there).
Go back to the jail and talk to the guard to get the keys.
Prepare for a fight. Ranged, mage, or a halberd are recommended to safespot, or the Protect from Melee prayer.
Use the keys on Sammy's prison door (the most north-eastern cell) to free him.

Note: During any cutscene dialogue, between opponents, you may click away and resupply with no need for the Khazard armour to re-enter the prison. All enemies may be safespotted using various skeletons around the arena.
Kill the Khazard Ogre (level 63) (if the fight doesn't start, talk to Justin).
You will be locked up again. Talk to your cellmate, Hengrad, to begin the next fight.
Kill the Khazard scorpion (level 44).

Kill Bouncer (level 137). 'Warning:' Once you begin the fight with General Khazard you are unable to reenter the arena. Dying in the arena after this point will most likely make the grave inaccessible, thus making them only retrievable from Death
Kill General Khazard (level 142) or run away through the door in the south-east corner of the arena (or just run north until he's not aggressive).
Return to Lady Servil.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Hazeel Cult
start: Central Ardougne, south of King Lathas' castle. Talk to Ceril Carnillean.
description: Discover the truth behind the Carnillean family fortune. Decide for yourself whether to aid the Carnilleans in retrieving stolen goods, or join the Hazeel cult members in their mission to resurrect the infamous Lord Hazeel.
recommendedItems: Combat 10
Weight-reducing clothing and stamina or energy potions
Fast travel to Ardougne to start the quest - Ardougne cloak 1-4 or Ardougne Teleport or Spirit tree to Battlefield or fairy ring to djp or Captain Barnaby's ship from Rimmington or Brimhaven
rewards: 2000 coins (plus 5 from the fake ending if you sided with the Carnillean family)
Hazeel's mark (if you sided with Hazeel)
Carnillean armour (if you sided with Ceril and obtained an extra during the quest)
5 Kudos, which can be claimed by talking to Historian Minas in the Varrock Museum
leagueRegion: <poem> Kandarin — location requirement Unlocking Desert will auto-complete the quest Unlocking Fremennik will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Hazeel Thieves
walkthrough.body: Head to the house in the south-western corner of East Ardougne. Speak to Ceril Carnillean, who will start ranting about thieving cultists. Ask him what's wrong; some cultists have stolen a suit of armour, and the player will offer to help get it back. He points you in the direction of a cave to the south of the city. Head east of the clock tower, and enter the cave (south of Valve 3 on the side). {{Clear|left}}

walkthrough.heading: Picking a side
walkthrough.body: At this stage you will have a choice between two sides in this quest, helping Ceril Carnillean get his family armour back and foiling the plan to revive Hazeel, or helping Hazeel's followers murder a Carnillean and resurrect their master. The reward is almost the same for both, though siding with Ceril will reward 5 additional coins and gives you the option to obtain Carnillean armour, although this armour has lower defensive bonuses than an iron platebody. Siding with Hazeel will reward the Hazeel's mark, which is a purely cosmetic reward. Rewards may only be obtained during or upon completion of the quest, and can 'never' be reclaimed afterward. Ceril's side is quicker, but requires killing Alomone, which is not recommended for very low-level players. Your choice will also have a minor effect on the events of the quest Secrets of the North. If siding with Hazeel, skip the following section and read the next one.

walkthrough.heading: Siding with Ceril
walkthrough.body: , 2: Clivet, 3: Alomone (level 13), A: Quest Area (Area to travel, from begin to end). Green numbers indicate valve locations.]] Weapon, armour and food If you've chosen to side with Ceril, talk to Clivet in the cave to learn about Hazeel, an ancient and powerful follower of Zamorak who was killed by an ancestor of Ceril. He will ask for your help in reviving Hazeel. 'Refuse'. Clivet will sail away on a raft, saying that you'll never be able to find him. Go back upstairs, find the sewer valves, and turn them in the proper direction. {{Checklist| *'Valve 1' - This is right across the bridge south of the Carnilleans' house. Turn it <u>'right'</u>. *'Valve 2' - This is right behind Carnilleans' house. Turn it <u>'right'</u>. *'Valve 3' - This is north of the cave. Turn it <u>'left'</u>. *'Valve 4' - This is south of the zoo's penguin cage. Turn it <u>'right'</u>. *'Valve 5' - Go south-east of the fourth valve, past the monk. Turn it <u>'right'</u>. }} After you've turned all five, go back into the cave. Board the raft, then head to the southernmost room and talk to Alomone. He will let it slip that Ceril's butler is part of the cult, before attacking you. Kill him, then open the chest in the room to get the Carnillean armour. 'Note': You can use the drop trick if you want your own armour. Board the raft again in order to return to the sewer entrance. Back at the Carnilleans' house, talk to Ceril Carnillean, who will take the armour from you and give you 5 coins. After the player accuses the butler, he will refuse to believe you. '''You'll see a quest reward screen, but you haven't received the real reward yet!' {{Listen|filename=Oh Dear!.ogg|align=right|title=Congratulations! Quest complete!|desc=Or not...}} Search the cupboard on the floor 1 and you will find the Mark of Hazeel and a bottle of poison. Show these to Ceril. He will fire Butler Jones and give you the real'' quest reward.

walkthrough.heading: Siding with Hazeel
walkthrough.body: , 2: Clivet, 3: Alomone (level 13), A: Quest Area (Area to travel, from begin to end). Green Numbers are marking valves.]] If you've chosen to side with Hazeel, make sure you have a free inventory slot and then talk to Clivet to learn about Hazeel. He will explain that Hazeel is an ancient and powerful follower of Zamorak who was killed by an ancestor of Ceril. He will ask for your help in reviving Hazeel. 'Accept.' He wants you to prove your loyalty by killing Ceril. Ask him how, and he will give you some poison and instruct you to pour it in Ceril's food. Head to the basement of Ceril's house, and use the bottle of poison on the range. Then, go upstairs and talk to Ceril Carnillean to learn that you've accidentally killed Scruffy the family dog instead; his son gave the meal to him. Talk to Clivet again, and he will have heard about the accident, but takes it as proof of your loyalty regardless. He'll give you Hazeel's mark, then tell you to meet with their leader Alomone in their hideout. To get to the hideout, you need to find five Sewer valves and turn them the proper direction. {{Checklist| *'Valve 1' - This is right across the bridge south of the Carnilleans' house. Turn it <u>'right'</u>. *'Valve 2' - This is right behind Carnilleans' house. Turn it <u>'right'</u>. *'Valve 3' - This is north of the cave. Turn it <u>'left'</u>. *'Valve 4' - This is south of the zoo's penguin cage. Turn it <u>'right'</u>. *'Valve 5' - Go south-east of the fourth valve, past the monk. Turn it <u>'right'</u>. }} Go back to the cave and board the raft. Once you're in the main hideout, talk to Alomone.
