He wants you to help the Carnillean's butler, an undercover cultist, retrieve a magical scroll of restoration that is hidden in the Carnilleans' house. Talk to Butler Jones in the house, who believes the scroll is hidden where even the family won't find it. Search the crate in the basement for a chest key (make sure to finish the dialogue to get the key in your inventory). Go up the ladder, then up the stairs and knock on the wall in the east room, on the northern side, then finally go up the ladder. Use the key on the chest to get the scroll. Return to Alomone to start Hazeel's resurrection.{{Clear}}

name: Sheep Herder
start: Speak to Councillor Halgrive outside of the East Ardougne church.
description: Dispose of plagued sheep and save Ardougne!
recommendedItems: Energy restoring items

Fast travel to East Ardougne to start the quest - Ardougne Teleport or Skills necklace to Fishing Guild or Spirit tree to Battlefield or fairy ring to djp or Captain Barnaby's ship from Rimmington or Brimhaven
Optionally a Skills necklace to save some time when walking from East Ardougne to the Fishing Guild
leagueRegion: <poem> Kandarin — location requirement Unlocking Tirannwn will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: A threat to public health and safety
walkthrough.body: 100 coins {{Map|x=2617|y=3299|r=3|mtype=square|align=right|caption=The quest's start point.|width=250|height=250}} Speak to Councillor Halgrive located in East Ardougne in the graveyard directly south of the church. He is concerned about plagued sheep located near East Ardougne that escaped from a local farm, causing a threat to the health and safety for the public. He is looking for someone to herd the sheep, kill them quickly and cleanly, and dispose the remains in a special incinerator set up by Farmer Brumty. Agree to help do the job. He will happily thank you and mention you need a plague suit while herding the sheep. He will tell you to pick up the plague suit from Doctor Orbon and hand you some poisoned sheep feed. Head inside the church and talk to Doctor Orbon. After explaining you need protective clothing to dispose the escaped infected sheep, he will sell his last suit for 100 coins so he can afford a replacement for himself. Agree to pay for the suit, and you should receive a plague jacket and plague trousers. Pray with missing Prayer points at the altar to complete an easy task in the Ardougne diary.

walkthrough.heading: Herding the sheep
walkthrough.body: Plague jacket, plague trousers {{Map|align=right|mtype=pin|caption=Location of the sheep. |2609,3389,title:Location of the yellow sheep,icon:yellowPin,desc: |2620,3368,title:Location of the green sheep,icon:greenPin,desc: |2608,3346,title:Location of the red sheep,icon:redPin,desc: |2569,3383,title:Location of the blue sheep,icon:bluePin,desc: }} Head to the fenced in enclosure located north-west of the north bank in East Ardougne. With your plague suit equipped, enter the gate on the west side of the enclosure. Head towards the incinerator where you will find a cattleprod lying on the ground a few steps south of the incinerator. Pick it up. Leave the fenced in enclosure using the west gate. You can begin to dispose of the sheep by equipping the cattleprod and using it to direct the sheep into the fenced in enclosure using the west gate. The sheep will be prodded in the direction of which you are facing. The sheep can return back to their initial locations if you wait too long to prod. 'You only need one of each colour (in any order)', and you can finish one sheep at a time. Note: You can have a friend join you and body block the sheep, preventing them from going farther than desired and also prevent them from going back to their original location. *Red sheep are located north of the north bank in East Ardougne. *Green sheep are north-east of the red sheep, directly north of a fenced in area with chopped and fallen trees. *Blue sheep are located north-west of the fenced in enclosure with the incinerator, nearby a small camp with warriors. Do not go too far, as there are also aggressive level 42 moss giants nearby. *Yellow sheep are located south of the Fishing Guild. Note: If a sheep goes '''BAAAAA!' (uppercase letters), it will be prodded in the direction you direct them towards. If a sheep goes 'Baa''', it will return to its initial location. When directing them to the fenced in pen with the incinerator located, it is better to spam click the sheep so that it does not walk back. If the sheep gets stuck against a corner or wall, prod them again, this will cause them to move towards an open tile. Make sure you prod the sheep one last time to get it IN the pen when you are close.

walkthrough.heading: Killing the plagued sheep
walkthrough.body: Plague jacket, plague trousers, Sheep feed poisoned sheep food Once you have directed them to the gate of the incinerator, the sheep will automatically go inside the gate. Use the poisoned sheep food to kill each sheep. Collect their bones and use them on the incinerator to burn the remains. Return to Councillor Halgrive and tell him you disposed of the four sheep. He will reimburse you the 100 coins you spent for the protective clothing in addition to 3,000 coins as recognition of your service. 'Congratulations! Quest completed!'

name: Plague City
start: Talk to Edmond, living next to the wall surrounding West Ardougne, north of Ardougne Castle.
description: The western part of Ardougne has been shut off as a deadly plague sweeps through the people. However, a young woman who went in to try to help those stricken by the illness has disappeared and her parents have become worried.
itemRequirements: Dwellberries (Spawns in McGrubor's Wood, squeeze through the loose railing, use ALS, or Telekinetic Grab them. They can be bought from Heckel Funch or Hudo in the Tree Gnome Stronghold or grown with 36 Farming.)
Rope (Purchasable in the East Ardougne general store, Port Khazard general store, Ned, or a spawn in Karamja general store.)
1-4 buckets of water (four uses required, there is a water source and bucket spawn nearby)
Hangover cure or the ingredients to make one:
Bucket of milk (Obtained by using a bucket on a dairy cow, one is north of Ardougne, or bought from Hudo or Heckel Funch.)
Snape grass (Spawns west of the Crafting Guild or the peninsula north-east of Hosidius. It can be grown at 61 Farming. Can also be obtained from killing Tribesmen in Karamja.)
Picture of Elena (Inside Alrena and Edmond's house)
recommendedItems: Fast travel to Ardougne to start the quest - Skills necklace to Fishing Guild or Spirit tree to Battlefield or fairy ring to djp or Captain Barnaby's ship from Rimmington or Brimhaven
rewards: Ardougne teleport scroll, reading it unlocks the Ardougne Teleport with 51 Magic and use of the Ardougne teletab.
ironmanConcerns: * The hangover cure can be made before the quest starts by combining milk, chocolate dust, and snape grass to conserve inventory space. * The hangover cure itself is an 'untradeable item' so if preparing for Group Ironman, do not premake these as you will be unable to share them with your group through Group Storage or Trading.
leagueRegion: <poem> Unlocking Fremennik will auto-complete the quest Unlocking Kandarin will auto-complete the quest Unlocking Tirannwn will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Infiltrating West Ardougne
walkthrough.body: dwellberries, 4 buckets of water, a spade, a rope, a bucket of milk, chocolate dust, and snape grass. Talk to Edmond behind his house, next to the wall surrounding West Ardougne, north of the Ardougne Castle. He will mention that he has to find his daughter; ask him what happened to her, and he explains that his daughter Elena is a healer who crossed the wall into plague stricken West Ardougne three weeks ago, and hasn't been heard from since. Agree to help him with his plan to get into West Ardougne, and he'll tell you to talk to his wife about protection against the plague. His wife, Alrena, is inside the house or wandering outside. She'll tell you she can make a gas mask if you get her some dwellberries. Give them to her and she'll give you a mask. There are spare masks in the cupboard. While in the house, 'pick up the Picture of Elena'. Talk to Edmond again, and he'll tell you his plan to dig under the wall and get into West Ardougne. First, you'll need to soften the ground. Use four buckets of water on the mud patch behind his house (between the cabbages and potatoes). You can refill buckets with the sink inside. Then use the spade on the softened ground. You'll fall under and Edmond will follow you down. Walk south to find a pipe blocked by a grill. After pulling on it to no avail, use a rope on the pipe, and talk to Edmond to pull the grill off. Put on your gas mask and climb inside to enter West Ardougne. {{Map|name=The Rehnison household|2531,3331|r=4|mtype=square|align=right|height=220|width=220|caption=The Rehnison House}}

walkthrough.heading: Finding Elena
walkthrough.body: Elena's Picture. Once inside West Ardougne, talk to Jethick. He's just to the east (in the same plaza). Show him Elena's picture and he'll tell you to go check the Rehnison house and give you a book that he borrowed from them. Go north to the house sitting right up against the edge of the wall, as shown on the map. The grey planks of the building set it apart. They'll let you in when you mention you have the book. Once inside, talk to Martha Rehnison or Ted Rehnison, then go upstairs and talk to their daughter, Milli Rehnison, who'll tell you more about Elena's disappearance and whereabouts. Leave and go south past the town square near the southern wall to find the house with the big black "X" on the doors and a stairwell in the middle going down, marked with a black box on the map. Attempt to open the doors; the Mourners won't let you in because it's been hit hard by the plague. Tell them that you're looking for a kidnapped girl (you need to select the option to ask again or you can't continue), and they'll tell you you need permission from Bravek to enter the house. {{Clear|left}}

walkthrough.heading: Getting inside
walkthrough.body: Hangover Cure or the ingredients to make it. Go back to the town square and into the large building on the north side, north of the manhole. Ask the clerk who is through the door, then tell him ''This is urgent though! Someone's been kidnapped!'', and he'll let you inside to see Bravek. He can hardly talk to you however, as he's badly hung over. He'll give you a scruffy note with a recipe for a hangover cure. To make it, put the chocolate dust into the bucket of milk, then add snape grass ('Be careful: do not left-click on the chocolate bar or the chocolatey milk, or you will eat/drink them!') Give the hangover cure to him, and tell him that the mourners won't listen to you. He'll then give you a warrant granting permission to enter the plague house and search for Elena. Go to that house, and try to enter again. The Mourners will try to stop you, but when given the warrant from Bravek they'll be at a loss, giving you a chance to sneak inside. Once inside, search the barrel to the west of the staircase to find a small key. Elena is downstairs. Go downstairs and unlock the door with the key, talk to her to release her. Return to Edmond's garden (where you started) by climbing down the manhole in the middle of the city, and climbing the mud pile. Talk to Edmond to finish the quest.

steps: Speak to Edmond.
Speak to Alrena inside or near the house.
Take the Picture of Elena off the table in the house.
Speak to Edmond.
Use 4 buckets of water on the mud patch behind the house (between the cabbages and potatoes).
Dig with a spade on the softened ground.
Go south to the farthest pipe.
Attempt to open the grill.
Use a rope on the grill.
Speak to Edmond.
Put on the gas mask and climb up the pipe.
Go east and speak to Jethick; he will give you a book.
Go north to the house against the wall (next to the rotten apple spawn).
Attempt to open the door.
Speak to Martha Rehnison or Ted Rehnison in the house.
Go upstairs and speak to Milli Rehnison.
Go south of the town square to the large building along the southern wall with an "X" on the doors and a staircase inside going down. Attempt to open the door.
Go to the large main building on the north side of the town square, north of the manhole.
Talk to the Clerk in the main room.
Speak to Bravek.
:He will give you a scruffy note for a hangover cure.
Use the hangover cure on Bravek; he will give you a warrant.
Return to the Mourner house, the one with "X" on the doors and the stairwell.
Search the barrel west of the staircase for a small key.
Go downstairs, enter the cell, and speak to Elena.
Return to the town square, go down the manhole, through the sewer, climb the mud pile, and speak to Edmond at his house.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Sea Slug
start: Speak to Caroline just north of Witchaven.
description:
Something strange is happening on the Fishing Platform.
Missing fishermen and the presence of dozens of strange sea creatures gives cause for concern.
Investigate the platform, discover the truth before it's too late.
itemRequirements: Swamp paste (made by mixing flour with swamp tar then cooking the mixture on a fire; can also be bought from a Trader crewmember for 75 coins, from Rasolo for 60 coins west of the Fishing Guild, or from the Khazard General Store for 42 coins at full stock)
recommendedItems: Small fishing net for Ardougne Medium Diary (can be bought near quest start in Witchaven)
Unlit torch (a small glitch might occur where you do not receive the torch during the quest)
leagueRegion: <poem> Kandarin — location requirement </poem>

walkthrough.heading: The Fishing Platform
walkthrough.body: swamp paste Talk to Caroline on the coast north of the town of Witchaven, east of Ardougne. She will tell you her husband Kent took her son Kennith to the Fishing Platform a week ago, and she hasn't heard from them since; other families have not heard from the fishermen there either. She wants you to talk to Holgart, who has a boat that can take you to the platform to investigate. Talk to Holgart, and he will tell you his ship is in need of repairs. He will ask for swamp paste ('not swamp tar') to fix it up. Once you give him it, Holgart will appear in a cut scene fixing the boat. Talk to him again to go to the Fishing Platform.

walkthrough.heading: Investigate
walkthrough.body: When you arrive, you will notice the odd behaviour of everyone as they all seem to be in a zombie-like trance. Avoid interacting with the sea slugs; they will deal 3 damage if picked up. 'Note:' If you brought a small fishing net, you can catch a fish here to complete a task for the medium Ardougne Diary. Look around and find Bailey inside a small room in the south-west corner of the platform. Talk to him, he will tell you about the odd happenings and the hauling up of the sea slugs. Pick up the broken glass on the floor for later in the quest.

walkthrough.heading: Helping Kennith
walkthrough.body: Pick up some damp sticks close to the ladder in the north-east corner of the platform, then climb up the ladder. Upstairs, in a room on the west side, past the crane, you will find Kennith. He will tell you that his father tried to leave days ago, but the fishermen stopped him from doing so. He will ask you to find his father, Kent and help him. Go back to Holgart and talk to him. He will take you to a deserted island, where you will find Kennith's father stranded. Talk to Kent and he will tell you his story. Then ask Holgart to take you back to the platform. Talk to Bailey to find out the slugs' weakness - they are afraid of heat. He will give you an unlit torch, which he cannot light himself as it is too damp. Use the broken glass on the damp sticks, which are found near the ladder to dry them, then rub them together to 'light the torch' (Firemaking 30). If you do not light it now, you will be damaged by a fisherman when going upstairs. Climb up the ladder again (on the north-east of the platform), go into the room, and talk to Kennith. From outside the room, kick the badly repaired wall to make an opening, then use your lit torch on any fisherman or sea slugs nearby and then talk to Kennith again. Rotate the crane to save him, shown in a cut scene. Talk to Holgart to return to shore. Finish the quest by talking to Caroline. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

steps: Speak with Caroline in Witchaven.
Talk to Holgart (right next to Caroline) and give him the Swamp paste.
Right-click Holgart and select the Travel option to travel to the fishing platform.
Pick up the Broken glass on the floor (hut to the west).
Go to the north-east corner of the platform and pick up some Damp sticks.
Climb the ladder right next to the sticks.
Go inside the cabin on the west side of the platform and talk to Kennith.
Go back down the ladder to the sea level.
Travel or speak with Holgart for a trip to a remote island.
Talk to Kent.
Talk to Holgart again to go back to the Fishing Platform.
Speak with Bailey in the south-west cabin for an Unlit torch.
Use the Broken glass on the Damp sticks to dry them.
Rub the Dry sticks together to light the torch.
Go back up the ladder.
Go talk to Kennith again.
From outside of the cabin, kick the badly repaired wall to make an opening.
Talk to Kennith again.

Just outside of Kennith's cabin, activate the crane controls to rotate it (a cutscene will play if you've followed the steps correctly - '''make sure you've talked to Kennith after you've kicked in the wall''').
Go back down the ladder to the sea level.
Tip: Before leaving, you can catch a fish with a small fishing net on the downstairs platform to complete a task for the Ardougne Medium Diary.
Speak with Holgart again to return to the shore.
Report to Caroline.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Waterfall Quest
start: Speak to Almera in her house north-east of Baxtorian Falls.
description: Investigate the death of elven leaders of old. Search for the elf King Baxtorian's tomb and discover the mysterious hidden treasure of the waterfall.
recommendedItems: Combat 25
15 or more Hitpoints (to run past enemies safely)
Food
Fast travel to several locations
Baxtorian Falls to start the quest, plus one additional trip - games necklace to Barbarian Outpost, Minigame Teleport to Barbarian Assault, or skills necklace to Fishing Guild
Tree Gnome Village (1 trip) - Spirit tree, fairy ring ciq, Ardougne cloak 1-4 to Ardougne Monastery, Minigame Teleport to Fishing Trawler, or ring of dueling to Castle Wars
Glarial's Tomb (1 trip) - skills necklace to Fishing Guild, games necklace to Barbarian Outpost, or Minigame Teleport to Barbarian Assault
ironmanConcerns: You must briefly visit Glarial's Tomb, which has significant item restrictions.
leagueRegion: <poem> Unlocking Kandarin will auto-complete the quest Unlocking Desert will auto-complete the quest Unlocking Fremennik will auto-complete the quest Unlocking Tirannwn will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Searching for treasure
walkthrough.body: Start out by speaking to Almera in her house west of the Coal Trucks and north-east of the Baxtorian Falls (use the games necklace to teleport to Barbarian Outpost, and run south). She will tell you that she is worried about her son, Hudon, who is on the opposite side of the river looking for treasure. She will request that you check on him. Exit Almera's house toward the river and board the log raft; you will crash into a small island. Talk to Hudon. You will tell him to come back to his mother, but he'll refuse, hoping to stay out and find treasure. When you ask if you can help, he rejects you, saying you will steal his loot. 'Finish all the dialogue or the book will not spawn in the next part'. Swim to the south and you will be sent downstream, washing ashore near a large building with a fisherman outside of it. Upstairs in the building, search the southernmost bookcase on the eastern wall to find a book named book on baxtorian. 'Read the book' or the key will not appear for the next part. You will discover that Baxtorian and Glarial were elven, and read about the legend of treasure under the falls. You will also learn that Glarial's pebble can be found under Tree Gnome Village, which will give you access to her tomb.

walkthrough.heading: Glarial's Pebble
walkthrough.body: {{Map|x:2533,y:3155|x:2545,y:3155|x:2545,y:3148|x:2542,y:3148|x:2542,y:3150|x:2539,y:3150|x:2539,y:3145|x:2549,y:3145|x:2549,y:3156|x:2551,y:3156|x:2551,y:3159|x:2545,y:3159|x:2545,y:3165|x:2550,y:3165|x:2550,y:3175|x:2544,y:3175|x:2544,y:3177|x:2533,y:3177|x:2533,y:3179|x:2531,y:3179|x:2531,y:3177|x:2529,y:3177|x:2529,y:3179|x:2527,y:3179|x:2527,y:3177|x:2514,y:3177|x:2514,y:3179|x:2521,y:3179|x:2521,y:3184|x:2524,y:3184|x:2524,y:3181|x:2529,y:3181|x:2529,y:3182|x:2532,y:3182|x:2532,y:3188|x:2511,y:3188|x:2511,y:3191|x:2503,y:3191|mtype=line|align=right|height=250|width=250|caption=Follow the line to find the Dungeon.}} Head to the Tree Gnome Village south-west of Ardougne. If you have previously started or completed the Tree Gnome Village quest, you may follow Elkoy through the maze, or use the Spirit Tree from the Grand Exchange to reach the centre (if it was completed). 'Note:' It is recommended to start the Tree Gnome Village quest now by talking to King Bolren in the centre of the maze, which will allow you to follow Elkoy through the maze in the future. If you have not begun Tree Gnome Village you will have to navigate through the maze. You should find a ladder in the hedge maze. Very low level players should exercise caution due to the hobgoblins within. Climb down the ladder, and find the key in the east room. The key is in the slightly differently-coloured crate next to the two crates stacked on top of each other in the south-east corner. In the west room, you will find a gnome called Golrie locked away. Use your key on the door, then speak to the gnome to receive Glarial's pebble. 'Note:' You can use the drop trick to obtain multiple pebbles, which is highly recommended for low level players in case you die during the next steps. You will also save some time in the future by keeping your pebble after the quest if you plan to complete Roving Elves. Once you've started Tree Gnome Village, you can exit the maze by following Elkoy.

walkthrough.heading: Tomb Raiding
walkthrough.body: Glarial's pebble, two free inventory slots {{Map|name=Glarial's Tombstone|x:2558,y:3445|plane=0|r=4|mapID=0|mtype=square|align=right|height=220|width=220|caption=Glarial's tomb location}} Glarial's Tomb has significant restrictions on items you can equip or carry, so it is strongly recommended to bank any prohibited items before travelling to it. This includes weapons, armour (including capes), runes, arrows and any type of logs you may be carrying. Jewellery like the games necklace can be taken in. See the Glarial's Tomb page for a full list. Bring food with you, as you will need to run past high level monsters. Head just south-east of Baxtorian Falls and just north-west of the Fishing Guild to find a tombstone, and use the pebble on it to enter. Inside, there are high-level monsters that you will need to pass. One strategy is to attack a lower level skeleton or zombie, as the area is single combat and this will prevent the more dangerous Moss Guardian attacking you, which has a max hit of 14. Run to the west part of the cave, past the level 84 moss guardians, and search the chest to get Glarial's amulet. Then head to the south part of the cave and search the coffin to get Glarial's urn. 'Note that you will be unable to perform actions while searching the coffin but can be attacked, so beware!' 'Note': You can get multiples of both items using the drop trick, which is advised for low levels as you can die in the next section. Once you have 'both items', you can exit the tomb by going up the ladder.

walkthrough.heading: The Chalice of Eternity
walkthrough.body: Rope, 6 Air runes, 6 water runes, 6 earth runes, Glarial's urn, Glarial's amulet, 5 free inventory slots Go back to Almera's house and board the raft. You will crash again. 'Do not swim or interact with the tree without the rope!' Use your 'rope' on the large grey rock on the small patch of land just downstream, then use the 'rope' on the dead tree that you can climb. When you reach the doors at the waterfall ledge, go inside. {|class="wikitable"!Map Label!Description |- |1 |A cavern with level 52 shadow spiders that drain your prayer |- |2 |A room with crates containing a key needed for the quest and level 16 skeleton mages |- |3 |Not used in the quest |- |4 |A cavern with level 86 Fire Giants |- |5 |The path to the Chalice of Eternity |- |6 |A room with the Chalice of Eternity |} Take the eastern passage first to search the crates for a key, then take the western passage north. This is a single combat area, so you may choose to attack a shadow spider so that the Fire Giants will be unable to attack you. This is a common training spot, so you may also consider world hopping until you find players fighting the Fire Giants. You may also consider killing a Fire Giant to complete a medium Kandarin Diary task (not recommended for lower level players) {{Color|Red|Warning:}} Follow the next part carefully. If done incorrectly you will either be washed from the final room, or take up to 20 damage if you do not place the runes correctly. Beyond the fire giants, you will find six pillars, two statues, and a chalice trophy. Use an air rune, a water rune, and an earth rune on one pillar, then do the same for the other five. Use Glarial's amulet on the 'Statue of Glarial', and then use Glarial's urn on the 'Chalice of Eternity', 'completing the dialogue'. Take the reward (note that you must have five free slots to accept it) from the chalice after the ground rises up to it to finish! {{Color|Red|Warning:}} any items you drop inside the chamber with the six pillars will be unretrievable once you use Glarial's amulet with the statue. Make sure to drop any items you want to recover outside the chamber by crossing the door. 'Note:' If you do get flushed out, or leave, the pillars will remain active. However, you will need to retrieve another amulet to re-enter the dungeon. 'Congratulations, quest complete!' {{Clear}}

steps: Speak to Almera north-east of Baxtorian Falls. (use Games Teleport to Barbarian Outpost and head south to the top of the hill)
Board the raft west of the house.
Speak to Hudon. 'Make sure to go through all dialogue or the upcoming book will not spawn.'
Walk to the southern end of the island and swim in the water.
Enter the large building to the north, where Hadley is.
Go upstairs and search the southernmost bookcase on the eastern wall for a Book on Baxtorian.
Left-click Read Book on Baxtorian and close the book again, or the key will not appear for the next part.
Enter the Tree Gnome Village maze.
If you haven't started Tree Gnome Village yet, be sure to enter the village and start the quest so you won't have to redo the maze later on.
Enter the dungeon at the end of the maze.
Go east and search the off-coloured crate near the entrance of the room for a key.
Go west and open the gate ("door") with the key.
Speak to Golrie, he will give you Glarial's pebble.
Keep the pebble in your bank for Roving Elves to save you some time in the future.

Bank all items EXCEPT Glarial's pebble, some food and a transport method ''(Runes won't be allowed since you won't be able to enter the tomb if you have anything deemed "not peaceful" in your possession; Jewellery is allowed including any jewellery that has any combat bonuses. You must have at least 2 open inventory spaces).''

For low levels, as Glarial's Tomb is single-way combat, it is recommended to initiate combat with a skeleton once inside to prevent being attacked by Moss giants which damage the player significantly more.
For Ultimate Ironmen there is a table (in the house you got Book on Baxtorian from) you can place your items on for temporary safe-keeping.
If you die while in the tomb, your gravestone will spawn on the surface.
Head to Glarial's Tombstone, east of the Waterfall. Use the pebble on it to enter.
Go west, search the chest to find Glarial's amulet. (Pick-up an extra amulet or two by dropping it from your inventory and picking them up from the ground).
Return and go the other way to search the tomb to find Glarial's urn.

Head to the bank and get 6 air runes, 6 water runes, 6 earth runes, rope, some food, Glarial's amulet, and Glarial's urn. (Warning, there are several high level monsters in the waterfall dungeon.) Weapons and armour are also allowed in the cave, so feel free to get these back too.
Make your way back to Baxtorian falls, board the raft, use your rope on the rock (across the water to the south), then use your rope on the dead tree. 'DO NOT GET IN THE BARREL'.
Carry/equip Glarial's amulet and enter the doorway.
Go to the right path and search the northernmost crates for a key.
Go back and to the left side, avoid the fire giants, use the key on the door.
Killing a fire giant is a medium Kandarin Diary task.
Use all 3 runes on each pillar (1 air, 1 water and 1 earth rune on each pillar).
Use an additional rune on each pillar to check if that type has already been added, yielding the message: "You've already placed this type of rune on the pillar."
After this, put Glarial's amulet on her statue. The ground will now rise to the chalice. 'Do not' click Take treasure, as you will be washed out of the cave.
Use the Glarial's urn in your inventory on the chalice. (Make sure you have 5 free inventory slots).
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Biohazard
start: Talk to Elena in her house in East Ardougne.
description:
This is the second part of an ongoing adventure. Help Elena discover the truth about the infamous Ardougne plague.

Smuggle test samples across Ardougne to Elena's old mentor.
itemRequirements: Priest gown top and bottom (can be obtained for free during the quest)
Gas mask (can be obtained for free from the cupboard in Edmond and Alrena's house in East Ardougne)
recommendedItems: Combat 10
Weight-reducing clothing and stamina or energy potions
Fast travel to several locations

East Ardougne to start the quest plus 1-2 trips - Ardougne Teleport or Skills necklace to Fishing Guild or Spirit tree to Battlefield or fairy ring to djp or Captain Barnaby's ship from Rimmington or Brimhaven
Rimmington (1 trip) - Teleport to House (the default house location is Rimmington) or Skills necklace to the Crafting Guild or Rat Pits minigame teleport
Varrock (1 trip) - Varrock teleport or Chronicle or Skills necklace to Crafting Guild or Ring of wealth to Grand Exchange
rewards: Use of the Combat Training Camp north of the city. Players can attack a total of six training dummies in the camp for 50 attack experience each.
The ability to travel freely through the West Ardougne gate.
The ability to use the West Ardougne Teleport in the Arceuus spellbook and teletab.
requiredFor: Recipe for Disaster: Freeing the Lumbridge Guide
leagueRegion: <poem> Unlocking Fremennik will auto-complete the quest Unlocking Kandarin will auto-complete the quest Unlocking Tirannwn will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Sneaking back
walkthrough.body: gas mask, two free inventory spaces {{Map|2614,3325|mtype=rectangle|rectX=8|rectY=6|caption=Jerico's house with pigeon cages and bird food.|align=right|width=200|height=200}} {{Map|mtype=polygon|2559,3267|2561,3267|2561,3262|2557,3262|2557,3264|2559,3264|caption=Omart's location.|align=left|width=200|height=200}} Talk to Elena in East Ardougne, directly west of the shortcut log. The mourners have confiscated her distillator, which she needs to test plague samples. She wants you to retrieve it, but the tunnel the player used to enter West Ardougne last time has been filled in. She suggests you talk to her father's friend Jerico, who has a method of communication with West Ardougne. Jerico can be found in a house just south of the northern bank, and just north of the chapel. Talk to him, and he will tell you that he has used messenger pigeons to communicate with two friends who are going to help you with a rope ladder to cross the wall. Open and search the cupboard on the north wall to find some bird feed, then go behind the house to grab a pigeon cage. Ensure you have your gas mask, then speak to Omart, who can be found by the wall just north of the Battlefield Spirit tree, near Ceril Carnillean's house. He will ask you to create a distraction to occupy the watchtower guards before his assistant Kilron can help you over the wall. Head to the small watchtower along the wall, directly north of Omart. Stand in the corner where the two spiked fences meet, put the bird feed on either fence, then click the cage in your inventory to create the distraction. Go back and talk to Omart, who will call out to Kilron to throw over the rope ladder. With the gas mask equipped, climb over the ladder into West Ardougne. {{Clear|left}}

walkthrough.heading: Infiltrating the Mourner HQ
walkthrough.body: Combat equipment to kill the level 13 Mourner, four free inventory spaces {{Map|2517,3274|mtype=rectangle|rectX=4|rectY=8|caption=Nurse Sarah's house.|align=right|width=200|height=200}} Head to the Mourners' headquarters located in the north-eastern corner of the city. If you tried to enter you would not be allowed in; instead, head to the western side and squeeze through a gap in the fence into the backyard. Pick up the rotten apple laying on the ground just to the west of the fence hole, and right click to use it on the stew that is brewing in the cauldron for the mourners. If you tried to enter the headquarters again, they would complain that several mourners have been taken ill with food poisoning, and are in need of a nurse. Head to nurse Sarah's house - the large building south-west of the West Ardougne church. Search the cupboard in the northern part of her house to obtain a medical gown. Equip the gown, and go back to the headquarters. The professional attire will easily fool the mourners into letting you into their base. For all subsequent visits to the headquarters during the quest, the gown must be worn at all times. Go upstairs and kill a mourner. A key will automatically be placed in the player's inventory. Use the key on the gate to get inside the caged room. Search the crate third from the left on the northern wall to find Elena's distillator. 'Note': Rings of recoil work against the mourner, after talking to him he will attack you and the key will still drop. Go back to Elena by climbing down the manhole in the middle of the city and climbing the mud pile. Alternatively, Kilron at the south-eastern corner of West Ardougne will help the player get back over into East Ardougne. Speak to Elena and the player will give her the distillator. After running the tests, she will be confused to find that the touch paper hasn't changed colour at all. She will give you a plague sample, liquid honey, ethenea, and sulphuric broline, and ask you to visit her old mentor Guidor in Varrock for guidance. First, you will need to visit the Chemist in Rimmington to obtain more touch paper and to find a way to smuggle the three vials into Varrock.

walkthrough.heading: Smuggling goods
walkthrough.body: Liquid honey, ethenea, sulphuric broline, the plague sample, and one free inventory space {{Map|2933,3210|mtype=rectangle|rectX=16|rectY=8|caption=The chemist's location.|align=right|width=200|height=200}} Make your way to the Chemist in western Rimmington, who will give you the touch paper; you need to have the plague sample in your inventory to talk to him about the quest. 'Note': You may fast travel to Rimmington; the vials used to break when doing so, but this is no longer the case. For a list of transportation options to Rimmington see here. The chemist will advise you to use his errand boys to deliver the goods, but warns you that they have a habit of stealing, and that you must give them each something they have no reason to steal. {|class="wikitable" |-!Helper!Sample Vial!Reason |- |Da Vinci |Ethenea |Da Vinci cannot use the ethenea to create a "work of art". |- |Chancy |Liquid honey |Owing to its low value, Chancy cannot wager the liquid honey in a gamble. |- |Hops |Sulphuric broline |Hops will not drink it because of its poisonous nature. |} Chancy the gambler, Da Vinci the artist, and Hops the drinker are located right outside the chemist's house crowding around a fire. Talk to each of them to give them their respective vials. If you give the wrong vial to someone, give the remaining vials to the others, speak to them all in Varrock, then return to Elena to get new vials before repeating this step.

walkthrough.heading: So far, so good
walkthrough.body: A priest gown top and bottom, the plague sample and touch paper, and three free inventory spaces {{Map|3271,3392|mtype=rectangle|rectX=10|rectY=8|caption=The Dancing Donkey Inn's location.|align=right|width=220|height=220}} Head to the fenced-in enclosure in south-eastern Varrock. The guard will search you when you try and pass through the gate, but will not find the plague sample; he will however confiscate the vials if you forgot to give them to the errand boys, and you will need to repeat the step. The errand boys can be found in the Dancing Donkey Inn inside this area. With the plague sample in your inventory and 'three free inventory slots', talk to Hops, Da Vinci, and Chancy to get the vials back. If your inventory is full when you talk to them, you will need to obtain a new set from the chemist. Warning: Now that you have the vials, 'do not leave the fenced area', or they will be confiscated on return. If you forgot your plague sample or touch paper, you can drop the vials at the gate, quickly retrieve your items from the Varrock east bank and then pick up the vials again. Guidor is ill, and his wife Julie will not let anyone visit him, though she wishes for him to see a priest. If you didn't bring a priest gown, you can obtain one for free by talking to Asyff in the Fancy Clothes Store in this area. Equip your priest gown and then talk to Guidor in his house in the south-eastern corner of the gated area. Give him the vials and sample, and tell him that Elena has sent a sample that needs to be processed. After analysing it, he will come to the conclusion that there is no plague - someone has been lying about it.

walkthrough.heading: Exposing the lie
walkthrough.body: Return to Ardougne, and talk to Elena. When you tell her that Guidor found nothing in his results, she suggests that the plague must be a hoax and that you should speak to the person on top of this - King Lathas of East Ardougne. King Lathas is located just south of Elena's house, in his throne-room on the floor 1 of the East Ardougne Castle. When told that the plague is in fact a hoax, the King replies that he did it for the best of his people, and that it protects them from a "far greater danger". He then tells the player about the journey of King Tyras - the king of West Ardougne and King Lathas's brother - towards the west and that he has been corrupted by the Dark Lord after drinking from the Chalice of Eternity. Hence, the wall has been erected between the cities to protect East Ardougne and in turn, all of Gielinor. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

steps: To begin speak to Elena in East Ardougne (directly west of shortcut log).
Speak to Jerico in the house just south of the northern Ardougne bank (The house with pigeon cages in the backyard).
Search the cupboard to obtain bird feed (click continue or the bird feed won't be added to your inventory).
Grab a pigeon cage from the backyard (note: if you are planning on doing One Small Favour, grab an extra 5 pigeon cages).
Go south-west of Ardougne Castle and speak to Omart.
Go north to the small watchtower along the wall, in front of the gates to West Ardougne.
Stand in the corner where the two spiked fences meet.
Use bird feed on the watchtower fence.
Click open on the pigeon cage in your inventory.
Equip your gas mask.
Run south from the watchtower and speak to Omart. After a slight delay, you will arrive in West Ardougne.
Head around the headquarters to the north-eastern area with the vat and mangle.
Squeeze through the fence into the backyard.
Pick up the rotten apple.
Use the rotten apple on the cauldron.
Go back through the fence.
Go to Nurse Sarah's house, south-west of the West Ardougne church.
Search cupboard in northern part of the house for a medical gown.
Equip the medical gown, go back to the headquarters and open the door.
Go upstairs and kill a mourner. A key will automatically be placed in your inventory.
Use the key on the gate to get into the caged room.
Search the crate third from the left on the northern wall to find Elena's distillator.

With 3 empty inventory spaces, return to Elena and give her the distillator (via Ardougne Teleport, Skills necklace teleport to the Fishing Guild, over the wall by Kilron, or via the sewers from the Plague City quest).

Go to the Chemist in south-western Rimmington (you can take a ship from Captain Barnaby at the Ardougne Dock directly to Rimmington for 30gp or use a teleport as the vials won't break upon teleportation anymore)
Speak to the Chemist. He will give you the touch paper.
You will find Chancy, Da Vinci and Hops around a fire outside the Chemist's house.
Give Chancy the {{plink|Liquid honey}}.
Give Da Vinci the {{plink|Ethenea}}.
Give Hops the {{plink|Sulphuric broline}}.

'If you happen to give the wrong item to one of the henchmen you must then give the rest of them an item and talk to each one of them in Varrock before being able to give them the correct items again.'
Teleport or travel to Varrock.

Travel to the fenced area to the south-east of the bank (south-eastern Varrock). The guard will search you, but you will be able to pass freely with the plague sample and touch paper in your inventory.

(Optional) Speak to Asyff, the Fancy dress shop owner, in the building south-east, to get a free priest gown (top and bottom) and equip it. Alternatively, purchase a priest gown (top and bottom) from him and equip it.
Go to the Dancing Donkey Inn.
Talk to Hops, Da Vinci and Chancy to get the vials back. 'Make sure you have the free inventory space.'
'Do not pass back through the gate or your vials will be confiscated by the guard and you will have to get new samples from Elena again and continue the quest from that point.'
'If you must pass through the gate to retrieve the plague sample or papers, you can drop the vials at the gate, quickly run to Varrock east bank for the items, and run back to pick up the vials.'
With your Priest gown equipped head to Guidor's house in the south-east of the fenced area.
Speak to Guidor, tell him Elena has sent a sample that needs to be processed.
Return to Ardougne and speak to Elena.
Go to the floor 1 of Ardougne Castle and speak to King Lathas.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Jungle Potion
start: Speak to Trufitus at Tai Bwo Wannai.
description: Trufitus Shakaya of the Tai Bwo Wannai Village requires that you collect five special jungle herbs for a potion so he can commune with his Gods.
recommendedItems: Combat 20
1-2 antidote++ or other antipoison potions
Food
Stamina potions
Combat equipment to kill a level 53 Jogre for an easy Karamja Diary task

Fast travel to Tai Bwo Wannai Village to start the quest - Brimhaven teleport, Teleport to House (Brimhaven), Captain Barnaby's ship from Ardougne to Brimhaven, fairy ring ckr or amulet of glory to Karamja
requirements: The ability to defend against level 53 Jogres and level 46 Harpie Bug Swarms.
requiredFor: My Arm's Big Adventure - To work in the Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup minigame during the quest
Several tasks in the Karamja Diary
Fairytale I - Growing Pains (For ironmen asked to obtain Proboscis or Volencia moss)
leagueRegion: <poem> Unlocking Karamja will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: An abandoned village
walkthrough.body: Head to the small village of Tai Bwo Wannai, located south of Brimhaven on Karamja. Talk to Trufitus, found in a small house north-east of the main village area, and ask him where everyone is. He will explain they are afraid to stay in the village. Ask him how you can help, and he will ask for several herbs to mix a potion to commune with the Gods, in order to see what fate befalls them. :'Note:' You cannot collect all of the herbs at once. You will need to go back to talk with Trufitus each time. {{Clear|left}} <gallery mode="packed" widths="180px" heights="180px"> Jungle Potion - Snake weed.png | Location of the snake weed. Jungle Potion - Ardrigal.png | Location of the ardrigal. Jungle Potion - Sito foil.png | Location of the sito foil. Jungle Potion - Valencia moss.png | Location of the Volencia moss. Jungle Potion - Rogue's purse.png | Location of the Rogue's purse. </gallery>

walkthrough.heading: Snake Weed
walkthrough.body: Head south-west of the village near the ocean to find marshy jungle vine. Search it to get a grimy snake weed; this may take 1-5 minutes depending on your Herblore level. Clean the herb and give it to Trufitus. :'Note': If you intend to do Legends' Quest and Zogre Flesh Eaters, take two extra to save yourself time later.

walkthrough.heading: Ardrigal
walkthrough.body: Head north-east of Trufitus' hut until you reach a peninsula with several palm trees on it, just south of the agility shortcut. Avoiding the nearby level 46 Harpie Bug Swarms, search a palm tree to find a grimy ardrigal. Clean the herb and give it to Trufitus. :'Note:' If you intend to do Legends' Quest, take 2-3 extra to save yourself time later (3 are needed for the long path).

walkthrough.heading: Sito Foil
walkthrough.body: {{Color|red|Warning:}} The tribesmen in this section are aggressive, and can poison you with damage starting at 11. Immediately south of the village you will find scorched earth. Search it to find the grimy sito foil. Clean the herb and give it to Trufitus.

walkthrough.heading: Volencia Moss
walkthrough.body: Head south-east of the hut until you reach a group of rocks you can search that are in the mining area, search an empty one to find the grimy volencia moss. Clean the herb and give it to Trufitus. :'Note': If you intend to do Fairytale I - Growing Pains take an extra to save yourself time later.

walkthrough.heading: Rogue's Purse
walkthrough.body: Head north-east of the village towards where you found the Ardrigal. Once you find the end of the cliffs, follow the coastline west until you find a pile of searchable rocks. Search them and enter the cave. :'Note:' You may kill a Jogre inside the dungeon for an easy Karamja Diary task. Take the jogre bones for Tai Bwo Wannai Trio. Although they may drop the grimy rogue's purse, they do not count for the quest. Run south past the aggressive level 53 Jogres until you find a fungus covered cavern wall. Search it until you find the grimy rogue's purse (may take some minutes). :'Note': If you intend to do Zogre Flesh Eaters, take an extra to save yourself time later. Return to Trufitus with the final cleaned herb. 'Congratulations, quest complete!' {{Clear}}

steps: Talk to Trufitus in his house located north-east of Tai Bwo Wannai. Everytime you gather a new herb you need to go show it to Trufitus before being able to get a new kind of a herb.
Go south-west of Tai Bwo Wannai until green and yellow vines labelled 'marshy jungle vine' are seen.
Search the vines and clean the herb. Your character may spend several minutes finding a herb.
'Note:' Take three if you intend to do Legends' Quest and Zogre Flesh Eaters.
Talk to Trufitus. Make sure you cleaned the herb.
Head north-east from Trufitus. There will be Harpie Bug Swarms and palm trees.
Search the palm trees and clean the herb.
'Note:' Take two if you intend to do Legends' Quest.
Talk to Trufitus.
To the direct south of Tai Bwo Wannai Village is a patch of scorched earth.
Search the scorched earth (the squares immediately next to the fire) for the herb and clean it.
Talk to Trufitus.
Go south-east from Trufitus until you reach the Karamja Jungle mine, marked with a pickaxe on minimap.
Search the rocks for the herb and clean it.
'Note:' Take two if you intend to do Fairytale I - Growing Pains (possible required item).
Talk to Trufitus.
Go back by the Harpie Bug Swarms and head north-west until a cave is seen over the cavern. Search the rocks and enter the cave.

In the cave, head south, look for green spots on the wall labelled 'Fungus covered Cavern wall', then search them and clean the herb. This process may take up to a minute. '''Do not try to use a Rogue's purse dropped by a Jogre. It <u>must</u> be obtained via searching the wall.'''
'Note:' Take two if you intend to do Zogre Flesh Eaters.
Killing a Jogre inside this cave completes an easy Karamja Diary task, and is worth doing along the way.
Talk to Trufitus.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: The Grand Tree
start: Talk to King Narnode Shareen in the Grand Tree.
description: The Grand Tree, which shelters the majority of the small gnome population of Gielinor, is dying. Is it human sabotage or an inside job? Help King Shareen to find the true cause and save the tree gnomes from an uncertain fate.
itemRequirements: 1,000 coins if you previously chose not to help Femi on your first entry to the Tree Gnome Stronghold (not required if you never used the gate entrance)
recommendedItems: Combat 50
Stamina or energy potions
Combat equipment to defeat a level 172 Black demon, Magic recommended
Fast travel to several locations:

Tree Gnome Stronghold to start the quest, plus 2 additional trips - spirit tree from Grand Exchange or Battlefield, slayer ring to the Stronghold Slayer Cave, Balloon Transport System, or necklace of passage to the Outpost

Hazelmere's house (1 trip) - fairy ring cls, Watchtower Teleport, Teleport to House (Yanille), Minigame Teleport to Nightmare Zone or Fishing Trawler, Ardougne cloak 1-4 to Ardougne Monastery, or ring of dueling to Castle Wars
requirements: The ability to defeat a level 172 Black demon (safespottable for Ranged and Magic or melee using a halberd).
rewards: Access to the mine under the Grand Tree.
Access to the Gnome glider transportation system.
Ability to use the rocks as an Agility shortcut from the Grand Tree to the Barbarian Outpost (with 37 Agility).
Ability to use the spirit tree in the Stronghold after the completion of Tree Gnome Village.
Completing this quest awards the player with 5 Kudos which can be claimed by talking to Historian Minas in the Varrock Museum.
Black demon accessible in the Nightmare Zone.
leagueRegion: <poem> Unlocking Kandarin will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: The dying tree
walkthrough.body:
{{Map|x=2678|y=3086|plane=1|r=2|mtype=square|width=220|height=220|align=right|caption=Hazelmere's house on the map.}} Ensure you have two free inventory slots, then speak to King Narnode Shareen on the ground floor of the Grand Tree. He will take you underground to show you the roots of the tree, which appear to be dying. He will give you a translation book and a bark sample and ask you to take the sample to Hazelmere, the last surviving gnome mage involved in creating the tree. Hazelmere is found on a small island east of Yanille, upstairs in his house. There are jungle spiders (level 44) on the way, although they are not poisonous. Talk to Hazelmere, who will take your bark sample, and after examining it, give you a message written in his language. Return to King Narnode in the Grand Tree, who will ask what the translation is. The correct translation can be deciphered using the translation book and reads: {{quote|A man came to me with the King's seal.
I gave the man Daconia rocks.
And Daconia rocks will kill the tree!}} Give him the correct translation from the options offered, selecting none of the above for the first two choices. The king will exclaim that someone must have forged his seal to obtain the Daconia rocks, which were made as a "fail-safe" and are the only thing that can kill the tree. He will direct you to talk to Glough, his head tree guardian.

walkthrough.heading: Charlie the prisoner
walkthrough.body: 1,000 coins (if you haven't helped Femi) {{Map|x=2477|y=3463|r=3|width=220|height=220|mtype=square|align=right|caption=Glough's house location.}} Glough is located in a treehouse south of the Grand Tree, east of the ramp by the hot air balloon. After remarking that humans can't be trusted, he will tell you that he will take care of the problem. Return to King Narnode Shareen, who informs you that Glough has caught and imprisoned a human found with the Daconia rocks. Head to the top floor to speak with Charlie the prisoner. He tells you that Glough paid him to retrieve the rocks from Hazelmere. He doesn't know what Glough is up to, but suggests you search Glough's house for evidence. Go to Glough's house and search the cupboard to find his journal, which describes how he plans to convince the tree gnomes that humans are naturally evil and must be destroyed. Confront Glough, who calls a guard over to lock you in the cell next to Charlie's. Talk to Charlie, who mentions he delivered a large amount of gold to the shipyard on Karamja. He suggests you give the foreman there a visit to covertly see if he knows what Glough is up to, and gives you the password to access it, which is 'Ka-Lu-Min'. The king will appear and apologise for Glough imprisoning you. He will tell you that guards are watching the entrances, and tells you to quickly escape on the Gnome glider on the top floor of the Grand Tree, next to the cells. Talk to the pilot. He will ask you where you want to go and you will ask him to fly you to Karamja. {{Clear|left}}

walkthrough.heading: Karamja investigation
walkthrough.body: The glider will crash land just west of the Shipyard. Run east, avoiding the aggressive level 53 jogres, and attempt to open the gate to the Shipyard. A shipyard worker will stop you; tell him Glough sent you, then give him the password 'Ka-Lu-Min'. Once inside, find the level 23 foreman on the southern docks. You may either kill him or talk to him to receive a lumber order. If you choose to talk to him, tell him Glough sent you, then answer some personal questions about Glough. He will ask how his wife is, select "'Sadly his wife is no longer with us'". He will then ask what his favourite dish is, select "'Worm holes'". Finally, he will ask for his new girlfriend's name, which is "'Anita'". You need to return to The Grand Tree to show the king the lumber order which is evidence of Glough's invasion plans, but Glough has ordered the guards not to let you in. If you have completed the Tree Gnome Village quest, you can sneak in by using the Battlefield spirit tree or the Grand Exchange spirit tree. Alternatively, talk to Femi by the gate to the stronghold. Tell her you need to get inside, and she will sneak you in. She will help you for free if you never entered the stronghold through the gate before, or if you chose to help her move boxes the first time you entered. If you chose not to help her when you first entered, she will charge you 1,000 coins.

walkthrough.heading: Tuzo
walkthrough.body: Lumber order {{Map|x=2391|y=3511|r=3|width=220|height=220|align=left|caption=Anita's house on the map.|mtype=square}} After you show the king the note from the foreman, he still will not believe your accusations, call you as paranoid as Glough, and ask you to leave for your own safety. Speak to Charlie the prisoner again on the top floor of the Grand Tree, who says he heard Glough mention a chest key that he left at his girlfriend Anita's house. In the north-west corner of the stronghold, climb up the most north-western ladder by the tortoise pens to speak to Anita and she will give you Glough's key and ask you to return it to him. Go to Glough's house, and use the key to open the chest. Inside, you will find his invasion plans detailing his plan to seize control of Gielinor. 'Click continue' to receive the plans. Ensure you have four free inventory spaces, then take the invasion plans to the king. He will still not believe you, stating that anyone could have made the plans. He will give you four bundles of twigs, which was all his guards could find when searching Glough's house. Return to Glough's house, and climb up the watchtower. This tree is located on the east side of the floor 1 by the chest and requires Agility 25 to climb. Up in the watchtower, you will find a stone stand and four pillars. Use the twigs with the four pillars to spell out TUZO, starting from the far left. Using the Translation book, this translates to "open." After you have placed the twigs on the four pillars, you will hear gears turning, activating the trap door on this platform, 'but do not go in yet unless you are prepared for the fight.' {{Clear|left}}

walkthrough.heading: Encountering the Black demon
walkthrough.body: Combat equipment and food to last in a fight against a level 172 Black demon (The Grand Tree) Black demon Climb down the trapdoor into the cave below, and Glough will appear, threatening you with his plans to wipe out humans. 'Complete the conversation' without interacting with anything else, or you will have to re-enter and repeat it. A level 172 black demon will appear down the tunnel and immediately attack you. It can be fought with any combat style, but can be safespotted with Ranged, Magic or a halberd. To safespot, immediately move one tile to the north and then east (adjacent to the ladder, see the picture). Magic is recommended, as the demon has a negative magic defence bonus. Use water spells if available to you as it has a 40% weakness to water spells. :'Note:' If the demon is not killed within 10 minutes, it will 'disappear' and the battle needs to be 'restarted'. To do so, walk through the tunnel and leave through the ladder next to King Narnode Shareen, and re-enter Glough's trapdoor. :'Note for 10HP pures:' With Bind, it is possible to kill the demon with a cannon with at least 120 cannonballs. When the scene begins, use Bind on the demon immediately and set up the cannon just 2-3 spaces west of the ladder you used to enter. If you die during setup the cannon will remain. You will know the cannon is in the right area if you can reload it from the ladder safespot. If the cannon aggros a rat during the fight without killing it, the cannon may stop firing, and you will need to take aggro from the demon by moving forward and back, or lure the rat away.

walkthrough.heading: The adamant king
walkthrough.body: After defeating the demon, walk along the passage until you find King Shareen standing by a ladder. Talk to him and tell him that Glough sent a demon to attack you. Not believing you, he will finally send a guard to scout for Glough, finding him hiding amongst the stones. The king apologises, and asks you to locate the last Daconia rock. Ensure you have one free inventory space, then search the roots all around the area until you find the Daconia rock. It may be in any of the roots, so keep going until you have found the rock. 'Click continue' once you find it or it won't appear in your inventory. If you somehow lose the rock, it'll spawn in the root where you first found it. Talk to King Shareen again for your reward for saving the Grand Tree. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

steps: Speak to King Shareen in the Grand Tree with two empty slots to receive a translation book and a bark sample.
Talk to Hazelmere in his house on the island east of Yanille (fairy ring code: CLS). He will take your bark sample and give you a message for the king.
Return to King Shareen. He will ask what the message says. Tell him:
Head south. At the bottom of the incline, turn east and go up the ladder to speak with Glough.
Return to King Shareen, and he will tell you that Glough has caught a human. Ask to see the prisoner.
Talk to the prisoner Charlie on the top floor of the Grand Tree. 'Make sure to finish the entire conversation!'
Go to Glough's house. Search the cupboard, and you will find his journal.
Talk to Glough and wait to be arrested.
Talk to Charlie; he will tell you about the shipyard on Karamja; the password is 'Ka-Lu-Min'.
The king appears and tells you to escape using the gnome glider on top of the tree.
Travel with the glider.
The glider will crash near the Ship Yard. Run east past the level 53 jogres to the Ship Yard gate.
Open the gate and tell the worker Glough sent you, then give the password 'Ka-Lu-Min'.
Find the Foreman on the southern dock. Kill him or talk to him to get a lumber order.
If you talk to him, he will ask you some security questions.

Take the lumber order to the king. (Teleport into the stronghold or get Femi to sneak you in, costing 1,000 coins if you didn't help her earlier). The king will not believe you when you show him the lumber order.
Speak to Charlie again on the top floor of the Grand Tree.
Speak to Anita up the stairs west of the swamp, north-west of the Grand Tree. She will give you a key.
Go to Glough's house, and use the key to open the chest and take the invasion plans. 'Make sure to complete the dialogue window to receive the plans!'
Take the invasion plans to the king. He will give you four letters made of sticks (you'll need 4 empty inventory spaces).
Climb the watchtower in Glough's house (tree in the east part of his house). Use the sticks with the four pillars to spell out 'TUZO'. If you are under 25 Agility, eat your summer pie now.
Bank if needed and prepare for the battle, then go down the trapdoor.
After you enter and talk to Glough, a level 172 black demon will appear and attack you.

Immediately after the cutscene ends, run to the tile directly north of the ladder. The black demon will become stuck behind the daconia rocks in front of you as he approaches. Attack with ranged, magic, or a halberd.

'Warning:' The demon will despawn after a while if it is not killed within 10 minutes exactly. If this happens, you'll have to exit through the ladder in the centre of the cave and go through Glough's trapdoor again.
Kill the demon. Walk along the passage until you find King Shareen standing by a ladder.
Talk to the king, and he will ask you to locate the last daconia rock. Fully complete the dialogue; otherwise, you cannot continue.
Search the roots until you find it (make sure to click continue on the dialogue when you find the stone).
Talk to the king one last time.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Shilo Village
start: Talk to Mosol Rei outside of Shilo Village in the south part of Karamja.
description: A foul mist and a plague of undead have overtaken Shilo Village. Can you stop the queen of the dead and save the village?
itemRequirements: Spade (can be purchased at the store north of Tai Bwo Wannai for 4 coins)
A lit torch (bruma works), candle or black candle (an unlit torch and tinderbox can be purchased at the store north of Tai Bwo Wannai for a total of 7 coins)
'you will not get this item back!'
Lanterns or Firemaking cape don't work
Rope (can be purchased at the store north of Tai Bwo Wannai for 27 coins)
Bronze bar and hammer to create one (both can be purchased at the store north of Tai Bwo Wannai for a total of 13 coins, there is an Anvil nearby)
Chisel (can be purchased at the store north of Tai Bwo Wannai for 1 coins)
recommendedItems: Combat 45
Good food and armour or Prayer 43 for Protect from Melee (enough to make it through two long tunnels of level 73 monsters)
Weight-reducing clothing and stamina or energy potions
Antipoison if below Combat 65 for the tribesmen found around Karamja with poison that hits for '11 each'
Combat equipment to defeat Nazastarool's three forms (all safespottable with Ranged, Magic or a halberd)
Magic 13+ to cast Fire spells (40% elemental weakness) or Magic 39 to cast Crumble Undead is recommended to kill him faster

Quick access to fairy rings and/or gnome glider is highly recommended - you may consider using a ring of dueling for quick access to a glider at Emir's Arena, and the Ardougne cloak 1-4 for quick access to a fairy ring
Fast travel to several locations:
East of Shilo Village to start the quest - Gnome glider, fairy ring ckr, Tai Bwo Wannai Teleport or Teleport to House (Brimhaven)
Tai Bwo Wannai (2 trips) - Tai Bwo Wannai Teleport, fairy ring ckr, or Teleport to House (Brimhaven)
Eastern Karamja (2 trips) - Gnome glider or fairy ring dkp
Cairn Isle (2 trips) - fairy ring ckr or Tai Bwo Wannai Teleport (only useful for the second trip)
requirements: Must be able to defend from many Undead ones (level 61-73) and able to defeat three monsters that are about level 90.
rewards: Ability to quick travel to Shilo Village using the cart near the Brimhaven docks

After completing the quest, you can sell every item you obtained during the quest to Yanni Salika in Shilo Village for a total of {{Coins|2000}} — 100 each for the stone-plaque, tattered scroll, crumpled scroll, Bervirius notes, and the bone key; 500 for the locating crystal; and 1000 for the beads of the dead.
Ability to charter the Lady of the Waves west to Shilo Village to Port Khazard or Port Sarim
Nazastarool accessible in the Nightmare Zone.
requiredFor: Recipe for Disaster - Freeing Sir Amik Varze
ironmanConcerns: Smithing 4 (boostable) (to make a bronze wire)
leagueRegion: <poem> Unlocking Karamja will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Beginning the quest
walkthrough.body: Ensure you have one free inventory space, then speak to Mosol Rei outside of Shilo Village, who tells you to run. Ask why, and he will say Rashiliyia has returned. Ask who she is, and he will explain she is the Queen of the dead that has brought a plague of undead upon the village. Ask what you can do, and he will ask you to talk to the shaman Trufitus in Tai Bwo Wannai Village about something called the Legend of Rashiliyia, which may be to blame. Agree to go see the shaman, then agree to take the Wampum belt to Trufitus. 'Ensure you have the belt in your inventory before continuing! The quest will not officially start until you give it to Trufitus.'

walkthrough.heading: The search for the temple of Ah Za Rhoon
walkthrough.body: {{Map|x=2922|y=3000|r=4|mtype=square|width=220|height=220|align=right|caption=Location of Ah Za Rhoon}} Spade, lit Torch or candle, rope, chisel, 2 free inventory spaces Head to Trufitus at the most north-eastern house in Tai Bwo Wannai and use the wampum belt on him. Ask about the legend, and he will say that any information regarding it was lost in the vanished temple of Ah Za Rhoon. Ask if he knows anything more about the temple, and he will mention that the priest Zadimus built the temple, and it is rumoured that Rashiliyia destroyed it after he rejected her affections. Ask him to tell you more, then tell him you will search for Ah Za Rhoon, and he will be skeptical but agree to help you if you are serious. Say you are serious about looking for Ah Za Rhoon and the quest will officially begin. The temple of Ah Za Rhoon is located on eastern Karamja, south-west of the Shipyard and east of Shilo Village across the River Amja (the pile of rocks on the minimap). Use a gnome glider or fairy ring DKP, or walk there by crossing the wooden log to the east, then head south until you reach a mound of earth surrounded by rocks. {{Checklist| *Use your spade on the mound of earth to find a fissure. *Use your torch or candle on the fissure to light it up ('this consumes the item!'). *Add a rope to the fissure. *Search the fissure and climb down into the dungeon below (Agility 32). }} :'Note:' The dirt mound may respawn if you take too long, but you may right click and search it twice to still enter (torch and rope not required). In the cave are undead ones (level 61 - 73) who may attack you. Killing them occasionally causes a cloud of shilo mist to appear and deal damage to you. In this cave system, you will need to find four items. Consult the following map to aid in finding them. {| align=center |- |colspan=2 | |- | '1' - Entrance || '5' - Waterfall rocks |- | '2' - Cave-in || '6' - Loose rocks |- | '3' - Smashed table || '7' - Sacks |- | '4' - Strange looking stone || '8' - Gallows |}.]] *Start off by heading south until you see the water. *Use a chisel on the strange looking stone (4 on the map; it is a small grey stone in the floor to the east of a Smashed chair and south of a stalagmite) to obtain the stone-plaque. *Go west past the column and search the Cave in (2 on the map) to crawl through and into some ruins. *Head north until you reach the end of the ruined buildings. Search the loose rocks (6 on the map) near the north-west wall to find the tattered scroll. If you fail, you will get hit for 4-7 (possibly more) damage. *Now head south-east until you come to a small dead-end branch. Search the sacks next to a smashed table (7 on the map) to obtain the crumpled scroll. *Finally, head north to the far end of the cavern, where you will find the ancient gallows (8 on the map). Search it and remove the corpse to obtain the Zadimus corpse. After acquiring all four items, you can teleport out. Otherwise, to exit the dungeon, return to the smashed table (3 on the map). You can craft the smashed table into a raft and use it to leave. This does not always work; it is possible to get the message that there isn't enough wood left. In this case, you will have to leave by other means. If you want, you can continue south, then east to the end of the cave. Search the rocks you find there to leave via the waterfall. You will take around 20 damage if you fall while leaving this way. You will find yourself near the stepping stones to the east of Shilo Village.

walkthrough.heading: Tomb of Bervirius
walkthrough.body: bronze wire, A chisel, 3 free inventory spaces 'Read' both the scrolls and the plaque, then use both scrolls, the plaque, and the corpse on Trufitus. He will tell you about the tomb of Bervirius and instruct you to bury the corpse. West of the hut is the Tribal Statue, bury the corpse there and the Spirit of Zadimus will appear, giving you a bone shard after some cryptic words. Use the bone shard on Trufitus, and tell him it appeared when you buried the corpse, that the spirit said something, and that it was about keys and kin. He'll tell you to look for Bervirius' tomb. If you didn't bring bones with you, you can obtain the three required bones from the chickens that spawn inside the village south of Trufitus now for a future section (beware of the poisonous tribesmen). Head towards Cairn Isle attached to the south-western coast of Karamja by either walking south or teleporting to a fairy ring and using code ckr. Climb the rocks and cross the bridge to reach Cairn Isle. You may fall and take damage, keep trying until you succeed. Search the well-stacked rocks (i.e. the cairn) on the north side of the island. Enter the crawl-way (Agility 32) to enter the Tomb of Bervirius. You may become stuck many times, but keep trying. Head south to the dolmen, and search it to get a sword pommel, a locating crystal, and Bervirius notes. {{Color|Red|Warning:}} If you drop the sword pommel or the bone beads, they will turn to dust and you will have to go back and get new ones. If you drop the locating crystal, you will take 10 damage. 'Note': If you lose the Bervirius notes, you will need charcoal and papyrus to get it again. You can purchase both from the store north of Tai Bwo Wannai. 'Read' the scrolls. You need to make a new necklace. Use a chisel on the sword pommel to make bone beads. Use the bronze wire on the beads to make the beads of the dead necklace. You now need to head to eastern Karamja. If walking there, climb up the nearby rockslide to exit the tomb (you may fall and take up to 10 damage). Otherwise you may teleport out to use fairy ring dkp or a gnome glider.

walkthrough.heading: Tomb of Rashiliyia
walkthrough.body: Chisel, Bone shard (Shilo Village) bone shard, beads of the dead necklace, locating crystal, 3 regular bones bones. bone key]] Rashiliyia's Tomb is north of the crashed gnome glider, accessible east of Trufitus across the log or south of fairy ring DKP. Look for a searchable palm tree. Avoid the nearby The Shaikahan enemy which cannot be harmed. The entrance is hidden behind a hill and is most visible if you are facing south. Search the palm trees to find two doors. Search these doors to find the shape of the keyhole, and then use your chisel on the bone shard to make a bone key (Crafting 20). 'Put on the beads of the dead necklace before entering or you will be unable to continue and will take constant damage!' Use the key on the door to enter. {|align=center |- |colspan=2 | |- | '1' - Entrance || '3' - Skeleton door |- | '2' - Rock slope || '4' - Dolmen |} Once inside, open the ancient gates, then climb down the rocks once you are ready to run past several aggressive undead ones. {{Color|red|Warning:}} In the next section you may be attacked by undead ones while trying to open the tomb doors by using your bones. The door will remember the amount of bones you have used, so if you die you can return and use the remaining bones. Head west until you find a stack of coins ('do not pick them up' or more undead ones will be summoned), then south, and then south-west at the first fork. At the end of this corridor will be a set of doors. Other sets of dummy doors exist if you take a wrong turn, so make sure you're in the right place. 'Right-click' the bones to use them on the door. 'While still wearing the necklace', enter the room.

walkthrough.heading: Nazastarool
walkthrough.body: While still wearing the beads of the dead, search the dolmen in the room. You will be attacked by Nazastarool, a level 91 zombie that attacks with Melee. After you defeat him, he will turn into a level 68 skeleton and then a level 93 ghost. You can safespot all three forms by running around the dolmen after each form spawns until he gets stuck (see image). Each form has a 5 minute despawn timer. He has a weakness to Fire spells and Crumble Undead, and is not resistant to any combat style. A salve amulet can be worn once the first form has spawned. A dwarf multicannon may be used. 'Note:' If you try to leave the cave the way you came in, the door will be locked and Rashiliyia will summon three Undead ones to kill you. You can however still leave by using the bone key on the doors. If you leave and return, you won't need to fight the forms that you already defeated, and you won't need bones to open the tomb door. 'Note:' A friend may attack the boss for you, but you must be the last person to attack it to progress in the quest (0s count but not poison/venom). Once you have defeated the ghost, you will get the corpse of Rashiliyia. Teleport out towards Cairn Isle or leave from where you entered (using your key on the door). Go back to the tomb of Bervirius on Cairn Isle west from Shilo Village, and use Rashiliyia's remains on the dolmen. Rashiliyia will appear before you. She will thank you for letting her rest in peace and give you your reward. {{Clear}}

steps: With one free inventory space, talk to Mosol Rei outside of Shilo Village. A gnome glider is nearby, as well as fairy ring CKR.
Use the wampum belt on Trufitus, found in the most north-eastern house in Tai Bwo Wannai (quest icon on minimap). Fairy ring CKR is nearby.
Follow the chat options once you've used the belt on him.

Head to the temple of Ah Za Rhoon south-west of the Shipyard and east of Shilo Village across the River Amja (the pile of rocks on the minimap). Use a gnome glider or Fairy ring DKP, or walk there by crossing the wooden log to the east, then head south until you reach a mound of earth surrounded by rocks.
Use your spade on the mound of earth.
Use a lit torch or candle on the fissure, then use your rope on the fissure. 'You will lose the item.'
Search the fissure (Agility 32) to climb down and follow the cave south until you reach the stream.
Use your chisel on the stone at 4 to receive a stone-plaque. Read it.
Search the cave-in at 2 to enter a new cave.
Search the loose rocks at 6 to find a tattered scroll. 'Read the scroll.'
Search the sacks at 7 to find a crumpled scroll. 'Read the scroll.'
Search the ancient gallows at 8 to get the Zadimus corpse.
Teleport out, or head back to the first area via the Cave in at 2.
If you went back to first area, leave by crafting the broken table at 3 into a raft, or by searching the rocks at 5. You will take heavy damage if you fail the search rocks at 5.
Return to Trufitus and use the 4 items you have collected on him.
Head west to the Tribal Statue near Trufitus' hut and bury the corpse.
Use the bone shard on Trufitus.
With your bronze wire and chisel, head south-west to Cairn Isle, west of Shilo Village, near fairy ring CKR. Climb the rocks (Agility 15) and then cross the bridge.
Search the well stacked rocks on the northern side of the island, and then enter the crevice, requiring (Agility 32). '''If you can't get in the cave you didn't read the scrolls'''.

Head south and 'with at least 3 empty inventory spaces' search the dolmen. If you had no space you'll have to return with charcoal and papyrus to get the notes. 'Do not drop the locating crystal or you will take 5-10 damage'.
Use a chisel on the sword pommel.
Use bronze wire on the bone beads.
Teleport out or climb up the rockslide nearby to escape the cave (may take up to 10 damage if you fail).
Prepare for the fight against Nazastarool. Crumble Undead is useful alongside Protect from Melee.
With your three regular bones, bone shard and chisel, head south-east from fairy ring DKP to the north-eastern dot on the Karamja map above.
Search the unique bright green palm tree 'from the north side' to find two doors.
Search the doors to find the keyhole.
Use your chisel on the bone shard to make a bone key.
Equip the Beads of the dead then use the key on the doors.
Open the ancient gate (while wearing the beads of the dead necklace), then climb down the rocks.
Run west, south, then south-west through the dungeon to reach a pair of doors.
'Use' (don't bury) 3 regular bones on the doors (can kill skeletons, 'not zombies' for the bones if you forgot).
Search the dolmen, then defeat Nazastarool in his 3 forms. If you click away from the dialogue at the end of each form, click on the dolmen again to resume the other phases.
Use Protect from Melee or stand behind the dolmen to safespot him.
Take the Rashiliyia corpse.
Return to Cairn Isle (fairy ring ckr).
Go through the well-stacked rocks.
Use the corpse on the dolmen.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Underground Pass
start: Talk to King Lathas on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of Ardougne Castle.
description: There are rumours of a secret passageway that can be used to get to the other side of the mountains west of Ardougne. Now it's just a matter of finding it.
itemRequirements: 1-5 arrows (only non-poisoned arrows with metal arrowtips will work. Craw's bow does not work. Crossbows and bolts will not work. Broad arrows, Ogre arrows, Ice arrows, and Training Arrows will also not work.)
recommendedItems: Plank (obtainable during quest)
Combat 60
Agility 50+ to reduce the risk of failing obstacles.
Thieving 50 for a helpful shortcut.
Weapon or combat spells. Using the bow is recommended if you need to save inventory space.
Armour or Prayer 43 for Protect from Melee.

Lots of food to survive traps and monsters. Taking a few Summer Pies is highly recommended if under 60 Agility, as eating these heals 22 in two bites and boosts your agility level by 5 per bite. Alternatively, Saradomin brews or super restores to reduce weight.
