Full access to Ape Atoll, with the exception of the bank and javelin store, which are unlocked after Monkey Madness II.
ironmanConcerns: * Smithing 40 (boostable) (to make the gold bar if not dropped by a monster) or Magic 33 (boostable) (to telegrab a gold bar from Varrock west bank basement) or Thieving 5 to steal from a crafting stall in Keldagrim. A gold bar is also a reward from The Digsite, Goblin Diplomacy, and Waterfall Quest
leagueRegion: <poem> Unlocking Kandarin will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Monkey Business
walkthrough.body: three free inventory spaces poison protection]], a lockpick, and a knife (to prevent the player from needing to bank by cutting the island's Pineapple plant pineapple plants for food) === Chapter 1 === '''"In which our hero/heroine finds himself/herself/themself drawn back into Glough's web of deception and deceit."''' Talk to King Narnode Shareen in the Tree Gnome Stronghold. He will tell you to investigate Glough's old shipyard for any trace of the missing 10th Squad, and will give you the gnome royal seal. Bring this to Karamja (the "Gandius" option on the glider at the top of the Grand Tree will bring you nearby). If you do not have monkey bones (or a monkey corpse), kill a monkey while on Karamja to obtain some. 'Note: If you leave the quest to do something else, you will need the gnome royal seal to get into the shipyard' After arriving, enter the shipyard north of the glider landing site and speak with G.L.O. Caranock, a gnome officer for the shipyard. He can be found in the building in the southern area, near the fence. He will act very suspiciously when spoken to, and advise you to return to the king. Return to King Narnode, and he will give you Narnode's orders and tell you to speak to Daero, the new head tree guardian. Daero can be found on the floor 1 of the Grand Tree, near Blurberry Bar. Go through all the chat options with Daero, and ensure you're ready for surviving Ape Atoll; when you're ready, tell him you're prepared to leave. He will then blindfold you and take you to an underground hangar. Talk to Daero in the hangar and he will introduce you to Waydar, a gnome pilot. Waydar will task you with solving a "reinitialisation" puzzle, which is similar to the puzzle boxes from Treasure Trails. If you have done these puzzles before, the sliding puzzle will be easy to complete; if not, see below for the solution, or bring 200,000 coins and go to Glough, who resides in the same area he did during the Grand Tree quest. ==== Waydar's puzzle ==== Begin solving the puzzle by clicking on the panel to the south-east by the southern glider. Players can take some spare controls from the nearby crate to view the solution, or simply consult the image below. Solve the sliding puzzle as follows (with the piece numbers counting from the top left corner, moving left to right): {{Checklist| * Manoeuvre pieces 1, 2, and 3 into their proper positions in the upper left corner. * Position piece 4 in the upper right corner. * Position piece 5 under piece 4 (shuffle pieces 4 and 5 around with some others if they are not in the right order). * Slide piece 4 to the left and piece 5 up; the first row will now be done. * Repeat this process with second and then third rows, leaving the completed rows intact. * With rows 1-3 completed, the puzzle should now be solved in terms of 2-piece high columns. * Position pieces 16 and 21 next to each other, in that order, on the right-hand side of the bottom row. Slide the remaining tiles clockwise to put them in place. * Repeat this process with pieces 17 and 22, then with pieces 18 and 23. * Pieces 19, 20, and 24 should now be easily moved to their correct places. }} After completing the puzzle, talk to Daero, and then Waydar. The two of you will depart and then land on the aptly named Crash Island, where the 10th Squad also crashed earlier. Ask the nearby sailor Lumdo to bring you to Ape Atoll, and he will refuse due to conflicting orders from his sergeant, Garkor; since Lumdo says he will not take orders from you, talk to Waydar again instead (watch out for poisonous scorpions just to his left, and 'do not' click "Travel", as this will bring you back to the Grand Tree). After speaking with Waydar, speak with Lumdo once more, and he will now agree to take you to Ape Atoll. Do not click the 'X' to close the story tablet that shows up after this conversation or it will cancel the subsequent cut-scene and you'll have to go through the chat option again. ===Chapter 2=== '"In which our hero/heroine finds themselves engaging in severe quantities of monkey business."' ====First Contact==== Once on the Atoll, start going west, sticking to the southern coastline until you reach a mahogany tree. From here, run north, avoiding the poisonous snakes, scorpions, and jungle spiders. If you have the level to use it, activate Protect from Missiles as you travel north, as a volley of poisoned arrows will start pelting you as you come closer to the Ape Atoll gate. Once you get close enough to the entrance, you will be knocked out and placed in a prison. After waking up, you will find yourself in a cell guarded by Trefaji and Aberab, two gorilla guards. Speak to Lumo, one of the captured 10th Squad members, and then prepare to make your escape. ==== Prison Break ==== {{Map:Monkey Mapness}}Throughout this section and any time you are re-jailed, you will need to stay one square away from the northern cell wall (near the patrolling guards' path) if the guards are in front of it. If you're in their range, they will punch you for 10-20 damage. The guards follow a path, which is as follows: one of the guards will patrol the area twice, walking the length of the prison each time, and then leave to rotate shifts. Use the time that the guard moves 'away from your cell door' to pick the lock. Once out, as the patrolling guard is walking out to switch with the one on standby, 'walk behind him to reach the exit.' Be prepared to make several attempts. After successfully making it out of the building, travel north of the jail and then east to find Karam, an assassin and member of the 10th Squad. Karam can be found in the bushes near the crafting shop ; he is mostly translucent and he can be difficult to spot, so look carefully. After finding him, speak with him to learn about the gnome mage Zooknock. Refer to the map to the right for relevant locations during the quest. Be wary of all 'yellow' dots, as they represent poisonous enemies (scorpions, snakes, and spiders), as well as aggressive monkey archers. When you are in the grass, the monkey archers do not fire, but it's still a good idea to activate Protect from Missiles as a precaution. Once you're ready, travel south, past the large door, while staying in the tall jungle grass. Past the door, go around the castle counter-clockwise until you're at the southern end, and from here, run south-east, until you are between a white building and the castle. To the east of that building is Garkor, the Sergeant of the 10th Squad. Speak with him, and make sure to get all the way through the dialogue to the point where he tells you to go meet Zooknock in person. ==== Supply Crates ==== Sprint west through the grass with Protect from Missiles on. Continue west (south of the buildings) in the grass until you reach the doorway to your north, marked on the map image above. Walk through the door to enter an enclosed area with a sleeping monkey guard, a banana crate, and a dentures crate. When inside this house, 'stay on the dark brown ground along the walls', or you'll risk being sent back to jail. The spiders inside are poisonous, but their poison only hits 1 damage, so it might be helpful to save your anti-poisons for later in the quest. There are bananas in the south-western crates next to the ladder if the player needs a source of food. From the entrance, head east and then north, and search the stacked crates towards the middle of the room to acquire monkey dentures. The sleeping guard is a non-threat so long as you don't talk to him; otherwise, he will call for guards. After you have the dentures, search the south-easternmost crate and a prompt will appear, asking if you're ready to enter the area below. You will take 32.9% of your current hitpoints as fall damage if you drop down into the cavern when entering, so heal up if necessary before attempting it to avoid dying to the poisonous spiders. Your Agility level has a chance to negate this damage, so a summer pie or other Agility boost may help avoid fall damage during this section. Once inside the cavern, 'travel to the north-west part of the area and search the crates' to acquire the m'amulet mould. At this point, if you need to resupply, you can exit the city by going to the south-east corner of Marim, running past the guards and the gravedigger, and climbing up the ladder. After climbing up, jump off the bridge, and go back to the boat to Crash Island. You can also teleport out.{{clear}} ====The Light at the End of the Tunnel==== the monkey dentures, the m'amulet mould, and a gold bar energy]], or Stamina potion stamina potions (or other energy-restoring items such as the Explorer's ring 1 explorer's ring), 4+ prayer potions, some food, a plank (not necessary if traversing the traps correctly, but can be obtained during the quest anyway), and a one-click teleport Note: Strange fruit are handy for this section as they also cure poison. You will spend about 220% total run energy to traverse to the end of the tunnel at minimum weight, with no energy conserving mechanics; bring enough energy restore to accommodate. It is 'highly recommended' to teleport out and bank at this point. This section involves running past dozens of accurate monkey zombies and gorilla skeletons which can hit up to 7 and 12 respectively, all while inside a long and tight multicombat tunnel. Ironmen or other accounts who don't have access to energy or prayer potions are advised to use other prayer-boosting items, in order to reduce prayer drain. Refer to the table below for the various threats faced throughout the dungeon.]] When you're ready, travel back to the southern part of Ape Atoll from the Gnome Hangar by speaking to Daero in the Grand Tree. Once you arrive, head west of Lumdo, and enter the tunnel  below. As soon as you enter, you'll see the screen will start to shake. Rumbling noises will play, and rocks will begin to fall; until you reach the tunnel, you are at 'constant' risk of taking damage. Use the map to the right to navigate the dungeon. {| class="wikitable" |+Dungeon threats and obstacles!Image!Name!Description!Action!Number |- | |Monkey Zombie |Slow-moving zombie monkeys will attack you and hit up to 7 melee damage. |Protect from Melee |30 |- | |Monkey Skeleton |Accurate skeleton monkeys will attack you and hit up to 12 melee damage. |Protect from Melee |17 |- | |Floor spikes |Spikes will launch from the ground and deal rapid damage if stood on, equal to 7.5% of your current health rounded up. |Avoid the dot clusters on the ground |30+ |- | |Rock trap |Two stalagmites will crash into you and deal rapid damage if you stand on the rock in the middle, equal to 20% of your current health rounded up. |Step on the square 'in front' of the rock, and then run through by clicking the other side, to avoid all damage. A plank can also be placed on the flat rock to pass the trap. |2 |- | |Falling rocks |Every 15 seconds, a pile of rocks will fall from the ceiling, dealing damage equal to 4% of your current health, rounded up. |You can stand under the overhangs to avoid the falling rocks if you are low on food. |N/A |} Even with consistent running, it will take at least three minutes of running to navigate the dungeon. Be prepared to drink your prayer and energy restoring potions, as well as food, when necessary. At the end of the tunnel, you will find the gnomes Zooknock, Waymottin and Bunkwicket. Talk to Zooknock, and then use your m'amulet mould, gold bar, and monkey dentures on him and speak to him again. 'Make sure he gives you an enchanted bar before leaving the tunnel'. Additionally, '''do not to use the m'amulet mould on Zooknock when you already have the enchanted bar''', as he will keep the mould and you will have to obtain another. Teleport out, and bank if necessary. If you have not gone through all the dialogue with Garkor you will not be able to use the items on him.{{clear}} ====Amulet of Monkeyspeak==== the enchanted bar, the m'amulet mould, a ball of wool, and five free inventory slots for the bananas '''Note': If you are going to do Recipe for Disaster, bring a ranged or magic weapon to kill a monkey guard and archer to save time later. Low level Ironmen can use rune spear (kp) from Tai Bwo Wannai Trio if the healing is too much to handle.'' After restocking, return to Ape Atoll and continue north-west until you are placed in the jail cell again. Escape the cell as before, then travel east towards the temple. You must now descend through the trapdoor to the east in the temple (see map). Activate Protect from Melee before entering the temple to block attacks from the powerful monkey guards. Most of the guards can simply be run through, but the ones with beards near the trapdoor will act as walls, trapping you if they surround you. The easiest method to get past the bearded gorillas is to go upstairs, and then climb down the ladder on the east side to get close to the trapdoor. If you choose to walk to the ladder directly, make sure to wait until the guards walk away; players can hide in the north-east corner of the temple until there is enough room to descend. If you're surrounded by guards and can't move, teleport out immediately; if you're trapped near the ladder, go up the stairs and hop worlds. Note that the ladder near the trap door can only be climbed up from the EAST side. Go down the trapdoor while still praying against melee. Ignore the monkey zombies (or kill one and pick up the bones if you want to do Recipe for Disaster later), and swiftly use the enchanted bar on the nearby wall of flames to make an unstrung monkey amulet. Either travel back up the ladder or find a safespot to get away from the foes, and use the ball of wool with the unstrung amulet to create the full m'speak amulet. Be aware that if you ascend the ladder, you will be attacked and can be trapped as before, so ensure Protect from Melee is active. ====A Monkey's Uncle==== Head to the building west of the jail, making sure to sneak through the grass. You'll see a banana garden that has a Monkey Child in it, which is being patrolled by The Monkey's Aunt. The aunt follows a predetermined path, which loops around the wooden house by the garden; do not enter the garden when the monkey's aunt is present, or she will call for guards to arrest you. Note that if you're caught, you can sometimes escape without being arrested by quickly climbing up the ladder in the building nearby before the monkeys reach you. Do not speak to The Monkey's Uncle upstairs, as he will also call the guards. You can use the abandoned building next to the banana garden to quickly access the garden, as it has a connecting corridor out of sight. Wait for the aunt to walk away, then speak to the monkey child, and tell him that you are his uncle. After he reveals that he is supposed to collect 20 bananas, search and pick five bananas from the nearby trees. The monkey cannot count, so you do not necessarily need 20, as long as you give him at least 5. Give him the bananas, then wait for a few moments in the corridor, and return to the monkey child when the aunt is away. Ask the child to lend you his monkey talisman. =====Multiple talismans===== You can obtain more than one talisman without dropping your current ones, so be sure to get an additional talisman for each greegree you want (four in total are needed for all quests; see below). You will need to speak to the monkey child again for each one, telling him you have lost the talisman, which will cause him to cry. Waiting for the aunt to pass by the child again will make the monkey child have another talisman available; Alternatively, you can switch worlds to potentially make the process go faster. If you talk to the child again before the aunt has passed by, you will get the message "The monkey child is too busy crying..." Note that after you make your first greegree, talismans can be purchased from Tutab's Magical Market for 1000 coins. Tutab will not open his shop unless you are in monkey form. =====Multiple greegrees===== 'Note:' This section is optional and not required for completing the quest, but it is required for future quests and it is convenient to do it now to save a future trip through the tunnels. For the Recipe for Disaster quest, you will need an additional three greegrees (four in total). Each of these requires one talisman, for a total of four talismans plus their respective monkey bones if making all talismans in one go. You will save yourself several trips if you obtain all of these materials before going to Zooknock in the next section. You must kill one of each of the following: {| class="wikitable" |+Greegrees!Type!Bones/corpse from!Quest |- |{{Ilink|Karamjan monkey greegree|txt=Karamjan monkey|pic=Karamjan monkey greegree}} | |Monkey Madness I |- |{{Ilink|Ninja monkey greegree|txt=Ninja monkey|pic=Ninja monkey greegree (medium)}} | |Freeing King Awowogei |- |{{Ilink|Gorilla greegree|txt=Gorilla|pic=Gorilla greegree}} | |Freeing King Awowogei. Using melee is not recommended to fight the Monkey Guards, as they will indefinitely heal for 25 hitpoints when low health and in melee range. If using melee, you may get the guard to 26hp and then use poison or ranged to finish it off from a distance. |- |{{Ilink|Zombie monkey greegree|txt=Zombie monkey|pic=Zombie monkey greegree (big)}} | |Freeing King Awowogei |} 'Note': Some monkeys will have large and small variants; both will work for the quests, and merely change the size of your monkey form. ==== Making the greegrees ==== Once you have all of the required bones (or monkey corpse) and talismans, you must run through the tunnels again, bringing your items to Zooknock. Travel through the tunnel for a second time, and when you reach the end, 'use' the monkey talisman and all monkey bones (or corpses) on Zooknock. After a brief delay and conversation, you will get a greegree corresponding to the bones you used on him. To make another greegree, you have to first talk to him again and ask him if he can make another. 'If you cancel the conversation accidentally, ask how to make the monkey talisman and it will resume.' If for some reason this doesn't work, try the drop trick with your previous greegrees, and go through the dialogue again. After all desired greegrees are made, bank or stock up as needed, and return to Ape Atoll. ===Chapter 3=== '<nowiki>In which our hero/heroine finds himself/herself contending with life as a monkey.</nowiki>' Karamjan monkey greegree, m'speak amulet, 1 free inventory space, and a method of reaching Ardougne In this chapter, you will be required to speak with King Awowogei and retrieve a monkey from the Ardougne Zoo. If you need to bank or in order to be more efficient, 'you can skip to retrieving the monkey in Ardougne' (section "Monkey See, Monkey Zoo" below), and then speak with Awowogei when you return to Ape Atoll (steps 1-3). 1- Wield the monkey greegree to become a monkey. In this form, you will not be approached or attacked by any of the monkeys or wildlife on the island, and you cannot engage in combat. As a Karamjan monkey, return to Garkor and speak with him. If you are transformed into a different kind of monkey, he'll tell you to change and come back. After you finish talking, with the m'speak amulet equipped, talk to the Elder Guard near Garkor. The guard will tell you to speak with Kruk. 2- From the guard, run west until you pass the main gate into Marim and have reached the Western shore of Ape Atoll (do not exit the gate). Head slightly south and follow the ground path up the western hill, then climb up the bamboo ladder at the top and cross the bamboo bridge. Climb down the ladder on the east side and speak to Kruk. After the conversation ends, he will conveniently take you back to King Awowogei. 3- Speak to Awowogei and offer an alliance, and he will ask you to rescue a monkey from the Ardougne Zoo. Teleport out and make your way to Ardougne. ====Monkey See, Monkey Zoo==== Once in Ardougne, ensure you have an empty inventory space and then head to the south-west corner and enter the zoo. Wield the greegree inside the zoo area to become a monkey, and then speak to the Monkey minder, who will place you in the cage. Speak with a monkey (the only one with a "Talk" option), and it'll hop into your inventory; then, unequip the greegree and speak to the Monkey minder again. He will be confused and let you out. You will now need to travel 'by foot' to the Gnome Stronghold. You cannot use any form of teleportation (including random events, spirit trees and fairy rings), as doing so will remove the monkey from your inventory, requiring you to re-obtain it from the zoo. The canoe system will work, however. Once in the Gnome Stronghold, talk to Daero on the floor 1 to travel back to Ape Atoll as usual. :''Extra: Your new monkey friend will supply you with some humorous dialogue, and examining him will get you poked. If you have any bananas in your inventory, he will most likely eat them. There is also a 1/256 chance that he will give you a clue scroll (medium) if you use bananas on him directly. Note that you must go through the entire dialogue. Only one clue may be obtained per player{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/707250010379952128|date=9 March 2016|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/101498|archivedate=30 May 2020|quote=1/256, and it's once only per player.}}. Once on Ape Atoll, equip your greegree and amulet to speak with Awowogei again. (If you have spoken before, simply speak to the Elder Guard to be let in; if not, refer to the section above). The monkey will automatically leave your backpack after speaking to Awowogei, and the king will consider an alliance. Speak with Garkor to begin Chapter 4. ===Chapter 4, "The Final Battle"=== Greegree, food, an antipoison, and combat equipment to defeat a level 195 Jungle Demon Speak with Garkor one more time (as a human or monkey) to receive a 10th squad sigil. 'Do not equip it until you are ready for the final battle'''. Make sure to hold onto the sigil, as if you lose it, Garkor will send you to Waymottin at the end of Zooknock's tunnel to reclaim it. Bank in preparation for the Jungle Demon fight, and ensure you have full prayer points and health. When you are ready to fight, wear the sigil, and you will be promptly teleported to the Jungle Demon's arena. 'note:' * You can wear the sigil, to start the fight, from anywhere in RuneScape; no need to return to Ape Atoll. * Although you "wear" the sigil, it stays in your inventory and doesn't unequip your neck-slot equipment. * Activate Protect from Magic '''before' teleporting, and drink any necessary potions. * Switch to your weapon/unequip your greegree before teleporting. 'You will lose your greegree''' if you have it equiped and your inventory is full when you teleport. Upon landing in the arena, you'll be confronted by a level 195 Jungle Demon which can hit up to 32 with both magic and melee. Protection prayers reduce all damage to zero; as such, if the player stands out of melee range, the fight can be completed by simply leaving on Protect from Magic and attacking the demon with Magic or Ranged. Note that the demon's melee attack can hit you even if you're two squares away, similar to a halberd; ensure you're three or more squares away to avoid it. Additionally, 'standing still' once you are teleported to the arena will keep a distance between you and the Demon, who will not move until you do, although it will still attack you with Magic. The 10th Squad gnomes will be nearby to assist with the fight, but 'you must deal the final blow to the demon yourself.' If the gnomes deal the final strike, he will heal around 20 percent of his health (anywhere from 12%-25%); when the demon reaches 1 hitpoint, there will be a period where the gnomes stop attacking, so use this window to deal the final blow yourself. The demon is weakest to Ranged, although Magic is fairly effective. Players should focus on their combat style with the highest damage. Note that the dwarf multicannon is effective against the demon, allowing pure accounts to kill him without gaining any Hitpoints experience; additionally, despite being from the jungle, he is not immune to poison. Melee is not recommended, but players looking to use melee combat will benefit from using rings of recoil, as the demon's melee attacks hit very accurately. There is a safespot in the arena, across a bridge on the outside edge. When you run to the safespot, he will make his way to the bridge, but won't be able to fit over it, allowing you to easily attack him with Magic or Ranged while leaving up Protect from Magic. If you die during the fight, the sigil can be reclaimed from Death's Office. No need to run through the Ape Atoll Dungeon.

walkthrough.heading: Finishing up
walkthrough.body: Once the Jungle Demon is slain, speak to Garkor, who is indicated by an arrow. He will tell you to speak to Zooknock; speak to Zooknock nearby to get the option to be teleported back to Ape Atoll. If players decline the offer and stay, they are free to explore the banana plantation, but Zooknock will leave, requiring players to speak to Bonzara instead if they want to be teleported. He can be found in the crack at the base of the statue. *'Warning:' The gnomes will teleport you into the jungle on Ape Atoll. It is advised to simply teleport off of the island as quickly as possible; players wishing to stay on the island should immediately equip their greegree after being teleported by the gnomes. Escape the island however you like, either through the main gates as a monkey, with any form of teleport, or by jumping off the bridge in the south-east part of the city, and go back to the Gnome Stronghold. Speak with King Narnode in the Grand Tree to finish the quest. 'Congratulations, quest complete! ' The king will then redirect you to Daero for your training as a new 10th squad member, so go have a chat with Daero for some optional experience rewards.

steps: Speak to King Narnode Shareen at the Grand Tree.
Without an open inventory space, the gnome royal seal will be dropped on the ground.
Climb up the tree and take the glider to Gandius.
If you don't have the monkey bones yet, you can kill a monkey nearby for some. (If you have started Tai Bwo Wannai Trio, only a monkey corpse will drop. That will work as well)
Enter the Shipyard gate to the north. Make sure you have the Royal Seal with you.
Speak with G.L.O. Caranock in the building south of the gate.
Return to King Narnode and speak to him. (Make sure you have 1 inventory space free as he will drop Narnode's orders to the floor otherwise).
Talk to Daero in the bar on the floor 1 (east side) of the Grand Tree. Make sure to go through all of the Chat Options to be teleported to a new location.
Talk (not "travel") to Daero again inside the hangar.
Click the panel in the south-eastern region of the hangar and solve the sliding puzzle. (guide here)
Alternatively, pay Glough (back in the Stronghold) {{Coins|200000}} to solve it for you.
Watch the cutscene. Talk to Daero, then Waydar to fly to Crash Island.
Talk to Lumdo.
Talk (not "travel") to Waydar twice, who will convince Lumdo to follow orders.
Talk to Lumdo again to travel west to Ape Atoll.
On the island, follow the red path on the map into the valley. You will be shot and arrested.
Watch the guards' pattern, pick the lock on your cell door and escape the prison.
Stay at least 2 squares away from the guards '
Follow the green path and talk to Garkor (Complete dialogue or Zooknock will not give you the m'speak amulet).
quickGuide.itemsNeeded: Note: You will need to teleport away and return to the island several times.

steps: Follow the blue path to the U-shaped building and enter through the southern door.
'Stay on the dark brown floor' or you will alert the guards.
Search the stacked crates on the light brown floor for Monkey dentures. (Complete the dialogue)
Search the south-eastern crate to fall into a cave.
Heal up before you do, you can take fall damage.
Search the crates in the north-west for a M'amulet mould.
You may now teleport away.
Now is an ideal time to resupply at a bank before heading into the Ape Atoll Dungeon.
Return to Ape Atoll by talking to Daero, Waydar, and Lumdo.
Follow the yellow path west and climb down the ladder into the Ape Atoll Dungeon.
Run to the end of the dungeon.
Use Protect from Melee prayer and ignore all the hazards, eating food and drinking potions as needed.
Talk to Zooknock.
Use your Monkey dentures, M'amulet mould, and Gold bar on Zooknock.
Talk to Zooknock to get an Enchanted bar and your M'amulet mould back.
'Do not' use the m'amulet mould on Zooknock when you already have the enchanted bar, otherwise he will keep it and you will have to obtain another.
Teleport away, then return by talking to Daero, Waydar, and Lumdo.
Follow the red path, get arrested, escape, then follow the pink path to the temple.
(Note: bearded guards cannot be walked through!) Enter the trapdoor. You may need to climb up the ladder to the south then down in the east to avoid the gorillas.
With a M'amulet mould in your inventory, use the Enchanted bar with a wall of flames, then string it with your Ball of wool to create the M'speak amulet.
Optional: If you plan on doing the Freeing King Awowogei section of Recipe for Disaster:
Kill one of the Monkey Zombies and pick up the zombie monkey bones.
Climb back up the rope, kill one of the Monkey Guards and pick up the gorilla bones.
If you're having trouble with the guard, stay out of melee range so it doesn't heal.

quickGuide.section: Well I'll be a monkey's uncle
steps: Follow the pink path back to the jail, then the cyan path to the Monkey child's house.
Keep an eye on The Monkey's Aunt, it's only safe to be in the garden while she isn't near it.
Equip your M'speak amulet and talk to the monkey child.
Talk to the monkey child twice more.
Pick 5 Bananas from the trees in the garden.
Talk to the monkey child to give him the bananas.
Leave the garden and wait for the aunt to pass through.
Talk to the monkey child to get a Monkey talisman.
Optional: If you plan on doing the Freeing King Awowogei section of Recipe for Disaster:
Talk to the monkey child again.
Leave the garden, hop worlds or wait for the monkey child to stop crying.
Talk to the monkey child again.
Repeat the above steps until you have four Monkey talisman in total.
If doing Freeing King Awowogei section, climb the ladder in the east building from Child, cross bridge east and there will be Monkey Archers you can kill and pick up one set of ninja monkey bones
Teleport away, then return by talking to Daero, Waydar, and Lumdo.
Now is an ideal time to resupply at a bank for the Ape Atoll dungeon.
Bring good Food, as well as Prayer, Antipoison, and Stamina/Energy potions.
Follow the yellow path west and climb down the ladder.
Run to the end of the dungeon.
Use Protect from Melee prayer and ignore all the hazards, eating food and drinking potions as needed.
Give Zooknock your Monkey talisman and Monkey bones (make sure these are bones from the regular monkeys; examine Text: These are small monkey bones.). After a moment he will give you a Greegree.
'Do not' accidentally bury the bones! Right click them and carefully select "use".
'Do not' leave the dialogue with Zooknock prematurely. Should the player exit the cutscene before it has finished, talking to Zooknock again will restart the cutscene, and no items will be lost.
Optional: If you plan on doing the Freeing King Awowogei section of Recipe for Disaster:
Talk to Zooknock again.
'Use' another talisman and bone on him. The type of bones you give him will determine the Greegree you receive. After a moment he will give you another Greegree.
Repeat the above steps until you have four Greegrees in total. (Karamjan, Ninja, Zombie, and Gorilla)
Note: Teleporting while wielding the Greegree will force it into your inventory. If your inventory is full then it will be dropped. If unnoticed, 'the Greegree can be lost.'

Head to the Ardougne Zoo and equip your Karamjan monkey greegree, then talk to the Monkey minder. If you haven't talked to him before, click through his dialogue (ask any question), then equip the Karamjan monkey greegree.
Equip your M'speak amulet and talk to a monkey, it will jump in your bag.
Remove your greegree and talk to the minder again.
'Travel by foot' (walk or run) back to the Grand Tree, then return to Ape Atoll by talking to Daero, Waydar, and Lumdo. 'Do not use any means of teleportation.'
Equip your M'speak amulet and Karamjan monkey greegree. 'Ape Atoll is no longer your enemy when wearing a greegree!'

If you want to skip going to talk to Kruk and you brought mithril seeds or tinderbox and logs you can stand on the east side of the Elder Guard and plant the mithril seeds or light a fire to be force moved one tile west and thus bypass needing to talk to Kruk or to Garkor.
Follow the red path, go through the gates, then walk east to the coast and talk to Garkor.
Talk to the nearby Elder Guard.
Head to the west coast of the island (orange path), then climb up the hill to the south.
Climb the ladder, walk across the bridge, climb down, and talk to Kruk.
Talk to Awowogei.
Talk to Awowogei again. Then talk to the Elder Guard again to be let out.
Talk to Garkor and watch the cutscene.
Talk to Garkor again to get the 10th squad sigil.
Prepare for final battle.
Equip the 10th squad sigil when you are ready to fight the Jungle Demon.
Tip: Use Protect from Magic prayer and stay out of melee range to avoid taking damage.
Kill the Jungle Demon.
Return to the Grand Tree and talk to King Narnode Shareen.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Haunted Mine
start: Speak to the Zealot at the mines in Morytania on the path to Mort'ton.
description:
Recent forays into Morytania by some of Saradomin's more fanatical supporters have unearthed murky rumours concerning an abandoned mine in the south.

Legend speaks of an unusual material, hidden in the depths of the mines, that is somehow linked to the desolation and fear that now surrounds the place. Do you have the nerve to find out more, and enter the haunted mines of Morytania?
recommendedItems: Combat 50
Agility 15 (boostable) if climbing over the mine cart and crawling down the cart tunnel of the front entrance
Prayer 40
2 empty inventory spaces, one for Zealot's key and one for the glowing fungus

Fast travel to Abandoned Mine to start the quest - Mort'ton Teleport, fairy ring BIP (req Agility 50), Shades of Mort'ton minigame teleport, Barrows Teleport, fairy ring BKR and take the swamp boaty (requires completion of In Search of the Myreque)
A filled druid pouch if not using the low fence agility shortcut from Burgh de Rott to skip the swamp section
A pickaxe to mine mithril ore after the quest for the hard Morytania Diary (obtainable during the quest) (requires Mining 55)
A Slayer Ring for easy completion of the Lair of Tarn Razorlor miniquest after completing Haunted Mine
Good combat equipment (at least level 50 is advised)
Magic is recommended — see the boss section of the guide for more details
1-2 prayer potions

walkthrough.heading: Preparation
walkthrough.body: {{Map|3440,3232|mtype=square|r=6|align=right|caption=The Abandoned Mine is located south-west of Mort Myre Swamp.}} To begin the quest, players need to head to the Abandoned Mine, which can be found in the south-westernmost part of Morytania, south of the swamps and west of Mort'ton and Burgh de Rott. To reach the abandoned mine players will either have to have started Nature Spirit or have access to fast travel to Mort'ton or Barrows. There is a low fence shortcut from Burgh de Rott which requires Agility 25 and partial completion of In Aid of the Myreque, which will save time not running through the swamp to the north of the mine. {{Color|red|Warning}}: The boss fight is very difficult even for higher combat levels, as you will take a lot of damage regardless of armour. The only nearby bank is the Burgh de Rott bank unlocked through In Aid of the Myreque, and returning to the boss fight room will require you to redo some steps of the quest, so it is recommended to bring all of your combat gear and supplies for the boss at the start of the quest. Read ahead to the boss fight section for tips. 'Note': If travelling through the swamp to reach the mine, don't forget your filled druid pouch.

walkthrough.heading: The mysteries of Mort Ridge
walkthrough.body: tells you about the mine and its contents.]] In the area between the mine and the swamp, a Saradominist zealot is walking around. Speak to him and he will demand to know your allegiance. Select any response other than Zamorak, and ask him what he is doing. He will explain that he is on a quest to reclaim the Haunted Mines in the name of Saradomin, and that the legendary Salve amulet, since lost, was carved from the crystals that grow in the lower levels of the mine. The mines are haunted by the condemned soul of Treus Dayth, a Zamorakian mage whose soul was bound by Zamorak to the mines to prevent those crystals from ever being reached again. The zealot hopes to reach these crystals to recreate the Salve amulet. Ask about other entrances into the mine, and the zealot will confirm that a second entrance may exist, and that he has come into possession of a key granting access to the lower levels of the mine. Pickpocket him to get his key (drops on the floor with full inventory). Follow the cart track to the south (avoiding the the feral vampyres) and climb over the mine cart blocking the way, then enter the cart tunnel. 'Note': If you don't have Agility 15, you cannot climb over the cart - instead, go to the west side of the mountain and enter the southern entrance.

walkthrough.heading: Into the depths
walkthrough.body: {{main|Abandoned Mine}} You find yourself in a dark cave with many bats, big and small, and many pickaxes and corpses strewn about. There are some hazards to be aware of throughout the mine: * Some skeletons are dormant; the ones called corpses in yellow letters will spring to life and become skeletal miners when you approach * Some pickaxes may become possessed and attack you when you attempt to pick them up * Creepy hazes are spooky but generally harmless (although they can sometimes turn into aggressive ghosts when adjacent to them) * Mine carts moving of their own accord will damage you if you get in their way Your task is to make your way to the depths of the caves and find the Salve crystal. Follow the cart track to the west and exit the cave on the western side (ignore the ladder). Once outside, enter the southern entrance (the same one used if you didn't climb over the cart). Climb down the ladder at the end of the blocked path. Head east and climb down the next ladder. Follow the path to the cart track running north to south. 'Wait until the moving cart has headed south', then follow it and wait in the western alcove to the south. When the cart passes north, run south to the ladder and climb down.

walkthrough.heading: Getting a light
walkthrough.body: {|class="wikitable"!Map Label!Description |- |9-12 |Ladder to Level 3. |- |13 |Lift (elevator) to Level 5. |- |A |Obstructions that block passage. |- |P |Point set panel. |- |Q |Levers for track switches A, B, C, D, and E. |- |R |Levers for track switches F, G, H, I, J, and K. |- |T |"Searchable" mine carts. |- |U |Water valve. |- |V |Iron pickaxe and several coin spawns. |- |W |Chamber contains two bronze pickaxes and two chisels. |- |X |Glowing fungus spawns. |} After climbing down the ladder '(12)', you will arrive next to a stagnant pool to the west with glowing fungus growing '(X)'. Pick one; this is to be your light source in the lowest level of the cave (no other light source will work). There is a lift to the east, but you cannot descend in it now - it leads to a flooded area which would extinguish any other light source. You will need to find a way to transport the fungi to the lift without carrying it, as it will crumble to ashes if taken outside. Warning: 'Do not' take the fungi outside of the cave and also 'do not drop it', as both actions will cause it to crumble to ashes. Random events that teleport the player will also destroy the fungi. ====All aboard!==== Head north-west along the track until you reach a searchable mine cart. Place the fungus in the cart '(T)'. Head north and then west to the Points settings '(P)' panel, which operates the cart system. 'Note': In the alcove immediately south of the panel is an Iron pickaxe. If you didn't bring a pickaxe but you plan to do the hard Morytania Diary task during the quest, you can pick this one up without it becoming possessed. Beware of the skeletal miner corpse becoming reanimated however. Open the panel, and it will show a map of all the cart tracks on this level as well as ten junctions that can each be in two positions. Pressing the start button sets the cart system in motion. The objective is to get the cart from the start position on the left to the ladder in the top right corner (north-west). The map also shows two groups of levers controlling the junctions. The cart will follow the crimson (lighter red) route at any junction when approaching from the tail direction of the corresponding arrow. Pulling the respective lever exchanges the crimson and burgundy arrows at the junction. The initial configuration will be different for each player, but the solution remains the same (see the image below). The levers A through E are south-east of the control panel (location '(Q)' on the map above), whereas F through J are north, around the corner (location '(R)'). Beware of skeletal miners lying in ambush at both stations. The levers F, G and H are inaccessible, meaning those junctions are fixed. When approaching a junction from the arrow head's direction, its orientation (i.e., colour) does not matter as long as it is a straight path. In order to round a corner and not plunge into a wall or the water, the direction taken by the cart must be marked by a crimson arrow. <gallery widths="300"> Haunted Mine - Levers A-E.png|Levers A-E. Haunted Mine - Levers I-K.png|Levers F-K. (The blocked levers F, G & H are unmarked in this picture.) Haunted Mine - Track map.png|The mine cart route solution. </gallery> Operate all the levers in accordance with the rules above and then check the control panel to make sure that the route on your map directs the mine cart to the ladder. Operate the mine cart by pressing the start button and the map will show the path of the mine cart. Depending on the contents and route of the cart, four outcomes are possible. They are indicated both by the second half of the short cutscene, and a game message or player dialogue: * {{mes|Oh dear, the mine cart seems to have sunk.}} - The cart sinks into the water. Any fungus in the cart will be destroyed. * {{mes|How useful, it's come right back to where it started.}} - The cart returns to the start. Any fungus in the cart will still be in the cart. * 'Player:' I wonder if that cart is anywhere useful now? - The cart successfully makes it to the other side. The fungus will now be on the other side. * (No message) - The cart successfully makes it to the other side. There was no fungus in the cart before sending it. If the cart sinks, the glowing fungus is removed from the cart. In that case, pick another glowing fungus and put it in the cart '(T)'. Operate the appropriate levers to fix the problem and hit the red button again. When the mine cart reaches the correct end point, you will remark that it may have ended up somewhere useful. If your character doesn't make a comment about the location of the cart, put another mushroom in and send the cart off again. ====Retrieving the fungus==== You will now have to reach the ladder yourself to retrieve the fungus. First, retrace your steps to the very top of the mine. Go back up the ladder '(12)' near the glowing fungi pool. Walk north along the track, avoiding the cart. Take the first path to the east and climb up the ladder at the end of the path. Go west and up the ladder, then exit the cave to the west. You should end up next to the River Salve. Enter the northern cave. Climb down the first ladder immediately to the east and head north-east through the cave. Climb down the northern ladder to the next level. Head to the north-west corner of the cave and climb down the ladder. Search the nearby cart and take the glowing fungus that was put in earlier. If there is no fungus in the cart, you will need to repeat the previous process. 'Note:' If you die during the boss fight, you will need to get another glowing fungus and send it through the mine cart again, but you will not need to set the levers again as they will remain the same.

walkthrough.heading: Waterlogged
walkthrough.body: Zealot's key, combat equipment and plenty of high-healing food Do 'not' take the mine cart track leading south. Instead, climb back up with the fungus in your possession. Head all the way east past the ladder going up and then south past a moving cart. Climb down the ladder to end up in a side cave east of the flooded tracks. Head south down the corridor. Pick up the chisel from the spawn on top of a crate if you did not bring one. In this area there is a water-powered lift going further down but it is not operational. To use it, head around the large pipe and use the zealot's key on the valve to activate the water flow from the nearby basin. 'Run' quickly back to the lift and head down, before a mischievous ghost can shut off the valve. If the ghost beats you, simply turn the valve again and retry. 'Note': If you die during the following boss fight, you will not need to use the valve again, and the key is no longer required for access. The lift will drop you into a pool of water, but the cave will be properly lit with the glowing fungus. From the flooded chamber, walk south onto the track (beware of possessed pickaxes) and 'follow the east track'. Climb down the stairs ('14') and go west into a large chamber with loading cranes and mine carts. This room is where the boss fight will take place. 'Do not take the innocent-looking key until you are completely ready to begin!' 'Note': If you want to return to the upper levels, simply return to the lift, click on it and you will automatically swim towards it.

walkthrough.heading: Treus's wrath
walkthrough.body: :'Note:' ''Read this part fully before entering the fight if you're not experienced with the fight! Especially if you're low combat! This boss fight is difficult and should not be taken lightly. High-healing food is recommended. The surrounding environment is more dangerous than the actual boss itself. To start the fight, try to pick up the innocent-looking key. It will float away and return. Click the chatbox to continue the dialogue and the ghost of Treus Dayth (combat level 95), the erstwhile guardian of the Salve crystals, will appear and start to attack you. During the fight Treus will use his ghostly powers to turn invisible, and move through obstacles about the room. He cannot be attacked while invisible, and you will need to chase him around the room until he reappears. His location is at any time indicated by a flashing yellow arrow on the minimap. As the fight progresses he will disappear at a faster rate. There are four methods that Treus uses to damage you: *Mine Cart - When the player steps on a cart track, a mine cart will be sent tumbling after them. This can hit up to 9 typeless damage every game tick, which can equal to '36 damage every 2 seconds' if the player is unlucky. This is the most dangerous attack. This attack can be easily avoided by running across the tracks instead as the cart will only move when the player is in its target range. *Crane - The possessed cranes will attack the player if the player moves to a square directly adjacent to it, dealing up to 10 typeless damage. This is the second most dangerous attack out of the three. *Pickaxes - If the player is not near any other obstacle, the player will be attacked by projectile pickaxes. These hit up to 15 damage each. The Protect from Missiles prayer only provides '33%' protection from this attack, reducing it to a max of 10. Pickaxes are the second least dangerous attack. *Melee'' - If the player is standing next to Treus Dayth, he may rarely use a melee attack that deals up to 8 damage. This is the least used attack and also the least dangerous. ====Strategy==== As Treus moves around the room, you will need to chase him across the tracks without staying on them, and while avoiding standing too close to the cranes. Treus will throw pickaxes at you, so you should pray Protect from Missiles while running around, using stamina potions to keep your run energy, and restoring your hitpoints with food while he is invisible. Note that you can also leave via the eastern door at any time and use that as a safe zone to regenerate your health, run energy and prayer if necessary - the boss will have the same amount of health when you re-enter. The boss will eventually reset back to a key if the fight lasts too long. If Treus moves between the north-western and north-eastern side of the room, you may run back and forth along the northern-most cart track where you only have to dodge one cart. If he moves south, try to hug the cavern walls to avoid the cranes as you approach him. Magic is the easiest choice against this boss due to its low Magic defence; it is also weak to Wind spells and Crumble Undead. If you have access to an Iban's staff (requiring 50 Attack, Magic, and completion of Underground Pass) it may be more effective, as it hits accurately (especially against this boss) and very high. Note however that most of your attacks will take place in close to melee range, as the obstacles in the room will block you from attacking the boss at range. You can kill the boss with any combat style if you have a stronger option due to your combat stats or gear. If using magic, consider bringing along an additional set of defensive armour to switch to while running after the boss to reduce the damage of his Ranged attack. When he reappears you can switch back to your offensive Magic gear. As you have limited opportunities to hit him, using a high hitting special attack like the dragon dagger as a secondary can be useful. Its special attack hits twice in one go, but this boss will only receive one of those hits before he moves away to a new spot and before you even get to him the second attack from the dagger will automatically hit him. If using melee as your primary attack style, bring the highest-hitting melee weapon you can use, such as a 2h sword or halberd. Interestingly, Treus Dayth's attack speed while not teleporting is 'dramatically' lowered to a 30-tick cycle if he is successfully poisoned. He is, however, immune to poison damage. You may consider using a trident of the swamp to apply venom. 'Note': It is 'not' possible to freeze the ghost from moving using Magic or the Zamorak Godsword special attack. 'Note': If you die, items will appear inside a grave for 15 minutes. You will need to get another glowing fungus to return. The boss will respawn once you take the key again. If you fail to retrieve your grave in time your items will be at Death's Office..]]

walkthrough.heading: Salvation at last
walkthrough.body: After defeating Treus Dayth, the machinery will stop attacking you. Pick up the innocent-looking key, which no longer resists and is, in fact, the crystal-mine key. Now, head back east through the door and climb up the stairs back to Level 5. Walk all the way west until you reach another staircase ('15') and head down. The crystal-mine key opens the large door to a room with several crystal outcrops in the south-east corner. Use a chisel to cut a piece from the crystal outcrop (Crafting 35). If you forgot your chisel, go back up the lift and pick up the chisel from on top of the crate. You will obtain a salve shard that can be crafted into a new amulet. Be sure to cut extras for backup! 'Note': Mining a mithril ore from the veins on the wall within this room will complete a task in the hard Morytania Diary. A nearby cart tunnel leads right back to the entrance of the mine and can henceforth be used as a shortcut. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

Avoid touching mine carts.

Climb down the ladder.
Pick a glowing fungus. Don't take any random events that teleport you out of the mine from now on or your fungus will turn to ash.
Go NW and place the fungus in the searchable cart.
Go NW to check the points settings. (Board on a wall)
Write down which levers need to change to match the correct setting to get to the ladder in the top-right corner.
The initial configuration will be different for each player. See pictures for the correct configuration and labels on each lever.
Go south-east and pull the needed levers (between A-E).
Go north-west and pull the needed levers (between F-K).
Return to the point settings and click start.
Leave the cave by going back the way you came
Go up the ladder by the glowing fungus spawn.
Go north past the haunted cart, then the first wing east, climb up the ladder.
Go west, climb up the ladder.
Go west and exit the cave.
Crawl-down the Cart tunnel to the north
Climb down the nearby ladder.
Go NE and climb down the ladder by the door.
Go west then north and climb down the ladder.
Search the cart for the fungus and take it. Do not drop until you have completed the quest!
Climb up the ladder and start saving your run energy after you turn the water valve in the next step.

Head south and use the Zealot's key on the water valve.
'Note:' If you forgot a chisel be sure to grab the one near the lift before you open the valve; you won't have enough time to pick it up while running there.
Quickly run to the lift and take it down.
Go south then East and down the stairs.
Go through the door.
Pick up the innocent-looking key to start the boss fight.

Kill Treus Dayth. It is recommended to pray Protect from Missiles throughout the fight. A good way to fight this boss is to run near him after attacking; the goal is to force him into the north-eastern corner. Once this occurs, run west to the end of the detached northern shaft and attack him from a distance. This prevents him from teleporting around the mine while also negating crane damage, which should make the fight easier.
'Note:' If you teleport away, you will have to get another Glowing fungus.
'Note:' If you die, you cannot get the Glowing fungus back from your grave in the flooded area. This is not a safe fight.
'Note:' If you are following the Optimal Quest Guide, using Crumble Undead is the most effective way to kill this boss.
Pick up the key
Go back up the eastern stairs.
Go west and down those stairs. You will need the Glowing fungus to act as a light source.

name: Troll Romance

description: Ug loves Aga, but Aga is together with Arrg. Since Arrg is a lot stronger than Ug, Ug can't follow the regular mating ritual, which involves ripping the opponent into pieces. Will you be able to find out what will impress the troll female more than a display of violence? Will you survive the journey to help a lonely troll find love?
