name: Mountain Daughter
start: Talk to Hamal the Chieftain in the Mountain Camp east of Rellekka. To get in, take the path north of the Golden Apple Tree and use a rope on the boulder behind the guard (see below for more details).
description: Ages ago, a small tribe of people split off from the Fremennik in Rellekka and decided to inhabit the mountains to the east of town. There they lived as nomads for many years, but now the chieftain of the camp has lost his daughter and will not move on before she has been found. Has she run away, has she been eaten by trolls, or is there something more sinister going on? Only you can find out.
itemRequirements: Staff or a pole (obtainable during the quest, Dramen Staff does not work, but elemental staves and Lunar staff do work)
Gloves (excluding: Slayer, Ranger, Moonclan, Lunar, vambraces, mystic and random event apparel)
recommendedItems: Combat 40
Combat equipment
Stamina or energy potions
Weight-reducing clothing
Fast travel to the White Wolf Mountain (gnome glider through Ring of dueling or Royal seed pod, or alternatively a Camelot teleport)
Fast travel to the Mountain Camp (Slayer ring or Fairy Rings to ajr and head north, or Camelot Teleport)
Fast travel to Rellekka (Enchanted lyre or Fremennik sea boots, or House teleport if your house is in Rellekka)
8 free inventory spaces
requirements: Agility 20 (boostable) <ref>Entering the Mountain Camp initially requires 10 Agility.</ref>
The ability to defeat a level 70 monster (can be safespotted)
rewards: The ability to pass into the Mountain Camp over the rockslide
The Kendal accessible in the Nightmare Zone.
leagueRegion: <poem> Unlocking Fremennik will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Mountain Camp
walkthrough.body: rope, plank {{Map|group=camp|align=right|x=2787|y=3685|caption= {{Mapkey|col=2 |line1=diamond...#FF00FF,text=Ragnar |line2=diamond...#FFA500,text=Jokul |line3=polygon...#F0FF00,text=Mud |line4=polygon...blue,text=Cave |line5=dot...red,text=Ancient rock |line6=dot...#00FF00,text=Pole |line7=dot...#7777FF,text=Muddy rocks }} |mtype:square,r:3,stroke:#0000FF,fill-opacity:0.5,2810:3705,desc:cave |mtype:circle,r:0.8,fill-opacity:1,2812:3680,2812:3687,2809:3679,2804:3660,desc:rocks |mtype:circle,r:1.5,stroke:#FF0000,fill-opacity:1,fill:#FF0000,2799.5:3660,desc:Ancient rock |mtype:square,r:3,stroke:#F0FF00,r:3,fill-opacity:0.2,fill:#F0FF00,2809:3662,desc:MUD |mtype:circle,r:0.8,stroke:#00FF00,fill-opacity:1,fill:#00FF00,2813:3685,desc:pole |mtype:polygon,stroke:#FFA500,fill:#FFA500,fill-opacity:1,2809.5:3683.5,2808:3681.75,2809.5:3680,2811:3681.75,desc:Jokul |mtype:polygon,stroke:#FF00FF,fill:#FF00FF,fill-opacity:1,2766:3677,2764.5:3675.25,2766:3673.5,2767.5:3675.25,desc:Ragnar }} Make your way to the Mountain Camp east of Rellekka and north-east of the Golden Apple Tree. To get to that area, you can use the enchanted lyre and head east; walk north from Seers' Village or use the fairy ring code ajr and then go north a bit; or if your house is in Rellekka, teleport to your house and go east, or by using Fremennik sea boots head east. Start up the path to the Mountain Camp, then head north up the slope above the guard. Use your rope on the boulder that says "push boulder" and you will automatically climb down. {{clear}}

walkthrough.heading: Hamal's daughter
walkthrough.body: Follow the path into the village, enter the longhouse to the east, and speak to Hamal the Chieftain by asking, "Why is everyone so hostile?", to begin the quest. Speaking of his tribe, Hamal tells you that they are citizens of Rellekka, although due to differences they have moved out to become closer to nature, disagreeing with the Fremennik tradition of choosing their tools over skill. The chieftain tells you about his missing daughter and after much arguing against "employing" an outerlander, he eventually allows you to search for her. From this point on, you can enter the camp by climbing over the rockslide. Head south of Hamal's house, and take some mud from the roots along the edge of the bubbling mud pond (swamp paste also works, but the mud can be obtained during the quest). If you did not bring a staff, go north of Hamal's house to Jokul's place and pick up the pole.

walkthrough.heading: Crisis
walkthrough.body: Just north of Hamal's tent are mountain goats. Follow the path leading west along the Shining pool. Follow it until you reach a tall tree by the geysers above the path you came up. #Use the mud (or swamp paste) you gathered on the tall tree to prevent yourself from slipping. # Climb the tall tree, crawl along its branch, and jump down to the little island. #Use your pole or staff on the clump of rocks to pole-vault over them. # Then use the plank to cross the flat stone. #On one of the bubbles rising from the pool, select "Listen-to Shining pool". : 'Note:' The Dramen staff can no longer be used as a pole vault as it was changed from a staff to a blunt weapon.<ref>Update: QoL and Treasure Trails Feedback Changes - April 18 2019</ref> You hear the voice of the spirit of the chieftain's daughter Asleif Hamalsdotter, who is dead. She asks you to make peace between her tribe and Rellekka and to also find a new food source for the camp. Agree to help her. To return to shore, use a plank on the flat stone. You can do her two tasks in either order. :'Note:' Both tasks can be started at the same time. This reduces going back to the Mountain Camp multiple times. Plan it out accordingly.

walkthrough.heading: Making peace
walkthrough.body: A pickaxe {{Map|name=Svidi|align=right|width=250|height=250|caption=Svidi's roaming area.|zoom=1|x=2724|y=3675|mtype=square|r=10}} Return to the Mountain Camp, and talk to Hamal the Chieftain. Ask about the people of Rellekka, and he tells you that he sent a villager named Svidi to initiate a simple trade route, but he hasn't yet returned. Head to the rockslide that first blocked your entrance to the Mountain Camp. Climb over it, and go into the forest north-west of the rockslide, outside the entrance to Keldagrim. Locate and speak with Svidi. To find Svidi, go to the black unicorns and look for a fast moving yellow dot on your mini map between the fence shortcut and the south fence turn. you must run to catch him once spotted. :'Note:' Make sure to choose the option "Can't I persuade you to go in there somehow?", as the other option will cause him to walk off and you will have to find him again. He will tell you he's afraid of the Fremennik in Rellekka and thinks that they might kill him. Offer to help him enter Rellekka and he agrees if you can secure a promise from the chieftain that he will be safe. Head to Rellekka, and talk to Brundt the Chieftain in the longhall. He will promise not to hurt Svidi if you can retrieve a relic - an ancient rock - that the Mountain Camp tribe stole from Rellekka long ago. Return to the Mountain Camp, and enter the large tent south-west of Hamal the Chieftain. If you want, you can first talk to Hamal, but he refuses to let you have the rock. Right-click to use your pickaxe on the Ancient rock located in the southern tent to acquire half a rock. If you're wielding your pickaxe, you will have to right-click on the ancient rock, as it cannot be mined using left-click. Take this back to Rellekka, and talk to Brundt the Chieftain, who will agree to share the rock and give you a safety guarantee granting Svidi safe passage. Take the guarantee to Svidi to initiate peace talks between the two tribes. 'Note:' Once back in Rellekka with your pickaxe, now may be a good time to run north to the mine and gather some coal for the Fremennik Diary task. Players will need to have completed The Fremennik Trials to enter the mine.

walkthrough.heading: Finding food
walkthrough.body: A pair of gloves Return again to the Mountain Camp and speak with Hamal, and then talk to Jokul, who is in the tent north of Hamal, looking after his mountain goats. He will tell you that he thinks the members of the Mountain Camp could survive if the seed of a White pearl fruit, a hardy plant which can grow anywhere, were planted in the area. :'''Note:' You must have talked to Jokul before being able to pick the fruit.'' on the peak of White Wolf Mountain.]] Travel to the peak of White Wolf Mountain and look for thorny bushes near the gnome glider. If you have completed The Grand Tree quest, you may use a ring of dueling to teleport to the Emir's Arena which is near a gnome glider. Head west from the Emir's Arena to the glider, then fly to the mountains. Alternatively, you may use a Camelot Teleport and walk up the mountain. Put on your gloves (4 damage will be inflicted if not wearing any, and you won't get the fruit seed), pick a White pearl fruit off the thorny bushes and eat it. You will automatically spit out the White pearl seed. Go back to the Mountain Camp and give the White pearl seed to Hamal the Chieftain, who accepts your solution for feeding the tribe.

walkthrough.heading: The Kendal
walkthrough.body: An axe, combat equipment, a staff (or pole found near Jokul), and a plank After you've completed both tasks, go back to the shining pool and speak to Asleif again (make sure to pole vault, and use your plank on the flat stone). She asks you to convince her father that she is really dead. She was attacked by a creature (the Kendal) and dragged off nearby to the north where she was killed. Leave the island and head to the north side of the pool (alternatively, cross the gap without using the plank; you'll end up on the north side). Follow the path east to a cave blocked by dead trees. Chop down the ones that block your path with an axe until you reach a cave entrance (if you face problems chopping down the trees, stand to the west side of the first tree when chopping it down to walk over the stump). Enter the cave and make your way to the large cavern. You find the Kendal as well as numerous corpses near a central pillar. Talk to the Kendal, and when it asks who you are, say, "It's just me, no one special", and then "You mean a sacrifice?". The Kendal tells you that it is the god of the northern lands. Say that he actually looks like a man in a bearsuit, to which he finally admits. After you blow his cover, he also confesses to killing Asleif more than ten years ago. Humbly request her remains, to which he refuses as he cannot let anyone know his true identity. Threaten to kill him, and he'll attack you. He has 50 hitpoints and a combat level of 70, and all damage can be blocked if you use the Protect from Melee Prayer. If you are using Ranged or Magic, you can find a safespot around the skeletons to attack him. : 'Note:' It is possible to defeat the Kendal with a Dwarf Multicannon. If safespotting, be careful though: after attacking the boss, another one will spawn. The cannon will hit him too, making him aggressive, and repeating the process multiple times. Once he dies, a Bearhead mask will appear in your inventory. Take Asleif's corpse, which lies in the south-eastern corner of the pillars (corpse of woman), and exit the cave. Cut your way back out of the dead trees and head back to Hamal the Chieftain. Tell him what you learned and show him his daughter's corpse. <gallery widths="200"> File:Mountain Daughter - Entering the Kendal's cave.png|The Kendal's Lair. File:Kendal safespot.png|The safespot for the Kendal. </gallery>

walkthrough.heading: Finishing up
walkthrough.body: 5 muddy rocks, a staff (or pole found by Jokul), and a plank Hamal asks you to give her a proper burial by building a grave on the island at the centre of the pool topped with a cairn, symbolising the longboats used to cross the seas, and some of her possessions. He tells you perhaps Ragnar has one of her possessions for you to use. On your way up, gather five muddy rocks from the mountain goat pen. The rocks respawn quickly, so it's possible just to pick up the same rock multiple times. Follow the path up to Ragnar (he is just past the tall tree), and speak with him. He gives you Asleif's necklace, which he had intended to give her as a gift. Climb up the tall tree, pole-vault the clump of rocks, and use the plank on the flat stones to make your way back to the small island. Bury the corpse there; you will go to the designated burial location. Use the muddy rocks on the burial mound to create Asleif's burial cairn. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

steps: Head to the entrance of the mountain camp east of Rellekka or north of the ajr fairy ring.
Take the path north, past the guard, and use your rope on a boulder you can push to get around.
Head into the camp and talk to Hamal the Chieftain. (or with The Fremennik Trials completed)
Dig some mud from the mud pond south of Hamal's house.
If you do not have a staff, go north of Hamal's house and take a pole. Keep this throughout the quest.
Go north, following the path along the lake westward.
Use the mud on the tall tree then climb it. You do *not* need to do this again for subsequent climbs.
Use your pole or staff on the clump of rocks to pole vault over.
Use your plank on the flat stones. Keep this throughout the quest.
Listen to the shining pool.
Use your plank on the flat stone to return to shore.
Talk to Hamal the Chieftain about the people of Rellekka.
Speak to Jokul north of the Cheiftains tent before leaving the camp to speak to Svidi.
Search for Svidi between Rellekka and the entrance to Keldagrim.
Go to Rellekka and talk to Brundt the Chieftain in the longhall. or if Lunar Diplomacy started/completed.
Return to the Mountain Camp, and enter the large tent south-west of Hamal the Chieftain.
Use your pickaxe on the Ancient Rock located in the southern tent to get half a rock.
Take this back to Rellekka, and talk to Brundt the Chieftain or if Lunar Diplomacy started/completed, who will give you the guarantee of safe passage.
(optional) While you still have your pickaxe, mine some coal in the Rellekka mine for a Fremennik diary task. (requires completion of The Fremmenik Trials)
Take the guarantee to Svidi. You do not need to check on Svidi afterward.
Return to Hamal the Chieftain.
Talk to Hamal the Chieftan again, this time about food supplies.
Talk to Jokul just north of Hamal. If you spoke to him earlier you do not need to do this. He will tell you of a White Pearl plant that is very hardy.
Travel to White Wolf Mountain (Keldagrim minecart system if The Giant Dwarf is completed, or Gnome glider if The Grand Tree completed.)
Equip gloves and pick-from the thorny bushes by the gnome glider.
Eat the white pearl you picked to get the white pearl seed.
Speak to Hamal the Chieftain to give him the white pearl seed.
Speak to the shining pool again (remember to use the pole/staff and plank).
Cross the gap back to shore without the plank, as this will put you closer to the cave.
Follow the northern path east to a cave.
Chop down the trees blocking your path (make sure you are facing east)
Enter the cave
Talk to The Kendal.
Kill The Kendal. He can be safespotted utilizing skeletons around the room.
Take the corpse of woman
Return to Hamal the Chieftain.
'Gather 5 muddy rocks from around the camp.'
Talk to Ragnar near the tall tree by the lake to get Asleif's necklace.
Return to the shining pool and bury the corpse on the island.
Use the muddy rocks on the burial mound. (You make the mound by burying the corpse on the island.)
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Between a Rock...
aliases: Between a rock and a hard place
A rock and a hard place
start: Speak to Dondakan the Dwarf at the Keldagrim south-west mine.
description: Hidden away from the fearsome trolls and the roaming Fremennik, the dwarves delve deep beneath the mountains in search for the ore they need to support their home of Keldagrim. One dwarf in particular, however, has for years been trying to crack open a rock that seems to be impervious to any material that he's tried on it. Convinced that solving the riddle of the rock will lead him to unimaginable wealth, he has spent the later part of his life on just this lump of stone. Help him out, but take care you don't end up in a tight spot!
itemRequirements: 4 gold bars (You will need an extra bar and telegrab if you want to keep a golden cannonball for after the quest)
An ammo mould (can be bought for 5 coins during the quest) or a double ammo mould
recommendedItems: Combat 50
Combat gear
A Falador teleport
A Combat bracelet (to teleport to the Monastery)
A Camelot Teleport
Ring of charos (a)
A lunar or dramen staff
An amulet of glory for a teleport to Edgeville for the furnace
Stamina Potion to reduce travel time
requirements: The ability to defeat a level 75-125 enemy (depends on how much gold you mine)
rewards: Access to the Arzinian Mine full of gold rocks and gold veins. A nearby dwarf at the river will bank the player's gold ore for a charge of 20% of the ores, rounded up (10% with the ring of charos (a)).
The ability to teleport to Dondakan's rock using a ring of wealth
leagueRegion: <poem> Asgarnia — location requirement Fremennik — location requirement Kandarin — location requirement </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Don's rock
walkthrough.body: 4 coins or a ring of charos (a) Monastery]] Start the quest by going to the Keldagrim mines north-east to Rellekka. You can get there in several different ways: * Fairy ring code dks, which can be found north-east of Rellekka. * You can use the enchanted lyre for easy access, or, if your house is in Rellekka, you can also teleport there. * Take the minecart from the Grand Exchange. If doing so, go north-west from the carts to the Dwarven Boatman and take the boat (free) to reach the ferryman at the entrance. Once you've entered the cave, there will be a crack between two dwarf statues directly across from you, which you should enter. From there, talk to the Dwarven Ferryman ('not the boatman') for a ride across the river, which will cost 2 coins or be free if you have a ring of charos (a) equipped. Go east and around the rock wall and then go west until you reach and cross the bridge that leads to Dondakan's Rock and his Dwarf Multicannon. Speak to Dondakan. Ask "Why are you firing a cannon at a wall?" to begin the quest, then speak to him again and ask "So why were you trying to get through the rock again?". Dondakan will then ask you to get further information about the rock and tell you to talk to the Librarian. Return to the other side of the river, paying 2 coins again or crossing for free with the ring. This time, speak with the 'Boatman' to be taken to Keldagrim. If you have not started The Giant Dwarf, you will be presented with a small cutscene introducing the area. You will then be taken by guards, giving you the option to start The Giant Dwarf. You can talk to the Librarian on the Western side of Keldagrim, but it won't do much other than specifying who to speak with. Instead, go into the western part of the Trading Consortium. Look for the area with an anvil on the minimap in the palace and speak with the engineer inside of the room it's located in. This is located within the large building 'not' the anvil which is further west. You will be told to speak with Rolad located in the eastern building at the Dwarven Mine entrance camp next to Ice Mountain. To get there, either teleport to Falador or the Monastery and walk the distance, use Ancient Magicks to teleport to Lassar, teleport to the Barbarian Village with a skull sceptre, or take the mine carts located in the south-eastern portion of Keldagrim for 150 coins (75 coins if you have the ring of charos (a)). If you took the carts, head south, east, then north and exit the mine. Rolad is inside the eastern house at the camp. He will ask you to find the pages from a book giving you information about the rock. :'Note:' Make sure to fully complete the dialogue otherwise the pages won't appear.

walkthrough.heading: Between the pages
walkthrough.body: A pickaxe, 1 gold bar (an extra 1 if you want your own golden cannonball), and 3 inventory slots, ammo mould. All three pages can be obtained in the Dwarven Mine in any order. Note that the pages may require multiple attempts to be obtained: # The first page can be found by killing scorpions in the south-eastern area of the mines. (It may take a few kills) (Try switching worlds if killing a scorpion doesn't give you page 1) #* 'Tip:' Squeeze through the narrow crevice (level 42 Agility) to complete a medium Falador diary task when returning to Rolad from the SE area of the mine. # The second page can be found by searching the mine carts along the tracks. # The third page can be found by mining clay, copper, tin, or iron rocks inside the mine. Return to Rolad when you have found all three pages, and he will give you the Dwarven lore. Rolad will ask you to give back the book because he wants to study it. You can answer '"Of course"' or '"Of course. (lie)"' Choose to lie and read the book, and 'keep it for later'. If you need an ammo mould, purchase it from Nulodion in the western house next door to Rolad. Head back to Dondakan using one of the methods first used to reach him and speak with him until you get a short cutscene where he kicks the rock to no avail. He then tells you that he wants a material that is stronger than runite and granite. This is where your gold bars come in handy. Show him your gold bar by using it on him. :'Note:' You can also show him a gold ore instead. If you have forgotten to bring one, there is a gold vein in the cave south of Dondakan's. Go to any furnace with a gold bar and your cannonball ammo mould, and make a golden cannonball by using the gold bar on the furnace. Some furnaces include: * Falador's furnace is just a few steps away using Falador Teleport. * Edgeville's furnace can quickly be reached using an amulet of glory or using the Minigame Teleport to Soul Wars and exiting the yellow portal. * Completion of Lost City lets you use the furnace at Zanaris, and partial completion of Fairytale II lets you take the fairy ring DKR to Edgeville. * If you have completed The Fremennik Trials, Rellekka's furnace is the fastest on foot; but teleporting is much quicker. * You can also walk back to the mine carts in SE Keldagrim, take Cart 3 to the Grand Exchange, then use the shortcut from the Grand Exchange to Edgeville (21 Agility). 'Tip:' If you want a trophy golden cannonball in your bank, make one and drop it, make another, then telegrab the one on the floor. Trying to pick one up normally won't work if you have another on you. When you are finished, return to Dondakan and give him the golden cannonball by using it on him. When he fires it, the cannonball will disappear through the wall. He will then ask to fire 'you' through the wall, but he needs the schematics in order to change the cannon to be able to fire a human. You will also need to make yourself a gold helmet (requires 50 Smithing) if you don't want your head to explode when you hit the wall. :'Tip:' Smithing a golden helmet in the Resource Area is a medium Wilderness Diary task.

walkthrough.heading: Breakthrough design
walkthrough.body: 3 gold bars (an extra 3 if you want your own golden helmet) and a hammer. There are a set of four (4) schematics: # The first schematic is given to you by Dondakan. # The second one is given by the engineer you spoke to earlier back in Keldagrim, by the anvil in the western palace bottom floor. #* Before moving on, you can make your golden helmet by the anvil. The helmet is extremely heavy, so it's a good idea to put it in the bank. 'Tip:' If you want to have more than one golden helmet after the quest, make one and drop it, make another, then telegrab the one on the floor. This helmet is useful for slaying gryphons and the Shellbane gryphon boss, as they have a special attack that is blocked by having a high equipped weight. # Read to the last page of the Dwarven lore book, and you will find another schematic page. # Enter the White Wolf Tunnel; it can be reached easily by using Camelot Teleport and walking down the stairs to the east, or teleporting to Burthorpe Games Room (Minigame Teleport / games necklace) and walking down the stairs to the south of Burthorpe. Go to the small bar area, and speak with Khorvak. He will ask for a dwarven stout. You can take one off the table and give it to him by using it on him, or refuse and enjoy a funny piece of dialogue about RuneScape and alcoholics. Either way, you will receive the final schematic. Once you have all schematics, click 'assemble' on the one Dondakan gave you. You will be shown all schematics, but they will not make any sense. What you must do here is move the schematics one by one so that they fit with the original schematic. Select and show one at a time, rotate and move them to fit. It may be easiest to use the human stick figure legs, torso, and head to position each of the pieces correctly. This part should be quite simple. Be aware that even if you move the pieces in the correct relative position, you might need to select them all and move them together to the correct position on the screen. Once you put them all in place, the screen will show: ''"That's it! It all makes sense now! If you were a dwarf, that is..."''.

walkthrough.heading: Riddle of the Rock
walkthrough.body: A weapon, armour and food to defeat a level 75-125 enemy; golden helmet (equipped), a pickaxe, and 2 coins or ring of charos (a) for ferry. Once the schematic is assembled, return to Dondakan. To fight the Arzinian Being of Bordanzan, you will need to mine at least six 6 gold ore. Otherwise, it will keep regenerating its hitpoints. Mining 15 pieces of gold is highly recommended as this will lower the combat level of the boss from 125 to 75. 'The gold must remain in your inventory.' 'You only have eight 8 minutes to mine the gold AND defeat the avatar; if you take off your gold helmet, you will be teleported back to Dondakan.' 'Note:' Mining a gold rock here will grant you the achievement for the Medium Fremennik Diary. You will not need to revisit the mine after the quest. Equip the golden helmet; make sure you have a pickaxe because 'any gold ore/ingots in your inventory will disappear'. Go back to Dondakan with the schematics and the items needed to kill the level 75-125 enemy. Once you are ready, ask Dondakan to shoot you into the rock. When you feel you have enough gold ore, go to the centre of the area, where you will find a set of flames. Go through the first set of flames and talk to the second set. While talking to the flames, the Arzinian Avatar will attack. The avatar will appear in one of three forms for the duration of the fight. The form chosen is usually based on your highest combat stat, though there is additionally a small chance to instead pick another form. The form that appears will determine the attack style of the boss: *Arzinian Avatar of Magic if your highest combat stat is Strength or Attack. *Arzinian Avatar of Ranging if your highest combat stat is Magic. *Arzinian Avatar of Strength if your highest combat stat is Ranged. Choose combat equipment and prayers accordingly. See Arzinian Avatar for more details. You can use Prayer for an easy fight; the spirit shouldn't take too long to kill. If you are close to dying, you can take your gold helmet off, which will teleport you outside of the rock, next to Dondakan. 'Tip': If you die then collect the helmet from the ground and enter the cave again. You will have to start over. <u>Remember food.</u> When you have defeated the spirit, you will be teleported back out of the rock. Speak to Dondakan to finish the quest. 'Note:' If your inventory was full when defeating the boss the helmet will be dropped on the ground. 'Congratulations, quest complete!' 'Tip': If you plan on obtaining the Music cape, re-enter the mine to unlock the song In Between.

steps: Find the Dwarven Ferryman. Either enter the tunnel and subsequent cave just south of the Polar Hunter area (fairy ring DKS) 'OR' go to northern part of Keldagrim and use the Travel option on the Dwarven Boatman.
Talk to the Dwarven Ferryman (not the Dwarven Boatman) and use the ring of charos (a) or use the Travel option to go across the river.
Run north and east across the bridge and west past the second wooden bridge to talk to Dondakan.
Go to western Keldagrim and talk to the Dwarven Engineer in the Trading Consortium's palace smithing shop.
'Note': The Dwarven Boatman (near the Dwarven Ferryman) will take you quickly to northern Keldagrim and back.
Go to the Ice Mountain entrance of the Dwarven Mine and talk to Rolad in the east house (chat will disengage once then re-engage).
(Optional) Purchase the ammo mould from Nulodion here
Go down the trapdoor to the Dwarven Mine. Complete the following in any order until you receive the respective pages:
Kill Scorpions for book page 1.
Search the mine carts for book page 2.
Mine any rocks 'except' Adamantite or Coal for book page 3.
Talk to Rolad. (chat will again disengage then re-engage)
Read Dwarven lore 'in its entirety and keep it for later'.
Go back to the Keldagrim mines and talk to Dondakan.
Use a gold bar on him.
Go to any furnace and use a gold bar on the furnace to make a golden cannon ball. Edgeville is recommended for easy fairy ring or Keldagrim minecart access.
Use the golden cannon ball on Dondakan to receive a Schematic.
Read the Dwarven lore book to receive the base schematics.
Go back to the Dwarf Engineer at the Western Trade Consortium to get the Schematics.
Use your gold bar on the nearby anvil to make a gold helmet.
(Optional) Smith the gold helmet in the wilderness Resource Area to complete a Wilderness Diary Medium Achievement.
Go to the pub in the White Wolf Mountain passage and speak to Khorvak.
Assemble the schematics per below to get the completed Schematic:
Equip your Gold helmet and pickaxe and prepare to kill a level 75-125 Arzinian Avatar.
Talk to Dondakan with the schematics.

Mine 6 OR 15 Gold ore (keep them in your inventory. If you aren't going to get 15, just get 6 as there is no benefit before 15). Getting 15 reduces the boss's level from 125 to 75, so this is recommended for lower-level players.
Go to the centre of the area.
Go through the first set of flames.
Talk to the second set of flames.

Kill the Arzinian Avatar. It will be either Arzinian Avatar of Magic (if your highest combat stat is a melee stat), Arzinian Avatar of Ranging (if your highest combat stat is Magic), or Arzinian Avatar of Strength (if your highest combat stat is Ranged). Choose combat equipment and prayers accordingly. See Arzinian Avatar for more details.
Talk to Dondakan.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: The Feud
start: Talk to Ali Morrisane east of the Gem Trader in northern Al Kharid.
description:
Ali Morrisane - Gielinor's self proclaimed 'greatest merchant' - is having difficulties. He is selling things at such a rate that he cannot keep his market stall in stock.

Word has it that he is on the lookout for someone; someone who can recruit some help from his home town Pollnivneach - a somewhat anarchic place, south of the Shantay Pass.
itemRequirements: Gloves - (see this page for gloves that 'do' work; Barrows gloves, ice gloves, vambraces, and Slayer gloves do 'not' work!)
Kharidian headpiece (can be bought from Ali Morrisane)
Fake beard (can be bought from Ali Morrisane)
3 beers (obtainable during the quest, bought from Ali the Barman for 2 coins each)

Bucket or Ugthanki dung (obtainable during the quest, spawns at the location it is needed – bring three extra buckets, four total, if you plan on doing My Arm's Big Adventure as three Ugthanki dung are needed for that quest). One more might be needed for Forgettable Tale... (1/25 chance for each player).
Snake charm (obtainable during the quest by putting a coin in the snake charmer's money pot, if you 'do not' already have one in your bank)
If you have the snake charm in your bank already, you will need to retrieve it.
Snake basket (obtainable during quest by putting a coin in the snake charmer's money pot, whether or not you have one in your bank)
recommendedItems: Combat 40
Stamina or energy potions
Armour and some food
Waterskin (one is enough)
Fast travel to Al Kharid (ring of dueling or an amulet of glory)
Fast travel to Pollnivneach (Magic carpet or Pollnivneach teleport, or House teleport if your house is in that city)
Ring of Charos (a) to save money on magic carpet rides
requirements: The ability to kill a level 70 bandit and a level 75 Menaphite (both can be safespotted).
rewards: A desert disguise (created during the quest)
A willow blackjack (as a drop from the tough guy)
An adamant scimitar (as a drop from the bandit champion)
Access to the Rogue Trader miniquest – Completing this will allow Ali Morrisane to sell blackjacks, various runes, and different clothing from around the Kharidian Desert
The ability to pickpocket villagers, bandits, and Menaphite thugs in Pollnivneach
leagueRegion: <poem> Unlocking Asgarnia will auto-complete the quest Unlocking Desert will auto-complete the quest Unlocking Fremennik will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Starting in Pollnivneach
walkthrough.body: Head to the bar in the south-eastern corner of the village. Buy 3 beers from Ali the Barman if you don't already have some, and then talk to Drunken Ali, who will ask for beer in return for information. 'Use' each beer on him, 'completing each dialogue before continuing'. He will tell you that Ali Morrisane's nephew is in trouble with the gangs, but you won't get any information out of them while they are feuding. Head west of the bar to a purple and yellow tent, and talk to any Menaphite Thug (not Ali the Operator). They will mention that the feud started after the Bandits stole a camel from them. Talk to any bandit in the north part of the town, who will blame the feud on the Menaphites stealing a camel from them. Talk to Ali the Camel Man at the building north-west of the bar, south of the kebab store, and ask to buy two camels. Offer him 500 coins to receive two camel receipts. Return to any Menaphite thug in the southern part of town, and then any Bandit in the northern part of town, to give each receipt. Both gangs will be outraged at the offering. Talk to Ali the Operator by the purple tent south-west of Pollnivneach, and ask him if you can join his gang. He will ask the player to pickpocket 3 villagers to prove themselves.

walkthrough.heading: Picking the villagers' pockets
walkthrough.body: s.]] *'1st villager' – Simply head out and pickpocket any villager. You will always fail unless you have spoken with Ali the Operator. *'2nd villager' – Go and talk to a Street urchin in or around the bar, and pay him 10 coins to distract a villager, then quickly pickpocket the villager with the flashing arrow above his head. Make sure that the Street urchin is nearby one of the villagers, otherwise he will tell you that there is none around to distract. You must approach the villager from behind. If it fails, you will not lose your payment: talk to the urchin to try again. *'3rd villager' – Talk to Ali the Operator again and ask for advice: he will give you a blackjack. Equip it, then lure a villager (into a secluded area in an empty building), knock them out with the blackjack, and finally pick their pocket (all options are right click).

walkthrough.heading: The second job
walkthrough.body: Return to Ali the Operator, who now wants you to steal the mayor's wife's jewels from the safe in their villa. He will give you keys to the front door. Combine the fake beard with the Kharidian headpiece to make a desert disguise, then equip it and your gloves. If you did not buy these from Ali Morrisane, you can get them from the Market seller at the general store icon on the map. The villa is north-east of the bar; on the huge cactus just outside, click 'Hide behind'. When the dialogue appears and tells you that it is safe to go in since nobody is home, use your key on the door and go in. On the floor 1, search the landscape picture hanging beside the bed to discover the safe. The numbers on the safe progress from 1-9 (clockwise), and you must click '1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8', on the dial to unlock it and take the jewels. This solution is the Fibonacci sequence, and you would have found a clue by searching the bed for a note which gives the first 5 numbers of the sequence. :'Note:' If you do not have at least one inventory space open, you will have to enter this sequence again.

walkthrough.heading: The third job
walkthrough.body: .]] Give the jewels to Ali the Operator. For your final task, he wants you to root out a traitor within the gang. Talk to a Menaphite Thug gang member about it, who will suggest that the traitor must be Traitorous Ali. Return to Ali the Operator who will ask the player to quietly kill him. Talk to Ali the Barman to find out that the beer on the table belongs to the traitor. Go talk to Ali the Hag up the hill to the west of the town, who will agree to make a poison for you if you can get her a snake..]] Now, go around the back of the pub, and put some coins in the snake charmer's money pot. He will give you a snake charm and a snake basket. Use ('not' Play) the snake charm on a desert snake, which can be found north of Ali the Operator's tent. You may fail to charm the snake causing it to attack you, simply kill it and then try again on another snake. :'Note': You may have a snake charm already in your bank if you have completed Ratcatchers. You may receive another now if you have lost it. Once you've brought the snake back to Ali the Hag, she will tell you the second item she needs is fresh camel dung. Go to Ali the Kebab seller, located just north-west of the well in the centre of town, and ask for his red hot sauce. Take this to the camel shop, and use it on the food trough. A pile of dung will appear after a few seconds; if it's green, repeat until you get brown dung. Use a bucket on it to obtain the desired Ugthanki dung. :'Tip:' Consider gathering 3 more pieces of dung for My Arm's Big Adventure, and 1 for Forgettable Tale of a Drunken Dwarf (where there is a 1/25 chance to need one). Take the dung to Ali the Hag and she'll give you some poison to kill Traitorous Ali. Go to the pub, use the poison on the table with the beer, and then go back to Ali the Operator. <gallery mode="packed" heights="150"> The Feud - pouring hot sauce.png|Pouring the red hot sauce on the trough. The Feud - poisonining drink.png|Pouring the hag's poison onto Traitorous Ali's drink. </gallery>

walkthrough.heading: Defeating the gang leaders
walkthrough.body: for the Tough Guy.]] Prepared for a fight, talk to Ali the Operator, who wants you to meet the Menaphite Leader. Speak to him outside the tent to discover that the Menaphites have world domination plans. After the player declines his offer to join them, the leader will summon a level 75 Tough Guy to attack you. You can safespot him behind the table inside the Menaphite Tent..]] After defeating him, talk to a villager; they are angry with you for upsetting the balance of power and will tell you that you need to deal with the Bandit Leader too. He's just north-west of the village by the Rug Merchant. Talk to the bandit leader, who will refuse to leave unless you can defeat their strongest warrior in battle, summoning a level 70 bandit champion. There is a safespot behind the crate near the rug merchant. Upon defeat, he will drop an adamant scimitar. Talk to the villagers, who will still be unimpressed by your actions so far and tell you to talk to the Mayor if you are looking for a reward. Talk to Ali the Mayor by the well in the centre of the village. He will be a little more grateful about the results of your deeds, and explain that he smuggled Ali Morrisane's nephew out of the town after he angered the gangs. Finally, return to Ali Morrisane, who reveals that the entire quest was an elaborate scheme to get the player involved in Pollnivneach 'tourism'. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

steps: Talk to Ali Morrisane next to the Silk Stall in Al Kharid.
Buy a kharidian headpiece and a fake beard and combine them.
Head to Pollnivneach.
'Use' the 3 beers on Drunken Ali at the bar. (Make sure to use one beer on him, then talk to him in full, then use the second beer, talk in full, then finally the third beer, and talk in full.)
'Note:' Don't skip dialogue after giving a beer.''' You can buy them from Ali the Barman.
Talk to the bandits in Pollnivneach by the general store.
Go west of the bar and question the Menaphite Thugs.
Head to the camel store just north-west of the bar.
Talk to Ali the Camel Man to buy the camels for 500 coins. You will need two free spaces in your inventory.
Talk to a Menaphite and a bandit to give them each a receipt.
Go to Ali the Operator and ask to join his gang (big purple tent, south-west)
Attempt to pickpocket a villager once then return to Ali the Operator.
Talk to the street urchin near the centre town well.
Pay him ten coins
Pickpocket the villager with an arrow over their head.
Talk to Ali the Operator
Equip the oak blackjack and then lure a villager into a secluded area.
Knock out the villager with the blackjack equipped
Pickpocket the villager
Talk to Ali the Operator.
Put on the desert disguise and gloves.
Hide behind the large cactus near the mayor's house (the large house to the East by the fountain).
Use the keys on the door.
Go up the stairs in the north-eastern corner.
Search the landscape picture near the bed.
Hit the button on the dial to reset it.
Click on 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, in that order, clockwise.
Give the jewels to Ali the Operator.
Talk to Ali the Operator.
Talk to a Menaphite Thug.
Talk to Ali the Operator.
Talk to Ali the barman.
Buy special sauce from the kebab seller. He can be found north-west of the well in the middle of the town.
Use it on a trough behind the camel shop.
Use a bucket on the dung if it is brown. Obtain three more buckets of dung if you plan to complete My Arm's Big Adventure.
Use a coin on the snake charmer's money pot, sitting south of the bar with 2 free inventory spaces to get a snake charm and a snake basket.
Use the snake charm on a desert snake north of the Menaphite tent until it goes into the snake basket.
Go to Ali the Hag north-west of the kebab seller. Talk to her twice to give her the snake basket and Ugthanki dung to receive the hag's poison in exchange.
Use the hag's poison on the table with a beer in the bar.
Talk to Ali the Operator.
Prepare for battle and talk to the Menaphite Leader (just outside the tent).
Kill the Tough Guy (level 75) (safespot behind bush). He drops a willow blackjack.
Talk to a villager.
Talk to the Bandit Leader wandering around the northern magic carpet station.
Kill the bandit champion (level 70) (safespot behind chair in house to the east). He drops an adamant scimitar (if you have a willow blackjack in your inventory).
Talk to a villager.
Talk to Ali the Mayor by the well in village centre.
Return to Ali Morrisane (with whom you started the quest).
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: The Golem
start: Talk to the clay golem in the ruins of Uzer, east of the Shantay Pass in the Kharidian Desert.
description:
Deep in the desert stand the ruins of the once great city of Uzer, where a lone survivor, an ancient clay golem, forever paces back and forth. It is badly damaged, and its mind cannot rest until it has completed the task for which it was created.

It is up to you to uncover the secret of the lost city, and add the final chapter to a story started in the violence of the Third Age.
itemRequirements: Papyrus (can be bought from Ali Morrisane for 10gp)
4 soft clay (or a bracelet of clay and a pickaxe to mine north-west of the ruins)
Phoenix feather (can be obtained north-west of the ruins)
Means to enter the desert (such as the Shantay pass, Teleport tablets or scrolls, Fairy rings or the Pharaoh's sceptre)
recommendedItems: Protective clothing for the desert heat (Desert boots, Desert robe, Desert shirt)
Waterskins
Stamina or energy potions
Fast travel to several locations:
Uzer to start the quest plus one additional trip - necklace of passage to Eagles' Eyrie or fairy ring dlq
Digsite (1 trip) - digsite pendant, Digsite Teleport or gnome glider
Varrock Museum (1 trip) - Varrock Teleport
Hammer and chisel to remove gems from the throne
Equipment to complete several optional Achievement Diary tasks:
A pickaxe for a easy Desert Diary task to mine clay
A woodcutting axe for a medium Desert Diary to cut a Teak tree with Woodcutting 35
A bird snare for a easy Desert Diary task to catch a golden warbler with Hunter 5
rewards: 2 cut rubies, emeralds, and sapphires (collect these by using a chisel and hammer on the throne)
Unlock the carpet ride from Shantay Pass to Uzer
leagueRegion: <poem> Unlocking Desert will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Optional Diary Tasks
walkthrough.body: pickaxe, bracelet of clay or 4 clay, bird snare This quest takes place in the vicinity of several diary tasks which may be optionally completed. This is recommended as several of the tasks may also save you time during the quest. You may choose to teleport to Eagles' Eyrie with the necklace of passage, complete the tasks and then head south-east towards the Ruins of Uzer where the quest takes place. {{Checklist| *Steal a Phoenix Feather from the Desert Phoenix (Thieving 25) for both a medium Desert Diary task and use in the quest itself. *Mine 5 pieces of clay for an easy Desert Diary task (4 of which can be used in the quest itself but require a method such as mining it with a bracelet of clay to turn it into soft clay). *Catch a Golden Warbler with a Bird Snare (Hunter 5) for an easy Desert Diary task. *Fill a Waterskin with water by cutting a Khardian cactus with a knife for an easy Desert Diary task. }} {{Map|3422,3162|r=5|mtype=square|align=right|width=220|height=220|caption=The clay mining spot. The desert phoenix can also be found nearby.}}

walkthrough.heading: Repairing the golem
walkthrough.body: 4 soft clay 'or' a bracelet of clay and a pickaxe Travel to the Ruins of Uzer. You can use a necklace of passage to the Eagles' Eyrie or fairy ring dlq. Talk to the broken clay golem to learn it is in need of repair. Use each piece of soft clay on it to slowly repair it. If you didn't already, you can mine clay at the north-western mine with a bracelet of clay. If you didn't bring a bracelet, there is a jug of water in the Oasis to the south of Uzer that may be used on the clay to make soft clay (world hop to respawn it). Once fully repaired, the golem will explain that he was programmed to destroy a powerful demon, Thammaron, and that he needs assistance to open a portal to defeat it. 'Ask him how to open the portal', and he will explain that four statuettes in the temple must be turned to the correct pattern, but he doesn't know it. Outside the temple ruins, near the golem, there is a letter. Take the letter and read it; it describes how an expedition here was discontinued after the opening of The Digsite near Varrock. Head east into the temple by climbing down the stairs behind the golem. Once inside, pick a black mushroom by the entrance, then pick up the strange implement in the north-western corner. :'Tip:' Pick a second for Shadow of the Storm, and keep the strange implement for the same quest. If you brought an axe, you may also choose to complete a medium Desert Diary task here by cutting the Teak tree (Woodcutting 35) behind the ruins, indicated on the minimap with a tree icon.

walkthrough.heading: The Digsite
walkthrough.body: {{Map|name=Elissa|x=3374|y=3434|r=4|mtype=square|align=left|width=240|height=240|caption=The location of Elissa.}} Head to the north-eastern corner of the Digsite to find Elissa, the author of the letter. The fastest method of reaching her is a digsite pendant or gnome glider. Talk to her about the letter, and she will suggest you look in the Exam Centre for her late husband's notes, the man whom led the discontinued Uzer expedition. Head to the Exam Centre and search the south-eastern most bookshelf to find Varmen's notes. 'Read them' before progressing; Varmen describes in detail the discovery of the golems and the great city of Uzer, and mentions taking a statuette from the ruins. Return to Elissa and ask where the statuette went, and she will point you towards the Varrock Museum. Go to the Varrock Museum and ask Curator Haig Halen on the ground floor about a missing statuette. Then, pickpocket him to get a display cabinet key (Thieving 25). :'Note:' Ensure that you have read the notes and completed all prior dialogue if the dialogue options do not appear. Unlock Display Case 30 upstairs to steal the statuette. It is on the floor 1 in the first row, the fourth case after you ascend the stairs. :'Note:' If you lose the statuette, you can use the display cabinet key on the empty display cabinet to receive a new one. {{Clear|left}}

walkthrough.heading: Returning to Uzer
walkthrough.body: An empty vial, pestle and mortar, statuette (The Golem) statuette, black mushroom (obtainable in Uzer dungeon), Strange implement, papyrus, Phoenix feather (obtainable near the clay mines north of Uzer), chisel and hammer (optional, for cutting gems). Ensure you have the required items and return to Uzer. Enter the dungeon near the golem, then use the statuette on the empty alcove on the wall in the centre. Turn all of the statuettes north to face towards the double doors to unlock the demon's lair. The east statues should face right and the west statues should face left when the player examines them. The statues will lock and the doors will automatically open. Go inside to discover that Thammaron had succumbed to his wounds long ago after the battle with the golems. :'Note:' You may optionally use a chisel and hammer on the throne to take 2 cut rubies, 2 emeralds, and 2 sapphires for yourself. Return to the golem to inform him of the demon's death. He does not believe the player - you will need to reprogram him to put his mind to rest. With an empty vial in your inventory, use your pestle and mortar on the black mushroom to make black dye. Use the phoenix feather on your ink to make a phoenix quill pen, then use it on your papyrus to write a Golem program. Use the strange implement on the golem followed by the golem program, and the golem will declare that his task is complete. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

steps: Travel to the Ruins of Uzer via the necklace of passage teleport to Eagle's Eyrie and run south-east. You can alternatively use a fairy ring (DLQ) and go north-east.
Pick up and read the Letter west of the broken clay golem
Talk to the golem.
Use four soft clay on the golem. If you chose to bring a pickaxe and a bracelet of clay, clay rocks can be found to the north-west, near the shore. The phoenix can be found there as well.
'Optional': Mine 5 clay for easy Desert Diary, and steal the Desert Phoenix's feather while nearby.
'Optional': Catch a Golden Warbler near the Desert Phoenix with a Bird Snare (requiring Level 5 Hunter) for an easy Desert Diary task
Talk to the golem again.
Pick a black mushroom near the stairs east of the golem before heading down (or downstairs at your right).
Use the black mushroom on the pestle and mortar to get black dye. You can do this later if you don't have your pestle and mortar.
'Note:' Take an extra black mushroom if you plan on completing Shadow of the Storm soon afterwards.
Climb down the stairs in the ruins.
Take the strange implement from the north-western room.
'Note:' Keep the strange implement if you plan on completing Shadow of the Storm soon afterwards.
Speak to the Golem again
Head to the most north-eastern part of the Digsite, near the large buried skeleton, and talk to Elissa. (make sure to read the letter if no 3rd option is seen)
Head to the Exam Centre just south of the Digsite.
Search the bookcase in the south-east corner and read Varmen's notes.
Note: If you have not repaired the golem up to this point, or read Varmen's Notes the curator will not speak to you about the quest.
Talk to Curator Haig Halen in the Varrock Museum about the statuette. ( if Bone Voyage is started)
Pickpocket him for the display cabinet key.
Head upstairs, and open the second-most western case in the northern-most row. You will get a statuette.
Return to the Kharidian Desert (fairy ring DLQ), or teleport to Eagle's Eyrie with Necklace of passage.
If you still need the Phoenix feather, run north to the clay rocks east of River Elid and grab a feather from the Phoenix.
Return to the ruins of Uzer where you started the quest and again go down the stairs.
In the centre of the room will be four alcoves. Place the statuette in the empty one.
Turn the statues until they all point north.
Go north, through the double doors.
'Optional:' Use your chisel and hammer on the throne for 2 sapphires, emeralds, and rubies.
Otherwise, immediately go back through the south portal.
Go back upstairs and talk to the golem.
With an empty vial in your inventory, grind the black mushroom using a Pestle and mortar.
Use the phoenix feather on the black dye to make a phoenix quill pen.
Talk to the golem
Use the phoenix quill pen on a piece of papyrus to get the golem program.
Use the strange implement on the golem then quickly use the newly acquired golem program on the golem.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Desert Treasure I
start: Speak to Asgarnia Smith at the Bedabin Camp.
description:
Rumours abound throughout Varrock and Al Kharid that an archaeologist has discovered clues to a hoard of treasure hidden deep in the desert, south of Al Kharid.

Anybody prepared to offer him assistance in his treasure hunting could well find themselves benefitting from a very large reward indeed...
itemRequirements: 10+ Shantay passes 'or' a way to enter the Kharidian Desert without one
Bones (can be noted to prevent accidental burial)
Garlic powder (made by grinding garlic in a pestle and mortar)
Spice (gnome spice and Evil Dave's spices will 'not' work)
A sweet (cake, chocolate cake (part cakes are accepted), chocolate bar, cooking apple, or pineapple pizza)
Spiked boots (obtainable during the quest by bringing Dunstan climbing boots and an iron bar; do so 'before' attempting to obtain the ice diamond)
Climbing boots (if Eadgar's Ruse isn't completed and/or you lack 61 Magic for the Trollheim Teleport)
A facemask, slayer helmet, or gas mask
recommendedItems: Combat 70
Started Nature Spirit to enter Mort Myre Swamp
High-healing Food
Prayer potions ('highly' recommended)
Super restore or Menaphite remedy potions ('highly' recommended)
Antidote++ or antipoisons (especially if Ironman) ('highly' recommended)
Ice gloves or Smiths gloves (i) (to be able to wield a weapon against Fareed if not using water spells with runes only)
Stamina, super energy or energy potions
Weight-reducing clothing to lower run energy drain and restore run energy faster
Coins for magic carpet rides (bring a ring of charos (a) for discounted rides)
Ring of dueling (easy access to Kharidian Desert)
Digsite pendant (easy access to Exam Centre)
Ectophial (easy access to Morytania)
Skills necklace or Necklace of passage (easy access to Rasolo)
Runes to cast Paddewwa Teleport to complete a Varrock Hard Diary task
80,000 Coins if purchasing an Ancient Staff after the quest from Eblis
requirements: Slayer 10 (boostable) 'or' the gas mask from Plague City
enemiesToDefeat: You will also need to tank hits by many high level enemies throughout most parts of the quest.
rewards: Magic 20,006.9 Magic experience{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/jagexash/status/1659205746851221507|date=18 May 2023|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/108236|archivedate=18 May 2023|quote=20,006.9, in fact!}}

The ability to use Ancient Magicks: At any time, you can pray at the altar and change between the standard and Ancient Magicks spellbooks. After traversing the pyramid for the first time, you may enter via the back-door of the pyramid to gain a short cut to the altar. Be warned that changing spellbooks will drain your prayer to 0.
Ring of visibility: If you ever lose it, you can obtain another one from Rasolo.
Access to ancient staff: You can buy one from Eblis for 80,000 coins. If you lose the staff, you will have to reobtain it from another source.
Access to the Smoke Dungeon, which can be used for various Slayer tasks.
Ability to talk to Eblis to obtain an ancient signet.
Dessous, Damis, Fareed, and Kamil accessible in the Nightmare Zone.
requiredFor: Recipe for Disaster – Defeating the Culinaromancer
Curse of the Empty Lord (miniquest) -- only partial completion of Desert Treasure I required.
Hard tiers of the Desert Diary, Varrock Diary, and Morytania Diary
Elite tiers of the Ardougne, Wilderness, Lumbridge, and Desert Diary
Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire
ironmanConcerns: * The player briefly visits Entrana. *Player will need to obtain Magic logs; see the "enchanting the mirrors" section for more information *Lockpicks and antipoisons may be pickpocketed from the Bandits in the vicinity of the chest where they're needed.

walkthrough.heading: Enchanting the mirrors
walkthrough.body: Two Shantay pass (item) Shantay passes (or another method of entering the Kharidian Desert), 650 coins, blood rune, ashes, bones, charcoal, 6 molten glass (noted works), 12 magic logs (noted works), 6 steel bars (noted works) Travel through the Shantay Pass south of Al Kharid and then west via flying carpet or by running to the Bedabin Camp. Fairy ring code BIQ, near the Kalphite Lair, is north-east of the camp. Talk to Asgarnia Smith near the small water pool; he'll give you some etchings to bring to Terry Balando, the archaeological expert, at the Digsite Exam Centre. Go to the Digsite, east of Varrock, and talk to Terry in the Exam Centre, who will take the etchings. Talk to him again to receive the translation to take back to Asgarnia Smith. Go back to Asgarnia Smith in the desert. When talking to him, choose the ''Don't read book option. Talk to him again and agree to help. Go south to the Bandit Camp. Before entering the camp, remove any equipment that depicts Saradomin or Zamorak imagery, otherwise the bandits will be aggressive. Talk to the bartender and buy a drink for 650 coins. Talk to him again to find out about the four Diamonds of Azzanadra. 'This step must be completed before talking to Eblis otherwise the option to talk with him about the diamonds won't appear.''' Talk to Eblis in a nearby building to the east, past the general store. Ask him about the diamonds and he'll tell you that he needs various items to create some scrying glasses: {| class="wikitable"!Item!GE Price!Notes and ironman concerns |- |{{plinkp|Magic logs}} x 12 |{{Coins|{{GEP|Magic logs|12}}}} |There are many ways to obtain magic logs: * Cutting a magic tree (75 Woodcutting, boostable) * Looting Nature Implings (58 Hunter, boostable) * Opening supply crates from Wintertodt * Looting the Brimstone Chest * Defeating various Revenants * Completing Hunters' Rumours * Opening Larran's big or small chests, using Larran's keys obtained through Wilderness Slayer * Chopping dead Yommi trees during Legends' Quest |- |{{plinkp|Molten glass}} x 6 |{{Coins|{{GEP|Molten glass|6}}}} |Can be made at 1 Crafting |- |{{plinkp|Steel bar}} x 6 |{{Coins|{{GEP|Steel bar|6}}}} |Requires 30 Smithing, or dropped by various monsters |- |{{plinkp|Ashes}} x 1 |{{Coins|{{GEP|Ashes|1}}}} |Can be obtained from any fire |- |{{plinkp|Blood rune}} x 1 |{{Coins|{{GEP|Blood rune|1}}}} |4 spawn in the Wilderness |- |{{plinkp|Bones}}x 1 |{{Coins|{{GEP|Bones|1}}}} |See all bone spawn locations here |- |{{plinkp|Charcoal}}x 1 |{{Coins|{{GEP|Charcoal|1}}}} |See all charcoal spawn locations here |- |Total: |{{Coins|{{GEP|Magic logs|12}}+{{GEP|Molten glass|6}}+{{GEP|Steel bar|6}}+{{GEP|Ashes|1}}+{{GEP|Blood rune|1}}+{{GEP|Bones|1}}+{{GEP|Charcoal|1}}}} |''It's possible for level three ironmen to obtain all items |}.]] Wearing a Zamorak item when giving Eblis the items will cause Eblis to not create the scrying glasses! Bring Eblis the items required. Make sure to 'use''' the bones on him instead of burying them, noting them will avoid this. After giving him the items, Eblis will have travelled south-east on top of a hill (shown as a grey circle on the minimap), surrounded by six mirrors. Looking into them will show locations related to the diamonds, though it is not required. Talk to Eblis again and he'll explain that his spell only makes the mirrors reveal where the diamonds have been at one point in time. Two of the mirrors show other locations entirely; the Bedabin Camp, which you visited, and the Ancient Pyramid itself, which you need to acquire the diamonds in order to enter. If using Runelite, disable the 'Easy Unnote' plug-in, or you will not be able to give Eblis noted items. 'Diamonds can be acquired in any order. The order below is sorted from easiest to hardest.'

steps: Talk to Asgarnia Smith in the Bedabin camp by the magic carpet with at least one inventory slot free.
Go to the Digsite Exam Centre and talk to Terry Balando.
Talk to him again for a translation.
Talk to Asgarnia Smith in the desert.
Talk to him again.

Run south to the bandit camp and buy a drink in the pub for 650 coins. (If you are wearing any saradomin or zamorak items e.g. unholy blessing, remove them now so you don't get attacked by the Bandits)
Talk to the bartender again.
Talk to Eblis in or just outside of the small rectangular building east of the bar.
Deliver all the required items to Eblis by using them on him (items can remain noted), then talk to him again.
Go south-east to the mirrors, and talk to Eblis there.
quickGuide.itemsNeeded: Recommended: waterskins, a charged ring of dueling, 400 coins for carpet rides to Bedabin Camp, stamina potions, 2 Shantay passes, Digsite teleport

steps: Equip your facemask and enter the Smoke Dungeon west of Pollnivneach and east of the mirrors
Light the 4 standing torches, one in each corner of the dungeon, and open the chest in the centre to get the key before any of the torches burns out.
Starting at the NE corner with 100% run and then onto SE, NW and then SW, you can make it to the chest without stamina or energy pots.
Use the warm key to open the gate to the east.
Kill Fareed to get the Smoke diamond. Protect from Melee is strongly advised and attacking with water spell or any range arrow.
quickGuide.itemsNeeded: Recommended: Stamina or energy potions, Dwarven cannon, good food, Protect from melee prayer.

steps: Talk to Rasolo outside the house south of Baxtorian Falls.

Go to the most southern tent in the Bandit camp. Bring antipoison, food, and 20+ lockpicks (you can bring noted ones and coins to exchange with Tiles in Bandit camp's general store, 5 coins for each lockpick) (For ironmen, note that both lockpicks and antipoisons may be pickpocketed from the Bandits in the vicinity).
Unlock the secure chest (the 3 locks must be picked consecutively, it can take upwards of 100 tries to open the chest and is dependent upon Thieving level).
Give the gilded cross to Rasolo. Even if your inventory is full, the cross will instantly be swapped for the ring.
Equip the visibility ring and climb down the ladder east of Rasolo in the fenced area.

Run through the dungeon, kill Damis in his 2 forms and pick up the shadow diamond (his second form drains player's prayer rapidly, it is advised to safespot Damis, this can be done by hitting a bat or rat and stacking npcs behind). Kill a Shadow Hound to complete a task in the Hard Kandarin Diary.

Note: If you run too fast and too far out of Damis' range, he will vanish once more into the shadows. If this happens, go back into the maze where you first enter the large area with Damis' spawn. He will re-appear in the form he disappeared in, with hitpoints reset to full.
Give your sweet food to the Troll child north-west of Trollheim by right-clicking and 'using' the cake on the troll child.
Talk to the Troll child.
Enter the ice gate and kill 5 ice trolls.
Note: You won't need to kill the trolls again if you teleport out and come back
Enter the cave.
Follow the path then kill Kamil (it is advised to approach with protect from magic to force him to teleport into range, then protect from melee, and manually cast your spells).
Continue west and follow the long icy path.
Wear spiked boots and climb the ice ledge, follow the new path.
Go through the gate and smash the trolls frozen in ice by using your fire spell on each of them. Talk to them for the ice diamond.
Talk to Malak in the Canifis pub.
Travel to the Draynor Sewer and give Ruantun a silver bar for a silver pot.
You can go upstairs in Morgan's house and search the cupboard to get garlic if needed. Grind your garlic with a pestle and mortar to receive garlic powder.
Take the silver pot to the High Priest in the Entrana church and he will enchant it.
Talk to Malak (He '
Add spices and garlic powder to the pot of blood.
Prepare for a tough boss fight (combat gear, high healing food).
Go to the Morytania Graveyard north of Castle Drakan (see map).
Pour your pot of blood on the tomb and defeat Dessous
Dessous has 99 Defence and 150 defence against slash and is generally very strong against melee. Recommended to range/mage him.

You can avoid taking damage by alternating between protection from melee and protection from range each game tick. (Note: if you leave the fight you will need to make a new pot of blood but you keep your blessed pot)
Return to Malak and claim the blood diamond.
quickGuide.itemsNeeded: Items required: Silver bar, spice, garlic powder (or garlic and pestle and mortar), food, prayer potions, and (

steps: Go south-east of Eblis and place a diamond in each of the pyramid's obelisks.
Enter the pyramid from the top.
Run through each floor and don't stop or a trap may send you back to the start. Traps may still trigger regardless. Beware Mummies and Scarabs as they can hit over 20.
Talk to Azzanadra at the end.
Praying at the altar twice after completing the quest will unlock a hard task in the Desert area.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Icthlarin's Little Helper
start: Speak to the wanderer in the camp west of the Agility Pyramid.
description:
In the deep south of the desert, unrest is brewing... The cities of the Menaphites have barred their gates to all. An unsettling desert wanderer may know of a secret entrance though, to Sophanem - the city of the dead.

Will you become Icthlarin's Little Helper by entering? Enter into a titanic struggle for the soul of the high priest of Icthlarin in a land where the cat is top dog.
itemRequirements: Regular or overgrown cat, hellcat, or kitten. No food is required as the kitten can stay in your inventory for the most part, or automatically go in/out of your inventory.
Bag of salt (can be bought from any Slayer Master, other players, or the Grand Exchange) 'or' an empty bucket to obtain a pile of salt in Sophanem
Bucket of sap (use a knife on an evergreen tree or a regular tree with the description "a commonly found tree" with a bucket in your inventory)
Full waterskin to give away (can be bought for 30 coins at Shantay pass)
Linen (Can be bought on The Grand Exchange or bought from Raetul in Sophanem for 30 coins during the quest)
Means to enter the desert. (Such as the Shantay pass, Teleport tablets or scrolls, Fairy rings or the Pharaoh's sceptre)
recommendedItems: Combat 50
Agility 35 Agility to jump over the pit in the pyramid (higher agility helps even more)
Waterskins for the desert heat
Knife to refill waterskins
Desert clothing to delay the desert heat effect
1–2 antipoison or superantipoison potions
Energy potions
Antidote, or other anti-poison potions
Nardah teleport
Armour and some food
Ghostspeak amulet for story comprehension (Klenter)
requirements: The ability to defeat a level 91 monster.
enemiesToDefeat: One of the level 75–81 guardians (chosen based on your stats):
rewards: Access to the city of Sophanem
Unlock the carpet rides from Pollnivneach to Sophanem and Menaphos

walkthrough.heading: Flashback Mechanics
walkthrough.body: 'Warning': Throughout this quest, you will encounter several flashbacks where you remember what you did while you were hypnotised. You must play through these in order to progress through the quest. Prior to triggering each flashback, make sure you are prepared as once you begin a flashback, you will be 'unable to teleport away until you either finish the flashback, or die.' Dying will cause your cat to be lost. During a flashback, to leave the pyramid you are expected to walk back to the entrance. You may also log out and back in, which will place your character outside of the pyramid entrance.

walkthrough.heading: Getting Started
walkthrough.body: Collect 'all' the supplies needed for the quest, including your cat. You will not have access to your bank after you start this quest, and will face multiple relatively high-level enemies before you can access it again. The closest bank to the Wanderer is in Nardah. Use the Nardah teleport if you have one or use a magic carpet ride to Pollnivneach, then south to Nardah (or fairy ring code DLQ) and head to the Wanderer (north of Sophanem) in the desert. If you brought an empty bucket to get a pile of salt, go to the pond west of the Wanderer, prior to talking to her. Use the collect water option to get a bucket of salt water. Note that when you first speak to the wanderer and begin the quest, the game will check your Attack, Strength, Ranged, and Magic levels, as well as the Strength, Ranged strength, Magic strength, and defence bonuses of any items you have equipped or in your inventory. The highest of these influences which canopic jar you are most likely to obtain, which affects which apparition you fight and which potion drop you will receive from the quest's final boss. While your stats and items make getting a certain jar more likely, note that there is still a chance to get a different one regardless. {| class="wikitable mw-collapsible" |+ Canopic jars |-!Stats!Equipment bonuses!Jar!Apparition!Potion |- |{{Skill clickpic|Attack}}Attack & {{Skill clickpic|Strength}}Strength |Strength, Stab defence, Slash defence, Crush defence |{{plink|Canopic jar (Het)|txt=Lid shaped like a man, contains a liver}} |Het apparition (fights with melee) |{{plink|Defence potion(4)}} |- |{{Skill clickpic|Ranged}}Ranged |Ranged strength, Ranged defence |{{plink|Canopic jar (Apmeken)|txt=Lid shaped like an ape, contains intenstines}} |Apmeken apparition (fights with magic) |{{plink|Attack potion(4)}} |- |{{Skill clickpic|Magic}}Magic |Magic strength, Magic defence |{{plink|Canopic jar (Scabaras)|txt=Lid shaped like a bug, contains a stomach.}} |Scabaras apparition (fights with melee) |{{plink|Agility potion(4)}} |- |Unused, unless the quest was started prior to 27 April 2022 |Unused |{{plink|Canopic jar (Crondis)|txt=Lid shaped like a crocodile, contains lungs}} |Crondis apparition (fights with magic) |{{plink|Magic potion(4)}} |} The Wanderer will have a strange reaction to your cat. Ask her why she has a problem with the cat. She will tell you that if you get your cat away from her, she would tell you about the secret entrance to Sophanem. Wait, and you will automatically pick up your cat. She will then ask for a tinderbox and full waterskin. Talk to her again and say 'Yes, I have them all here' (4th dialogue option). Once you give them to her, she will hypnotise you and you'll enter a small cave just north-east of her tent. You can now use this passage to enter the city at any time, including if you die, which will give you the quest items back. You will end up just outside a pyramid in Sophanem, and a canopic jar will appear in your inventory. The door to the pyramid is immediately to your south, with a picture of a cat on the door. Proceed to the first Flashback. 'Note: If you take too long, a spectre will attack you and steal some of your gold or deal damage.'

walkthrough.heading: First Flashback
walkthrough.body: 'Warning': Prior to proceeding, ensure you are prepared and familiar with the Flashback mechanics outlined at the start of this walkthrough. 'Important note: Using the mini-map to navigate the pyramid will automatically avoid the traps (both the wall-crushers and pit traps) and is much more time efficient than manually navigating it.' Touch the door of the pyramid to begin the first flashback. During the flashback, you will need to go through the pyramid. You'll see some wall crushers. Stand on the opposite wall and don't go next to them, as they will damage you if you do. Once you're past the crusher blocks, you'll find pit traps in the next hallway. If you step on the wrong spot, you'll fall into a pit and end up at the beginning of the pyramid. You can move forward by clicking on the map, and your character will avoid the traps automatically. To avoid traps, stay along the left wall until you pass the whitish rectangle on the wall, and then go to the right side. Continue walking until you are opposite a square. Go back to the left side until you pass a candle. Switch to the right wall once more. You'll see mummies (level 84). They will attack you; simply go past them. You'll also see Scarab swarms (level 96) crack out of the ground. They can rapidly hit you for 2 damage and can also inflict a poison condition which hits you for another 2 points of damage, and they very obnoxiously stop you in your tracks, regardless of whether or not you have auto-retaliate enabled. Continue to some more wall crushers. Past these—you'll eventually find a large pit. Jump over it. (You'll need 20% run energy. If you fail, you'll reappear near the second set of wall crushers.) Go to the west door (double-check your compass) and try to open it. Now, you need to solve a puzzle. The objective is to flip all of the tiles onto their gold sides. There is no required number of flips that you must make, nor is there any limit of tries. Each time you flip a tile, the nine tiles in a 3x3 grid will also flip. To solve this puzzle click on the squares in the order shown on the image below (make sure the puzzle is in the default position as shown below. To get to the default position, right click on the gold solution to reset. Keep hitting the "reset puzzle" button until the puzzle looks as shown in the picture below). Once you've solved it, you'll wake up fully healed outside the pyramid. {{Clear|left}}

walkthrough.heading: After Flashback 1
walkthrough.body: After you finish the flashback, talk to the Sphinx with your cat out. Ask for help and the Sphinx will ask you this question: "A husband and a wife have six sons and each son has one sister. How many people are in the family?" The answer is 9 (6 brothers + 1 sister + 2 parents = 9; while a naive reading might assume that each brother has a separate sister, since every member of the family is related, if that was true each brother would have six sisters, not one sister). 'If you guess wrong, you will lose your cat and have to obtain another one from Gertrude.' Before making your guess, the Sphinx will ask you to confirm your answer; 'if you are about to choose the wrong answer, your cat will shake its head and scratch your leg as a warning.' Once answered correctly, you will receive the Sphinx's token, so you can speak to the High Priest. Go to the High Priest, located in the south-west corner of the city, and ask him about the remains. He will tell you to put them back in the burial chamber. Return to the pyramid, and select open door. Your cat will help you get back inside. Go through the pyramid using the same steps as in the first flashback. Before you jump the pit examine the canopic jar in your inventory! so that you can know in advance which attack style the apparition you must fight will use, and thus be able to bring the appropriate equipment to fight it. When you jump across the pit, you'll enter the second flashback.

walkthrough.heading: Second Flashback
walkthrough.body: The second flashback begins where the first one left off—on the other side of the pit. Open the unlocked door of the west room. Examine the four jars to find which one you used to have in your inventory. If you don't remember, you can open your quest journal to figure out which jar you need to pick up, which will be stated by the major organ inside of it, or just try them all. The player will only take the correct one. As soon as you try to pick up your jar, one of four apparitions will attack you, which can range in Level between 75 and 81 and which uses a specific attack style. Two of the apparition types attack with Magic and the other two with Melee, and which one will appear depends on which specific jar you have, as follows. Protection prayers offer full protection against their attacks. * If your jar's examine text is "It has a lid shaped like an 'ape'. Eeew! I think it contains someone's 'intestines'", then the guardian will be Apmeken, who attacks with 'Magic'. * If your jar's examine text is "It has a lid shaped like a 'crocodile'. Yuck! I think there are 'lungs' inside.", then the guardian will be Crondis, who attacks with Magic. * If your jar's examine text is "It has a lid shaped like a 'bug'. Disgusting! I think there's a 'stomach' inside", then the guardian will be Scabaras, who attacks with 'Melee'. * If your jar's examine text is "It has a lid shaped like a 'man'. I think it contains someone's 'liver'. Eeew!", then the guardian will be Het, who attacks with Melee. Dying during this fight will send you to your respawn location with the canopic jar in your inventory. Any other items are subject to normal death rules, while Ultimate Ironmen will have a death pile next to the pyramid entrance in Sophanem. Your cat will be gone. Re-entering the pyramid will return you outside of the west room in the flashback state. '''Once you've defeated the guardian, pick up the jar.''' Leave the room and jump across the pit again. The flashback ends. (If you forgot to pick up the jar before jumping the pit, leave the pyramid and enter it again to return to just outside the jar room.)

walkthrough.heading: Returning the canopic jar
walkthrough.body: {{Listen|filename=Icthlarin's Little Puzzle.ogg|desc=The jingle that plays upon solving the puzzle.|title=Solved!}} After the flashback is over, you will feel regret, and you will say to yourself that you think you should put the jar back. Jump the pit and go to the west door (remember you need to have 20% run energy to successfully jump the pit). You will need to solve the same door puzzle to enter the room. Click on the large golden bird to reset the puzzle until it lands on the solution shown in the image to the right. Then click the tiles indicated on the picture. Once you turn all of the tiles to their gold side; you will automatically enter the room. Drop the canopic jar where you found it and go back through the pyramid, across the pit, past the monsters, and past the traps to the High Priest. Alternatively, you can log out and back in, which will return you to the entrance with the objective still completed.

walkthrough.heading: The High Priest
walkthrough.body: Talk with the High Priest. He will ask you to prepare a ceremony. You will need to help the Embalmer and the Carpenter. If you used a Protection prayer during the fight, recharge your prayer points at the altar here.

walkthrough.heading: The carpenter
walkthrough.body: Then, head to the city's eastern side to find the Carpenter, who can be found directly East of the Southern pyramid. He needs a willow log to make a holy symbol. Talk to him again to give him your willow log. After a short wait, the carpenter will give you the symbol.
