The race is on!' (yellow-green eastern platform) ==== A simple Agility test. Beat the Ethereal Expert to the end of the passage by jumping four hurdles whilst he walks a straight path. This is fairly easy, though an Agility potion (or Summer pie) and some food might help because failing a hurdle will cost you 8 Hitpoints. ==== '6. Anything you can do...' (teal south-eastern platform) ==== A mime-copying game, very similar to the mime random event. Simply copy the emotes the Ethereal Mimic uses. After each emote, the mime will teleport to a different location. Talk to them again for the next. ====The fight====.]] :'Note:' If the fight doesn't start after the white screen, you will need to try again for a few times, it will eventually let you in. Also, try dropping your axe and then talking to the guide, or dropping your axe and picking it up again before talking to the guide. Once you've completed all the challenges, talk to the guide in the centre, and they will ask if you are ready to face the ultimate challenge. Say that you are, and you get to face "Me", a level 79 opponent who attacks with melee and is easily defeated. You will occasionally be teleported around this arena, but this is more annoying than dangerous. The chats are quite amusing from "Me", so listen out! Once you have defeated "Me", talk to the guide at the centre of the Dream World, then exit via the lectern, and go and talk to the Oneiromancer again. 'Congratulations, quest complete!' 'Tip:' Before leaving Lunar Isle you can unlock the Ourania Teleport spell. If you intend on doing this, switch spellbooks to the Lunar spellbook at the altar next to the Oneiromancer before going to Baba Yaga.

steps: Talk to Lokar Searunner on the western most Rellekka docks.
Speak to Brundt the Chieftain in the Longhall for a seal of passage.
Return to Lokar Searunner.
Climb the ladders, and board the pirate ship. Talk to Captain Bentley about sailing to Lunar Isle.
Speak to Captain Bentley again.
Climb down the nearby south stairs through the door, talk to 'Birds-Eye' Jack.
Climb back up the stairs and talk to Captain Bentley again.
Climb back down the stairs and return to 'Birds-Eye' Jack again.
Talk to 'Eagle-eye' Shultz at the very front (north-end) of the ship.
Talk to the Cabin boy up one deck from the captain (south).
Talk to 'Beefy' Burns on the lowest level of the ship.
Talk to 'Lecherous' Lee at the very top-rear of the ship.
Talk to First mate 'Davey-boy', on the deck level, south room.
Climb back up to the top, talk to the Cabin boy (2 inventory spaces required).
Use the emerald lens on the bullseye lantern you brought. Light it with your tinderbox.

If you didn't bring a lightable lantern, you can make lamp oil in Rimmington and add it to the bullseye lantern (unf) given by the Cabin boy, after using the emerald lens on it. If you lose your emerald lens for any reason, you can ask the Cabin boy for another one.
If you still own a sapphire lantern from the Tears of Guthix quest, you can use the emerald lens on the sapphire lantern.
Use the lantern on the following objects, and rub away the symbols:
'Cannon': Eastern cannon a few steps away (same level as Cabin boy).
'Wallchart': Climb down the stairs, southern-most room (on the wallchart north of the long wooden table).
'Chest': Lowest level of the ship, northern chest.
'Support pillar': Also lowest level, just north of Beefy Burns, the cook.
'Crate': Directly east of the cooking range.
Talk to Captain Bentley.
Climb down the ladders and walk into the city (there will be a small cut-scene).
Run out of the city to the south-east part of the island. Talk to the Oneiromancer.
Kill Suqah (safespottable), until you've received a suqah tooth. Keep any hides you get as drops (you will need a total of 4 hides later in the quest, which you can also collect later).
Return to the city, northern section. Enter the chicken house and talk to Baba Yaga (1 inventory space required).
Exit the house and use the vial on a nearby water source.
Add the Guam leaf and marrentill to your vial.

Ironmen: If you have guam and marrentill to get rid of, now is a good time do so for Herblore experience (~10,000 xp/hr). Destroy the vial after creating the guam-marr vial, reobtain one from Baba Yaga, and repeat.
Grind the Suqah tooth and use it on the vial to complete the potion.
Return to the Oneiromancer with the potion.
Use your Dramen staff/staves on the following altars 'in order':
Air Altar (south of Falador).
Fire Altar (north of Al Kharid entrance of Emir's Arena).
Water Altar (Lumbridge Swamp).
Earth Altar (north-east of Varrock).
Travel back to Lunar Isle and give the Lunar staff to the Oneiromancer. Do not forget to bring your seal of passage.
In the north-eastern part of the isle, climb down ladder to the Lunar Mine.
Mine a stalagmite for 1 lunar ore. Grab three extra ores to save time during The Fremennik Exiles quest.
Smelt the ore at a furnace or superheat the ore to receive a lunar bar (closest furnace and anvil is in Rellekka).
With a hammer, use the bar on an anvil to make the helm.
Go back to the Lunar Isle.

North-west in the city, talk to Pauline Polaris (1 inventory space required) 'Note: The chat options appear in a random order when guessing her real name.' First guess must be Pauline. Pick the option that says '"Jane Blud-Hagic-Maid."'
South in the city, talk to Meteora.
Kill Suqahs until one drops a special tiara. Keep up to 4 hides the Suqahs drop. Make sure you have at least 4 hides.
Give Meteora the tiara.
South of the bank, talk to Rimae Sirsalis about ceremonial clothes.
Talk to Rimae Sirsalis again, she will tan your hides.
Craft a Lunar torso, trousers, gloves and boots from your hides.
Centre of the city, talk to Selene.
Exit the city and run south then west past the two bridges. With your spade, dig up the blue flowers furthest west to receive the lunar ring. (You must click continue on the chatbox!)
Give the Oneiromancer all your lunar gear. She will then give you all the items back. You will need to have 11 inventory spaces free (8 for your lunar gear and 3 other spaces) or you cannot continue.
Use the Waking sleep vial on the kindling you received.
Get your combat runes and supplies and 'wear all your lunar items (but do NOT bank your seal of passage)'. 4 inventory spaces are required.
Enter a long building on the western side of the village that has a ceremonial brazier and a staircase inside.
Light the ceremonial brazier then use the kindling on it.
Talk to the Ethereal Being.
If you logout during the dream state you will have to speak to the Oneiromancer again to retrieve the Waking sleep vial and kindling.
Step on the south-western yellow platform.
Talk to Ethereal Fluke.

He will call out a number, you need to make the dice add up to the number he called. Roll the dice for the numbers in the answer that are not on the dice. E.g. for number 12, roll any dice that are numbers 4, 5 or 6.
He will teleport you back to the centre area after 5-6 correct answers.
Talk to the Ethereal Being.
Step on the south-eastern purple platform.
Talk to Ethereal Numerator.
Click on the numbers to complete the patterns:
He eventually teleports you back to the middle.
Talk to the Ethereal Being.
Step on the north-eastern blue platform.
Talk to Ethereal Perceptive. If you don't have an axe, he'll give you one.
Run west and chop 20 logs, depositing them on your log pile. (Warning: Pick up any items you dropped before handing in last log or you will be teleported away without time to grab them.)
He will teleport you once you've won the competition.
Talk to the Ethereal Being.
Step on the north-western grey platform.
Talk to Ethereal Guide.
Cross the chasm by jumping on the correct combination of Dream Puffs. Keep a note of the correct steps!
Once complete, talk to the Ethereal Being.
Step on the eastern grey platform.
Talk to Ethereal Expert and start the race.
Turn on run, and keep it on while jumping the hurdles.
Jump over the Hurdles. If you fail 3 times you will lose the race.
After you have won talk to the Ethereal Being.
Step on the south-eastern green platform.
Talk to Ethereal Mimic.
Click on him, then copy the emote that he performs. He teleports after each correct emote.
After 5 correct emotes, he'll teleport you back.
Talk to the Ethereal Being to begin the final fight.
Kill Me (level 79, safespottable). (Cannot tele from this area, must kill Me or log out.)

You cannot equip any different equipment when fighting Me, however you can bring combat runes to make the fight drastically easier. A tome of fire or any shield slot item can be used if equipped before entering the dream.
Read the lectern to return to Lunar Isle.
With the seal of passage equipped or in your inventory talk to the Oneiromancer.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: The Eyes of Glouphrie
start: Speak to Brimstail in his cave south-west side of the Tree Gnome Stronghold, directly west of the bank near the Stronghold Slayer Cave.
description: After you foiled a plan to destroy the Grand Tree things have been quiet in the gnome world. Brimstail has found a strange machine, though, built by Oaknock the Engineer during the Gnomes' Golden Age. What does the weird device do? Why on Gielinor was it built? If you agree to help this bookworm gnome get this confusing device working, you will learn a little about gnome magicks, gnome history, and you will start to uncover a new threat (or is it an old one?) to gnome security - a threat that is a lot harder to see ...
itemRequirements: Bucket of sap (If you do not have one, you can use a knife on any tree that looks pointy (evergreen shaped trees) with a bucket in your inventory)
recommendedItems: Several free inventory slots (about 8) to solve the puzzles more easily

Fast travel to the Tree Gnome Stronghold (Balloon Transport System, gnome glider, Spirit Tree or Slayer ring to the Slayer Cave to directly reach the Stronghold -- alternatively, use a necklace of passage to the Outpost and walk north)
Fast travel to Hazelmere (Fairy rings to cls, or Watchtower or Nightmare Zone minigame teleport and walk east if you have no access to fairy rings)
Slayer ring to the Slayer Dungeon or a necklace of passage to the Wizards' Tower for easy access to fairy rings
rewards: A crystal saw seed — Either take it to Ilfeen in Tirannwn or use it on the singing bowl by Brimstail to get an enchanted crystal saw. It allows items (that require a saw) to be made three levels above your Construction. It has a limited number of charges (28), but the recharge is free - use the bowl again.
ironmanConcerns: *A method to obtain mud runes: **Runecraft 13 to craft them **As a reward from the Mage Training Arena with Magic 33 **1/100 drop from essence implings with Hunter 42 *A method to obtain maple logs: **Woodcutting 45 (boostable) to cut maple trees **Guaranteed from the Managing Miscellania activity (requires Quest Throne of Miscellania) **Firemaking 50 (boostable) for maple logs from the Wintertodt Reward Cart (drop chance based on Woodcutting level). **Completing Hunters' Rumours with Hunter 46 (boostable) to receive Hunters' loot sack (drop chance based on Woodcutting level) **Using Serum 208 for a 1/128 drop of maple logs from curing Afflicted (requires Quest Shades of Mort'ton). *A method to obtain oak logs: **Woodcutting 15 to chop oak trees **1/17.2 drop from sorting small salvage with Sailing 15, 1/11.6 from fishy salvage with Sailing 26, 1/5.68 from barracuda salvage with Sailing 35 **1/16.2 drop from Brutus (Combat 30), requiring completion of Quest The Ides of Milk Magic glue can be made before starting the quest by grinding the mud rune with the pestle and mortar and using it on a bucket of sap, saving inventory space.
leagueRegion: <poem> Unlocking Kandarin will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Starting out
walkthrough.body: {{Map|x=2402|y=3419|r=4|mtype=square|caption=Brimstail's cave entrance.|align=right|width=250|height=250}} Head south-west from the Spirit Tree in Tree Gnome Stronghold until you see a dungeon entrance marker near the edge of a small lake. Enter the cave, and speak to Brimstail. Ask him about the cute creature wandering around, and then agree to let him tell you about his research. He will offer to tell you some history - agree and say that you love a bit of history (the second option does not work to skip the dialogue). You will then be given the option to start the quest. Brimstail will ask you to go into the next room and look at it carefully. First, Inspect the singing bowl set in the centre of the cave and surrounded by a black circular pothole. Next, Inspect the machine panel next to Oaknock's exchanger. Then, Unlock Oaknock's Machine. After completing these three actions, 'in that order', talk to Brimstail again. Talk to Brimstail again, and he will tell you to go and talk to Hazelmere. 'Fully finish the dialogue or Hazelmere will not be understood later on.' Hazelmere is located on the island chain east of Yanille, there is also a fairy ring directly beside his hut code CLS. You can also use the Watchtower Teleport spell and run east. Another way to reach him is by using the Nightmare Zone minigame teleport and running south-east.

walkthrough.heading: Memories
walkthrough.body: Speak to Hazelmere, located east of Yanille. There's a long conversation, and he will get inside your mind where you can now talk to him. This requires 46 Magic and 'cannot' be boosted. A long cutscene will follow showing the battle between the gnomes and goblins, with King Healthorg, Oaknock, Glouphrie and Hazelmere fighting alongside. Glouphrie uses his magic to scare away the goblins, and later uses his magic to cover up Argento's death. Oaknock then builds a machine that reverses Glouphrie's magic, revealing that Argento is actually dead to the King. The King, unable to trust Glouphrie, banishes him from the Stronghold, which Glouphrie isn't happy about. Hazelmere will then give you a violet pentagon for the machine. <gallery captionalign="center" widths="180"> File:The Eyes of Glouphrie - Hazelmere enters player's mind.png|Hazelmere gets inside your mind. File:The Eyes of Glouphrie - gnome battalion.png|Gnomes and Goblins battle. File:The Eyes of Glouphrie - gnome army council.png|King Healthorg (top), Oaknock (left), Glouphrie (front), and Hazelmere (right) are seen on the battlefield. File:The Eyes of Glouphrie - Glouphrie's grand illusion.png|Glouphrie summons holograph tortoises to fool Goblins. File:The Eyes of Glouphrie - Argento dies.png|Argento is dead! File:The Eyes of Glouphrie - Argento convention.png|Oaknock summons the King and his advisors. </gallery>

walkthrough.heading: Sabotage
walkthrough.body: Go back and speak to Brimstail where you will see a shorter cutscene in which an invisible gnome will sabotage the machine you examined earlier. Crush your mud rune with the pestle and mortar, and then use it on the bucket of sap to create magic glue. Repair the machine using your maple logs, oak logs and the glue. You will need to have a hammer and a saw in your inventory. If you did not bring a bucket of sap ahead of time, there is a tree just north of Brimstail's cave, between two Oak trees, that you can extract sap from. Use a knife on it with a bucket in your inventory to extract the sap. Now, you will have to unlock and restart the machine. For this, you will need more crystal discs—talk to Brimstail to get some from him. You can talk to him multiple times to get more shapes. If you can no longer get discs from Brimstail, drop the discs and talk to him again to get more discs. 'Alternatively, you can exchange the discs at the exchanger next to the machine.' To work this machine, you have to fit crystal discs to the numbers shown. The numbers will be different for everybody; therefore, you have to solve this mostly yourself. This is how it works: To the west side is a chart showing the values of each colour. {{Colour-shape value|align=right}} The crystal is equal to: *Red: 1 *Orange: 2 *Yellow: 3 *Green: 4 *Blue: 5 *Indigo: 6 *Violet: 7 This value is multiplied by the number of sides each crystal has: *Circle has 1 side. *Triangle has 3 sides. *Square has 4 sides. *Pentagon has 5 sides. *Example 1: a 4 can be a red square or a green circle (1 * 4) *Example 2: a 7 can only be a violet circle (7 * 1) *Example 3: a 12 can be a green triangle or a yellow square (4 * 3) Some of the colours can be easily mixed up, since they are very similar (e.g. blue, indigo, and violet). Hover them with your mouse to be sure. The yellow circle can 'never' be obtained. If the puzzle requires a value of three, you must use the red triangle instead. Brimstail cannot directly give you any circles, or red coloured shapes. If you need the lower value shapes the exchanger must be used. There is a token exchanger on the right-hand side, which allows you to insert various tokens and change them for others of the same value. <u>You cannot exchange more than 35 points worth at a time</u>, but you may exchange a single token for many other lower valued tokens if its value is high enough. You will always receive the same value back, in different tokens. For example, if you need an indigo pentagon (30), and have a violet pentagon (35). Put the violet pentagon into the exchanger, and keep declining the transaction until the machine offers you an indigo pentagon (30) and a red pentagon (5). To unlock the machine, you have to create a single disc worth the number of points shown on Oaknock's machine. The numbers are different for everyone. As a general strategy, try and get the smaller numbers and it's easier. Any violet pentagons or similar if not needed may be exchanged for ones of a lower value using the Oaknock's exchanger. Once unlocked, you need to restart the machine. For this, you will need to fit 'six' separate tokens to three different numbers (1 for the first number, 2 for the second and 3 for the third). Be patient—it can take a while to get all the tokens that you need. 'You may speak to Brimstail to get more tokens which may make getting the ones you want easier; it is possible to solve the puzzle by continuously asking for and dropping coins until you get the ones you need.' An example of a completed machine. 'Note: You must fill all slots to unlock the machine!' In this example, using two violet triangles turned the light green, but still did not work. If this happens, you can just use the exchanger to turn it into two pieces, since the total points stay the same.

walkthrough.heading: Assassination
walkthrough.body: Once you have unlocked the machine, speak to Brimstail again. The once cute creatures are revealed to be evil creatures. After the cut-scene, talk to Brimstail and he will tell you to speak to King Narnode. There are six creatures in total, and they have 1 Hitpoint each. {{checklist| * 1 - One by Brimstail (he may kill it for you). * 2 - One by King Narnode. (You may need to range or mage this one, as it can get stuck behind the trapdoor.) * 3 - One at the top of the Grand Tree, by the prison. (Do not climb down the ladders immediately after killing the creature—it will not count as a kill.) * 4 - One by the giant tortoises in the pen north-west of the Grand Tree (north of the toad swamp). * 5 - One by the Gnome Stronghold Spirit Tree. * 6 - One by the entrance to the Gnome Stronghold. Go south from the Grand Tree, down the ramp and keep walking to the main entrance of the Stronghold. }} 'Note:' If Brimstail kills the evil creature, or if you mess up a creature kill count at any time, the last Evil Creature will spawn at the entrance to Gnome Stronghold. Talk to King Narnode, and he will reward you. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

steps: Talk to Brimstail in the cave found in the south-west corner of the Gnome Stronghold.
Optionally right click teleport on Brimstail for an easy Western Provinces Diary completion
Inspect the singing bowl in the western portion of the cave.
To the north, attempt to unlock Oaknock's Machine.
Talk to Brimstail.

Talk to Hazelmere, located upstairs in his house (on the small island east of Yanille, fairy ring code cls goes directly to his house, Nightmare Zone minigame teleport or Watchtower Teleport). There will be several cutscenes, the last being King Healthorg and the white Spirit Tree Argento. You'll know you're done when you get a Violet pentagon in your backpack.
Return to Brimstail.
Get the bucket of sap outside of Brimstail's cave on your way back.
Use your Mud Rune on the Pestle and Mortar to make Ground Mud Runes.
Add the Ground Mud Runes to the Bucket of Sap to make Magic glue.
Repair Oaknock's machine (click on the machine twice).
Talk to Brimstail.
Talk to Brimstail twice more to receive more discs.
'Optional': Drop the discs and talk to Brimstail to receive even more discs.
Head back to the Oaknock's machine and unlock the machine.
Unlock the front panel by inserting a disc with a value equal to the green number. (When done, click the green box next to the number.)
You will need to exchange some of the tokens to obtain certain values. (see full guide here).
Talk to Brimstail for more discs.
Complete the three puzzles inside the unlocked machine
You need to fill up every slot, the first puzzle's single slot, the second's two slots, and the last puzzle's three slots.
You will need to exchange some of the tokens to obtain certain values. (see full guide here).
Talk to Brimstail.
Talk to Brimstail again.
Kill all Evil Creatures: (wait for the whole death animation to end before running or teleporting away!). Their colour is now black.
The one by Brimstail, if you haven't killed it already.
One outside of the main gate (south-east from Brimstail's cave). Note: It must be killed within stronghold walls. If it is outside, simply kill it, let it spawn, and kill it again for credit.
One by the gnome agility course entrance (near the spirit tree).

One by King Narnode, at the bottom of the Grand Tree. If it is stuck behind a trapdoor, kill it with mage or range, or hop worlds. Make sure you wait a few seconds after killing before using the ladder.
One at the top of the Grand Tree, by the prison. 'Make sure you wait a few seconds after killing before using the ladder.'
One by the giant tortoises north-west of the Grand Tree (in the pen north of the swamp).
Talk to King Narnode.
Optional: Use the crystal saw seed on the singing bowl by Brimstail to get an enchanted crystal saw, and complete a medium Western Provinces diary task.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Darkness of Hallowvale
start: Go to Burgh de Rott and into the basement of the inn there and speak to Veliaf Hurtz.
description:
Fighting tooth and nail against the vampyre overlord, Drakan, the Myreque have moved their secret base camp to Burgh de Rott. Now the fight starts in earnest! Veliaf needs someone to make their way into the Sanguinesti region, the eastern side of Morytania cut off from the west behind an impenetrably huge wall.

Will the fight be supported by Myreque resistance inside the vampyres' domain? What grim discoveries are to be found behind that dread wall? And what of the Vyrewatch - deadly sky-bound patrollers of the blood-tithed lands of Meiyerditch?

Only a daring, quick-witted agent with an eye for detail can hope to pick their way through the tumbled down slums of Meiyerditch.
itemRequirements: Knife (obtainable during the quest) or a sickle
Means to cast Telekinetic Grab (air and law rune; both obtainable during the quest)
recommendedItems: Combat 50
Stamina or energy potions to traverse through the maze of houses
Pickaxe, 'highly recommended', to take a great shortcut through the city (obtainable during quest)
Fast travel to several locations
Burgh de Rott to start the quest plus 3 additional trips - Mort'ton teleport, Shades of Mort'ton Minigame Teleport, Morytania legs 3+, or Barrows teleport
Paterdomus (1 trip) - Salve Graveyard teleport, fairy ring cks, or Kharyrll Teleport
Varrock (1 trip) - Varrock teleport, runes for this teleport are provided during the quest
Vyrewatch outfit (top, legs, and shoes) as disguise against the Vyrewatch, only if your Thieving or Hitpoints are low (can be bought for {{Coins|1950}} from Trader Sven during the quest)
Armour and some food 'or' Prayer 43+ to use Protect from Melee
requirements: Thieving 22 (boostable) <ref>The level 22 Thieving requirement to begin the quest is boostable, but unhooking the latch in Meiyerditch has an unboostable requirement of 22 Thieving.</ref>
Agility 26 (boostable) <ref>The level 26 Agility requirement to begin the quest is boostable, but the obstacles within Meiyerditch have an unboostable requirement of 25 Agility.</ref>
The ability to withstand several melee attacks from a level 169 enemy.
rewards: Tome of experience, granting 2,000 experience to any three skills of the player's choosing (level 30 or over). Can be the same skill.
Access to passage through two shortcut doors within Meiyerditch
Lore-related in-game Membership of the Myreque
leagueRegion: <poem> Unlocking Morytania will auto-complete the quest </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Introduction
walkthrough.body: Throughout the quest, you're expected to run around parts of Morytania, which can take quite some time, even with the proper teleports. To avoid having to retrace steps, '''be sure to read each section carefully! If you're unsure if a step is finished, check your quest log to see if it matches what's next in the walkthrough.''' Rushing to finish the quest can end up causing parts to be skipped and require going through all of Meiyerditch over again.

walkthrough.heading: Starting out
walkthrough.body: 2 planks, 8 nails and a hammer Speak to Veliaf Hurtz in the basement of the pub in Burgh de Rott. Ask if there is something you can do to help out, and he will request assistance in scouting a route into the Sanguinesti region. He wants you to make contact with the Myreque in Meiyerditch. Go south-east to the docks where you'll find a hut with a boat in it. Inspect the boat to repair it using a plank and four nails. Inspect the boat chute going down into the water to repair it, also using a plank and four nails. You can now bank or drop your hammer. Push the boat down the chute into the water and board it to travel to Meiyerditch.

walkthrough.heading: Welcome to Meiyerditch
walkthrough.body: 'Note': While in Meiyerditch, the Vyrewatch will occasionally stop you, and you will be presented by several options. You may choose to logout and login during the conversation to avoid this. * "Pay a blood tithe" - The Vyrewatch will damage you for 6 Hitpoints. 'Chosen by default if you don't select an option.''' * "Bring it on" - The Vyrewatch will attack you, allowing you to run away. 'The Vyrewatch are invulnerable to all sources of damage available to you at this stage.' * "Distract him" - Success rate depends on your Thieving level, if you fail you will be damaged for 6 Hitpoints. * "Send me to the mines!" - (this option appears after you've found the Myreque hideout). You will not lose health, instead you will need to mine 15 Daeyalt ores, place them in a minecart and then talk to a guard to leave. '''You'll then appear in the north-east part of the city.' If you have no pickaxe, a miner will supply one. After boarding the boat, you will arrive at the very southern, damaged end of the southern wall of Meiyerditch. Climb onto the rocks and then climb up. Follow the winding wall until it runs straight north, then search (right click) the very first set of floorboards. Kick them in, then climb down into the passage below. Climb over the wall rubble to enter the town, and talk to any nearby Meiyerditch citizen. Ask them in a 'whisper' if they know about the Myreque, then 'whisper' that you really need to meet them. They will tell you to speak to Old Man Ral. Ask if they can introduce you to him. They will tell you to say a friend recommended him. Old Man Ral is north of where you climbed over the rubble - follow the wall until it turns inwards, and he is in the second building to the east (and one building north of Trader Sven). Tell him someone said you could help me, then when he asks you what they called him, tell him it was the "Sage of Sanguinesti". He should now tell you that you need to get to Sector 3 of the city by following sickle symbols on the walls. '''Optional:' Just to the south, Trader Sven sells the Vyrewatch outfit for 1,950 GP. The vyrewatch will stop you less often while wearing this outfit, which may save you time throughout the quest.

walkthrough.heading: The sickle logo agility course
walkthrough.body: {{map:Meiyerditch DoH}} A knife or a sickle (a knife can be acquired on the way, in sector 3 of the agility course) You now need to make a complex journey across the city - watch for the sickle marks or simply follow the instructions below. Make sure to have a knife or a sickle on you. 'Note:' The sickle marks may be more difficult to see when using RuneLite graphics enhancers like 117 HD. You may click each of the steps below as you do it to track your progress. {|class="wikitable lighttable"!Sector 1 directions |- |Go to the house south-west of Old Man Ral with the door facing north (with a sickle symbol next to the door) |- |Climb up the ladder there. |- |Jump south to the floorboards. |- |Jump east to the floorboards. |- |Go to the north-east corner of the room, push the wall and walk across the gap. |- |Crawl under the wall to the north. |- |Go north to the second room, look on the west side, push the wall and go across. |- |Go down the ladder. |- |Search the table next to the west wall, open the trapdoor, and go through the resulting tunnel. |- |Climb up the shelf next to the sickle in the north west corner. |- |Crawl under the wall to the east side. |- |Jump to the floorboards to the east. |- |Go down the ladder. |- |Search the pots near the eastern door to get a door key. |- |Use the key to open the door in that room. You are now in sector two. |} {| class="wikitable lighttable"!Sector 2 directions |- |Go up the ladder in the room to the east, by the sickle. |- |Jump south to the floorboards. |- |Go east around the wall then climb up the shelves to the south. |- |Go up the ladder to the west. |- |Jump south again to the floorboards. |- |Go down the ladder to your immediate west. |- |Go east and walk across the washing line. |- |Climb down the ladder. |- |Push the wall to the north and walk across the floor. |- |Climb up the shelf to the north. |- |Climb down the shelf in the north-eastern corner. |- |Jump to the floorboards to the north. |- |Jump to the floorboards to the north again. |- |Go to the north end of the building and jump to the floorboards to the east. |- |Climb up the ladder (not down using the broken one). |- |Search the wall to the west to get a ladder top. |- |Climb down again and repair the broken ladder (going down) with the ladder top. |- |Climb down the fixed ladder. You are now in sector three. |} {| class="wikitable lighttable"!Sector 3 directions |- |Exit through the door, and go past the building to the north. |- |Enter the only house with an intact door to the north. ''If you don't have a knife yet, climb the ladder in this room to take one. Climb back down after. |- |Go west through the door into the next room, then north out of the house. |- |Head north until you reach a sickle symbol, then follow the path east and enter the house to the south with a ladder inside. |- |Go up the ladder. |- |Jump to the floorboards to the east. |- |Climb down the stairs. Go around the east side of the stairs, and use your knife or sickle on the wall to the south. Push open the wall. |- |Press the decorated wall with a hanging sickle, then open the lumpy rug from the south-east square. If you take too long, you will have to push the wall again as the system will quickly reset.'' |- |Climb down trapdoor to enter the hideout. |} Speak to Vertida Sefalatis in the northern room of the hideout. Tell him you've come to investigate and make contact with the Myreque, and he will give you a message to take to Veliaf Hurtz back in Burgh de Rott.

walkthrough.heading: Urgent business
walkthrough.body: Message (Vertida) Message (from Vertida) Return to Burgh de Rott and talk to Veliaf Hurtz in the basement of the pub again. He will tell you that he has received word from Drezel that something strange has been happening in the Temple of the Salve in Paterdomus, and he wants you to check it out. s.]] Go to Drezel in Paterdomus (fairy code CKS) and talk with him. He will say that strange noises have been heard outside the temple and asks you to investigate. Exit the temple via the west ladder towards Varrock. Past the stairs to the temple, look for a bush that is searchable. A short cut-scene will follow where you will be knocked out. You will see werewolves that seem to have managed to get across the River Salve. Return to Drezel, and tell him what you have just seen. He tells you to speak with King Roald and gives you runes for a Varrock Teleport. Go to Varrock Castle, and speak with King Roald located in the south-easternmost room near the main entrance. After a long, fruitless conversation, ask him what you should do now. Afterwards, a free teleport back to Paterdomus is offered by Aeonisig Raispher. Accepting the teleport is optional, as you will need to then return to Burgh de Rott instead. Speak to Veliaf Hurtz again, who will send you onwards to warn the Myreque's Sanguinesti order.

walkthrough.heading: Scoping Castle Drakan
walkthrough.body: A knife or sickle and 4 free inventory spaces. Travel once more with the boat you fixed to Meiyerditch. Head towards Vertida Sefalatis again, using the rooftop route described above or with the faster alternative method described below. {{Map|align=right|x=3635|y=3278|height=500|zoom=3|caption= {{legend|#f0ff00|caption=Laboratory}} {{legend|#ff0000|caption=Myreque Hideout}} |mtype:line,stroke:#0fff00,stroke-width:4,3631:3267,3634:3267,3634:3277,3638:3277,3638:3283,3635:3283,3635:3288,3633:3288,3633:3294,3628:3294,3628:3300,3631:3303,3631:3306,3624:3313,3624:3320 |mtype:line,stroke:#f0ff00,stroke-width:4,3633:3294,3635:3294,3635:3300,3640:3300,3640:3302,3638:3302,3638:3305,3641:3307 |mtype:line,stroke:#ff0000,stroke-width:4,3631:3267,3631:3258 |mtype:line,stroke-width:4,3632:3257,3633:3256,3639:3256 |mtype:line,stroke:#ff0000,stroke-width:4,3639:3256,3639:3257,3640:3257,3640:3253 |mtype:rectangle,rectY:2,rectX:2,stroke:#ff0000,fill:#ff0000,fill-opacity:0.7,desc:Myreque Hideout,3639:3250 |mtype:rectangle,rectY:2,rectX:2,stroke:#f0ff00,fill:#f0ff00,fill-opacity:0.7,desc:Laboratory,3643:3305 }} {| class="wikitable lighttable"!Alternative route to Vertida Sefalatis |- |Speak to any Vyrewatch and ask to be sent to the mines. |- |Mine 15 Daeyalt ores and place them in the minecart. If you have no pickaxe, talk to a miner to obtain a bronze one. |- |Once the mine cart is full, talk to a guard to leave. You will appear up on the surface, north-east of the slums. |- |See the map to the right and follow the green path. This involves zigzagging through a southern path between the houses. You will have reached the correct house to enter once you can no longer head any further south along the path. Travel through this house and enter the next one to the south. |- |From there, follow the old route; climb up the ladder, jump east to the floorboards, climb down the stairs, and go south-east through the hidden door. |- |Push the wall to the north and enter the trapdoor underneath the rug (south-east corner). |} Once you're down the trapdoor, talk to Vertida Sefalatis. He will urge you to talk to their leader Safalaan Hallow, who is out on a mission to sketch Castle Drakan. Ask Vertida to lead the way, and he will take you to the south of Meiyerditch. Starting from the south of Meiyerditch, reach Safalaan Hallow with the following steps; {| class="wikitable lighttable"!'Route to Safalaan Hallow' |- |Climb down the ladder. |- |Head south and climb over the wall rubble where you first came into the city. |- |Head south climb up the floor to get on top of the wall. Then, travel as far north on the wall as you can, until you reach a ladder you can go down. |- |Proceed down the ladder. |- |Search the rocky surface (east wall) to unlock the false wall to the north (labelled as "barricade"). |- |Open the barricade; then go north, and climb the ladder. |- |Go north along the wall, up a ladder and down one to cross a gap, and keep going north until you reach the Darkmeyer south wall. |- |Climb the wall and go north until you see Safalaan. |} Talk to Safalaan and the player will inform him of all the developments so far. Safalaan wants to return to the Myreque base, and asks you to take over his mission to sketch Castle Drakan. He asks you to sketch three sides of the castle in order -- north, west and south, and gives you some papyrus and charcoal to draw with. There are sickle symbols on the ground to tell you where to sketch. Follow the wall west towards the back of the castle. Walk past the first sickle symbol, heading instead to the north towards the second one. Standing on the sickle symbol to the north, use charcoal on a piece of papyrus to make a drawing of the castle. Head back to the sickle symbol you passed by earlier, and make a second sketch. You will see a short cutscene, of Vanstrom Klause talking to Vanescula Drakan and Ranis Drakan. They will drink some fresh blood and then fly away.

walkthrough.heading: Ambush!
walkthrough.body: Go to the south-eastern side of the castle (where you spoke to Safalaan), and attempt to make another drawing on the sickle symbol there. After a short cutscene, Vanstrom Klause will interrupt your drawing and attack you. You cannot damage him in any way, and it is possible to die here. Vanstrom only uses melee, so Protect from Melee will stop all damage - activate it after the cutscene has concluded. After five attacks, Vanstrom will knock you out. When you awake, remember to 'finish your final drawing'. Speak to Vanescula's servant, Sarius Guile. She gives you a long-winded hint about where to find a secret laboratory. Your quest log should then read "I have all three sketches of the castle. I need to take them to Safalaan". 'Note': If you die on the fifth attack from Vanstrom, you will be teleported back to your grave and the cutscene will continue.{{fact|Confirmation needed. An elaboration may also be appropriate.}}

walkthrough.heading: The secret laboratory
walkthrough.body: Be on the normal spellbook. A knife.]] Return to the Myreque base in Meiyerditch via your preferred route; having a vyrewatch send you to the mine is the fastest. Just before you enter the base, head to the building with the fireplace and portrait just west of the rug entrance. If you lack a knife, climb the ladder in the building with the fireplace and grab one off the table. Use the knife on the fireplace to discover a hidden message about a laboratory. Using a sickle will cause it to say it's the wrong shape. Then, use the knife on the southern portrait in the same room. Search the slashed portrait to get a large ornate key. Return to Vertida, who is now accompanied by Safalaan. Give Safalaan the message you got from the fireplace and the three drawings of the castle. After filling in Safalaan, you need to locate the hidden laboratory that Sarius mentioned. Leave the hideout, go up the stairs, jump west, go down the ladder, and exit the house on the northern side. Walk through the house north. Continue north-east staying near the eastern wall. You will find the house with a clearly visible large tapestry in one of the rooms, coloured red and yellow. Enter the house and use your knife on the tapestry, then walk through it. 'Note': If you see the message {{Mes|you see no reason to destroy this tapestry}}, then you did not collect the message from the fireplace earlier. Use the large ornate key with the vampyre statue to open the secret laboratory entrance. 'Do NOT try to open the door by using the key on the door as this will inflict 10 damage.' Open the door, and go down the stairs. You may search the broken rune case to the west of the staircase for some runes (including Telekinetic Grab runes). Use Telekinetic Grab on the book Haemalchemy volume 1 in the room.

walkthrough.heading: Finishing up
walkthrough.body: Leave the room and take the book back to Safalaan. He will tell you to return to Veliaf Hurtz with a sealed message. You will now be able to use the shortcut doors on the path to the Myreque Hideout. However, this is not recommended due to this method being slower than being teleported to the mine. Get back to Burgh de Rott via any method, and talk to Veliaf Hurtz in the basement of the pub to finish the quest. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: The Slug Menace
start: Speak to Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador Park.
description: The small village of Witchaven was all but deserted when the Fishing Platform was built a short ways off the coast. Now, some of the inhabitants of the village have been acting somewhat strangely....
itemRequirements: Commorb (can get another by speaking to Sir Tiffy)
Dead sea slug (obtainable during the quest)
At least 5 rune/pure essence (bring 15–20 in case they shatter; succeeding with 5 is very unlikely)
Access to the Air, Water, Earth, Fire, and Mind Altars
Elemental talisman 'OR' Air, Water, Earth, and Fire talismans or tiaras
Travelling through the Abyss or using a Runecraft cape

Falador (Falador teleport)
