walkthrough.heading: Historical
walkthrough.body: {{Main|/Historical}} While Guthix Sleeps was originally released in RuneScape 2 on 26 November 2008, more than a year after the August 2007 archive of RuneScape that Old School was built off of. Though the quest is largely the same as the original, numerous changes were made to the lore, graphics, gameplay, music, and rewards.

steps: Speak to Ivy Sophista in Taverley, in the building where the crystal chest is found.
Climb up the ladder to the east and speak with Thaerisk.

Kill the two assassins that appear. Pray Protect from Missiles. Every few attacks the assassin that attacks you will say {{overhead|Now!}} and launch an arrow towards you; swap to Protect from Melee after the arrow lands, and then focus back on the assassin.
Note that there is currently a small glitch where the player may not be able to attack the second assassin, so let Thaerisk kill him off if this occurs. Thaerisk cannot die during this fight.
Finish the conversation with Thaerisk.
Head to the Fight Arena just north of Yanille.

Speak to the Khazard Launderer at the laundry house, two buildings north of the Fight Arena Bar. Charm the launderer with either the ring of Charos(a) or bribe him with 500 coins for information on Movario.
Head to Feldip Hills (fairy ring code AKS), and talk to the Hunting Expert ({{Map|type=maplink|x=2525|y=2916|r=2|mtype=square}}). ( if you're 99 Hunter)
Set up a pit trap to the west and bait it.
Dismantle the trap to receive an unconscious broav, then return to the expert to have her train it.

With the trained broav, head to the run-down house in the battlefield ({{Map|type=maplink|x=2519|y=3249|mtype=pin}}) where a broken table will be found. 'Drop' the broav (not release) and use the dirty shirt on the broav; once it *squeals*, you will be able to right-click "Search" on the broken table.
Climb-down the trapdoor to Movario's base.
Run north-west, and search the open chest for a number of runes.
Climb down the stairs.

Inspect the old battered door, and pay close attention to the word "PROHIBITED"; one of the letters is stylised after a rune, which is the rune you must use to open the door, which is different for every player.
Warning: Using an incorrect rune will result in the door dealing 20+ damage to you. However, if you do choose incorrectly, the spell's colour indicates the correct rune:
Upon using the correct rune, open the door. NOTE: You must be above a certain weight. If you're wearing graceful/weight-reducing items, unequip them.
Once inside, search the bookcases until the chatbox indicates that you hear a click as you pull a lever (or an audible click sound).
From that initial bookcase, follow the floor wires that illuminate to search the subsequent bookcase, continuing to do so until the chatbox indicates the electric gate deactivating.
Open the gate which is no longer electrified. Right-click search the spiral staircase to disable the trap, and then climb the spiral staircase.
Search the desk to obtain Movario's notes (volume 1), and read through it (22 pages) (do not interact with the Treasure pile to the north west as it will deal 20+ damage to you).
Pick up the waste-paper basket next to the desk, then search it for a ruby key.
Use the key on the north-western most bookcase in the room, against the west wall.
Climb the staircase and search the bed, then use the ruby key on the bed chest.
Search the bed chest to disable the trap, then attempt to open the bed chest. If you don't do this you will get hit for 18+ damage.
Search the bed chest again, then open it for Movario's notes (volume 2); read through it.
Head back downstairs and head to the southern side of the room and inspect the painting on the wall, pull the lever and cross over the broken wall.
Inside, search the drawers to obtain some notes on pressure, and read through it.
Check the pressure gauge, which displays a number in the unit of "tickits"; this value represents how much you weighed upon entering the room with the wires in the beginning.
Check your weight in the Equipment Stats interface, and take from the pile of weights nearby with 1kg, 2kg, and 5kg being available.

Pick out the weights as needed to match the pressure gauge's value. If you weigh more than the required tickit, place weights on the statue in the room by the desk. If you weigh less, pick up weights and keep it in the inventory.

If you weigh 11 kg, and the pressure gauge says 9 tickits. You need to pick up a 2 kg stone and place it on the stone statue. If the pressure gauge says 13 kg and you weigh 11 kg, pick up a 2 kg rock and keep it in your inventory.
Exit via the eastern door and leave the base (you will be attacked by the Elite Khazard Guards again upon exit).
Return to Thaerisk in Taverley with both volumes of Movario's notes.
Head to McGrubor's Wood (fairy ring code ALS).
Head to the building by way of the loose railing to the east to view a cutscene.
Defeat the mercenaries and speak to Idria.
Head to White Knights' Castle and speak to Akrisae who is on the ground floor to the east, until you receive a teleorb from him.
Speak to Akrisae to receive a one-time teleport to Draynor Village.
Use the teleorb on any shady strangers in the vicinity. One can be found just south of Diango's Toy Store.
After planting the teleorb, return back to White Knights' Castle and speak to Akrisae.
After the cutscene, finish the conversation with Thaerisk and *MAKE SURE* to obtain the snapdragon seed from him, before accepting his offer to teleport you to Port Sarim.
Head west to Betty's Magic Emporium. Purchase a pink dye from Betty in exchange for 20 coins.
Use the pink dye on the lantern lens for a rose-tinted lens.
Speak to Betty again.
Stand in the doorway of the shop and use the lens on the counter to enrich the snapdragon seed.
Take-from the counter to pick up the enriched snapdragon seed.
Travel back to Falador and climb up the westernmost stairs of the castle all the way to the top.
Plant the enriched snapdragon seed at the special patch.
Speak to Idria.

Cast NPC Contact and contact Turael, Mazchna, Cyrisus, and Duradel each; choose the option regarding Lucien. You can also go and visit Turael, Mazchna, and Duradel in person if necessary, though NPC Contact is needed for Cyrisus.
Return to the White Knights' Castle and harvest the enriched snapdragon.
Speak to Thaerisk and he'll give you some truth serum.
Use the enriched snapdragon on the serum to create the super truth serum.
You will now need to obtain charcoal and papyrus from the drawers just south of the jail cell.
Enter the jail cell and use the super truth serum on the shady stranger.
Once you create a suspect sketch, exit the jail cell and give it to Idria.
Head to the Warriors' Guild and recruit Ghommal, Harrallak Menarous, and Sloane (found north-east on the floor 1) by asking about Lucien.
Ghommal and Harrallak can be found right by the guild's entrance, whilst Sloane can be found one floor above to the north-east through the heavy door.
Optional: If you do not already have a disguise to enter the Black Knights' Fortress, you can buy a bronze med helm and iron chainbody from the Warrior Guild Armoury on the floor 1 while here.

Return to Akrisae at the White Knights' Castle in Falador. Watch the ensuing cutscene with Hazelmere, then finish the conversation with Akrisae and accept his offer to teleport you to Black Knights' Fortress. If you didn't accept the teleport, Mind Altar Teleport, combat bracelet teleport to the Edgeville Monastery, and Lassar Teleport are the fastest ways to get there.
Equip the disguise you brought (bronze med helm and iron chainbody or a black armour set) to enter the Black Knights' Fortress.
Push the hidden wall directly ahead and climb down the ladder.
Head south towards the tiled flooring, and inspect the carved tile with an orb symbol on it.
Cast any charged orb spell on the carved tile, and enter the trapdoor to access the Black Knight Catacombs.
Head immediately north to the western, broken bridge whilst praying Protect from Missiles, then jump across it.
Pray Protect from Melee and kill the Elite Black Knight that is accompanied by Elite Dark Warriors until you have a full set of elite black armour.
Wear the armour, then run to the north-east path and climb up the wall to the second level.
Head north and around the barricades, then run north-west until you reach two solid doors. Use the western door to unlock a shortcut back to the Black Knight Catacombs' exit.
Enter the northern door to the Dark Squall's inner base.
Search the wardrobe north of the entrance for a second set of elite black armour to give to Silif.
Search the wardrobe to the south of the room for the Dark Squall's robes.

Search the table with the lobster and restore potion to obtain the two items. If you have an additional three inventory spaces, take the strange teleorb alongside the death and law rune; otherwise, you can take them later.
Search the key rack in the north wall for a cell key.
Head back and use the long, eastern path and attempt to open the gate to Silif's cell.
Use the lobster (any food works) and restore potion on Silif.
Talk to Silif until you give him the elite black armour. You can equip the Dark Squall's robes now if needed and simply give Silif your set.
With Silif following you, head back to the Dark Squall's inner base.
Go to the Map board to the south, few steps east of the entrance and Silif will notice the map boards on the wall. Finish the conversation for a teleorb.

With the Dark Squall's robes equipped, climb up the ladder at the eastern side of the room. Be prepared for a boss fight. (You can prepare and re-enter the Black Knights' Fortress by wearing the Dark Squall's robes and also prevent enemy aggression).

Defeat Surok with Magic (He 'CANNOT BE FOUGHT' with other styles). He has 450 Hitpoints and is immune to powered staves, so you cannot use weapons such as the trident of the seas and warped sceptre. Pray Protect from Magic to reduce damage taken. He still does chip damage, so take some food. 10-15 karambwans and 1 prayer pot is enough. Surok follows the same attack pattern as Vorkath, performing 6 regular attacks before using one of the special attacks below for every 7th attack.

Henchmen: Surok will call in either a Strong Warrior or Agile Warrior to approach and bind you. The Agile Warrior must be bound via Bind and the Strong Warrior must be weakened via Weaken. Kill the warrior after using the proper counter spell. Stronger versions of each respective counter spell will also work. If the warrior reaches you, Surok will launch a spell that deals 40+ damage.
Explosive: Surok will throw an explosive orb around the player. This must be telegrabbed and then alched, or it will explode and deal 45+ damage. Picking it up will cause it to immediately explode.

Surge attack: Surok will cast 1-4 elemental surges at the player. To nullify these attacks, the player must cast a spell of the opposite element on the incoming attack (i.e. air for earth, water for fire, earth for air, and fire for water). Otherwise, they will deal significant damage (45+).
Once defeated, plant the orb on Surok.
Finish the conversation and return to Akrisae at White Knights' Castle.
Wear the Dark Squall's robes and enter the jail cell.
If you didn't do so earlier, take the strange teleorb alongside the death and law rune from the desks downstairs.
Run to the middle of the room and activate the strange teleorb whilst standing within the magic circle to teleport to Lucien's camp.
Run along the north-east path until you are across the Chaos Temple, then climb up the ice wall and jump to the ledge. This 'will not' take you into the Wilderness, and your items are 'safe'.
Walk towards the eastern side of the Chaos Temple's roof to view the cutscene.
After the cutscene, return to White Knights' Castle.
Talk to Idria.
Head to the Chasm of Tears and speak to Movario whilst wearing the Dark Squall's robes.
Use a lit sapphire lantern on a light creature to be transported into the chasm.
Search the nearby skeletal remains for the following items: a spade, a hammer, and a chisel.
Use the spade on the pile of rocks to uncover a brazier, then use the chisel on it to obtain a fire orb.
Head further west and do the same to the lone pile of rocks for an earth orb.
Head directly south, and use a chisel on the intact brazier there for an air orb.
Head east, and use a chisel on the intact brazier there for a water orb.
Head all the way south to reach three skull cavities.
Examine each recessed block and use the each of the three corresponding orbs on them for the matching elemental block. (The first three recessed blocks are found right next to the cavity entrances)
Climb up the walls next to the centre skull to find the last recessed block, and use the fourth orb on it for the block.
Head back down and unequip items from your weapon and shield slots.
Enter each of the skull nose cavities and crawl to the end, using the correct elemental block on each mechanism by matching the symbols. The specific positions are individual to each player.
Climb back up to the fourth skull. Use the fire block on the recessed block.
Inspect the stone cube and enter the cave opening in the skull. Drop the tools you obtained earlier if more space is needed.
Make your way south to the central chamber where the stone table is found, split into multiple forked paths leading to statues.
Search the skeleton to receive a silver sickle (b) and six druid pouches.
There are 13 possible statues, with 8 being found at the end of these paths, differing between players.

Along the paths, use the druid pouch on the druid spirits to receive herblore ingredients that are used for a statue. These are a one-off reward, so make sure to have plenty of inventory space to pick them all up. If you run out of charges, cast Bloom while standing on the vines to get vine flowers for more charges.

Examine the statues and use the corresponding ingredients on them, using the table below. The druid spirits should give you the exact amount of ingredients needed. NOTE: If you are using a third-party plugin that hides ground items based on value, you might miss an ingredient!
If you mess up or accidentally use the wrong working combination, teleport out to bank, teleport back to Tears of Guthix and finish the remaining statues.
Once you receive all eight dolmens, use them on the stone table to open the huge door. You may use them one at a time to free up inventory space.
Leave the temple and prepare for the last fight battles ahead. Bank the Dark Squall's robes and bring your best gear.
Bring:
Equipment for all 3 combat styles
3-4 super restores
1 Menaphite remedy (one dose before the fight begins and a second dose if you need more time)
10-12 combo food (sharks and karambwan are fine)
A sapphire lantern to attract a light creature to enter the chasm
An emergency teleport (not runes, as the Elemental can lower your magic to 1 if you run out of supplies)
Proceed past the huge door until you reach the Mysterious Stone.

Upon arriving in the room, a small cutscene will happen and the fight with the Balance Elemental will then begin. It can use a magical, stat-lowering attack after every 3-4 attacks, then proceeding to change attack styles based on the player's protection prayer.
Fight overview:
Fiery / Orange -> attacks with Ranged
Airy / White -> attacks with Melee
Watery / Blue -> attacks with Magic
The Elemental will start praying against your attack styles at 50% of its hitpoints.

At 25% the Elemental will attack faster, harder and have double prayers up. Be sure to correctly pray against the style it uses, since it can hit high 30s on a 2-tick speed attack whilst switching attack styles as well.
Make sure you drink your restores if the Elemental reduces your stats or bring a menaphite remedy and drink it before the fight starts so it will restore your stats when weakened.

It is recommended that you use one of the pillars at 25% since you can exchange hits 1:1 and take your time to have the right prayer protection up. Or focus on prayers first, and then your switches, as you only have 1 tick to react. If the attack hits you off prayer it will drain your stats and prayer. (You are able to use the pillar the entire fight if you are a lower level/hardcore who is worried about death)
If you die while fighting the Balance Elemental, your grave will appear at the top of the chasm at Tears of Guthix.
Upon defeating it, search the Stone again to view a cutscene.
Fight the two Tormented Demons alongside the Guardians of Armadyl.

They are surrounded by a flame shield that reduces damage done by non-demonbane weapons/spells and non-abyssal weapons by 20%, though this should not be an issue for this fight thanks to the extremely high boost from the Stone of Jas.
They can use protection prayers, switching prayers after taking a certain amount of damage.
They can also switch attack styles based on the player's protection prayers every 16 seconds or so.

Sitting behind the south-western column and waiting for the Guardians of Armadyl to finish off the demons is viable and completely removes any combat from the encounter if you do so wish. (Very slow, but completely safe for HCIM)
Upon defeating the demons, speak to Idria and have her teleport you to White Knights' Castle.
Speak to Idria again to complete the quest.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: The Heart of Darkness
start: Speak to Prince Itzla Arkan at the Teomat.
description: Uncover the secrets of a mysterious cult and unlock a new dungeon.
recommendedItems: Combat 65 Combat level
Prayer 43 or higher Prayer level for Protect from Melee
Combat gear
Food
10 Quetzal feed, 3 limestone brick, and 4 soft clay to build the Unbuilt Landing Site in Salvager Overlook
Prayer potions or Super restore potions
Super combat potions or similar
ironmanConcerns: You will need 3-4 empty inventory slots at multiple parts of the quest.
leagueRegion: <poem> Varlamore — location requirement </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Infiltration
walkthrough.body: Start the quest where you left off at the end of Twilight's Promise, at the Teomat. Speak to Prince Itzla, who will propose you and him go undercover by infiltrating the Twilight Emissaries. As he discusses the plan, his mother, Queen Zyanyi Arkan, will arrive. Frustrated at her son's failure to protect his father, Itzla tells her about his plans to lead the infiltration. However, she refuses, insisting that he confide in someone he absolutely trusts to lead in his stead. After the Queen's departure, Itzla relents and asks you to visit a pub in the Quetzacalli Gorge to meet a trusted contact of his, who will fill you in on the infiltration operation. Head south-west towards Renu and fly to the Quetzacalli Gorge, then head to the Windbreaker pub and speak to the bartender. Ask him to rent the basement room as instructed, only to find out a basement doesn't exist; he will offer to let you rent the ground floor room for 30 coins instead. If you don't have 30 coins, either pickpocket the citizens around the area or use the bank just east of the pub. Once you have the coins, accept the bartender's offer, then head to the east room and rest at the bed. Upon waking up, you will find a disguised Prince Itzla to be your "trusted contact". He claims that there are very few people he can trust after the events of the previous quest, and that the less people who know about his mission, the better; additionally, as an outsider fairly uninvolved in Varlamorian politics, you ironically are far more trustworthy. He will then tell you that he believes a shopkeeper in the Gorge is recruiting members for the cult, and that you will pose as a potential recruit in the hopes he'll contact the Emissaries. Head out east to the Quetzacalli Gorge General Store and speak to the shopkeeper, and tell him that you've heard he can offer help to those in need. He is initially skeptical, but accepts your request to join the Emissaries, and tells you and your "friend" to head to the Twilight Temple, where he'll send word for them to expect two recruits. Return to Prince Itzla at the Windbreaker, he will then meet you at the Temple.

walkthrough.heading: Trials of the Emissaries
walkthrough.body: 4 empty inventory slots Head north-east past the gate, and make your way east past the Proudspire, then head south to the Tower of Ascension to meet Prince Itzla. He will tell you that a person named Forebearer Janus will call on the both of you when its time to be tested. In the meantime, he wishes to speak to the nearby recruits for insights on why they wish to join the Emissaries. Talk to the nearby recruits: Nova, Sergius, Felius, and Caritta. Nova will speak of the Augur, the new leader of the Emissaries, who has reorganized the cult and is said to guide them to Mokhaiotl. Return to Prince Itzla, who will explain that Mokhaiotl refers to the centre of the world, which is where it is said Ximoua will happen. As you discuss this with him, Forebearer Janus calls on the both of you to begin your trials. Before leaving, it is recommended that you bring the materials to build a landing site: 10 quetzal feed, 3 limestone bricks, and 4 soft clay, as you'll be in proximity to the Salvager Overlook landing site en route to the Temple. ====The first trial==== {{Cquote2|The aim is simple: Speak the correct pass phrase to me and you will be allowed to proceed.}} You will be in a room with three Emissary Ascended. Pickpocket one of them to obtain a tower key, which is used to open the south-east gate. Search the chest to receive a book and scrap of paper. Take note of the first letter of each white word in the book, which is the passcode for the south-western chest; you will receive a poem and another scrap of paper. The first word of each verse in the poem uses the language of the Old Ones, translated as cardinal directions: Takam = East, Makt = North, Silam = West, Uitt = South. Reference the poem to get the order of arrows for the code for the last chest located in the north-west part of the room. Enter the code to get the last scrap of paper. Combine the three for a completed note, which contains a pass phrase. Speak the pass phrase to Forebearer Janus to complete the first trial. ====The second trial==== {{Cquote2|Welcome to your next trial. Here, there is one simple goal... Survive.}} The second trial is combat-based, with Emissary Brawlers (melee) and Emissary Conjurers (magic) attacking two at a time, then four at a time. The level 86 brawlers can use a special attack that strikes the tiles adjacent to them, while the conjurers can heal themselves and adjacent brawlers. These special attacks are marked by black shadows appearing on the ground. Players should take care to move out of the brawlers' special attack as it can hit through prayer. The prince is able to dodge this attack on his own. There are a total of four waves: * Wave 1: Two level 74 brawlers initially, with two reinforcements replacing them as each falls. * Wave 2: One level 74 and one level 86 brawler initially, with two reinforcements of the same kind. * Wave 3: One level 86 brawler and one conjurer initially, which are replaced by one level 74 brawler and another conjurer. * Wave 4: Two level 86 brawlers and two conjurers at the same time, with no reinforcements. Both you and Prince Itzla must survive the trial; use the bandages from the medical boxes around the room on him to heal. There are a total of three boxes with five bandages each, and will heal 18 hitpoints to Prince Itzla. The bandages can also be used on yourself, but will heal less{{Clarify|12 HP from one source, unsure if this scales}} than when used on the prince. Lower level players who cannot clear the trial quickly should be careful to leave enough to heal him. If Prince Itzla dies, you will fail the trial and have to restart. The bandage boxes will be refilled. Speak to Forebearer Janus again to start the third trial. Any remaining bandages should be used to heal before this as they will be removed upon proceeding. ====The third trial==== {{Cquote2|Welcome to your third trial. Before you stand some recently initiated acolytes. However, it seems one of them was not as loyal to our cause as first believed. Your task is to question all four and determine who the traitor is.}} The third trial involves questioning the members of the cult - Tenoch, Silia, Adrius, and Eleuia - and working out who the traitor is. Ask each of them either why they joined the Emissaries or what they know about the Final Dawn; 'the traitor (different for each player) will always mention Mictl'''''. Mictl (the afterlife in the Losanium religion) not only doesn't exist in the religion of the Twilight Emissaries, but is also in conflict with its cyclic cosmological model, where the world is periodically destroyed and rebuilt into a new one. Once you question each member, you'll be given the option to accuse them while talking to them. If none of the members mention Mictl, you may need to exit and re-enter the floor. If the chosen member is the traitor, Janus will kill them rather than keep them barely alive; speak to him to begin the final trial. {| class="wikitable" |+ 'Traitor Dialogue (by character)'! Player Prompt!! If Tenoch is traitor!! If Silia is traitor!! If Adrius is traitor!! If Eleuia is traitor |- | 'Why did you join the Emissaries?' | To do my duty, of course. Ralos and Ranul wish us to bring about the end of this world. Only then will we all unite in Mictl. | I always knew people were wrong about me. I knew I would serve a higher purpose. I never cared what it was. I only cared that in doing so, I would be granted a place in Mictl. | To be honest, I wasn't too sure about joining at first. My friend convinced me though. Here we have a chance to be granted a place in Mictl. | I wished to see my god in mortal form and be granted eternity in Mictl. In return for my service, the Emissaries promised me they could grant that wish. |- | 'Tell me about the Final Dawn.' | The Final Dawn is our destiny. Ralos and Ranul will unite us all and end this world, but in doing so, they will grant us eternal life in Mictl. | The Final Dawn is an end, but also a beginning. It is when Ralos will use his holy fire to destroy this world. Then he and Ranul will guide us to Mictl. | They say the Final Dawn is inevitable. It's the end that we can't escape from. It's a scary thought, but at least here I have a chance to control my destiny and obtain a place in Mictl. | The Final Dawn is the will of Ranul. He will show us all that death is nothing to be feared. He and Ralos will lead us into forming a new world before then guiding us to Mictl. |} ====The fourth trial==== {{Cquote2|Victory is within your reach, but one more trial awaits... Face your opponent.}} The final trial requires you to battle Prince Itzla. He uses melee attacks, so Protect from Melee is advised. He will use protection prayers whenever you perform a special attack, and uses two in turn, both of which he will warn you about in advance. For instance, he will pray Protect from Magic if a Voidwaker special is used. The sword swipe special attack turns off any active protection prayers, but you can simply reactivate them without any delay. The other is an AoE attack, once he warns you he is going to do it, run behind him immediately to dodge. Upon his defeat, speak to Janus to complete the trials.

walkthrough.heading: The Ruins of Tapoyauik
walkthrough.body: up to 4 empty inventory slots (the icons can be done one at a time, but is recommended against) Now that you and Prince Itzla have passed the trials, the Augur herself will oversee the initiation process. Open the nearby chest to obtain the Twilight Emissary Robes, then wear them and make your way to the Twilight Temple to begin a cutscene. '''Note:' If you teleport out or walk too far, Itzla will go back to the Tower of Ascension. During the initation, it is revealed that the Augur is indeed Metzli, the Teokan of Ranul, and claims Ennius and Furia Tullus are the mortal forms of Ralos and Ranul, who were reborn as the twins during an eclipse 31 years ago. After the cutscene, speak to Forebearer Fides. She will task you with opening up the passage to the Ruins of Tapoyauik, a fortress of the Old Ones under the temple, where Metzli believes they left behind secrets to bring about the Final Dawn. Make your way to the building directly south, and climb down the stairs to the blocked passage; a barrel containing pickaxes can be found nearby to mine it. Upon mining the blockage, a cutscene will play in which you proceed further into the fortress. However, the ground rumbles, manifesting two frost nagua, killing Forebearer Vulcan and knocking Prince Itzla over a pit. 'Note:' Once you have completed the cutscene, you no longer need to wear the Twilight Emissary Robes to proceed. The robes will be required in the subsequent quest The Final Dawn, and can be reclaimed at anytime from the chest you found them in. You will now need to navigate the fortress to meet up with Prince Itzla. Run past the frost nagua (use Protect from Magic if able), then avoid the spear traps; getting hit by one will stun you and deal 6-12 damage. Once past them, 'pull the lever' and climb down the nearby ledge. Next, run past the frost crabs and make your way north, avoiding stepping on the traps by taking the middle path. You will come across a wall by an icy ledge that you can slide across. Once across, enter the north-eastern room and move around the trap before 'pulling the lever'. Move west to the frozen platforms and cross them, then climb down the western ledge. Head west to the enclosed room and 'pull another lever', avoiding the trap. Head south to find a large gate and another 'lever to pull' on the north side. Before entering, pull the chain just east to unlock a shortcut to the exit. If you need to leave and come back, climb down the stairs to enter the dungeon and head west to climb down this chain. There are four total levers to pull, each lever lighting a brazier at the large gate. ====Icons Puzzle==== When you walk west through the gate, you will find yourself in a large, rectangular room divided into thirds. The eastern third that you start in contains many urns and two murals. The middle third has a floor of ice and several frost nagua. The western third contains urns, another two murals, four statues, and a frozen door. 'Do not search the urns yet''' - whilst searching urns, frost naguas will spawn and attack and cannot be safespotted. Instead, inspect the two murals and take note of the first words used (zema, oma, yeya, naui) and the corresponding element that is visible on them. You will need to recall these word-element pairs soon. Then, run all the way west to meet up with Prince Itzla. He will help you fight any nagua that you bring near him. Now in the western third of the room, inspect the other two murals for their words and elements. Check which three of the statues are broken. Then, you will need to run back east again. In the eastern third again, search the urns to find three distinct icons which correspond to the broken statues that you inspected earlier. The icons will be found in the urns corresponding to their elements, but there are multiple possible urns for each icon. Incorrect urns will spawn a frost nagua that will attack and chase you around the room. Once you have all three icons, run west again. Finally, in the western third again, use the icons on their corresponding statues. Once you have done so, you will need to touch each of the four statues in the correct order. The words on the murals determine the order in which the player must touch the statues: Zema = 1, Oma = 2, Yeya = 3, and Naui = 4. Meanwhile, the elements on the murals determine the specific statue that must be touched. The order is different for each player. If all statues are touched, but in the incorrect order, you will take damage from falling rocks. Upon touching the statues correctly, they will unleash a wave spell, melting the ice off the door and killing any remaining frost naguas near it. The next section will be a boss fight, so return to a bank if needed.

walkthrough.heading: Guardian of the Fortress
walkthrough.body: {{Instance}} Combat gear (Melee combat strongly recommended) Enter the door to begin a cutscene in which you and Prince Itzla encounter Amoxliatl, a powerful frost nagua guarding the fortress. She will tell you and Itzla that the Mokhaiotl - or the Tlati archive - is off-limits to humans, claiming they are unworthy. Suddenly, Prince Itzla is teleported away, revealing that Metzli, Ennius, and Furia followed you here. As they attempt to deal with you, Amoxliatl claims they have defiled Tapoyauik and will face the consequences. However, as they teleport away, you are forced to fight her in their stead. <gallery captionalign="center" widths="200"> The Heart of Darkness - Amoxliatl.png|The player and Prince Itzla encounter Amoxliatl. The Heart of Darkness - Metzli and the Tullus twins.png|Metzli and the Tullus twins reveal themselves. </gallery> The quest version of Amoxliatl is somewhat easier than the regular fight, possessing 400 hitpoints instead of 520 and having more forgiving damage. Nevertheless, players will still have to properly handle her mechanics to beat the fight. Amoxliatl uses three different attacks. In her standard attack, she attacks with magic, summoning ice spikes on the player's current tile and around the arena. Protect from Magic will protect against the initial attack, but the ice spikes additionally deal typeless damage. Finally, an icy pool will be left on the tile where the player was originally standing that will deal 6-10 damage per tick. After every 2-4 standard attacks, Amoxliatl will use one of two special attacks. The first one used is randomly selected, but after that, she will alternate between them and will not use the same special attack twice in a row. If you are standing in the narrow entry path, she will not use her Unstable Ice special attack. * Unstable ice blocks: Amoxliatl forms 1-4 blocks of unstable ice around the arena. If not destroyed in time (16 ticks, ~10 seconds), all remaining ice blocks will shatter, causing icy pools to form within 3x3 of the ice blocks and healing the boss (16-25) for each ice block shattered. Ice Blocks can only be destroyed with melee, but will be fully destroyed in 1 tick regardless of the melee weapon used. * Icicle attack: Amoxliatl disables the player's prayer and launches an icicle at them. A message is shown in the chatbox: {{mes|Amoxliatl disables your prayers and launches an icicle attack!|colour=red}} Turn on Protect from Magic before the icicle hits you to negate all damage. After defeating Amoxliatl, you will forcefully be banished from Tapoyauik. Make your way to Sunrise Palace, where Servius is currently staying. You will inform him of the events that transpired, and he will ask that you leave so as to avoid the Queen's anger, but assures you that you will be involved in whatever plans are made next. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

steps: Talk to Prince Itzla Arkan at the Teomat to start the quest.
Talk to him again after the cutscene.
Travel to the Quetzacalli Gorge (There is a Quetzal landing site that is automatically unlocked).
Talk to the bartender in the south-west pub and ask to rent the room for 30 coins.
Enter the south-eastern room in the same building (there is no basement) and rest on the bed.
Talk to the Prince.
Talk to the shopkeeper in the general store east of the pub about help.
Return to the rented room in the pub and talk to the Prince again.
Go through the large gate to the north and run all the way east to the Tower of Ascension and talk to the Prince (just outside the entrance to the tower with the dungeon icon on the minimap).
Optionally, build the Unbuilt Landing Site in the Salvager Overlook on your way there if you haven't already done so.
Talk to the nearby recruits, Nova, Sergius, Felius, and Caritta.
Talk to the Prince again (make sure you don't have a pet following you, or you'll be unable to proceed)
Enter the tower to the west and talk to Forebearer Janus and climb the stairs.
Pickpocket the Emissary Ascended in the caged area on the floor 1 for a tower key.
Use the key to open the south-eastern gate, open the chest to receive a book and scrap of paper
Open the south-western chest with a keyword. The solution is different for each player.
The solution can be found by connecting the first letter of each highlighted word in the book
Read the poem, then talk to Prince Itzla
Open the north-western chest with the code, the code is unique for each person.
Transcribe the marked words from the poem into directions: Takam: East, Makt: North, Silam: West, Uitt: South
Combine the scraps of paper to reveal the passcode.
Speak the passcode to Forebearer Janus on the current floor. 'Do not go downstairs' to speak with him as this will reset the trial.

This is a wave-based combat trial, with melee and mage enemies attacking two at a time, then four at a time. Some of them do a 3x3 AOE attack which can be dodged. Use the bandages from the medical boxes around the room to heal Prince Itzla by left click Healing him during the fight as needed.
Speak to Forebearer Janus again to start the next trial.
Talk to the prince
You must question each member of the cult to work out who the traitor is. Choose the person who mentions anything about Mictl as this is not part of the Emissaries' beliefs.
Once you question each one, you'll be given the option to accuse them while talking to them.
If none of the members are the traitor you may need to exit and re-enter the floor.
Go up the stairs.
Fight Prince Itzla.
Pray melee against his basic attacks.

He has two special attacks, both of which he warns you about. The sword swipe turns off any protection prayers, but you can turn them straight back on. The other is an AOE attack, once he warns you he is going to do it, run behind him immediately to dodge.
He is immune to special attacks. (NOTE: If using a Scythe of Vitur; you must unequip it and punch or kick to finish the fight.)
Talk to Forebearer Janus.
Search the chest south to obtain a set of Twilight Emissary robes.
Equip the emissary robes, speak to Prince Itzla to have him follow you, and then enter the temple to the east.
After the cutscene, speak with Prince Itzla and then speak with Forebearer Fides.
Enter the ruins south of the temple and go down the stairs.
Take a pickaxe from the barrel near the entrance.
Mine the rocks.
Run past the Frost Nagua and the spikes and 'pull the first lever.'
Climb-Down the Ledge, run past the frost crabs while avoiding the traps.
Throughout the cave, several traps deal 10 Hitpoints of damage. You can avoid them or tank the damage.
Slide along the icy ledge, and then enter the room in the north-east and 'pull the second lever'.
Continue through the cave and jump over the frozen platforms to get to the west side.
Climb down another ledge, and run into the north-western room with stone chests to 'pull the third lever'
Walk south-west to the large gate and 'pull the fourth lever' located on the northern wall next to the gate. Note: If you forgot a lever, not all braziers will be lit and the gate will be closed.
Pull the chain before continuing, as this will allow you to climb up and down it in the future.
Walk west through the gate and search urns to collect three coloured icons.
Level 104 Frost Nagua will continue to spawn and attack you while searching. Protect from Magic will negate the damage from their regular attacks.
Fix the broken statues in the western area with the corresponding coloured icons.
Inspect the four markings in the four corners of the area. The first word describes the order in which to activate the four statues to open the frozen door.
Different for every player: check the murals and they will have Zema (1), Oma (2), Yeya (3), or Naui (4). Touch the statues in the order determined by the markings (1-4).
Go through the door, prepared to fight the final boss.
Fight the Amoxliatl.
Pray magic
Step away from the spikes
Avoid standing on the ice pools
Re-enable protect from magic when it is disabled
The blocks she summons will deal area damage and heal her, melee them to destroy them. (higher level players can leave these and just attack with fire spells)
Head to the Sunrise Palace and speak to Servius, Teokan of Ralos to finish up the quest.

name: Death on the Isle
start: Speak to Patzi by the entrance to Villa Lucens.
description: Solve a mysterious murder on the island of Aldarin.
recommendedItems: Combat 40
rewards: A costume needle from the costumer
The butler's tray and an assortment of masks from the Head Butler
The ability to unlock the North Aldarin teleport destination via the pendant of ates
leagueRegion: <poem> Varlamore — location requirement </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Getting the right fit
walkthrough.body: Travel to the island of Aldarin; the easiest method is to use the Mastering Mixology Minigame Teleport (requires Herblore 60), fairy ring CKQ, or you can pay 20 coins to take a boat from the Sunset Coast. Talk to Patzi at the entrance to Villa Lucens. He will ask that you help him with a new play that is due to be performed at the villa, whose owner is a patron of the arts and is hosting a party for the play. He will ask that you acquire a butler's uniform to help him fit in; Adala, Patzi's bag carrier, suggests "borrowing" one and tells you she recalls seeing some through a window in a villa to the north. The villa in question is found just west of the Aldarin General Store. Break into the villa via the house window on the south side once the Wandering Guard is far enough, then take a uniform from the wardrobe nearby. Return to Patzi, who will then ask that you follow along Adala to the staff entrance to blend in. Wear your uniform, then head south along the hedge until you see the Head Butler. He will inform you of the rules whilst inside the villa, and will hold onto your items before entering for security purposes.

walkthrough.heading: Inside Villa Lucens
walkthrough.body: Once inside Villa Lucens, you will be wearing one of several possible masks (snake mask, ram mask, jaguar mask, wolf mask or bird mask) and butler's tray alongside your uniform. You will find Patzi by the eastern exit, who will tell you to introduce yourself to the guests on his behalf; however, as a butler, he will ask that you at least get their names for him. Speak to Constantinius, who you find out is the host of the party, and then the three guests: Cozyac, Pavo, and Xocotla. After doing so, you will relay what you've learned to Patzi, who then asks you to fetch him a glass of Principum Red in the wine cellar. Head outside and enter the cellar entrance, then head to the south-west room and investigate the antique wine along the south wall. As you attempt to retrieve some wine from the antique wine jug, you will hear glass breaking in another part of the cellar, spilling some on you. Head to the south-east corner to find a fallen man. Upon investigating him, two guards, Stradius and Hutza, will accuse you of murder and take you away to a small room in the villa. After some questioning, you offer to help solve the murder of Livius, an actor who was due to perform on stage. They will give you a case file and ask you to investigate the crime scene.

walkthrough.heading: Playing detective
walkthrough.body: Speak to Constantinius, Cozyac, Pavo, and Xocotla again, then return to the wine cellar and investigate the following: * Jug by the stairs * Small box in south room * Broken stool in south room * Wine storage in east room * Broken pottery in east room * Livius' corpse in east room After investigating everything, speak to Stradius and Hutza to discuss your findings. You will not find sufficient evidence to accuse the guests, but believe the butlers may be suspicious like you were, and will attempt to pickpocket them in hopes of finding something of note. Pickpocket the following people for your investigation: * Cozyac - threatening note * Pavo - drinking flask * Xocotla - shipping contract * Adala - wine labels After inspecting each item, return to the guards and they will gather everyone on the top floor. Speak to all the suspects, then place your accusations on Adala, who admits to being in the cellar to steal the extremely valuable Principum Red. However, she claims not to have killed Livius and starts attacking the player. She is level 49, and has no special mechanics to attack with. Once either of you are close to death, she will stop and claim that she's too weak to kill Livius or you depending on how the fight went. She will then be taken away.

walkthrough.heading: The Show Must Go On
walkthrough.body: Though the killer is still at large, Constantinius demands that the show must go on, and asks that you keep an eye on the situation behind the scenes. He will tell you to use the back way around the theatre so as to not attract attention. Use the southern path down the steps that leads around the cliffs until you reach a set of loose rocks by the shortcut icon. Navigate through them and speak to the guards - they will ask that you investigate the backstage downstairs to check for additional clues. Enter the backstage entrance then speak to the costumer, and ask about the actors. Then search the following: * The crate next to the exit containing poison * The costume rack behind the mirror containing Naiatli's wine-stained costume * The bookshelf hiding a secret passage to the wine cellar After searching the aforementioned objects, speak to the costumer and ask her about each of them. Next, return to the guards and accuse Naiatli of being the culprit. However, the play has started already, and you decide to step into the limelight. As you accuse Naiatli of her crimes whilst doing so under the guise of improvising the play, you begin to attack her with a prop sword while she continues to "perform". Whenever she runs away, resume attacking her until she "dies". You will find out that in reality, Naiatli only tripped him in an attempt to injure Livius so that he would be unable to perform the play, but was far too drunk and fell harder than anticipated. Stradius and Hutza will thank you for your assistance and apologise for hastily accusing you. 'Congratulations, quest complete!' Before leaving Villa Lucens, players can claim some rewards: * Speak to the Head Butler in the kitchen to obtain the masks (ram, wolf, bird, jaguar, and snake) that you and the butlers wore during the quest, as well as the butler's tray you used. * Speak to the costumer for a costume needle, which can be used for Crafting in place of a regular needle, without needing any thread. * Pickpocketing Constantinius for a chest key, which is used to open the fancy chest in the wine cellar. This allows the fountain to the south-west of the villa to be searched for an icon, which is then used to activate the statue on the North-East corner of the island. This drops one water rune on the ground and unlocks a teleport destination on a pendant of ates.

name: Meat and Greet
start: Talk to Emelio at his home in Outer Fortis.
description: Bring the joy of kebabs to the land of Varlamore.
recommendedItems: Combat 60 Combat level
Prayer 43+ Prayer to use Protect from Melee and Protect from Magic
Stamina potions or energy potions
Combat equipment
Food
leagueRegion: <poem> Varlamore — location requirement </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Starting off
walkthrough.body: Make your way to Emelio's house in Outer Fortis, just outside the south-eastern entrance to Civitas illa Fortis. Alternatively use Fairy ring AJP. Recognising you as an "easterner," Emelio will enlist your help in a business venture involving something called a kabit. After you inform him that what he's speaking about is in fact called a kebab, Emelio will share his goal of introducing the kebab to Varlamore by opening up a shop. However, he'll mention that the spices and meat he ordered have not been delivered yet, and will ask you to speak to the spice merchant in the bazaar and Alba at Ortus Farm to see what the delay is.

walkthrough.heading: Supply chain issues
walkthrough.body: Head west into Civitas illa Fortis, to the bazaar, and speak to the spice merchant in the south-eastern corner of the market. Ask her about the missing delivery, and she'll tell you the spices arrived that morning; however, Ali Morrisane, her "reputable" supplier, sent them in a locked box. Offer to help her open the box, which is a four-digit PIN. Based on the brightness of the keypads, the order of the numbers is '2546'. Press the {{Mes|→|colour=white|size=14pt|bg=grey}} key to open the box, and she will send the delivery to Emelio. Next, head further west to the Ortus Farm, and speak to Alba inside the building. She will tell you the order was delayed due to a pack of wolves causing issues for the farm. You will offer to deal with it, and she'll tell you that their den is directly west of the farm. Run all the way westwards until you see a pack of dire wolves, and enter the Wolf Den to face the level 113 Dire Wolf Alpha. ('Warning': the Wolf Den requires confirmation to exit - if overwhelmed, lower-level players may get stuck inside.) The alpha dire wolf uses a strong melee attack, and can summon dire wolves that accurately attack with ranged. However, the alpha will only summon wolves if the player is within melee distance. Players can use a safespot to safely kill the alpha by quickly moving behind the stalagmites north of the cave exit at the start of the fight. Return to Alba to inform her the problem has been dealt with. She'll tell you that the meat was delivered during your time away, so head to Emelio's house to check in.

walkthrough.heading: The golden ratio
walkthrough.body: Return to Emelio's to find he has gathered three "connoisseurs" from the nearby pub, and given them the individual ingredients to try. He will ask that you find the perfect ratio for the kebab. Talk to Vincens, Renata, and Lucas for their opinions on the ingredients: {| class="wikitable" |+Connoisseur comments!Connoisseur!Ideal ratio!Formula!Conclusion |- |Vincens |As much sauce as spice and salad combined |S<sub>1</sub> = S<sub>2</sub> + S<sub>3</sub> |Sauce must be '3 portions' |- | rowspan="2" |Renata | rowspan="2" |Less spice than there is salad | rowspan="2" |S<sub>2</sub> < S<sub>3</sub> |Spice must be '1 portions' |- |Salad must be '2 portions' |- |Lucas |Twice as much meat as there is salad |M = 2*S<sub>3</sub> |Meat must be '4 portions' |} Speak to Emelio, and give him above portion amounts. Once you confirm the amounts are correct, tell him it is perfect and he will give you a test kebab that the "connoisseurs" can try out. Give it to any one of the three, who will say it's brilliant and amazing. Speak to Emelio once more, and he will move on to the next phase of his plan: marketing the kebabs at the Fortis Colosseum.

walkthrough.heading: Guerilla marketing
walkthrough.body: Emelio will give you another two test kebabs to bring to Lelia, located in the southern room of the lobby area of the Colosseum. Though initially skeptical, she will change her mind upon tasting the kebab, and will mention a free advertising spot that opened up for the next contest. She will suggests you head in, eat one of the kebabs, and fight a young minotaur as part of your advertising act. Prepare for an encounter with a level 193 enemy. Lelia will ask if you are prepared before sending you in. Once you accept the fight, you will be brought into the arena, as the Colosseum Announcer advertises Emelio's kebab. You eat the kebab as instructed, but the young minotaur will mistakenly believe you ate minotaur meat rather than buffalo, and will attack you in anger. If you die or leave the arena during the fight, you can speak to Lelia to re-enter. ==== The fight ==== The minotaur attacks with melee, can move at running speed, can path around the pillars, and is immune to binds and poison. It is weak to slash attacks. Protect from Melee will block all of its primary damage, but it can also use two special attacks: * When it shouts {{overhead|Moo!}}, it will launch a 'magic' attack. To block, switch to Protect from Magic until after the attack hits you, then switch back to Protect from Melee. * When it shouts {{overhead|Moooooo!}}, it will attack 1 tick faster for the rest of the fight. This happens when it reaches 50% and 25% health. Keep Protect from Melee on during this time. * Between 50-100% health, it will attack with melee three times and magic on the fourth. Below 50%, it will attack with melee two times and magic on the third. This rotation means it is possible to prayer flick the minotaur without taking any damage. Since the minotaur's damage ramps up significantly in the later portions of the fight due to its attack speed increasing, lower level players with limited or no prayer restoration should consume their food first and save their prayer points for later on. Once the minotaur is defeated, Lelia will be satisfied, and will tell you to return to Emelio and inform him of the good impression the kebabs made on the crowd. Return to Emelio, who will give you a premium discount on any Varlamorian kebabs you buy. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Ethically Acquired Antiquities
start: Inspect the empty display on the ground floor of the Grand Museum in Civitas illa Fortis.
description: Investigate a mysterious theft from the Fortis Grand Museum.
recommendedItems: 3,000 coins for the charter ship to Port Sarim, Ring of charos for reduced charter cost, or Explorer's ring 2 or better for teleport.
Varrock Teleport
Civitas illa Fortis Teleport
leagueRegion: <poem> Not completable, as it requires access to Misthalin. </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Museum Heist
walkthrough.body: Make your way to the Grand Museum in Civitas illa Fortis. Inspect the empty display to start the quest, then speak to Curator Herminius; fed up with how long the guards are taking, he will take the investigation into his own hands, and ask you to see if there's anything he missed. Investigate the set of tools on the ground behind the display to find out they are specialist tools, and inspect the display again to observe that the glass was tampered with. Next, talk to the nearby citizens, academics, and tourists around the floor and ask whether they had seen anything suspicious. The person who gives you the information is random for each player, but one will eventually mention a shifty individual skulking around who left through the front door and turned right towards the landing site. Speak to Regulus Cento at the Civitas landing site (not in Varrock) and ask whether he's seen anybody suspicious around. He'll mention a person carrying a case who wanted to have a go with his bird. However, Regulus refused, and the person went east to the Fortis Cothon instead. Make sure you have one free inventory space, and then head to the Cothon and talk to any Trader Crewmember. Ask them about the man with the case, and they will ask for a small favour in exchange for the information. Agree, and they'll give you some tattered sails which need to be fixed up at Artima's Crafting Supplies. Head just south of the Cothon, to the shop marked on the map with a, and speak with Artima. Tell her you were hoping for some help, and she will ask you for a favour as well; to thank the crew for bringing in her latest shipment. She will then give you the repaired sails. Use the sails on any trader crewmember, and they'll tell you a "grey-haired fella" came by and asked if he could have a go with their boat. The crew then explained to him how to charter a ship properly, and sailed the man to Port Sarim.

walkthrough.heading: Theft Across the Sea
walkthrough.body: Make your way to Port Sarim by any method you wish, such as the charter ship, the Rat Pits Minigame Teleport, or a planted spirit tree. Once there, head all the way to the southernmost dock and speak any trader crewmember about the grey-haired man. They will tell you that he wandered up north in search of some runes to get a hold of. The nearest rune store is Betty's Magic Emporium, found in the north-west corner of Port Sarim. With one free inventory space, make your way to the store and ask Betty about the man. Betty will mention that he wore a monocle, and that he didn't know what he was looking for when he arrived. She'll give you some some notes she took while trying to understand him, hoping you'll make sense of them. Based on the notes, the runes being requested are those for casting Varrock Teleport. With all this in mind, the man who best fits the description you have been given so far is in fact Haig Halen, the curator of the Varrock Museum. Make your way there, and tell him that you're looking for Xerna's Diadem; he will immediately act suspicious, claiming that he can't help you. You may now destroy the notes, leaving an open inventory space for the next section of the quest.

walkthrough.heading: Misunderstanding
walkthrough.body: Pickpocket the curator to receive a storeroom key, and use it to enter the storeroom to the north-east of the museum (right under the stairs to the first floor). Search the single unstacked crate in the middle of the room to discover that Xerna's Diadem is hidden inside, along with various other artefacts that don't seem to belong there. Return to Curator Haig Halen, and speak to him to begin an interrogation in which you press him for answers. A "Shame-o-meter" will appear on the screen; you must now select chat options that will shame him. The exact sequence varies for each player, but the most effective options are usually calling him a thief or disparaging his museum as being full of stolen goods. Once the shame meter reaches 100%, Haig will explain what happened. Haig will claim that, during his visit to the Grand Museum, he saw a thief break in and steal Xerna's Diadem. Haig will then claims that he used the combat skills he picked up during his time in the Varrock Guard to subdue the thief. However, stuck on what to do next, Haig explains that he decided to take the artefact back to Varrock Museum for "safekeeping." The player offers to omit the details of the theft to the Grand Museum, as long as Haig arranges the safe return of the diadem. After Haig agrees to return it, head back to Civitas illa Fortis and speak with Curator Herminius at the Grand Museum to complete the quest. <gallery captionalign="center" widths="200"> File:Museum storeroom.png|The surreptitious storeroom in which Haig hides his haul. File:Ethically Acquired Antiquities - shaming the curator.png|The player presses the curator for answers on the theft of Xerna's Diadem. File:Ethically Acquired Antiquities - curator visits Grand Museum.png|Curator Haig Halen visits the Grand Museum in Fortis. File:Ethically Acquired Antiquities - curator beats up thief.png|The curator beats the thief into submission. </gallery>'Congratulations, quest complete!'
