name: The Curse of Arrav
start: Speak to Elias White at the Uzer Oasis.
description: The icy waste to the north of the troll country is as mysterious as any land in Gielinor, no less because of the interest the Mahjarrat take in it. Elias White thinks that he might have found a way for you to discover more about this strange area to the north. Uncover more of the mysteries of the Mahjarrat and learn about the dark magic that was used to enslave Arrav for these last few millennia.
itemRequirements: Mith grapple (Hallowed grapple will not work)
recommendedItems: Combat 85
Combat gear, Prayer potions, Super combat potions, and food for the final fight
Salve amulet for the final fight
Quick access to fairy rings
Lumberyard teleport, digsite pendant, or ring of the elements for quick access to Zemouregal's Base
Trollheim Teleport, stony basalt, or any Ghommal's hilt for quick access to Trollheim
Stamina potion
Anti-venom or Serpentine helm with 75 defence.
Any ranged weapon (or suitable bolts for the crossbow already brought), or magic; recommended way to kill the toxic zombies during the fight against Arrav.
Emergency teleport
Lockpick unlocking code key chest towards the end to avoid small lockpick fails
ironmanConcerns: * Fletching 59 (boostable) to make a mith grapple * Smithing 59 (boostable) to make a mith grapple tip 'OR' * Firemaking 35 (boostable) for Barbarian Firemaking, to access the Ancient Cavern, and the means to defeat level 132 enemies for a 1/42.67 chance at a mith grapple drop (ideally the skeleton brute).
leagueRegion: <poem> Not completable, as it requires access to Misthalin. </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Starting off
walkthrough.body: Combat equipment, 3 dwellberries, a ring of life The player may receive Elias' message from a messenger once eligible to start the quest, but this is not necessary to start the quest itself. Players may choose to wait and receive it if they wish to read the message for immersion, but it is removed upon completion of the quest. Speak to Elias White at Uzer Oasis to begin the quest. The quickest way to get there is via fairy ring code DLQ, then running eastward towards the coast. Elias will tell you that he has made progress towards Arrav's predicament, having discovered information on an unusual form of necromancy that was once practised in the surrounding lands, matching what Arrav is currently suffering from. His research had led him to the Uzer Mastaba, where a Pharaoh Queen, known for her work on saving the victims of a Mahjarrat necromancer, is buried. According to Elias, in order to free Arrav from Zemouregal's hold, you will need a way to recover his heart while keeping it preserved and beating. As such, he tasks you with searching the mastaba for information on heart preservation, while he works on finding where Arrav's heart is being kept.

walkthrough.heading: Tomb Raiding
walkthrough.body: Enter the Uzer Mastaba atop the nearby hill. Inside, you will find various dead skeletons littered around the area. Two of these will give the player a mastaba key when searched: the first is the southernmost skeleton in the cave beyond the first room, while the other is found north-west of the stone boat in the central chamber. Searching the rest of skeletons will only provide empty waterskins, damaged armour, vases, and dust. The keys are used automatically when operating the levers in the north-east and south-east corners of the area which are behind wall traps. Ensure you search the odd markings on the walls preceding them to disable the traps and avoid damage, then attempt to pull the levers with the keys in your inventory. If you do not search the odd markings, you will be pierced for up to 19 damage when attempting to walk past them. Once the two levers have been pulled, the door to the north will then be unlocked, but the way downstairs is guarded by the golem guard. It attacks with melee, cannot be safespotted, and has a prayer-piercing special attack. When the game screen shakes and he draws his arms close to his body, it will stand in place and attack three times every two ticks, dealing up to 30 damage per hit; simply move one tile away from the golem guard to avoid this. Dying to the guard will send a grave to just outside the entrance to the mastaba. Upon descending the stairs, you will come across a chamber with multiple coloured tiles which raise and block the way, depending on which sets the player stands on. Walk on either the blue and green tiles or the yellow and red tiles on the south side to cross over to the burial chamber; if the wrong pair of tiles are stepped on after starting the crossing, the player will take moderate damage. After crossing to the burial chamber side, pull the lever to disable the coloured tiles. The Pharaoh Queen's burial chamber contains multiple statues depicting the lesser gods of the Menaphite Pantheon. The shelves to the north can be searched to receive a canopic jar filled with sacred oil. Head to the southern chamber where Tumeken's statue is found, and inspect the southern mural, which depicts the canopic jar being filled with three dwellberries and a ring of life; use the items in that order on the jar to fill it. With the jar in tow, head back to Elias. You can save a bit of time by hopping worlds, which will teleport you back outside the mastaba.

walkthrough.heading: Fort Invasion
walkthrough.body: A pickaxe Elias will tell you that one of his contacts spotted Zemouregal entering an old fort near Trollweiss Mountain, and also found an entrance on the summit that appears to lead right into it. However, he suggests bringing a pickaxe as parts of the tunnels within have been caved in. Make your way to Trollheim. Take the path just north-west of Trollheim (towards the ice gate), then enter the Trollweiss Dungeon directly west of the ice gate. Activating Protect from Melee is recommended for lower-levelled players as the ice trolls can hit up to 21. Follow the path north until you can enter a crevasse to get to the summit of Trollweiss Mountain. Once you've exited the crevasse, run directly east and enter the tunnels. Mine the rubble within the caves to clear the path; certain piles of rubble may need to be mined multiple times to be cleared, while some can only be mined once from each side before they're cleared, so you may have to run around the tunnels to mine the same rubble from different directions in order to clear it. Along the way, you can pick up the stone, granite, slate, and shale tablets, which depict a Mahjarrat attempting to avoid being chosen as a sacrifice in their ritual. Mine your way to the eastern end of the tunnels to reach the fort's basement. Players can optionally search the bookcases on the eastern wall to receive Mahjarrat notes (a-j), which are written by Zemouregal and list various living and recently-sacrificed Mahjarrat, as well as his opinions of them. Head upstairs to find that Arrav is standing before you, warning you to leave before Zemouregal returns. You will ask him about his heart, but he will tell you it is not present in the fort as Zemouregal did not want it too close to his fellow Mahjarrat. However, he will tell you to look behind the flame tapestry in the north-eastern room for something helpful. He is then summoned by Zemouregal, thanking you before he is teleported away. The rest of Zemouregal's Fort is not accessible, so enter the door to the east and search the tapestry. You will receive a base key and base plans, which depict Zemouregal's Base.

walkthrough.heading: Hearty Heist
walkthrough.body: A Crossbow (weapon) crossbow, mith grapple, insulated boots, Canopic jar (The Curse of Arrav) the filled canopic jar, Base key, base plans, combat equipment (enemy is weak to Crush.) Return to Elias, who you show the base plans to. He confirms that the base has a chamber marked as containing Arrav's heart, but it is found in the inner section of the base with state of the art security: <gallery captionalign="center" widths="200"> The Curse of Arrav - heist cutscene 1.png|Human detection spells... The Curse of Arrav - heist cutscene 2.png|A sewage system accessed via the kitchen... The Curse of Arrav - heist cutscene 3.png|... whose floor is secured by periodic energy surges. The Curse of Arrav - heist cutscene 4.png|A guarded vault door, made of five-inch thick runite-enforced steel, with a four digit access code to boot... The Curse of Arrav - heist cutscene 5.png|Special fire ray enchantments, courtesy of Zemouregal... The Curse of Arrav - heist cutscene 6.png|... leading to a pedestal holding Arrav's heart hostage. </gallery> While seemingly daunting, Elias will suggest various measures to bypass the traps: a form of insulation from the energy surges, having him distract the zombies guarding the vault door, and a crossbow and mith grapple to climb over the fire traps. Before heading to Zemouregal's Base, bring the required items for the heist, as well as the base key. Furthermore, players will be forced to enter a fight in which teleportation is the only way of escape. During the fight, players can be inflicted with venom. As such, take a sip of Antidote++ or similar proactively beforehand or after you are afflicted by venom. '''NOTE: If you're doing this all in one go, bring the filled canopic jar.''' Make your way to Zemouregal's Base, just west of where the Odd Old Man is, by your preferred method. Talk to Elias outside the entrance, then enter the base and run through the dungeon until you reach the kitchen (marked by the icon). Enter the kitchen, wear your insulated boots, and then enter the sewer system via the southern wall using the pipe. Head all the way around the path to the other end of the pipe exit to find yourself at the vault doors, ignore them for now. You can now safely remove/change your insulated boots. Make your way south to the room with three tables. Search the western table for decoder strips, and the chest for the code key. Optionally, you can search the eastern table for Mahjarrat notes (k-z), the other half of Zemouregal's writings; this reveals the Mahjarrat who dug the tunnels to his fort was Lamistard. He was discovered and promptly sacrificed for the ritual. Read the code key and take note of the four-letter code. Return north to the vault doors. Attempt to open them. An interface will appear; enter your key code in order on the decoder strips in the interface that pops up (right side of interface). Each strip will be associated with a number, 0-9, and will have an order, 1-4 on the left hand side of the strip. Use the up and down arrows to input the number and the right arrow to enter each number once picked. For example, a code key with the code "DAFE" would have the player put strip 1 on D, 2 on A, 3 on F, and 4 on E, which reveals the access code to be 9449. Upon entering the vault, equip your crossbow and mithril grapple, then click on the metal bars above the fire traps to climb over them. Do not attempt to walk across the room as you will take ~14 damage and wake up far away. There are no further traps here. Attempt to take the heart from the pedestal to initiate a cutscene.

walkthrough.heading: The Hero of Avarrocka
walkthrough.body: Bring combat equipment, the enemy is weak to Crush. Upon attempting to take the heart, your character turns around to find out that Zemouregal and Sharathteerk have discovered your presence and send Arrav to kill you. Players cannot leave the vault physically as Zemouregal blocks your path, and as such bringing a means to teleport out is recommended in case of an emergency. If you leave, you will need to bring insulated boots to return, but you do not need a mith grapple or crossbow, as the rematch with Arrav starts immediately after entering the doors to the grapple room. If you die during the fight with Arrav, your gravestone will be in the caves past the zombies and you can grab your boots before trying again. If you die at the same time you kill Arrav, you don't have to fight him again. Arrav uses a standard melee attack whose damage can be reduced with Protect from Melee. Every three attacks, Arrav will swing his axe in the direction he's facing, which will rebound back to him, dealing up to 26 damage in both directions. The thrown axe attack has a wind up time, allowing you to move adjacent or behind him and resume attacking; alternatively, you can quickly unequip your weapon and position yourself between Arrav and the axe, allowing you to catch it and strike his chest with a lightning animation for additional damage. When successful, a game message in the chatbox will state {{mes|You catch the flying axe and embed it in Arrav's chest!|colour=#229628}} Off-hand equipment does not need to be unequipped for this counterattack to be successful. Additionally, armoured zombies will also spawn with 10 Hitpoints each. They will not attack, even if attacked, and instead wander around the area, leaving behind venom pools wherever they walk. Stepping on these will inflict venom and deal up to 4 damage every tick if not moving; this stacks up to a maximum of 20 damage per tick if the player does not move. It is advised to target the armoured zombies with ranged, magic, or manually casting Crumble Undead, as melee will often lead to you walking into their venom. The player is healed and cured of venom when Arrav is defeated and the subsequent cutscene finishes. Faster attack speed ranged weapons like dragon darts are ideal for dealing with these enemies - later in the fight two at a time will spawn so it's best to deal with them as soon as they spawn with a fast hitting weapon. Due to the armoured zombies significantly negative ranged defenses, ranged attacks hit very accurately, and having a ranged max hit of at least 10 often allows one-hit kills. Upon defeating Arrav, Zemouregal will order Sharathteerk to teleport Arrav away. However, the spell is blocked courtesy of Elias, who teleports in and asks you to grab the heart promptly. He will then cast a powerful spell that binds both Zemouregal and Sharathteerk in chains. You quickly take Arrav's heart from its pedestal, causing it to glow red, and Elias will teleport you and himself back to the Uzer Oasis. <gallery captionalign="center" widths="200"> The Curse of Arrav - Zemouregal arrives.png|The player is discovered right before the heart is recovered. The Curse of Arrav - fighting Arrav.png|Arrav fights the player against their will. The Curse of Arrav - Elias rescue.png|Elias comes to the rescue, casting a powerful binding spell. </gallery> You will be surprised at Elias' apparent capabilities of directly teleporting into a heavily secured location and binding a Mahjarrat in chains, however briefly. He will remain reluctant to share his history with the Mahjarrat, insisting it is a complicated one, and quickly switches the topic to Arrav's heart; while he has it, it is not enough to break Arrav free from control, and he commits to researching this further. He will lastly note that you will not hear from him for some time, but will contact you when the time comes. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

update: The Curse of Arrav & Mobile Anniversary Update
developer: Paul Gower (original), Mod Ed, Mod Lenny (Old School)

steps: Head to Uzer Oasis and talk to Elias White. The quickest way to reach it is via fairy ring code DLQ.
Enter the Uzer Mastaba to the south, on top of the hill.
Head immediately south to the cave beyond the first room. Search the southernmost skeleton for a mastaba key.
Head to the central room with the stone boat. Search the skeleton north-west of it for a second mastaba key.
Head to the south-easternmost part of the area, and search the odd markings on the wall to disable a set of traps, then pull the lever.
Head to the north-easternmost part of the area (east of the imposing doors) and do the same.

Open the imposing doors to the west and kill the golem guard. When the game screen shakes, it will stand in place and perform a prayer-piercing attack that hits up to 28 three times in succession. Simply move one tile away from the golem to avoid this.

Climb the stairs and cross the coloured tiles by walking over either the blue and green or yellow and red tiles on the south side; if the wrong pair of tiles are stepped on after starting the crossing, the player will take moderate damage.
Pull the lever on the other side of the coloured tiles to disable them.
Enter the burial chamber and search the shelves in the north of the room to get a canopic jar.
Enter the room to the south with the Tumeken statue and inspect the southern mural.
Use 3 dwellberries on the canopic jar, then use the ring of life on it afterward.
You can log out and log back in to quickly exit the mastaba.
Talk to Elias.
Make your way to Trollheim. Take the path just north-west of Trollheim (towards the ice gate), then enter the Trollweiss Dungeon directly west of the ice gate. Activate Protect from Melee.
Follow the tunnel north until you can enter a crevasse to get to the summit of Trollweiss Mountain. Once you've exited the crevasse, run directly east and enter the cave.

Mine the rubble within the caves to clear the path. Each pile of rubble can only be mined once from each side, so you may have to run around the cave to mine the same rubble from different directions in order to clear it.
Mine your way to the end of the dungeon, then head up the stairs and speak to Arrav.
Use the unlocked door in the east and search the tapestry in the room for the base plans and base key.
Head back to Elias at the Uzer Oasis with the plans and key.
Make your way to the entrance of Zemouregal's Base north of the Digsite and talk to Elias again.
Enter the base and run through the dungeon until you reach the kitchen (marked by the icon). Enter the kitchen through the gate.
Wear your insulated boots, then enter the sewer system via the pipe on the southern wall.
Enter the other end of the pipe at the very end of the path.
Head into the southern room and search the western table for some decoder strips.
Open the chest for the code key. Read it and take note of the four-letter code.
Head back and attempt to open the metal doors to the east.
Enter your code key in order on the decoder strips in the interface that pops up.

Each strip will be associated with a number, 0-9, and will have an order, 1-4 on the left hand side of the strip. Use the up and down arrows to enter the number, using the right arrow to enter each number once picked.
Equip your crossbow and mith grapple, then click on the metal bars above the fire traps to climb over them.
Attempt to take Arrav's heart to begin a cutscene, after which you'll fight him. Activate Protect from Melee to reduce his damage.

Every three attacks, Arrav will swing his axe in the direction he's facing, dealing up to 26 damage; move adjacent or behind him and resume attacking. You can also unequip your weapon and position yourself to face Arrav whilst being behind the axe; this results in you catching the axe and dealing additional damage.
Armoured zombies will also spawn with 10 Hitpoints each, leaving behind venom pools wherever they walk. Stepping on these will inflict venom and deal up to 4 damage every tick if not moving.
Upon defeating Arrav, finish watching the cutscene and the ensuing dialogue afterward to complete the quest.

name: The Final Dawn
start: Speak to Servius in the Sunrise Palace.
description: Bring an end to the plots of a deadly cult and unlock a new boss.
itemRequirements: Any kind of bones (except sun-kissed bones) or raw meat/cooked meat
recommendedItems: Combat 85
Combat gear (melee and ranged)
Food
Pendant of ates
Quetzal whistle
enemiesToDefeat: Multiple waves of Emissary cultists (lvl-70 to lvl-90)
rewards: A lamp granting 55,000 experience to any combat skill of at least level 40, including Prayer
Access to the Crypt of Tonali
Access to the Doom of Mokhaiotl (also known as Osto-Ayak) 'delve' boss
leagueRegion: <poem> Varlamore — location requirement </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Infiltration II
walkthrough.body: Two empty inventory spaces, emissary robes, combat gear Speak to Servius, Teokan of Ralos at the {{floor|uk=0}} of the Sunrise Palace. He will tell you that Queen Zyanyi Arkan seeks an audience with you; accept to start the quest. A cutscene will begin in which you will be brought to the top of the palace, with the Queen asking you about your involvement with Prince Itzla Arkan, even though it meant disobeying direct orders from her. You admit that you helped him regardless of the consequences, but you offer to atone for your mistake. Servius convinces her to do so, and she decides to let the incident slide by proving yourself. She asks you to infiltrate the Twilight Emissaries and see what they're up to. Make sure to bring your emissary robes. Head back to the Twilight Temple (quetzal to Salvager Overlook then running south to the temple will be fastest), and head inside whilst wearing your Twilight Emissary robes, and another cutscene will play as Metzli reveals to the cultists that they have Prince Itzla captive. Itzla is defiant in front of the crowd before he is taken away, seemingly underground. After the cutscene, attempt to go downstairs; you will be stopped by a Emissary Ascended asking you for the passcode, which is "Final Dawn". :'Note': While in the basement you will be unable to unequip your robes. Logging out may return you to the ground floor, and logging out or teleporting out can remove any quest items collected there. Once in the basement, go north and then east into an offshoot. You will need to make your way past the Emissary Enforcer, who will throw you out if he sees you or you are too close behind him. Once you sneak past him, head into the next room, where you will try to get information on Itzla's whereabouts. When Metzli and Furia walk out of a room, the latter is concerned about the former's reckless actions before they leave. Search the bed from the room they came out of for a key, and then search the drawer with the key to obtain a canvas piece. There are two drawers; one in the north and another in the south, and the location of the canvas is different for every player. Use the piece on the painting, then attempt to pick the lock on the chest inside. To open the chest, simply move the tumblers by clicking on slots above them. The fastest way to brute force the lock is to simply click confirm, see if any show up as green on the right, and if not, move everything up by one. This will take no more than eight tries for the final combination. When picking the chest, if a number is blue, that means it is used in the combination but on a different tumbler. Once you picklock the chest, you will obtain an emissary scroll and attempt to leave, only for the enforcer to walk in and spot you. He will take the scroll from you before attempting to kill you for your betrayal. The enforcer has 180 hitpoints and uses a 3x3 AoE melee attack centered on himself. Periodically, he will yell a random quote (such as {{overhead|Thief!}} or {{overhead|Traitor!}}) and lunge forward, dealing moderate damage if caught in it and also having a chance to apply a bleed. In other words, all of his attacks are avoidable as long as players react to them in time by running away or side-stepping him. The player is unable to change their equipment during the fight, so it is highly recommended to have equipped the necessary gear beforehand. Additionally, players cannot use prayers or teleport out, though escape is possible via right-clicking "Quick-escape" on the exit door. Should players die during this fight, their gravestone will be placed at the entrance to the Twilight Temple. After the enforcer dies, pick up the emissary scroll, read it, and then return to the Sunrise Palace.

walkthrough.heading: Home Invasion
walkthrough.body: One of the following: bones, raw meat, cooked meat Make your way to the top floor of the Sunrise Palace, and inform Queen Zyanyi of the scroll's contents, which reveal that Forebearer Janus intends to move into a newly acquired property across from a bank as a safe house for the cult. Servius immediately recognises this bank as the south-western bank of Civitas illa Fortis, since there are no houses around the eastern bank. Zyanyi will have Captain Vibia help you capture Janus, asking you to meet up with her at the safe house, where she will ask you to set up the trap. Head over to the safe house, Captain Vibia will be located on the road just south of the building. After talking to her, interact with the south-eastern window and force it open, then climb through the window. A dog inside will become agitated and attack; use either a pile of bones, or a raw/cooked meat of any sort to calm it down; raw beast meat will not work. Pet the dog to see its nametag, which is "GUS". This is the code needed to unlock the door to the rest of the house, and you will bring Vibia in after the coast is clear. You will now need to make preparations to capture Janus whenever he arrives. First, grab the knife in the kitchen, then the sack of potatoes just outside the kitchen. Empty the sack, then head upstairs and grab the coin purse lying there. Open the purse, then head up to the top floor and use the knife on the potted fan plant with a lighter shade of green for a branch. Additionally, use the now-empty coin purse on the pot of sand for a sandy coin purse, then lastly use the branch on it to create a makeshift blackjack. With the sack and blackjack, return to Captain Vibia, and a cutscene will ensue where Janus enters the house and discovers you and Vibia before you knock him out with the blackjack and Vibia restrains him with the sack. Search him for a key, then enter the basement for another cutscene. Zyanyi and her entourage will arrive to confront Janus, who is defiant towards her and states that he is not afraid of death. Zyanyi asks you and the others to leave while she makes him talk. The screen fades to black while various sounds of an unarmed man being assaulted can be heard. Shortly after, the group returns, and Janus is found dead on the floor, with Zyanyi having tortured and interrogated him. Zyanyi reveals that the cult really intends to perform the Gathering, a ritual in which a dead Teokan is laid to rest and a successor chosen. While you question this, Zyanyi states that they intend to perform this ritual at the Crypt of Tonali in the Tlati Rainforest, where a set of doors must be opened with the blood of two Teokan, and beyond said doors is where the cult believes the path to Mokhaiotl lies. However, without Servius, the cult hopes to use Prince Itzla's blood instead, and has sought help from the Dwarves of Cam Torum, as they were the ones who had built the doors. You will be offered to depart with them (acting as a "teleport" to the city). Accept this offer to initiate another cutscene.

walkthrough.heading: Dwarven Traitor
walkthrough.body: On the way to Cam Torum, Highlord Katlo and Attala will arrive to greet the group. Zyanyi will explain the reason for their visit and asks to lead an investigation, but Katlo refuses, believing a human investigation within his city would cause friction between the dwarven citizens and the human presence. However, Attala will vouch for you given your previous assistance during the events of Perilous Moons, and Highlord Katlo will grant the group permission to search for the cultists. Attala will ask you to meet her in the market, while Queen Zyanyi heads to Tal Teklan to prepare the defences at the Crypt of Tonali. Servius will accompany you, knowing that he is not safe anywhere and may have some knowledge to contribute towards the investigation. Head further inside, and Attala will question Servius' presence, though you stop their arguing. Attala explains that only four individuals are authorised to grant human access to Cam Torum: Highlord Katlo, herself, Highseer Vandra, and her advisor Teumo. Attala believes that Teumo is the likeliest suspect, as she has enough trust in Katlo and Vandra, and asks you to meet her and Servius at Teumo's home. Teumo's house is just east of the bank; enter it, where you will meet Galna. Attala will claim that Teumo allowed them to help with a project, while Galna allows the three of you to stay but avoid going downstairs, as she claims Teumo doesn't like anyone going down there. Go upstairs, grab the beer on the table, then speak to Galna again. Offer the beer to her, which she will chug and get drunk, allowing you to go wherever you want. Go downstairs and search the cabinet to the south-west and grab one of each of the following beverages: steamforge brew, dwarven stout, beer, and wizard's mind bomb. You will need to place these on the barrels around the area. * Place the steamforge brew on the barrel directly south of the cabinet (indicated with "steam") * Place the stout directly east of this barrel (indicated with "black liquid") * Place the beer on the northern barrel (indicated with "smells like a Gielinorian pub") * Place the mind bomb on the south-eastern barrel (indicated with "bubbling") * Drink any beer from the cabinet, then place the remaining beer glass on the original regular beer barrel ("This barrel seems to be empty"). Once the last correct drink is placed, you will hear a click and the fireplace will extinguish, revealing a lever. Pull the lever, then head to the south-east room and go through the hole. A cutscene will play where you eavesdrop the Tullus twins talking with Teumo, who agrees to help them open the doors in the Crypt of Tonali, provided that they retrieve an Old One keystone from Neypotzli, which he needs to succeed in getting the doors opened. Report the news back to Servius and Attala, revealing that Teumo was bribed by the cult for his assistance, and you will tell Servius to head to Tal Teklan to see if the defences are ready, while Attala gets the guards to deal with Teumo. Attala will tell you to go to Neypotzli.

walkthrough.heading: Interlopers in Neypotzli
walkthrough.body: Combat equipment, one empty slot Retrieve combat equipment and optionally supplies at the Cam Torum bank, then make your way north to Neypotzli. As you enter, Eyatlalli will appear before you, telling you of interlopers tampering with the icosahedron behind her. She will tell you that it is a form of keystone, and that an earlier form of it remains from when the prison was built. As she must keep the Moons of Peril in check, she cannot stop them from obtaining it, though you offer to do so in her stead. She will give you a keystone fragment to locate the other keystone. Before you leave, you will ask about Mokhaiotl. Eyatlalli states that while she was created near the end of the Old Ones' time, she did hear the word at least once, and believes that it was related to hope. Head through each chamber, using the keystone to pinpoint the exact tile to resonate with the key. You will need to do this once in both the Streambound and Earthbound Caverns. If no supplies were brought, also make some potions and food in these caverns to prepare for the upcoming fight. Then head to the Ancient Prison and use the key in the room to the south-east in the section, revealing a glowing symbol. Go through it, and a cutscene ensues where you confront the Tullus twins, who have already retrieved the keystone. Ennius will call in Metzli, who teleports the twins out and orders Lucius and Chimalli to kill you. The two cultists have 180 health. Lucius uses magic, while Chimalli uses ranged. They will attack off-sync, allowing the player to flick against their attacks, and it is recommended to do so as they can hit fairly hard. Every three attacks, Lucius will unleash a triple projectile while a 2x2 mini-sun in the arena appears as a safespot. Failing to be in this zone before the projectile hits will deal heavy damage and disable protection prayers. Meanwhile, Chimalli will unleash a barrage of fire arrows that can be avoided by running away from where they would land, indicated with glowing shadows. When one of the pair dies, the other will enter an enraged state; their attacks will pierce through prayer (dealing chip damage), and they will use their special attack more often. It is recommended to kill Lucius first, since Chimalli's special attack is much easier to avoid, especially if you are using melee for the fight. The arena the fight takes place in is considered a part of Neypotzli, meaning that moonlight potions and cooked bream/cooked moss lizard can be made and used as free supplies for the fight. When the last of the cultists dies, Attala and a few guards will arrive. You will tell her that the twins managed to escape with the keystone, and she will tell you in turn that they failed to find Teumo. You ask if Cam Torum will aid the Queen, but Attala states that this is a human matter and of no threat to Cam Torum, and as such, will not intervene; however, she does hope you survive before leaving to inform Highlord Katlo of the situation.

walkthrough.heading: Crypt Assault
walkthrough.body: Combat equipment of any style for fighting cultists, melee combat equipment for Ennius Tullus, food, potions Head to Tal Teklan and find Servius, who is by the eastern gate. He will tell you that the cultists are attacking the Crypt of Tonali. Run south-east; you will find the cultists fighting the Tonali archers and warriors outside the crypt as Queen Zyanyi leads the defence to prevent them from charging through. You will face six waves of cultists (Emissary brawlers, archers, and conjurers), alongside Queen Zyanyi (level 144), Captain Vibia (level 128), and two Tonali warriors and archers (level 85). While a few more Tonali and some of the Kualti are fighting them a bit further down, they are simply there as scenery. *'Wave 1:' 2x Emissary Brawler (level 74), 2x Emissary Brawler (level 86) *'Wave 2:' 2x Emissary Brawler (level 74), 1x Emissary Brawler (level 86) *'Wave 3:' 1x Emissary Brawler (level 74), 1x Emissary Brawler (level 86), 1x Emissary Archer (level 71) *'Wave 4:' 1x Emissary Brawler (level 74), 1x Emissary Brawler (level 86), 1x Emissary Archer (level 71), 1x Emissary Conjurer (level 71) *'Wave 5:' 2x Emissary Brawler (level 74), 1x Emissary Brawler (level 86), 1x Emissary Archer (level 71), 1x Emissary Conjurer (level 71) *'Wave 6:' 2x Emissary Brawler (level 86), 2x Emissary Conjurer (level 71) The next wave starts when one enemy from the previous wave remains. While the cultists initially target the Tonali, the player can draw their aggression by attacking them, or may restore hitpoints to the Tonali using food. If too many Tonali fall, the battle is lost, and players must restart from the beginning. The cultists can run, but they don't use routefinding, so the Emissary Brawlers can be trapped behind fires in the room allowing them to be safespotted. The archers and conjurers cannot be safespotted due to their higher attack range. After the last wave of cultists is slain, another group will barge in. Additionally, Metzli, the Tullus twins (Furia and Ennius), Teumo, and Prince Itzla are all teleported into the crypt by a conjurer. Teumo activates the door and walks off, while the others, barring Itzla, rush inside. Zyanyi will get her son and order him away to recover, telling you to come with her to chase after the leaders.

walkthrough.heading: Tullus Showdown
walkthrough.body: Pursuing the leaders to a small platform, you, Zyanyi, and Vibia confront the Tullus twins, with Furia realising that Metzli had deceived them, though Ennius fails to do so. Furia also reveals that she only accepted Metzli's offer as she promised to return the throne to the Tullus family, which had been seized from them after Emperor Imafore's death. Zyanyi offers them a chance to surrender, but Ennius will refuse and instead draws out his sword and casts several fire spells around the area, separating Vibia and Furia, leaving you and Zyanyi to fight Ennius. Ennius will have both Protect from Magic and Protect from Missiles active simultaneously, so players must use melee to harm him. He has 380 hitpoints and attacks with melee, along with a few special attacks: * 'Sunfire Blast:' Circles will begin glowing around the area, indicating safespots for his upcoming attack. Getting caught in this attack will deal moderate damage and inflict a weak burn. * 'Sunfire Strike:' A row or column of sunfire through him. Getting caught in this attack will deal moderate damage and inflict a weak burn. If the player is diagonally across, he will likewise launch one across himself. * 'Sunfire Smite:' Ennius will disable the player's overhead prayers. Queen Zyanyi will usually react to the special attacks. Upon reaching 0 health, Ennius will empower himself, yelling {{overhead|The sun burns within me!}}, entering the enrage phase. He will heal for 120 health, attacks significantly faster, pierces prayer slightly more, and the Sunfire Strike is enhanced to cover three rows/columns at a time. A halberd weapon can be useful in attacking diagonally across to minimise time loss. Upon reaching 0 health a second time, Ennius will die for good, while Vibia informs the two of you that Furia was injured but managed to run away. Prince Itzla will then appear in his combat gear and insist that he accompany you in pursuing Furia and Metzli. Queen Zyanyi will initially refuse, but is persuaded to remain at the Crypt entrance to defend against the cultists.

walkthrough.heading: The Tonali Cavern
walkthrough.body: A knife blade (found in pile of Old Tools), 3 free inventory spaces for the knife blade, ancient roots, and root kindling You will need to navigate through the underground cavern beneath the Crypt. A Earthen Nagua will appear, prompting Prince Itzla to stay behind and fight it while telling you to go further ahead. Make your way across the agility shortcuts or portals to reach the other end of the chamber, where Prince Itzla will have caught up to you. Make sure to activate the strange platform, as this unlocks a permanent shortcut. Upon entering the next room, you will find both a moon and sun puzzle to the sides, both of which need to be solved to proceed further in. Avoid logging out or hopping worlds during the puzzles, as this may reset your progress. ====Sun Chamber==== The right side of the room contains a sun-related puzzle. First, inspect the statue, which is written in the Old Ones' language. Prince Itzla will be able to translate the words for you by inputting them into the message box when prompted. In order to activate the statue, both you and Prince Itzla must be at a specific altar and imbue it with Kuhu essence, found by searching the urns near the altars. The altars are not labeled or numbered in any way in game, but their numbering starts with 1 being the north-east altar and travels clockwise, with 8 ending at the north altar. The statue's wording will determine where you and Prince Itzla need to be positioned, and is random for every player. You will need to be on one altar corresponding to either the first or second numbered altar of the statue's given code, while Prince Itzla would be moved to the altar of the second altar number, respectively. The third number/word is not used (but is good for translation purposes). * Oma = 2 * Naui = 4 * Kuli = 5 * Chaki = 6 * Koma = 7 * Ueai = 8 * Makti = 10 For example, if the statue states "Naui Koma-Makti", Itzla needs to be placed by the fourth altar, while you need to go to the seventh altar. The altars are numbered 1 to 8, with the first being the north-east altar and the next number in sequence going clockwise. When placed on the correct altar, attempt to imbue the Kuhu essence. If successful, the statue will generate a new phrase. If failed, you will take 5 damage. After three successful tries, the room is finished. ====Moon Chamber==== The left side of the room contains a moon-related puzzle. You will be teleported to the side of the room, while Prince Itzla is teleported into the centre. Flames block your path forward, and Itzla can disable them by standing on the corresponding pressure plate. He will need to move back and forth so that you can fully navigate the room. Upon nearing the statue, search the old tools to get a knife blade. Then, use the blade on the tree roots across the room to get ancient roots, which must be fletched into root kindling. Then, this kindling must be used on the statue. To find how much kindling to use you will need to have Prince Itzla step on both plates in turn, and sum the total number of braziers that are alight in each case. If the wrong amount of kindling is deposited, the player will take 4-5 damage. After three successful deposits, the room is finished.

walkthrough.heading: The Truth of Mokhaiotl
walkthrough.body: Combat equipment (preferably ranged), food, potions Head into the next chamber to find Metzli, who reveals that she manipulated the cult to acquire the means to access Mokhaiotl, which she knows is an archive built by the Old Ones. She will then initiate combat, entering a ranged form. Immediately activate Protect from Missiles and fight her. Metzli has 600 hitpoints, and Prince Itzla will assist you in the fight. It is recommended to fight her using ranged since her magic defence is fairly high and many of her mechanics must be dodged. Every three attacks, Metzli will perform a special attack based on her current active style: *'Sunfire Blast:' Same as the one used by Ennius, except used twice in a row. *'Sunfire Waves:' Metzli will unleash two waves of sunfire that sweep across the room. To avoid damage from the attack, simply stand on the row/column that doesn't have sunfire on it. *'Sunfire Sweeper:' Metzli will unleash two waves of sunfire simultaneously while also summoning two white portals to her sides. To avoid damage from this attack, wait for the sunfire wave to close in, then stand on the white portal to teleport behind it. *'Triple Projectile: Same as the one used by Lucius, except used twice in a row. *'Moonfire Waves:' Same as 'Sunfire Waves'. *'Moonfire Sweeper:' Same as 'Sunfire Sweeper'. After every sweeper attack, Metzli will change combat styles, this time using magic. Upon using 'Moonfire Sweeper''', she will revert to ranged. Pray accordingly to minimise damage. Upon reaching 10% of her health, Metzli will enter an enrage phase, conjuring a wall of fire in all cardinal directions. She will not use any auto-attacks. Instead, she will target the quadrant that the player and Itzla are on. A white portal will additionally spawn to move to the next quadrant, avoiding damage from the attack. Itzla will react to the mechanic but will be unable to attack her. Upon reaching 0 health, Metzli will run further into the cavern. Head down the stairs to the west then search the skeleton on the lower level for a stone tablet, revealing that human refugees assisted the Old Ones (seemingly referred to as the Kuhu) in constructing the archive's defences. Continue around this path to the north to the next entrance to reach the final chamber. Dying after defeating Metzli will not require the player to repeat the fight. Note: With 75 Agility, you can cross the pillar shortcut on the north side of the chamber where you fought Metzli, to more quickly reach the final chamber. However, you will still need to return and take the stone tablet to complete the quest. In the final chamber, Metzli will be shocked to discover that there were no archives at all. Prince Itzla tells her that the gift might never have existed or was never meant for them to access. As he finishes, Furia appears from behind, calls Metzli a traitor, and throws a rune knife at her, finishing her off. You and Prince Itzla will then take Furia back to Queen Zyanyi. As you exit the chamber, you will be prompted to explore the area fully before returning. Inspect the statues at the entrance to the final chamber, and then search the skeleton for a second stone tablet, which reveals that the chamber was indeed named Mokhaiotl and was in fact an archive, but during its construction, something ancient awakened deep in the archive and destroyed it entirely. Lastly, attempt to return to the chamber, resulting in a message appearing that a horrifying screech can be heard within, and the player will automatically return to the crypt. Do not forget to inspect the statues in the area to complete the investigation sequence and automatically return to the crypt. Queen Zyanyi orders to take Furia to prison in Fortis for her betrayal, presumably with death, but Prince Itzla stops her from doing so, believing that while the cult is mostly leaderless, there are still supporters from the shadows. As Metzli and Ennius had been martyred, Prince Itzla suggests sparing Furia for the time being, which she accepts, seeing it as a sign of his growth throughout the entire ordeal. Queen Zyanyi and Captain Vibia will then return to Fortis with Furia in tow. You and Prince Itzla will exchange some banter, and he'll thank you for sticking by him, showing his gratitude by handing down the Arkan blade, which was passed down to him from his grandfather. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

update: Varlamore: The Final Dawn Out Now

steps: Talk to Servius at the {{floor|uk=0}} of the Sunrise Palace to start the quest.
After the cutscene, make your way to the Twilight Temple. Search the chest at the Tower of Ascension for the emissary robes if needed.
Equip the emissary robes and enter the temple.
After the cutscene, attempt to go downstairs and choose the passcode "Final Dawn".
Enter the basement, and head east toward the backroom while avoiding the Emissary Enforcer.
Enter the backroom and watch the cutscene.
Search the large bed (south room) for a key.
Open the drawer in either the south or north room for the canvas piece.
Use the canvas piece on the painting at the eastern end.
Inspect the painting and enter a hidden passage.
Picklock the blue chest for an emissary scroll. To open the chest, simply move the tumblers by clicking on slots above them.

The fastest way to brute force the lock is to simply click confirm, see if any show up as green on the right, and if not, move everything up by one. This will take no more than eight tries for the final combination.
Fight the Emissary Enforcer (180 HP AoE melee):
You cannot teleport, pray, or change gear. If you die here, your gravestone will appear at the Twilight Temple entrance.
Step back during normal attacks, and step sideways when he shouts {{overhead|Traitor!}} or {{overhead|Thief!}}
Pick up and read the emissary scroll.
Return to Queen Zyanyi at the top floor of the Sunrise Palace.
Go behind the safe house south of the western bank in Civitas illa Fortis.
Talk to Captain Vibia.
Inspect the southernmost window on the east side of the safe house.
Enter the window and use your chosen bones/meat on the dog.
Pet the dog for the door's passcode, "GUS".
Grab the sack of potatoes; empty the sack.
Take the knife nearby.
Head up to the middle floor and pick up the coin purse.
Empty the purse, then head up to the top floor.
Use the knife on the diseased off-green potted plant for a branch.
Use the empty coin purse on the pot of sand to fill it up.
Use the branch and sandy coin purse on each other to create the makeshift blackjack.
Show the sack and blackjack to Captain Vibia to initiate a cutscene.
Search Janus for a key which initiates another cutscene.
Agree to go with Queen Zyanyi to Cam Torum.
Speak to Attala in the Cam Torum market.
Enter Teumo's house east of the bank.
Head upstairs and pick up the beer.
Return downstairs and use the beer on Galna.
Enter Teumo's basement. Search the cabinet to the south-west and grab one of each of the following beverages: steamforge brew, dwarven stout, beer, and wizard's mind bomb.
Place the steamforge brew on the barrel directly south of the cabinet (indicated with "steam")
Place the stout directly east of this barrel (indicated with "black liquid")
Place the beer on the northern barrel (indicated with "smells like a standard Gielinorian pub")
Place the mind bomb on the south-eastern barrel (indicated with "bubbling")
Drink the beer on the barrel south of the staircase (indicated with "empty"), then place the beer glass on it.
Inspect the fireplace and pull a hidden lever.
Climb through the hole in the wall in the south-eastern room to initiate a cutscene.
Return to Servius and Attala in the basement and talk to them.
Head to the bank and prepare for a fight against two level 160 cultists.
Head north to Neypotzli to have Eyatlalli give you a keystone fragment.
Head through the Streambound and Earthbound Caverns, using the keystone to pinpoint the exact tile to resonate with the key.
Head to the Ancient Prison and use it in the room to the south-east in the section.
Touch the glowing symbol to initiate a cutscene.
Kill Lucius and Chimalli.
Alternate Protect from Magic/Ranged. Step into golden circles to avoid Lucius' special, and avoid Chimalli's fire arrows by stepping away from where they will land.
Once one of them are defeated, the other will start to pierce prayer and perform special attacks more frequently.
It is recommended to kill Lucius first, since Chimalli's special attack is much easier to avoid, especially if using melee.
Talk to Attala.
Head to Tal Teklan. Servius is north-east of the Quetzal Transport System landing site, east of the altar.
The Crypt of Tonali is a fair distance to the south-east, just west of Kastori.
Enter the Crypt of Tonali to initiate a cutscene.
Kill six waves of cultists; allies can be healed by using food on them. If all Tonali warriors and archers helping you die, the waves reset.
Complete all six waves successfully to initiate a cutscene. The fight will not start until after all the dialogue.
Kill Ennius Tullus (380 HP). He uses melee attacks (pray Protect from Melee), and can only be attacked with melee, using three special attacks:
'Sunfire Blast:' Circles will begin glowing around the area, indicating safespots for his upcoming attack.
'Sunfire Strike:' A row or column of sunfire through him. If the player is diagonally across, he will likewise launch one across himself.
'Sunfire Smite:' Disables the player's overhead prayers.
Upon reaching 0 health, he will enter the enrage phase, healing 120 health, attacking faster, and Sunfire Strike is enhanced to cover three rows/columns at a time.
After the cutscene, descend into the Tonali Cavern.
Make your way across the agility shortcuts or portals to reach the northern end of the cavern.
Inspect the Strange Platform, as this unlocks an entrance from the surface directly east of Tal Teklan.
Proceed north slightly, and descend east into the sun puzzle room.
Search all the urns for Kuhu essence.
The altars are numbered 1 to 8, with the first being the north-east altar and the next number in sequence going clockwise.
Inspect the sun statue for your puzzle; the wording will determine where you and Prince Itzla need to be positioned (The third number/word is not used):
Naui {{=}} 4
Kuli {{=}} 5
Chaki {{=}} 6
Koma {{=}} 7
Ueai {{=}} 8
Makti {{=}} 10
For example, if the statue states "Naui Koma-Makti", Itzla needs to be placed by the fourth altar, while you need to go to the seventh altar.
Inspect the sun statue for the next engraving.
After successfully imbuing an altar three times, the puzzle is complete.
Descend west into the moon puzzle room.
Use pressure plates to move Prince Itzla and suppress a set of flames.
Search the old tools and obtain a knife blade.
Pull the tree roots around the room for some ancient roots.
Use the knife blade on the roots for some root kindling.
Count the total amount of lit braziers from stepping on both pressure plates

Count the lit braziers while Itzla is standing on one pressure plate, tell him to move, count the lit braziers. Add the two numbers up, and that's how many kindlings you need to add to the statue. The total number will not change until you add the correct amount of kindlings.
Deposit the equivalent amount of root kindling in the moon statue.
Doing so correctly three times will complete the puzzle.
Leave the puzzle through the portal.
Follow Prince Itzla to unlock the northern doors.
Return to the surface and resupply for the final fight if needed; ranged style is recommended.
Return to the entrance to Mokhaiotl via Lift Platform (Crypt of Tonali) then traveling north. Enter the door to initiate a cutscene.
Defeat Augur Metzli. She has 600 Hitpoints, and uses special attacks every three attacks, after which she sometimes switches from ranged to magic and vice versa.
Dodge flame walls via a gap or gold symbol to teleport to a safe area.
She also uses the same special attacks used by Lucius and Ennius earlier. She may do them multiple times in a row.

Upon reaching 10% of her health, she will enter the enrage phase. She will target the quadrant that the player and Itzla are on. A white portal will additionally spawn to move to the next quadrant, avoiding damage from the attack.
After defeating Metzli, make your way to the next entrance at the northern end by using the stairs or jumping across the pillar (requires 75 Agility).

Enter the final chamber to initiate a cutscene. Note that clicking elsewhere during the dialogue will reset the player back outside the room. Should this happen, you will have to watch the cutscene again.
After the cutscene, search the skeleton next to the entrance for a stone tablet. Read it.
Inspect the Sun Statue and Moon Statue.
Interact with the final chamber to return to the Crypt of Tonali.
Finish the final conversation with Prince Itzla.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Shadows of Custodia
start: Read the notice board in Auburn Pub.
description: Solve the case of some missing people and unlock a new dungeon.
itemRequirements: Can be purchased from Arcuani's Archery Supplies in Tal Teklan or Lowe's Archery Emporium in Varrock
Fishing rod (obtainable during quest) (Oily fishing rod, Pearl fishing rod, or Barbarian rod also works)
recommendedItems: Any axe (if gathering logs during the quest)
1 stamina potion or other means of energy restoration
Combat 60
rewards: Access to the Stalker Den containing Custodian stalkers
ironmanConcerns: *A method to obtain maple logs: **Woodcutting 45 (boostable) to cut maple trees **Guaranteed from the Managing Miscellania activity (requires Quest Throne of Miscellania) **Firemaking 50 (boostable) for maple logs from the Wintertodt Reward Cart (drop chance based on Woodcutting level). **Completing Hunters' Rumours with Hunter 46 (boostable) to receive Hunters' loot sack (drop chance based on Woodcutting level) **Using Serum 208 for a 1/128 drop of maple logs from curing Afflicted (requires Quest Shades of Mort'ton).
leagueRegion: <poem> Varlamore — location requirement </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Starting off
walkthrough.body: The quest begins in the Auburn Pub. Players have several options for reaching Auburnvale: * Taking Renu to Auburnvale, then running south-west * Using fairy ring AIS, then running north over the bridge * Teleporting to Nemus Retreat with the pendant of ates (if the nearby statue has been unlocked), then running north into the town Once inside the pub, read the notice board hanging on the wall. You notice that the board is covered entirely in missing person posters, and decide to try and look for the missing people.

walkthrough.heading: Auburn alert
walkthrough.body: A fishing rod (or oily fishing rod) and one empty inventory space After starting the quest, talk to Marcus nearby in the bar, who will tell you about a strange man by the sea claiming the missing people were abducted. The man that Marcus is referring to is Ictus, who is found north-east of the sawmill. Talk to Ictus, and he'll tell you that creatures walking on two legs have been scraping against the walls at night. Besides Marcus and Ictus, you can talk to Captain Ariadna, the bartender, and the shopkeeper for more information about what's happening. Speaking to <u>at least</u> one of them is required to continue. If you don't have a hammer and fishing rod yet, it is recommended to talk to the shopkeeper in the general store as you can buy both while you're there. Next, go to the house west of the Auburn Pub and speak to Francis or Aemilia. If you haven't talked to Marcus and Ictus yet, the two will refuse to believe you want to help them. Once you've convinced them you genuinely want to help, they will mention that their boys vanished whilst playing upstairs one night. They also mention strange behaviour from the ents that night, who usually pass by their house on a regular path; on the night of the disappearance, however, the ents did not approach their house, as if the ents were avoiding something. You will ask if you can search their house for clues, and they will allow you to look around. Go outside and investigate the scratched wall. You will notice strange claw marks and a puddle of mysterious liquid; follow the trail south-west outside the town (you don't need to inspect the puddles), until you reach a river with an item hanging on a plank. With a fishing rod (one spawns south-west of the log, and the general store nearby sells them as well), retrieve the wet fabric scrap and bring it to Francis or Amelia, who will confirm that it matches what one of their sons was likely wearing at the time. After showing the scrap, head back out of town, and follow the path, which will loop around to the northern end of the Custodia Pass. South-east of the rowboat will be a cave; this is the Stalker Den, in which you will find the two boys. Speak to the injured boy deeper inside, and you will automatically bring them back to town, with Francis and Aemilia thanking you for saving them.

walkthrough.heading: Helping around town
walkthrough.body: Four maple logs, a hammer, and four willow longbows When you ask to speak to the boys about what happened to them, Aemilia and Francis will say that they're still recovering and refuse to let you. They'll ask you to inform Captain Ariadna of what happened, and when you ask if there's any other way you can help, they'll mention that the scratched wall needs to be reinforced so that the boys aren't abducted again. Use four maple logs and a hammer to reinforce the scratched wall on the ground floor. Maple trees can be found around town, with a hammer spawn located just to the north, in the building with a furnace. Next, talk to Captain Ariadna by the town gate, and she'll ask if you saw anyone else in the caves. You will then offer to help prepare the guards. Captain Ariadna will tell you that their fletcher, Antos, has gone missing and they are in need of bows; she will request four willow longbows for her team. You can grab them from the nearby bank, fletch them using the trees and flax in the area, or use the nearby quetzal to travel to Tal Teklan and buy them from Arcuani's Archery Supplies. After giving Captain Ariadna the bows and reinforcing the scratched wall, Shas and Etz will be well enough to talk to you. Talk to them on the floor 1 of Aemilia and Francis's house and they will tell you that Antos was also in the cave with them. After telling you that he was dragged deeper into the cave, they will ask you to rescue him.

walkthrough.heading: Rescuing Antos
walkthrough.body: Combat gear Grab some combat gear and head back to the cave entrance from earlier. Inside, run east to a small chamber offshoot to find Antos; you will try to get him out, but three level 93 strange creatures will attack. Activate Protect from Melee to reduce almost all damage (note that this section of the cave is a multicombat area). The creatures will also occasionally inflict a bleed, but standing still will reduce the rate at which it deals damage. After killing the last of the strange creatures, Antos will ask about the others, but you will sadly tell him that they were all dead. You will automatically bring him back to town; after the dialogue, inform Captain Ariadna of the monsters and that you found Antos, and she will thank you for your help. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Scrambled!
start: Speak to Alan at the temple of Tal Teok north of Tal Teklan.
description: Egg.
itemRequirements: Bowl of water (two spawn in town, fountain next to bank)
2 planks (south of the town near the water)
6 nails (more recommended as they can bend, 20 nails may be found on the workbench)
recommendedItems: Combat 50
Combat equipment with dragonfire protection
rewards: An Egg can be obtained by talking to the egg on the wall, which can be placed in the pet house
Alan's bones can be picked up from just south of the temple (if the player is wearing the Bonecrusher necklace the bones will automatically be buried and the player will receive 1.5 prayer xp).
leagueRegion: <poem> Varlamore — location requirement </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Humphrey Dumphrey Sat On A Wall
walkthrough.body: Head to the temple of Tal Teok, just north of Tal Teklan. You will find a tourist named Alan, alongside his egg-shaped friend Humpy Plumpy, who has chosen to occupy the temple as a squatter. He will ask that you stay as a guest and insists he prepare a feast, and requests you to look after Wumty Scrumpty while he gathers the food. As soon as he leaves however, gravity claims the life of Hampty and results in a great fall. Inspect Gumty on the ground, which prompts you to head back to Tal Teklan to look for help. Talking to any citizen there will direct you to King, the local bartender for The King's Inn.

walkthrough.heading: All the King's Men
walkthrough.body: Speak to King located in the inn about your predicament. She will tell you that she has to stay and man the bar, but has capable men who are up to the task. She will direct you to three people. ====Acatzin==== Acatzin is also in the inn. He will help you as soon as he gets his axe back from the blacksmith. Head south-west to the furnace and speak to the blacksmith, who will tell you that his whetstone has broken and needs repairing. Take the hammer nearby and repair the whetstone. He will then give you Acatzin's axe (not knowing that it is his) and ask you to repair it instead. Repair the axe on the whetstone then return to Acatzin and he will be on his merry way to Tal Teok. Before leaving, take the empty bowl on the table. ====Nezketi==== Nezketi is found at the temple directly south of the inn. In order to help you, he will need to be on top of his game - he will need tea made from damiana leaves. Agree to get his tea, and he will give you an empty cup. Damiana can be found directly outside of the south-eastern walls of Tal Teklan. While you are there, head a bit further south-west and pick up the two planks. Acquire a bowl of water; if you didn't take a bowl earlier, pick it up on a table in The King's Inn. A fountain is right outside to fill the bowl. Use the damiana leaves on the bowl of water, then head into the Tal Teklan General Store just south of the bank, and use the bowl on the oven to boil the damiana water. Finally, use the bowl of tea on the empty cup to finally create damiana tea. Head back to the temple and talk to Nezketi, who you will automatically give the tea to. Freshly energised, he will depart for the temple immediately after. ====Kauayotl==== From the temple, head directly east to the eastern entrance of Tal Teklan, where you will find Kauayotl with a damaged cart. In order to help you, he will first need to sort out his racing cart. Offer to help repair it, and he will tell you what you'll need: * Two planks - if you did not pick up two planks earlier, there are two spawns south of the city. * Nails - search the blacksmith's workbench for 20 iron nails. * Hammer - spawns on the table south-west of the workbench * Saw - spawns on a table in Arcuani's Archery Supplies just south of the blacksmith. Return to Kauayotl, repair the damaged cart, and speak to him again to have him on his way to the temple.

walkthrough.heading: Putting Humphrey together again
walkthrough.body: Head back north to Tal Teok and speak to any of the three men. It quickly becomes apparent that all of King's men couldn't put Pumpty Lumpty together again, and that replacing him is the only option. However, the three argue over which type of egg is suitable: a large chicken's, a dragon's, or a... jaguar's. You will offer to get all three and have them pick a suitable one. Head to the small chicken farm directly south of the Tal Teok temple in the north of Tal Teklan, and search the pile of eggs. A level-16 large chicken will attack; defeat it, then search the eggs again to obtain a large egg. The entrance to the Dragon Nest is found to the south-east of Tal Teok temple, across the river. Once inside, make your way to the south-east and search the pile of eggs. A level-106 red dragon will attack. Players can safespot the dragon using the eggs; defeat it, then search the eggs again to obtain a dragon egg. Head back outside, and run eastwards until you reach a campsite. Search the pile of eggs, and a level-88 black jaguar will attack; as it has routefinding capabilities, you will have to trick the jaguar by standing next to tropical tree and a fern to safespot it. After triumphing over the egglaying jaguar search the eggs again to obtain a jaguar egg. Return to Tal Teok and speak to each of King's men, who will each paint the egg to resemble Rumpty Bumpty as best they can. Once all three eggs have been given, a cutscene will play in which the eggs are judged. The chicken egg is deemed too small to be Wumty Scrumpty, the dragon egg's innate heat is melting the paint, and the jaguar egg is deemed to be the best replacement for Mumpty Rumpty. However, gravity is a cruel mistress and claims the lives of all the eggs, resulting in three additional great falls. With no options left, you and King's men must put Humphrey Dumphrey together again. There are many pieces to reassemble, but players can hover over the puzzle piece icon to view the solution. When a piece is rotated in the correct orientation and placed in the correct location, it will stay in place indicating the correct placement. Upon putting Scrumpty Lumpy back together again, a cutscene will play in which you thank King's men before they take their leave, and Alan returns none the wiser. As you head down to help him bring in the food, he reflects on his life, finally sure of himself and his place in the world. However, gravity is apparently out for blood, giving Alan a great fall. 'Note:' Players who wish to keep Alan's bones as a souvenir should ensure they do not have a bonecrusher or bonecrusher necklace on their person before fixing Bumpty Numpty, as the bonecrusher deems the player responsible for his death and will automatically crush his bones. <gallery captionalign="center" heights="200" widths="300"> File:Scrambled! - judging eggs.png|The player and King's men judging their eggs. File:Scrambled! - three great falls.png|Gravity causes several great falls. File:Scrambled! - Alan's great fall.webm|Alan has a great fall. </gallery> 'Congratulations, quest complete!'
