name: Pandemonium
start: Speak to Will and Anne on the docks of Port Sarim.
description: Embark on your first voyage and unlock the Sailing skill.
rewards: An additional Sailing 100 experience is gained when delivering the cargo, for a total of 400 experience
ironmanConcerns: (Quest info)
leagueRegion: <poem> Starts in Asgarnia but is inaccessible due to Sailing being unavailable in the Demonic Pacts League. </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Job interview
walkthrough.body: To begin the quest, talk to either Will or Anne on the dock immediately east of the Food Store in Port Sarim. They will eagerly offer you a role within their new salvaging business. When ready, you will be taken aboard their boat, and the pair will reveal that they want to collect some salvage from an old pirate wreck. They will put you in charge of steering the ship; after clicking the helm to control the ship, use the minimap to navigate south, through the Bay of Sarim, to the wreck east of the Karamja Shipyard. {{Map|align=left|name=Pirate wreck|x=3031|y=3035|r=3|mtype=square|caption=Pirate wreck location, east of Karamja Shipyard.|width=220|height=220}} Upon arriving at the wreck, Anne will ask you to lower the salvaging hook. After deploying the salvaging hook, you'll retrieve a mysterious medallion and an old cup. Will, recognising the medallion, will take it and leave you with the cup. Anne will then shove you overboard.

walkthrough.heading: Pandemonium!
walkthrough.body: You'll wash up at The Pandemonium. Speak to 'Squawking' Steve Beanie, who will recognise Anne and Will as thieves that stole a map to the wreck, breaking the one rule of the Pandemonium. He'll point you towards Ribs, the map's original owner. Talk to Ribs in the pub, and he'll share the tale of Crimson Kraken, a deadly vessel captained by the cruel and vicious pirate Barnacle Barnaby. He'll claim that now that Barnaby's medallion has been found, a curse has been unleashed, and will ask you to talk to Steve Beanie again to find Will and Anne. Talk to Steve again, and he'll mention Old Grog, who might be interested in tracking them down. In the meantime, you'll need to acquire your own boat.

walkthrough.heading: Collecting cargo
walkthrough.body: Head east out of the pub, and talk to Junior Jim on the second docked ship. After giving him the old cup in exchange for a raft, he'll inform you that you need to pick up cargo to get sails for the boat. He'll then take you to the shipyard, where you'll learn how to customize your boat (or in this case, raft). Pick up a hammer and saw from the two open crates to the south, then board the gangplank. On your raft, build a cargo hold in the facilities hotspot, then use the gangplank to disembark your raft and return to Junior Jim. After giving you a Captain's log, he'll ask you to head over to Port Sarim to collect the cargo. Use the gangplank to the north east to board your raft, then use the helm to navigate and travel north past the shipyard to Port Sarim. Use the buoy just south of the southernmost dock to dock your raft, then use the gangplank to the north to disembark. Take cargo from the ledger table at the western end of the dock. 'You must unequip weapons before carrying cargo.' Return to the gangplank to board your raft, then open the basic cargo hold to deposit your cargo. Navigate south back to the docks of The Pandemonium, parking within the perimeter of the buoys. Open the basic cargo hold and withdraw the crate, then use the gangplank to the north west to disembark. Deposit the cargo on the ledger table at the western end of the dock, and talk to Junior Jim to let him know you delivered his cargo. Finally, talk to Steve Beanie in the pub for an update on Will and Anne, and he'll introduce you to Old Grog, who'll agree to help track them down. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

steps: Talk to Will or Anne at the south docks of Port Sarim to accept their shipwreck salvaging job.
Navigate the helm to take control of the ship.
Navigate south through the Bay of Sarim until you reach east of the Karamja Shipyard.
Click the minimap or water to set your heading in that direction.
Click to trim the sails when a gust of wind arises for a speed boost.
Un-set the sails when Will says you have arrived.
Deploy the salvaging hook, after which you will be pushed overboard.
Talk to 'Squawking' Steve Beanie at the Pandemonium Pub.
Talk to Ribs just to the north to discuss the map.
Talk to 'Squawking' Steve Beanie again.
Head east to the docks and talk to Junior Jim to get a raft in exchange for the salvaged old cup. He will take you to the shipyard.
If needed, take a hammer and saw from the crates just to the south.
Board the gangplank to your raft and build a cargo hold in the facility hotspot.
Disembark the gangplank and talk to Junior Jim again to return to the Pandemonium and receive a Captain's log.
Board the gangplank to the north-east.
Navigate north through Mudskipper Sound and the Bay of Sarim until you reach Port Sarim.
Optionally use the buoy to dock your raft, then disembark the gangplank.
Take cargo from the ledger table near the docks and board the gangplank again.
Open the basic cargo hold to store the cargo.
Navigate back to the docks at the Pandemonium.
Open the basic cargo hold and withdraw the cargo.
Disembark the gangplank and deposit the cargo at the ledger table.
Talk to Junior Jim to let him know you delivered his cargo.
Talk to 'Squawking' Steve Beanie in the pub for an update on Will and Anne.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Prying Times
start: Steve Beanie on the Pandemonium might be able to help you with prying open crates.
description: Help Steve Beanie recover some 'pirate treasure' and unlock the crowbar, a useful Sailing tool.
itemRequirements: Hammer or Imcando hammer (obtainable during quest)
recommendedItems: Combat 10
{{Coins|120}} coins or ring of charos(a) for four trips via charter ship between The Pandemonium and Port Sarim
Leave your boat docked at Port Sarim if using charter ships
rewards: Unlimited crowbars from the crate of crowbars
ironmanConcerns: *A method to obtain a redberry pie: **Cooking 10 Cooking to cook one. A pie dish can be found in the Varrock Palace kitchen, and redberries can be picked just west of the South-east Varrock mine **Purchased from Romily Weaklax in the Cooks' Guild with Cooking 32 and a chef's hat **Partial completion of Perilous Moons to purchase a Redberry pie from Yarnio
leagueRegion: Not accessible in the Demonic Pacts League

walkthrough.heading: Starting off
walkthrough.body: Captain's log Make sure you have at least one task slot open and the captain's log in your inventory, then make your way to The Pandemonium. You can save some time in this section by leaving your boat docked at Port Sarim, taking a charter ship to The Pandemonium, then returning to Port Sarim via charter ship after Steve gives you the task. Speak to 'Squawking' Steve Beanie in The Pandemonium Pub and ask if he has heard any word from Old Grog. Old Grog hasn't returned yet, but in the meantime Steve wants you to collect some precious pirate looty from Port Sarim. Steve will add a Port Task to your captain's log. Travel to the Port Sarim dock and take the crate of looty from the ledger table, then board your vessel and deposit the crate into the cargo hold. Sail south, back to The Pandemonium, dock your boat, withdraw the crate of looty from the cargo hold, and disembark the vessel. Deposit the crate at the ledger table on The Pandemonium docks. Return to Steve, and tell him you delivered the cargo, and he'll encourage you to find a "special key" to open the crate. Pick up a hammer from the crate next to Junior Jim if you didn't bring one.{{Map|align=right|height=200|width=200|zoom=2|mtype=square|x=3014|y=2999|r=1|stroke=#FF0000|caption=Sealed Crate Location}}

walkthrough.heading: Key findings
walkthrough.body: redberry pie, steel bar, hammer Travel to Thurgo, in his hut with the anvil south of Port Sarim. Ask for help with the key; he'll say he needs a steel bar, a hammer, and a redberry pie, which he'll use to make a crowbar. Give him the items, then return to The Pandemonium. Return to the pub and talk to Steve about the "special key," and he'll ask you to test it out on another crate before using it on his precious pirate looty. Return to the docks to board your vessel, then sail to the north-west island off of The Pandemonium to find a sealed crate. From your vessel, pry open the sealed crate to find a bottle of fish bladder stout. 'If you want to skip the following fight, return to the buoys before drinking it'. Drink the stout and either defeat the drink troll that spawns or disembark to despawn it, then return to The Pandemonium and talk to Steve for the final time. Open the crate behind Steve to finish the quest. ::::'Congratulations, quest complete!' {{Clear}}

steps: Talk to 'Squawking' Steve Beanie in the the Pandemonium Pub, with your Captain's log in your inventory, to accept the courier task. Note: you must have an empty courier task slot to accept.
Sail to Port Sarim and take cargo from the ledger table.
Board your vessel and deposit the crate into the cargo hold.
Sail south to The Pandemonium.
Dock your boat, withdraw the crate of pirate looty from the cargo hold, and disembark the vessel.
Deposit the crate at the ledger table on The Pandemonium docks.
Talk to 'Squawking' Steve Beanie.
Head south of the Port Sarim docks and talk to Thurgo. or depending on if Below Ice Mountain has been completed.
Fairy ring AIQ is closest to Thurgo; you can return to Pandemonium via Captain Tobias from Port Sarim (30 coins).
Head back to Steve.
Sail to the north-western island of Pandemonium to find a floating sealed crate.
Take the crowbar from your cargo hold and pry open the crate.
Drink the bottle of fish bladder stout.
Defeat or disembark from the drink troll that spawns on the boat.
Return to Steve.
Open the sealed crate behind Steve with the crowbar.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Current Affairs
start: Start the Quest by speaking to Arhein on the Catherby docks.
description: Help Arhein get past some political red tape and unlock the current duck, a useful Sailing tool.
recommendedItems: 'Highly recommended:' A boat docked at the Catherby docks - you will be required to sail nearby at the end of the quest
leagueRegion: <poem> Takes place in Kandarin but is inaccessible due to Sailing being unavailable in the Demonic Pacts League. </poem>

walkthrough.heading: Duck troubles
walkthrough.body: charcoal (obtainable during this section) {{Map|align=right|2835,3418|mtype=pin|caption=The starting point for tracking the current.}} Talk to Arhein on the northern end of the Catherby docks, and ask him what's with the duck. He explains that a travelling salesman claimed a duck is able to accurately track currents. Unfortunately, Arhein is unable to test that theory, as the local councillor is threatening to fine Arhein for using non-human workers. After offering your help, he suggests you might want to talk to Councillor Catherine. Find her in the council office in north-east Catherby, just north of the Archery shop. Ignoring your concerns, she points out that you are not registered as a sailor to do business in Catherby, and hands you the form cr-4p to fill in. If you didn't bring charcoal, search the cabinet and grab some. Click on the form with the charcoal in your inventory, and you will be presented with a series of nonsensical questions with three options. 'You can select any responses you want, but you will need to repeat the same answers later'. This can be simplified by simply picking the first answer every time, as the order of the answers do not change later when being quizzed. Speak to her again to return the form. She explains that any change to the by-laws requires approval from the Mayor of Catherby, but the Catherby Data Protection Regulation prevents her from sharing their location. Return to Arhein and ask him about the mayor. He explains that the mayor recently died; there have been 25 consecutive mayors, all of which have been fish. As nobody other than Catherine wanted the job, the citizens used fish to prevent her from becoming mayor. You need to sneakily replace the latest mayor before she realises, and Arhein suggests that Harry at the nearby fishing shop could help.

walkthrough.heading: Fishing a mayor
walkthrough.body: 50 coins Harry is located in the most eastern building in Catherby. Tell him you are here about the mayor, and he will sell you a mayoral fishbowl and tiny net for 50 coins. Fish the Mayor of Catherby from one of the two aquariums in the shop. Show Arhein the mayor and he will give the fish a mayoral chain and tell you to return to Catherine. Speak to her and after showing the mayor, she will refuse to do anything until you've reviewed your form cr-4p and ensured all the information is correct. Repeat your answers from before. 'Note': If you make any mistakes, Catherine will ask you to repeat only the incorrect answers after finishing the form, allowing you to choose new responses each time until they’re correct. After successfully confirming your answers, she gives you form 7r4-5h. Use it on the Mayor of Catherby to sign it, then return it to Catherine to finally change the by-law.

walkthrough.heading: Charting the current
walkthrough.body: Inform Arhein that the by-law has been changed. He will hand you his duck; he wants you to take it out on the ocean to test the theory. Head east in your boat until you find a ripple in the water just west of the Obelisk of Water. While on top of the ripple, click on the current duck to track the current. Follow the duck until it arrives at the shore where Holgart is. Collect the duck and return to Arhein to tell him you've charted the currents. He thanks you for your help and lets you keep the current duck and mayor. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

steps: Talk to Arhein on the Catherby docks.
Talk to Councillor Catherine in the council office in north-east Catherby.
Fill in form cr-4p with any information, and 'remember what you chose.'
If you need charcoal, search the nearby cabinet.
Talk to Councillor Catherine again.
Talk to Arhein.
Talk to Harry at the fishing shop in east Catherby. He will sell you the mayoral fishbowl and tiny net for 50 coins.
Fish in the aquarium next to Harry to catch a mayorfish.
Talk to Arhein again to receive his mayoral chain.
Talk to Councillor Catherine again and match the answers you gave earlier.
Use form 7r4-5h on the Mayor of catherby to sign it. Return the form to Catherine.
Talk to Arhein again to receive the current duck.
Board your boat to the south and sail east to find a small ripple in the water by the Obelisk of Water.
When near the ripple, click on the current duck on your inventory to set it in the water.
Follow the duck until you get to the shore (near where Holgart is) and collect the duck.
Talk to Arhein again.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: Troubled Tortugans
start: Talk to Floopa, an Injured Tortugan, on a Remote Island in the Unquiet Ocean.
description: Help a stranded tortugan and gain access to the Great Conch.
itemRequirements: Any axe (a bronze axe can be found during the quest, but bringing a better one is recommended for cutting 10 logs)
Hammer (obtainable during the quest) or Imcando hammer
Saw (obtainable during the quest) or Amy's saw
recommendedItems: At least 4 free inventory spaces (or up to 22 for all the construction materials at once)
Combat 60
Food and combat gear
Stamina Potion
rewards: Access to the Great Conch and its facilities (such as the fairy ring CJQ and notice board)
leagueRegion: Not accessible in the Demonic Pacts League

walkthrough.heading: Finding Floopa
walkthrough.body: Using your boat, head to the remote island north-west of The Great Conch, marked on the map with the quest icon. Talk to the injured tortugan to attempt to help her, and she will decline your assistance. Eventually, the tortugan will reluctantly accept your aid, and ask you to make some bandages with nearby resources. Shake the palm trees for a palm leaf, then pick up a nearby seaweed spawn, and use the items on each other to create makeshift bandages. Give the bandages to the tortugan, who will then introduce herself as Floopa. Offer to take Floopa home and she'll again refuse your help, this time believing that returning home would mean failing everything. Eventually, she will begrudgingly agree, and let you bring her back home to the Great Conch. Floopa will then board your boat, who will remain there even if the boat capsizes or is abandoned.

walkthrough.heading: The Great Conch
walkthrough.body: Sail south-east from where you found Floopa, making your way to the pier at the southern end of the Great Conch. Disembark and head up the docks to find Floopa, alongside Elder Korel. :'Note': Fairy ring CJQ will now be unlocked, allowing you to return to the island at any time. Speak to Floopa, and Elder Korel will send her to Elder Raley's hut. Elder Korel will then ask you to leave, as the tortugans are not fond of humans; you'll insist on staying until she recovers, causing Elder Korel to allow you on the island as a "tourist." He will mention that in order to stay permanently, you will need to become a honorary tortugan. He will then direct you to Elder Raley's hut, found just east of the entrance to the town (marked on the map with a range icon ).

walkthrough.heading: Making repairs
walkthrough.body:
hammer, saw, axe, 10 jatoba logs, 6 sea shells, 6 tortugan scutes Speak to Floopa inside Elder Raley's hut, and Elder Raley will tell her that the village was attacked by gryphons. While no one died, the village was damaged in the scuffle. They will then notice you, with Floopa surprised to see that you were still waiting for her. You explain to them that Korel allowed you to stay as a tourist, and offer to help fix the damage, causing Elder Raley to thank you and give you a list of repairs. You will now need to make six repairs in the town centre, marked by several shop icons. Each repair gives 80 Construction experience. {| class="wikitable lighttable"!Repair!Location!Items needed |- |Krill's wall |House north of the marketplace |2 {{Plink|Tortugan scute|txt=Tortugan scutes}}

walkthrough.heading: Tracking the attacker
walkthrough.body: Axe, combat gear As you return, Floopa will lament the permanent damage to her flipper. Raley will reassure her that the village will be there for her, at which point you will inform Raley that the repairs are done. Elder will now ask for your help finding and killing the gryphon that attacked the village, saying it's only a matter of time before it returns. Since the gryphon was injured in battle, it wasn't able to fly away; however, it retreated into the forest, and you'll now have to track it. Head to the statue in the centre of the village and inspect it to reveal some tracks. Follow these tracks west, then examine the spiky red plant found at the split in the path. Follow the tracks north, and inspect the rockslide, then continue north once more and inspect the plant immediately east of the passage entrance. You'll come to a cluster of three plants; inspect the eastern plant to find the final set of tracks, which takes you to a cave entrance. Use your axe to clear the growth blocking the cave, and enter it to begin a fight with a level 95 gryphon. The gryphon only attacks with melee, but it will also use a special attack that knocks the player back and deals moderate damage if their 'worn weight' is not high enough. To avoid taking any damage, simply stand next to the wall and pray Protect from Melee. Once the gryphon is dead, report back to Elder Raley.

walkthrough.heading: Pearl in peril
walkthrough.body: combat gear, prayer, food, and a tortugan shield You'll return to Elder Raley's hut to find Elder Korel informing him of another gryphon attack, this time on the Little Pearl. Elder Korel will immediately depart, as this is where tortugans lay their eggs. Elder Raley will ask you to help Elder Korel, but since the gryphon appears to be one of the larger ones, he'll direct you to Elder Blunn for further preparation. Grab any gear, food and supplies from the bank before speaking to Elder Blunn, then speak to him in the marketplace to receive a tortugan shield. Head back to the dock and sail to the Little Pearl, which is south-east from the dock. When you arrive, you will see a cutscene in which a strange ship quickly departs, leaving elders Korel, Hubber, and Root engaged in battle with a shellbane gryphon. ==== The fight ==== As soon as the cutscene ends, the gryphon will attack. Activate Protect from Melee if attacking from up close, otherwise go with Protect from Missiles and stand near the ocean shore where the gryphon can't reach you directly. The tortugan shield 'must be equipped' for the entire fight, or else the gryphon's attacks will deal heavy damage that ignores protection prayers. The gryphon will use both melee and ranged auto-attacks and occasionally line up a special attack: {| class="wikitable"!Attack!Attack!Negation |- |Slam |The gryphon will knock the player back and deal heavy damage if 'worn weight' is less than 40kg. |Wear heavy equipment, or any items with a Gold helmet. Alternatively, stand out of reach; behind a tree or eggs, or near the ocean shore. |- |Whirlwinds |The gryphon will flap its wings, creating whirlwinds on the player's location that can hit for 50+. |Moving around during the flapping sequence will prevent the whirlwind from growing and hurting you. |- |Corrosive spit |The gryphon will spit orange acid on the player's current tile, causing a corrosion effect. |Step at least one tile away from the spit before it lands. |} If you die during the fight, your gravestone will appear where you last docked, and the ship you moored at the Little Pearl will be considered Lost, requiring recovery at a Shipwright. Dying to the Gryphon's whirlwind attack after reducing its HP to 0 will still progress the quest. Players having trouble fighting the Gryphon may hide behind the palm trees and let the Tortugans lower its health to 20 hitpoints. Speak to Elder Korel after killing the gryphon, and he will question how the gryphon went so far from the conch. You will then tell him about the strange ship with red sails leaving the island as you came, and he'll suggest you inform Elder Raley. Head back to Elder Raley's hut and tell him and Floopa about the ship, and Floopa recalls being betrayed by her crew and thrown overboard. She'll comment that might be a connection between the events, but will need time to think about it further. Raley will tell her to rest and allows you to explore the island in the meantime, promising to call you when Floopa has recovered. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'

steps: Talk to the Injured Tortugan on the remote island north-west of The Great Conch, far south of The Pandemonium.
Pick up some seaweed. Shake any palm tree and pick up a palm leaf.
Use the seaweed on the palm leaf to make a bandage.
Talk to the Injured Tortugan.
Floopa will board your boat automatically. Sail to the south shore of The Great Conch.
Disembark and talk to Floopa on the Docks.
Enter the village to the north and speak with Elder Raley (first house on the right, south-east of town) to receive a list of repairs.
Acquire the following repair materials; this can be done in batches if low on inventory space:
A saw can be found in Elder Raley's house if you did not bring one.
Take a hammer from the building with the anvil and furnace.
Pick up 6 Tortugan Scute scattered around town.
Run west and chop 10 Jatoba Logs from the Jatoba Trees (there is a bronze axe which can be picked up from a tree stump north of the calquat tree patch).
Pick up 6 sea shells near beach (closest spawn is to the south-east of town).
Repair Elder Krill's stall (the fish stall on the north side of the marketplace):
1 sea shell, 1 Tortugan scute, 2 Jatoba logs.
Repair the south wall of Elder Krill's store (directly north of his marketplace stall):
2 Tortugan scute, 2 Jatoba logs.
Repair the north wall of Elder Strom's store (west of the marketplace):
2 Tortugan scutes, 2 Jatoba logs.
Repair Elder Strom's crate (On the west side of the marketplace, east outside of his store):
2 sea shells, 1 Jatoba log.
Repair Elder Coco's stall (on the south side of the marketplace - Crafting stall)
1 sea shell, 1 Tortugan scute, 2 Jatoba logs.
Repair Elder Coco's crate (directly south of his marketplace stall, north of the building)
2 sea shells, 1 Jatoba log.
Speak to Elder Raley again.
Track the Gryphon:
Inspect the monument in the center of the market to reveal footprints.
Where the trail ends, inspect nearby objects like flowers, rockslides, and plants to pick up the trail again.
Clear the roots blocking the cave entrance with your axe.
Enter cave and defeat the Gryphon (level 95).
Exit the cave and return to Elder Raley in town.
You can climb the rocks south of the cave (with level 50 Agility) for a quick way back to town.
Talk to Elder Blunn at the north-eastern stall in the marketplace to receive a Tortugan shield, a cape-slot item. Keep this equipped for the fight!
Use the bank in town to prepare for battle.
Sail to The Little Pearl, south-east of The Great Conch.
Disembark and a cutscene will play. Immediately after the cutscene, the battle will begin. Defeat the shellbane gryphon.
Use either Protect from Melee or Ranged.

Fighting with Ranged or Magic is recommended to negate one of his mechanics. This fight can be done without taking damage if using ranged and mechanics are handled properly, but supplies are still suggested.
It can charge you and perform a knockback that hits for up to 65 damage if your 'equipped' weight is under 40 kg. If blocked by a tree or eggs, it will not perform this.
It will occasionally spit out an orange orb. Move 1 tile away.

When "The gryphon aggressively flaps it wings..." is displayed in the chatbox, whirlwinds will spawn under you for a few seconds and then explode shortly after. Move repeatedly off of the affected tiles to avoid damage.
'''Don't leave yet''': Talk to Korel about the strange ship you saw.
Return to The Great Conch and talk to Elder Raley again.
'Congratulations, quest complete!'

name: The Ides of Milk
start: Speak to Cassius by the Lumbridge pond.
description: Lumbridge, the iconic city for all the fresh-faced arrivals and budding adventurers. Home to regular citizens of Gielinor, they chop the trees, work the fields, and tend to the animals of the realm, except there has been a disturbance in the nearby cow pen and the steaks have never been higher! Distress runs through the herd and while they have always feared adventurers claiming their lives, a new threat has entered their domain bringing the beef...
rewards: Access to Brutus, the cow boss.
A magic lamp providing 1,000 experience in any combat skill, including Prayer.
leagueRegion: <poem> Not completable, as it requires access to Misthalin. </poem>

walkthrough.heading: The cash cow
walkthrough.body: Speak with Cassius by the Lumbridge pond, just south of the windmill. He will offer you a partnership in his future milk empire, and ask you to question Seth and Gillie Groats about how they've made their animals so productive. Gillie Groats can be found inside the Lumbridge cow field, just north of the gate. Talk to her and she'll say that happiness is the secret to better milk production, and suggest you talk to her father. Seth Groats can be found inside the house by the chicken coop, slightly north-west of the cow field. He will recommend his book, The Groats Principles, which discusses his approach to husbandry. Search the shelves on the southern wall to obtain it, and return to Cassius. Cassius will snatch the book away, and offer a milk sample. Drink the sample to discover that his milk tastes awful. Although the player takes 1 poison damage, they will 'not' be poisoned and cannot die. Speak to him again, and he will give you another milk sample for Duke Horacio to try, in order to convince the Duke to give you a permit for selling the milk.{{Clear|left}}

walkthrough.heading: A milketoast product
walkthrough.body: Duke Horacio can be found in Lumbridge Castle on the floor 1. Ask about the permit, and he'll refuse to issue it without the Groats' approval, seemingly worried about their potential response. He will ask you to speak with Gillie directly. Return to Gillie and offer her the sample. She'll be apprehensive about drinking a strange liquid, and ask you to drink the sample instead. Drink it (no damage will be dealt this time) to find that it tastes even worse than the first one. Gillie will comment that she might be helping people out by refusing to give a permit, given how bad the milk seems to be. You will then ask if there's anything you can do to convince her to give you one, and she'll mention that an aggressive bull has been disrupting her herd, saying that if you deal with it, she'll authorize the permit. Head to the gate north east of her and prepare for a fight. {{Clear|left}}

walkthrough.heading: Grabbing the bull by its horns
walkthrough.body: {{Instance}} {{see also|Bull/Strategies}} Upon entering the north-eastern gate you will need to fight the bull. If you wish to leave during the fight, run south-west to the gate to escape. The bull attacks using melee with a max hit of 3. However, this cannot kill the player during the quest, as they will always hit for 0 if the player is at 1 Hitpoint. After three melee attacks, he will also start using his special attacks after 1-6 hits. The damage of both special attacks scale with the player's Hitpoints level, with a max hit of upwards of 19. This damage is 'NOT' mitigated like his auto-attacks, and will kill the player if they hit. Low level players can expect to be hit for around 30-40% of their health by the special attacks. This damage ignores protection prayers, but may be avoided entirely by moving out of the way before Brutus moves. * When the bull {{overhead|*snorts*}}, he will then slam the ground and hit a number of tiles around the player, either a 3x1 row (if the player is adjacent to him) or an L shape (if the player is diagonal to him). This attack can be fully avoided by stepping two tiles 'to either side' or one tile 'backwards'. * When the bull {{overhead|*growls*}}, he is about to charge towards the player. This attack can be fully avoided by stepping two tiles 'to either side'. After defeating the bull, your player will pick up the tag he drops and it reveals the bull was Brutus, Cassius' supposed business associate. Return to Gillie and let her know that the bull belonged to Cassius. She'll tell you to confront him; return to Cassius, and it is revealed that he was stealing milk from Seth's cow herd, and Brutus' aggression disrupting the herd was causing them to produce bad milk. He then chastises you for killing Brutus, and refuses to speak to you further. 'Congratulations, quest complete!' After completing the quest, return to Gillie to receive the additional quest rewards.

name: The Red Reef
start: Talk to Elder Raley at his home on the Great Conch.
description: Investigate the dealings of the Red Reef Trading Company and gain access to some trees to cut.
itemRequirements: Cannons on your boat for ship combat, or Magic/Ranged gear to skip it
recommendedItems: Combat 65
Prayer 40 for Protect from Missiles during boat combat.
Mahogany repair kits or better
enemiesToDefeat: 2 pirate ships (or the crew on the ship)
rewards: Ability to unlock Red Rock as a teleport destination on the Sailor's amulet by inspecting the Sailors' Marker just west of the bank
leagueRegion: Not accessible in the Demonic Pacts League

walkthrough.heading: Troubled Tortugan
walkthrough.body: {{Bug|You may be unable to start the quest if you have just levelled to the skill requirements, or just completed Troubled Tortugans. Relogging should fix this. {{fact|Confirmation needed}}}} Speak to Elder Raley at his house just south of the bank at the Summer Shore. He asks whether you've seen Floopa, who has wandered off somewhere. You'll offer to look for her, and Raley recommends that you ask around town whether they've seen her. {{Map|mtype=pin|3196,2466|caption=Elder Katt, by the Sacred Grove entrance.|align=right|width=200|height=200}} Speak to any tortugan in the Summer Shore marketplace, and they'll direct you to the Sacred Grove to the north-east. Speak to Elder Katt, who will permit you temporary access to the Grove. Upon entering the Grove, speak to Floopa to the north-west, who will tell you that she was just out to gather camphor logs, but is taking a while due to her injury. She further says that the camphor wood is for a new spear, and upon pressing her for details, she reveals that she recognized the ship that sailed away from the Little Pearl during the events of Troubled Tortugans, which is a ship owned by the Red Reef Trading Company. Once a navigator for their flagship, The Zenith, she was betrayed by Spencer Brentwood, the company's founder, who caused the events that resulted in her injury. You will offer to investigate the trading company on her behalf while she recovers, and she tells you that their headquarters is on Red Rock, to the far west of the Great Conch.

walkthrough.heading: Problem Solving
walkthrough.body: Make your way to Red Rock via boat. :'Tip:' While in Red Rock, inspect the Sailors' Marker next to Shipwright Sylvia to unlock the teleport for the sailor's amulet. Head to the building headquarters to the west and speak to the receptionist, who will set you up with a meeting with her superior, Theodore Paxton, after hearing of your need for employment. She will tell you to inspect the displays detailing the company's history while you wait. Start with the display closest to the door, and move anti-clockwise to view the displays in chronological order. Once all four displays have been inspected, players will be able to speak to Theodore Paxton in the southern part of the building. Theodore will ask that you help deal with a pirate captain named Black Eye Bethel, who has been attacking the company's ships. He will ask that you sail to their hideout at Last Light and "put an end to her and her ships". {{Clear}}

walkthrough.heading: Last Light
walkthrough.body: {{Instance}} Sail south towards Last Light, and the The Bark of the Bight and The Four of a Kind will appear upon approaching the island. To defeat both ships, players must either kill all of the crew onboard or sink the ship; the former requires magic or ranged attacks, while the latter requires the use of cannons on the player's boat. While the player is engaged in battle, both captains, Captain Jack and Captain Ruban Acer, will directly attack the player with ranged attacks. As such, players should activate Protect from Missiles as soon as they appear. Once both ships are dealt with, sail further south to Last Light. Upon disembarking, players must defeat six pirates in multi-combat before they can head upstairs. The four pirates outside may be safespotted by trapping them to the north of the mooring point, while the two pirates inside may be flinched by standing just north of the staircase. Protect from Melee will prevent all damage. Leaving the fight early via the mooring point will reset the fight. :{{Color|red|Warning:}} Teleporting away from the island after docking will cause your ship to become lost at sea, along with its contents. ==== Black Eye Bethel ==== Head up two flights of stairs to find Black Eye Bethel. She will only attack with melee, but has various special mechanics: * Step out of the way when she charges up an attack. Her attack will still hit you even if you're several tiles back; instead you must stand to the left or right of the row of tiles she's facing. You'll know she's charging up when the tile she stands on turns blue, and she says {{Overhead|Dodge this!}}. * Upon reaching below 70% health, she will switch to a rune scimitar, which increases her max hit but decreases her accuracy and defence. * Upon reaching below 40% health, she will switch to a dragon scimitar, which increases her max hit further but decreases her accuracy and defence further. Additionally, she can use its special attack to disable the player's protection prayer. If you die to Black Eye Bethel, you will not be required to fight the six pirates on the Last Light again. Upon defeating Black Eye Bethel, return to Theodore Paxton at Red Rock, who will refer you to his boss Spencer Brentwood.

walkthrough.heading: Meeting the Boss
walkthrough.body: Sail to The Zenith, found to the east of Red Rock. {{Bug|The Zenith is missing on most worlds. It should be where the map says "Red Reef." If it's not there, hop worlds until you find it.}} Speak to Spencer Brentwood upon boarding The Zenith, and he'll ask that you come along to help him repair the coral dredgers on the seabed. If you did not bring diving equipment, he will provide you with a set. Should you need to leave, speak to Spencer to board your boat again; teleporting out will result in the boat being 'lost at sea' and must be recovered via shipwright! Once you reach the seabed, talk to Spencer about repairing the dredgers. After talking to him, the option to repair will be visible and you can help Spencer repair the northern coral dredger. Upon attempting to do so, a giant lobster will appear. It can be safespotted by standing to the west of the dredger, moving down to attack and then back up to prevent the lobster from pathing towards you. It may use a special attack which can be avoided by moving when bluish particles appear under you. You may also choose to avoid the fight altogether by waiting for it to despawn. Upon defeating the giant lobster, repair the coral dredger and head to the dredger to the south-east to find Spencer, who will take your back to the surface. He will at last reveal to you the issue he faces: the red coral in the Red Reef is depleting, and he requires a new source of red coral - a large reef in the Pearl Bank. However, as the Little Pearl is nearby, the tortugans will not allow the company to set up operations, confirming their involvement in the attack on the island. He will task you with finding a way for the company to acquire the Little Pearl with minimal bloodshed. Return to Elder Raley's house, where you will find that Floopa has returned as well. Report your findings to them, and they will reward you with access to The Sacred Grove and a schematic. 'Congratulations, quest complete!'
